projects.tagline: Capture rooms with iPhone LiDAR as editable Three.js scenes
projects.taglineZh: 用 iPhone LiDAR 捕捉房间并重建可编辑 Three.js 场景
projects.description: 3D Model Anything captures iPhone LiDAR and photos, reconstructs editable Three.js rooms with an AI coding agent, and lets you explore the results in a browser.
projects.descriptionZh: 3D Model Anything 通过 iPhone LiDAR 与照片采集房间，借助 AI 编码智能体重建可编辑的 Three.js 场景，并支持在浏览器中查看结果。
projects.content:
## Overview

3D Model Anything is a room\-capture and reconstruction workflow built around an iPhone app, a Three\.js browser viewer, and the scan\-to\-threejs agent skill\. It records room geometry and photographs on an iPhone, then guides an AI coding agent through measurement, modeling, and matched\-camera visual comparisons to produce an editable Three\.js scene\. The project includes a detailed office demo and focuses on rooms and interiors\.

## Key Features

- iPhone app records room geometry and photographs for reconstruction\.
- scan\-to\-threejs agent skill guides an AI coding agent through measurement, modeling, and matched\-camera visual comparisons\.
- Three\.js viewer offers dollhouse, walking, overhead, wireframe, and knolling views\.
- Includes Wes's office demo with a reconstructed room and selected textures\.
- Supports exporting captures through the system share sheet for use in the agent workflow\.
- Browser viewer includes camera presets, render quality controls, and copyable view links\.

## Use Cases

- Rebuild a captured room or interior as an editable Three\.js scene using the scan\-to\-threejs skill\.
- Explore reconstructed rooms in a browser through dollhouse, walk\-around, overhead, wireframe, and knolling views\.
- Import and review scans on non\-LiDAR devices\.

## Getting Started

- Use Node\.js 22\.12\+ or a newer supported release for the viewer\. Run npm ci and npm run dev, then open the local viewer on port 5188\.
- To capture your own space, build the iPhone app with Xcode, scan and share a capture, extract it into data/captures\-in/\<room\>/, and ask an agent that supports local skills to use scan\-to\-threejs with the extracted export\.
- Helpers need Python 3; photo comparisons need Pillow, and optional depth reconstruction needs NumPy, Open3D, and Pillow\. Capture scripts use the agent\-browser CLI\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 22\.12\+ or a newer supported release for running the viewer\.
- Xcode for building the iPhone app; scanning needs a LiDAR\-equipped iPhone or iPad\.
- Python 3 for helpers, Pillow for photo comparisons, and NumPy, Open3D, and Pillow for optional depth reconstruction\.
- The agent\-browser CLI for capture scripts\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The reconstruction workflow is iterative and aimed at rooms and interiors, not one\-click perfect conversion\.
- Scanning requires LiDAR hardware; non\-LiDAR devices can only import and review scans\.
- The app is source\-available, but an App Store release is separate and should not be assumed\.
- Only the office example is distributed, and captures should remain private; inspect assets before publishing demos\.

## 项目简介

3D Model Anything 是一套围绕 iPhone 应用、Three\.js 浏览器查看器和 scan\-to\-threejs 智能体技能构建的房间采集与重建工作流。它在 iPhone 上记录房间几何与照片，再引导 AI 编码智能体进行测量、建模和匹配相机的视觉对比，生成可编辑的 Three\.js 场景。项目包含一个详细的办公室演示，当前重点面向房间和室内空间。

## 核心功能

- iPhone 应用记录房间几何与照片，为重建提供素材。
- scan\-to\-threejs 智能体技能引导 AI 编码智能体完成测量、建模和匹配相机的视觉对比。
- Three\.js 查看器提供娃娃屋、行走、俯视、线框和 knolling 等视图。
- 包含 Wes 的办公室演示，其中有重建房间和部分纹理。
- 支持通过系统分享面板导出采集内容，用于智能体工作流。
- 浏览器查看器包含相机预设、渲染质量控制和可复制的视图链接。

## 适用场景

- 使用 scan\-to\-threejs 技能，将采集到的房间或室内空间重建为可编辑的 Three\.js 场景。
- 在浏览器中通过娃娃屋、行走、俯视、线框和 knolling 视图查看重建房间。
- 在非 LiDAR 设备上导入并查看扫描。

## 快速开始

- 查看器需要 Node\.js 22\.12 或更新的受支持版本。运行 npm ci 和 npm run dev，然后在 5188 端口打开本地查看器。
- 要采集自己的空间，请用 Xcode 构建 iPhone 应用，扫描并通过分享面板导出采集，将其解压到 data/captures\-in/\<room\>/，再让支持本地技能的智能体使用 scan\-to\-threejs 处理导出的内容。
- 辅助脚本需要 Python 3；照片对比需要 Pillow，可选的深度重建需要 NumPy、Open3D 和 Pillow。采集脚本使用 agent\-browser CLI。

## 部署与要求

- 运行查看器需要 Node\.js 22\.12 或更新的受支持版本。
- 构建 iPhone 应用需要 Xcode；扫描需要配备 LiDAR 的 iPhone 或 iPad。
- 辅助脚本需要 Python 3；照片对比需要 Pillow；可选的深度重建需要 NumPy、Open3D 和 Pillow。
- 采集脚本需要 agent\-browser CLI。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Other。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

ADR (Agentic AI Detection and Response) is an enterprise security system for AI agents\. It helps organizations secure employee\-facing agents such as coding assistants and customer\-facing support agents through discovery, observability, security benchmarking, and threat detection\. It is deployed in production at Uber, and the accompanying paper was accepted to MLSys 2026\.

## Key Features

- Inventories installed AI applications, CLI agents, IDE extensions, local model runtimes, and MCP servers, and flags unknown surfaces for review\.
- Captures agent intent, tool use, and execution traces across more than seven AI coding tools on macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- Provides ADR\-Bench with 300\+ tasks, 134 MCP servers, and coverage of all 17 agent attack techniques\.
- Uses a two\-tier detection architecture that combines high\-recall triage with deeper agentic reasoning for suspicious sessions\.
- Includes open\-source ADR Discovery, ADR Sensor, ADR\-Bench, and ADR Detector components\.
- Supports observability for employee\-facing agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, and DeepSeek Harness, as well as customer\-facing AI support agents\.

## Use Cases

- Securing employee\-facing AI coding agents and developer tools\.
- Monitoring customer\-facing AI support agents\.
- Evaluating agent defenses against realistic enterprise attack scenarios\.
- Detecting risky agent behavior in production sessions\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository, change into Detection, run uv sync, and set ANTHROPIC\_API\_KEY and OPENAI\_API\_KEY\. The default detector is adr; for keyless smoke tests, use \-\-detector llamafirewall\. See the reproducibility guide for the full evaluation workflow\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- ADR Sensor captures telemetry on macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- The Detection quick start uses uv and requires ANTHROPIC\_API\_KEY and OPENAI\_API\_KEY for the default detector\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

## 项目简介

ADR（Agentic AI Detection and Response）是一套面向企业 AI 代理的安全系统。它通过发现、可观测性、安全基准评估和威胁检测，帮助组织保护编码助手等员工侧代理以及客户侧支持代理。ADR 已在 Uber 生产环境部署，相关论文已被 MLSys 2026 接收。

## 核心功能

- 清点终端上安装的 AI 应用、CLI 代理、IDE 扩展、本地模型运行时和 MCP 服务器，并标记未知面以供审查。
- 在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上采集 7 种以上 AI 编码工具的代理意图、工具使用和执行轨迹。
- 提供 ADR\-Bench，包含 300 多个任务、134 个 MCP 服务器，并覆盖全部 17 种代理攻击技术。
- 采用两层检测架构，将高召回率初筛与针对可疑会话的更深层代理推理相结合。
- 开源包含 ADR Discovery、ADR Sensor、ADR\-Bench 和 ADR Detector 组件。
- 支持对 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot CLI 和 DeepSeek Harness 等员工侧代理，以及客户侧 AI 支持代理进行可观测性。

## 适用场景

- 保护员工侧 AI 编码代理和开发者工具。
- 监控客户侧 AI 支持代理。
- 针对真实企业攻击场景评估代理防御能力。
- 检测生产会话中的高风险代理行为。

## 快速开始

- 克隆仓库后进入 Detection 目录，运行 uv sync，并设置 ANTHROPIC\_API\_KEY 和 OPENAI\_API\_KEY。默认检测器为 adr；无密钥冒烟测试可使用 \-\-detector llamafirewall。完整评估流程参见可复现性指南。

## 部署与要求

- ADR Sensor 可在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上采集遥测数据。
- Detection 快速开始使用 uv，默认检测器需要 ANTHROPIC\_API\_KEY 和 OPENAI\_API\_KEY。

projects.content:
## Overview

AG\-UI is an open, lightweight, event\-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user\-facing applications\. It is designed as a general\-purpose, bidirectional connection between a user\-facing application and any agentic backend, standardizing how agent state, UI intents, and user interactions flow between agent runtimes and frontends\.

## Key Features

- Open, lightweight, event\-based protocol for agent\-to\-frontend communication\.
- Bidirectional connection between user\-facing applications and agentic backends\.
- Streaming chat with live token and event streaming, plus cancel and resume\.
- Multimodal attachments and real\-time media such as files, images, audio, and transcripts\.
- Shared state with read\-only or read\-write typed stores and streamed event\-sourced diffs\.
- Human\-in\-the\-loop interrupts to pause, approve, edit, retry, or escalate mid\-flow without losing state\.

## Use Cases

- Building agentic applications powered by AG\-UI\-compatible agents\.
- Building integrations for new agent frameworks, custom in\-house solutions, or use without an agent framework\.
- Building AG\-UI\-compatible clients for web, mobile, Slack, messaging, and other targets\.
- Adding frontend tool calls, shared state, and human\-in\-the\-loop approvals to agent\-powered apps\.

## Getting Started

- Build agentic applications powered by AG\-UI\-compatible agents\.
- Build new AG\-UI integrations for agent frameworks, custom in\-house solutions, or without an agent framework\.
- Build AG\-UI\-compatible clients for web, mobile, Slack, messaging, and other targets\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Some complete AG\-UI applications depend on CopilotKit Intelligence, a hosted service outside the protocol, for platform credentials, message delivery, threads, or memory\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Agency Agents, presented as The Agency, is a growing collection of meticulously crafted AI agent personalities\. Each agent is described as a specialized expert with a distinct voice, processes, and concrete deliverables\. The project includes a native desktop app for macOS, Linux, and Windows that browses the roster and installs agents into supported tools, plus scripts for command\-line and multi\-tool integration\.

## Key Features

- Specialized agents with deep domain expertise rather than generic prompt templates\.
- Personality\-driven voices, communication styles, and approaches for each agent\.
- Deliverable\-focused profiles with code examples, workflows, and success metrics\.
- Production\-ready agent workflows described as battle\-tested\.
- Native desktop app for macOS, Linux, and Windows that browses the roster, installs agents with a click, and auto\-updates\.
- Script\-based installation and multi\-tool integration, including selection by division or individual agent\.

## Use Cases

- Activate a specialist mode inside Claude Code sessions, such as Frontend Developer mode for building a React component\.
- Install selected divisions or individual agents into supported tools such as Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode\.
- Use agent files as reference material to adapt identity, workflows, technical deliverables, and success metrics\.
- Browse and install the roster through the native desktop app or command\-line scripts\.

## Getting Started

- Install the native Agency Agents app for macOS, Linux, or Windows to browse the roster and install agents into supported tools\.
- On a Mac, install the app with: brew install \-\-cask msitarzewski/agency\-agents/agency\-agents\.
- For Claude Code, run \./scripts/install\.sh \-\-tool claude\-code to install all agents, or copy engineering markdown files into ~/\.claude/agents/\.
- For other supported tools, run \./scripts/convert\.sh to generate integration files, then run \./scripts/install\.sh and select a target tool\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The native app is available for macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- Script\-based installation uses the repository scripts install\.sh and convert\.sh and supports Claude Code and other listed development tools\.
- OpenCode installations should use a subset selected with \-\-division because of its runtime registration limit\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenCode's runtime may silently drop agents beyond its registration limit, so install a subset with \-\-division and heed installer warnings\.

Agent Autoloop is a very lightweight automation hub for command\-line agents such as Claude Code and Codex\. It turns schedules, GitHub Issues, and service alerts into standard events, then uses local rules to decide which agent receives each event and in which directory it runs\. It does not depend on a cloud server or public port and can run on a personal Mac or Linux machine\.

projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Agent Autoloop 是一个极轻量的自动化中台，面向 Claude Code、Codex 等命令行 Agent。它把定时任务、GitHub Issue、业务告警等变成标准事件，按本机规则决定交给哪个 Agent、在哪个目录执行；Agent 干完一轮就退出，遇到需要用户拍板的事才发卡片询问，回答后接上原会话继续完成。它不依赖云服务器或公网端口，可在个人 Mac 或 Linux 上运行。

## 核心功能

- 单机运行：一台电脑、一条命令即可启动，不需要云服务器或开放公网端口。
- 规则派活：在 rules\.json 中配置什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干，定时任务与外部事件共用同一套规则。
- 挂起零消耗：等待用户拍板时进程退出，不占 Agent 进程、不消耗 Token；回答后恢复原会话继续。
- 可插拔体系：事件来源、Agent、通知通道和交付流水线均可替换，内置 GitHub/GitLab Webhook、Claude Code、Codex、ACP、飞书等插件。
- 内核机制：零运行时依赖，采用事件溯源、指令数据分离和跳数熔断，支持查询每一轮的来龙去脉。
- 场景模板：提供每日早报、GitHub Issue 跟进、线上告警排查、用户反馈处理、网站巡检等现成流程。

## 适用场景

- 每日早报：按定时规则整理本地笔记和 Git 提交，写入 briefs/YYYY\-MM\-DD\.md。
- 跟进 GitHub Issue：定时查新 Issue，在本地改代码并通知查看；不提交、不推送、不回复 Issue。
- 线上告警排查：接收报错、对照代码查原因，需要重启服务时发卡片询问，回答后继续。
- 网站巡检：每 5 分钟检查状态和关键内容，首次异常交给 Agent，持续异常不重复通知，恢复后更新原卡片。

## 快速开始

- 在 macOS 或 Linux 上使用项目提供的 install\.sh 安装；安装和 agent\-autoloop update 都取最新 Release。
- 运行 agent\-autoloop try，用本机已登录的 Agent 真实走一遍提问、退出等回复、拍板、继续干完。
- 打开 ~/\.agent\-autoloop/rules\.json，在 rules 中写清什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干；保存后几秒内自动生效。
- 运行 agent\-autoloop check 检查规则；可用 agent\-autoloop rules explain 查看生效规则和下次定时。

## 部署与要求

- 支持 macOS 和 Linux；Windows 版待定，当前不能在 Windows 上使用，等不及可先用 WSL2 并查看安装说明。
- 运行前需要 Node 24、Git、curl，以及任意一个已登录的命令行 Agent；不需要 GitHub 账号。
- 安装在个人 Mac 或 Linux 上，不需要购买云服务器，也不需要开放公网端口。
- 默认开启桌面通知；飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 等通道需要按插件说明配置。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- Windows 版仍待定，当前还不能在 Windows 上使用。
- 运行依赖 Node 24、Git、curl 和一个已登录的命令行 Agent，属于外部依赖准备。
- 高频自动化场景下，模型厂商通常更建议使用 API Key。
- 四种 Webhook 模板只在本地模拟服务验证，GitLab Webhook 未连接真实 GitLab。
- 部分场景模板的样例数据为虚构，脚本和回执未在真实账号跑过完整业务。

projects.content:
## Overview

agent\-browser is a browser automation CLI designed for AI agents\. It provides compact text output to reduce context usage and is implemented as a native Rust CLI with a client\-daemon architecture that manages Chrome via the Chrome DevTools Protocol\.

## Key Features

- Agent\-first compact text output uses fewer tokens than JSON for AI context efficiency\.
- Snapshot returns an accessibility tree with refs for deterministic element selection\.
- 50\+ commands cover navigation, forms, screenshots, network, storage, files, tabs, frames, and debugging\.
- Built\-in observability includes video recording, streaming, debugging, profiler, and diffing tools\.
- Stateful sessions, profiles, auth state, cookies, storage, proxy, and security controls support long\-running agents\.
- Cross\-platform native binaries are available for macOS, Linux, and Windows\.

## Use Cases

- AI coding agents and shell\-capable agents can drive browsers through CLI commands\.
- Agents can navigate pages, inspect accessibility snapshots, interact by ref, capture screenshots, and close the browser\.
- Long\-running agents can use sessions, profiles, auth state, cookies, storage, and proxy controls\.
- Developers can use built\-in recording, streaming, debugging, profiling, and diffing for browser workflow observation\.

## Getting Started

- Install globally with npm install \-g agent\-browser, then run agent\-browser install to download Chrome on first use\.
- Try without installing by running npx agent\-browser open example\.com\.
- Use agent\-browser open example\.com, agent\-browser snapshot, agent\-browser click @e2, agent\-browser fill @e3 "test@example\.com", agent\-browser get text @e1, agent\-browser screenshot page\.png, and agent\-browser close for a basic workflow\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Chrome is required; run agent\-browser install to download Chrome from Chrome for Testing, and existing Chrome, Brave, Playwright, and Puppeteer installations are detected automatically\.
- No Playwright or Node\.js is required for the daemon\.
- Node\.js 24\+ and pnpm 11\+ are required only when building from source; Rust is also required only when building from source\.
- On Linux, agent\-browser install \-\-with\-deps installs system dependencies and exits nonzero if the package manager cannot install every required browser library\.
- Native binaries are provided for macOS ARM64 and x64, Linux ARM64 and x64, and Windows x64\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Chrome is the runtime browser dependency; existing Chrome, Brave, Playwright, and Puppeteer installations are detected automatically, and the daemon does not require Playwright or Node\.js\.
- The daemon exits after one hour without commands or dashboard input by default; headed browsers, Safari and iOS WebDriver sessions, and user\-attached browsers are exempt, while provider\-owned cloud browsers are not\.
- WebMCP page\-provided names, descriptions, schemas, annotations, and results are untrusted data\.

projects.content:
## Overview

agent\-desktop is a CLI and C library from Vercel Labs that reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON\. Each element an agent can act on gets a ref; the agent acts on a ref, reads the UI again to verify, and repeats\. It targets macOS, Windows, and Linux and does not include an LLM or GUI\.

## Key Features

- Reads a desktop app's accessibility tree and returns snapshots as JSON, with a ref for every actionable element\.
- Uses snapshot\-scoped refs and re\-reads the UI after actions to verify results rather than matching pixels\.
- Ships as a CLI with 60 command names covering observation, interaction, keyboard, mouse, app and window, notification, clipboard, wait, session, and system commands\.
- Ships as a C library called libagent\_desktop\_ffi for in\-process calls with documented entry points, memory ownership, and threading rules\.
- Supports macOS through the AX API, Windows through UI Automation, and Linux through AT\-SPI\.
- Can map dense apps with a shallow skeleton snapshot and drill into one region before acting\.

## Use Cases

- Agents that need to inspect and operate desktop applications without relying on pixel matching\.
- Automating actions such as clicking, typing, selecting, scrolling, and waiting in native apps\.
- In\-process integrations that prefer calling a C library instead of launching the CLI for each command\.
- Mapping large or dense desktop interfaces by taking a skeleton snapshot and drilling into one region\.

## Getting Started

- Install globally with npm: npm install \-g agent\-desktop; then run agent\-desktop version to check the install\.
- On macOS, run agent\-desktop permissions \-\-guide to grant Accessibility permission\.
- Take a snapshot with agent\-desktop snapshot \-\-app Finder \-i, act with agent\-desktop click @s8f3k2p9:e8, then snapshot again to verify\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS 13 or later on Intel or Apple Silicon, with Accessibility permission for the app that runs agent\-desktop\.
- Windows 10 1809 or later or Windows Server 2019 or later, on x64 or ARM64, in the signed\-in user's interactive desktop\.
- Linux: Ubuntu 24\.04 or later on x86\_64 or aarch64 (glibc 2\.35 floor), in the user's graphical session with a running AT\-SPI bus\.
- Linux needs at\-spi2\-core\.
- On macOS, TMPDIR must be owned by the current user with mode 0700; the standard macOS per\-user temporary directory satisfies this requirement\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Agent Development Kit (ADK) is an open\-source, code\-first framework that applies software development principles to AI agent creation\. It supports building, debugging, evaluating, and deploying agents from simple tasks to complex systems\.

## Key Features

- Code\-first development in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin, with agent logic, tools, and orchestration defined in code\.
- Graph\-based workflow runtime with routing, fan\-out/fan\-in, loops, retry, state management, dynamic nodes, human\-in\-the\-loop, and nested workflows\.
- Modular multi\-agent systems that compose specialized agents into flexible hierarchies\.
- Rich tool ecosystem including pre\-built tools, custom functions, OpenAPI specs, and MCP tools\.
- Agent Config for building agents without code, plus tool confirmation for human\-in\-the\-loop control\.
- Deployment options including containerization, Cloud Run, GKE, and Agent Runtime on Google Cloud\.

## Use Cases

- Building managed, repeatable multi\-step AI agent processes that run with minimal human input\.
- Orchestrating multiple specialized agents in collaborative, sequential, loop, or parallel workflows\.
- Adding graph\-based execution with explicit paths, predictable outcomes, and human input\.
- Testing, evaluating, debugging, and showcasing agents with the built\-in development UI\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Python package with pip install google\-adk; Python 3\.11\+ is required\.
- Run an agent locally with adk run path/to/my\_agent or use adk web path/to/agents\_dir for the web UI\.
- Other language packages include npm install @google/adk for TypeScript, go get google\.golang\.org/adk/v2 for Go, and package coordinates com\.google\.adk:google\-adk and com\.google\.adk:google\-adk\-kotlin\-core for Java and Kotlin\.
- Install optional integrations with pip install google\-adk\[extensions\]\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.11 or newer is required for the Python ADK\.
- For transitive dependency protection, the project recommends installing with companion constraints files matching the Python version\.
- Deployment can be done by containerizing and running ADK on your own infrastructure or through Google Cloud options such as Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, or GKE\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The development version may include experimental changes or bugs that are not present in the stable release\.

projects.content:
## Overview

agent\-device is an open source device layer for AI coding agents from Callstack\. It lets agents inspect, control, debug, and verify apps on devices and simulators through a CLI, MCP server, or typed Node\.js API\. It supports iOS, Android, HarmonyOS, tvOS, Android TV, Fire TV, Vega OS, web, macOS, and Linux, and can run locally or with remote device hosts\.

## Key Features

- Accessibility snapshots, refs, and selectors let agents inspect app state instead of relying on screenshots alone\.
- Agents can tap or press elements, fill fields, scroll, make gestures, wait, assert state, and handle alerts\.
- Debugging evidence includes screenshots, video, logs, traces, network data, performance samples, crash details, and React profiles\.
- Working runs can be saved as \.ad replay scripts for local use or CI, with strict Maestro YAML export when needed\.
- A built\-in MCP server and typed Node\.js API expose the same runtime as the CLI\.
- Sessions are scoped to git worktrees, and device claims stop parallel agents from taking over each other's simulators and emulators\.

## Use Cases

- Let a coding agent implement a screen, run it on the iOS simulator and Android emulator, and attach screenshots\.
- Reproduce a crash or slow screen, capture logs and network data, and profile React Native renders\.
- Explore a checkout flow, save it as a replay script, and run it in CI\.
- Verify a pull request on a physical device and attach reviewable evidence\.

## Getting Started

- Install with npm install \-g agent\-device@latest\.
- Run agent\-device doctor before handing the CLI to an agent, then use agent\-device help workflow for guides\.
- For MCP, start the official stdio server with agent\-device mcp\.
- Use CLI commands such as agent\-device open Contacts \-\-platform ios, agent\-device snapshot \-i, agent\-device press @e2 \-\-settle, and agent\-device screenshot \./contact\-form\.png\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Node\.js 22\.12 or newer; web automation requires Node\.js 24 or newer\.
- Run agent\-device capabilities \-\-platform \<platform\> to see what a target supports\.
- Can run locally on simulators, emulators, physical devices, macOS, and Linux, or through a remote proxy, device clouds, and hosted devices\.
- Hosted device support includes BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm, TestMu AI, Limrun, and Expo Simulators on EAS\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Target support is not uniform; some backends cover only a subset of commands\.
- Web automation has a higher Node\.js runtime requirement than the core CLI\.
- Hosted device execution depends on external device\-cloud providers or Expo Simulators on EAS\.

projects.content:
## Overview

agent\-purge is a local CLI and web console for applying one shared persona across multiple coding agents\. It unifies each harness's system\-prompt entry point into install, shim, and slash channels, with replace, strict, append, and off modes that can be switched hot and reverted\.

## Key Features

- One persona file body is shared across managed coding\-agent entry points\.
- Four modes: replace, strict (persona only), append, and off; all can be switched hot and reverted\.
- Three delivery channels: install writes managed config, hooks, or plugins; shim fronts same\-name commands; slash commands switch in\-session\.
- A local web console and CLI list personas and show runtime harness support, versions, injection layer, and channel availability\.
- Supports harnesses including Codex, Claude, Grok, OMP, Hermes, ZCode, OpenCode, OpenCode2, dsh, Pi, Antigravity, and CodeBuddy\.
- An optional magpie gateway plugin rewrites the system segment for requests traversing the gateway\.

## Use Cases

- Maintain a consistent persona across Codex, Claude, and other coding agents without rewriting prompts per tool\.
- Switch persona or mode for a single session with in\-session slash commands while leaving disk unchanged\.
- Use the local web console to choose personas and inspect runtime harness support and channel availability\.
- Apply the current persona at a local magpie gateway for requests from multiple agents\.

## Getting Started

- Install globally with npm i \-g agent\-purge, or run npx agent\-purge web\.
- Run agent\-purge web to open the local console on port 7788 and generate the persona directory; use agent\-purge ls if you do not want the UI\.
- Launch an agent with the current persona, such as agent\-purge codex, or make a one\-off query with agent\-purge pi \-\-ask\.
- Manage personas with agent\-purge ls, agent\-purge use, or a one\-run persona override\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 20 or newer; zero dependencies\.
- Data lives under ~/\.agent\-purge/ by default; set AGENT\_PURGE\_HOME to change the location\.
- The optional magpie plugin is installed from the repository magpie\-plugin directory, not from the npm package, and requires generated persona data via node magpie\-plugin/gen\-personas\.mjs\.
- For dsh, the cordis plugin is installed into desktop, web, and headless profiles and requires a restart once before hot updates\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Closed\-source desktop harnesses whose prompts live server\-side or in binaries are launched as\-is with no injection\.
- OpenCode and OpenCode2 are separate npm packages with different plugin interfaces and independent support\.
- The magpie gateway plugin is not part of the npm package and must be installed by repository path\.
- The gateway plugin only rewrites text in the request body and cannot intercept content assembled client\-side by the harness\.
- Runtime state is stored locally and no data is uploaded\.

agent\-purge 是一个本地 CLI 与 Web 控制台，用于把同一份共享人设应用到多个 coding agent。它把各 harness 的系统提示词入口统一为 install、shim、slash 三类通道，并提供 replace、strict、append、off 四种模式，可热切换、可还原。

## 核心功能

- 同一份 personas/\<id\>\.md 正文可共享到多个受管 coding agent 入口；四种模式为 replace、strict（仅人设）、append、off，均可热切换与还原；三类交付通道为 install 写入托管配置、hooks 或插件，shim 前置同名命令，slash 在会话内切换；本地 Web 控制台与 CLI 可列出人设，并显示运行期 harness 支持、版本、注入层与通道可用性；支持 Codex、Claude、Grok、OMP、Hermes、ZCode、OpenCode、OpenCode2、dsh、Pi、Antigravity

## 适用场景

- 在 Codex、Claude 等多个 coding agent 间保持同一人设，避免逐个工具重写提示词；在单个会话中用 slash 命令切换人设或模式，且不改动磁盘；通过本地 Web 控制台选择人设并查看运行期 harness 支持与通道可用性；在本地 magpie 网关为多个 agent 的请求应用当前人设。

## 快速开始

- 使用 npm i \-g agent\-purge 全局安装，或运行 npx agent\-purge web；运行 agent\-purge web 打开 7788 端口本地控制台并生成 personas 目录，不想用界面可用 agent\-purge ls；用 agent\-purge codex 以当前人设启动 agent，或用 agent\-purge pi \-\-ask 做一次性提问；用 agent\-purge ls、agent\-purge use 管理或单次覆盖人设。

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Node\.js 20 或更高版本，零依赖；数据默认位于 ~/\.agent\-purge/，可通过 AGENT\_PURGE\_HOME 修改位置；可选 magpie 插件需从仓库的 magpie\-plugin 目录安装，而非 npm 包，并需先运行 node magpie\-plugin/gen\-personas\.mjs 生成人设数据；dsh 的 cordis 插件需装入 desktop、web、headless 三个 profile，并在首次安装后重启一次以支持后续热更新。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Agent Relay is an open\-source toolkit that gives engineering teams infrastructure for running coding agents together without replacing the agents and tools they already use\. It combines messaging, integrations, shared sessions, and enforceable workflows across agents, people, tools, and machines\.

## Key Features

- Messaging through shared channels, threads, DMs, files, search, and real\-time events so agents on different machines can coordinate in one workspace\.
- Integrations that expose GitHub, Linear, Notion, Slack, and other tools as a virtual filesystem for agents using ordinary file commands\.
- Shared Sessions that capture coding agent sessions so teams and their agents can search previous work, decisions, and context\.
- Flows that turn instructions into TypeScript\-defined multi\-step workflows with deterministic checks, required steps, and human gates\.
- Forward deployed agents can have a public address and selectively communicate with other agents\.
- Works inside existing tools including terminal agents, desktop apps, and mobile agents without requiring a new IDE\.

## Use Cases

- Let frontend and backend agents query each other directly and resolve merge conflicts without routing every handoff through people\.
- Share searchable session history across teammates and agents so decisions are not locked in one chat\.
- Coordinate agents across laptops, cloud boxes, and different time zones in one workspace\.
- Enforce multi\-step agent workflows with deterministic checks and human gates using Flows\.

## Getting Started

- Use Agent Relay Cloud, which does not require a credit card, to explore all the pieces without setting up infrastructure\.
- Install the CLI with the recommended install script or with npm install \-g agent\-relay, then run relay init in your project\.
- Run relay init to start a private server on this machine with no account needed, find installed coding agents, and add Relay to them\.
- Install the desktop app and sign in; the source says about 10 minutes to your first handoff\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Use the hosted Agent Relay Cloud or run the open\-source relay yourself on your own servers\.
- The install script places Agent Relay binaries in ~/\.agentworkforce/relay/bin; set AGENT\_RELAY\_INSTALL\_DIR or AGENT\_RELAY\_HOME to move the install directory\.
- The npm\-installed CLI links into npm's global bin directory and copies only its broker into ~/\.agentworkforce/relay/bin on first run\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Integrations depend on third\-party tools such as GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Slack\.
- Agents on other machines may need the hosted service to join\.

projects.name: Agent Substrate
projects.tagline: Zero-trust sandboxing for millions of agents on Kubernetes.
projects.taglineZh: 面向 Kubernetes 的大规模智能体零信任沙箱运行时
projects.description: Agent Substrate is a security-hardened, zero-trust Kubernetes runtime for sandboxed agents. It snapshots idle actors and restores them on demand onto a smaller pool of warm workers, with VM-grade isolation and per-agent identity.
projects.descriptionZh: Agent Substrate 是面向沙箱化智能体的安全加固零信任运行时，运行于标准 Kubernetes。它把大量有状态 actor 映射到较小的热 worker 池，空闲时快照、请求到达时恢复，并提供 VM 级隔离与按智能体身份。
projects.content:
## Overview

Agent Substrate is a low\-opinion runtime for sandboxed agents that maps a larger set of stateful actors onto a smaller pool of warm Kubernetes workers\. It snapshots idle actors out of memory and restores them when requests arrive, and it treats every actor as untrusted with VM\-grade isolation, per\-agent cryptographic identity, and controlled networking\.

## Key Features

- Snapshots idle stateful actors out of memory and restores them on demand onto warm workers, claiming sub\-500ms resume and more than 500 activations per second\.
- Runs each actor inside a dedicated gVisor runsc or Cloud Hypervisor microVM sandbox with segregated compute, network, and storage; plain Linux containers are not supported\.
- Issues short\-lived SPIFFE X\.509 certificates per active actor by default and can mint per\-actor JWTs through the egress gateway when policy requires it\.
- Keeps credentials outside the sandbox and injects them into approved outbound requests through the atenet\-egress gateway\.
- Provides default\-deny networking with ingress routing and egress policy enforcement, including pluggable external policy enforcement\.
- Runs on standard Kubernetes primitives such as Pods, autoscaling, and NetworkPolicies while adding agent\-specific scheduling, snapshotting, identity, and network mediation\.

## Use Cases

- Platform teams running large fleets of untrusted, mostly idle agent workloads on Kubernetes\.
- Agentic, inference, training, and reinforcement learning workloads sharing one infrastructure plane\.
- Running framework\-agnostic agents and tools, including ADK, LangChain, Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and sandboxed MCP servers\.
- Demonstrating high\-density multiplexing with demos such as the counter demo, sandbox demo, Claude Code multiplex demo, multi\-template demo, and request parking demo\.

## Getting Started

- Follow the Quickstart (development) after installing Go, kubectl, and docker; the project manages other dependencies, including kind\.
- The quickstart creates a kind cluster and local registry, installs Substrate, deploys the counter demo, installs kubectl\-ate, creates a counter actor, and runs a local proxy to send requests through the network router\.
- For Google Kubernetes Engine, use the official GKE installation guide and the substrate\-gke installer\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on standard Kubernetes and currently aims to support the latest stable Kubernetes release and the previous minor release\.
- The development quickstart requires Go, kubectl, and docker installed and configured on the development machine\.
- A Linux host that will run more than about a thousand sandboxes needs a larger kernel neighbor table: net\.ipv4\.neigh\.default\.gc\_thresh1/2/3 = 4096/16384/32768\.
- Every actor runs in gVisor runsc or Cloud Hypervisor microVM sandboxes; plain Linux containers are not supported\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Security and lifecycle controls must fit within the cold\-start and resume budget, which the source describes as a real engineering constraint\.
- The project describes itself as very young, with near\-term focus on the core system and demos\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Agent Substrate 是一个低倾向性的沙箱化智能体运行时，将有状态 actor 映射到较小的热 Kubernetes worker 池。它把空闲 actor 从内存中快照并在请求到达时恢复，同时将每个 actor 视为不可信，提供 VM 级隔离、按智能体的加密身份和受控网络。

## 核心功能

- 对空闲的有状态 actor 做内存快照，并按需恢复到热 worker；项目声称恢复时间低于 500ms、每秒超过 500 次激活。
- 每个 actor 运行在专用 gVisor runsc 或 Cloud Hypervisor microVM 沙箱中，计算、网络和存储隔离；不支持普通 Linux 容器。
- 默认给每个活跃 actor 发放短时 SPIFFE X\.509 证书，并可在出站策略需要时通过出站网关签发按 actor 的 JWT。
- 凭据不进入沙箱，由 atenet\-egress 网关注入到经批准的出站请求中。
- 默认拒绝网络，提供入站路由和出站策略执行，并支持可替换的外部策略执行点。
- 运行在标准 Kubernetes 原语上，如 Pod、自动扩缩和 NetworkPolicy，并增加面向智能体的调度、快照、身份和网络中介。

## 适用场景

- 平台团队在 Kubernetes 上运行大量不可信、多数时间空闲的智能体工作负载。
- 智能体、推理、训练和强化学习工作负载共享一个基础设施平面。
- 运行框架无关的智能体和工具，包括 ADK、LangChain、Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity，以及沙箱化 MCP 服务器。
- 通过 counter、sandbox、Claude Code multiplex、multi\-template 和 request parking 等演示展示高密度多路复用。

## 快速开始

- 安装 Go、kubectl 和 docker 后，按 Quickstart（development）操作；其他依赖包括 kind 由项目管理。
- 快速启动会创建 kind 集群和本地 registry，安装 Substrate，部署 counter 演示，安装 kubectl\-ate，创建 counter actor，并运行本地代理通过网络路由发送请求。
- 在 Google Kubernetes Engine 上，使用官方 GKE 安装指南和 substrate\-gke 安装器。

## 部署与要求

- 运行于标准 Kubernetes，目前目标是支持最新稳定版 Kubernetes 及上一个次版本。
- 开发用快速启动要求开发机安装并配置 Go、kubectl 和 docker。
- 要运行超过约一千个沙箱的 Linux 主机需要更大的内核邻居表：net\.ipv4\.neigh\.default\.gc\_thresh1/2/3 = 4096/16384/32768。
- 每个 actor 都运行在 gVisor runsc 或 Cloud Hypervisor microVM 沙箱中；不支持普通 Linux 容器。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Agent Toolkit for AWS is an official AWS\-supported toolkit that gives AI coding agents tools, knowledge, and guardrails for working with AWS services\. It works with coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Kiro, and fx, and provides MCP servers, skills, plugins, rules files, and a managed AWS MCP Server\.

## Key Features

- Bundles AWS MCP Server configuration and agent skills into installable plugins for supported coding agents\.
- Includes core AWS guidance for service selection, CDK/CloudFormation, serverless, containers, storage, observability, billing, SDK usage, and deployment\.
- Offers task\-specific agent skills that are loaded on demand, so agents retrieve only what is relevant to the current task\.
- Provides a managed AWS MCP Server with full AWS API coverage, sandboxed Python script execution, real\-time documentation access, and enterprise controls\.
- Includes recommended rules files that tell agents how to use AWS effectively, such as searching documentation before acting\.
- Includes plugins for building AI agents on AWS, data lake and analytics workflows, DevSecOps tasks, and startup advisory guidance\.

## Use Cases

- Helping AI coding agents select AWS services and generate CDK/CloudFormation, serverless, container, storage, observability, billing, and deployment guidance\.
- Building AI agents on AWS with Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore\.
- Running data lake, analytics, and ETL workflows with S3 Tables, AWS Glue, and Athena\.
- Investigating incidents, reviewing code, scanning for vulnerabilities, and running penetration tests with AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Security Agent\.

## Getting Started

- For the AWS CLI, run aws configure agent\-toolkit\.
- For Claude Code, install supported plugins such as aws\-core from the official Anthropic marketplace; aws\-startup\-advisor is installed from this repository's marketplace\.
- For Codex, add the repository as a plugin marketplace with codex plugin marketplace add aws/agent\-toolkit\-for\-aws, then install aws\-core through /plugins\.
- For Cursor, add the repository as a team marketplace and install the aws\-core plugin from the Plugins panel\.
- For Devin, install a plugin with devin plugins install aws/agent\-toolkit\-for\-aws\#plugins/aws\-core after running devin auth login\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- uv must be installed for skills setup, including Kiro and fx configurations\.
- An AWS account with credentials configured locally is required for API calls and script execution, but not for documentation search or skill discovery\.
- Devin installation requires devin auth login\.
- Plugins are currently available for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin; other agents configure the AWS MCP Server directly and install skills from the repository\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The toolkit succeeds the AWS Labs MCP servers, skills, and plugins, and AWS recommends using the Agent Toolkit instead\.
- Plugin availability is currently limited to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin; other agents require direct AWS MCP Server configuration and skills installation\.
- AWS API calls and script execution require an AWS account with locally configured credentials, while documentation search and skill discovery do not\.

Agent Toolkit for AWS 是 AWS 官方支持的工具包，为 AI 编码代理提供使用 AWS 服务所需的工具、知识和防护措施。它可与 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Devin、Kiro 和 fx 等编码代理配合使用，并提供 MCP 服务器、技能、插件、规则文件以及托管的 AWS MCP Server。

## 核心功能

- 将 AWS MCP Server 配置和代理技能打包为可安装插件，供受支持的编码代理使用；包含核心 AWS 指导，覆盖服务选择、CDK/CloudFormation、无服务器、容器、存储、可观测性、计费、SDK 使用和部署；提供按需加载的任务型代理技能，使代理只获取与当前任务相关的内容；提供托管 AWS MCP Server，具备完整 AWS API 覆盖、沙箱化 Python 脚本执行、实时文档访问和企业控制；包含推荐规则文件，指导代理高效使用 AWS，例如在行动前搜索文档；包含用于在 AWS 上构建 AI

## 适用场景

- 帮助 AI 编码代理选择 AWS 服务，并生成 CDK/CloudFormation、无服务器、容器、存储、可观测性、计费和部署指导；使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 AgentCore 在 AWS 上构建 AI 代理；使用 S3 Tables、AWS Glue 和 Athena 运行数据湖、分析和 ETL 工作流；使用 AWS DevOps Agent 和 AWS Security Agent 调查事件、审查代码、扫描漏洞并运行渗透测试。

## 快速开始

- AWS CLI：运行 aws configure agent\-toolkit。Claude Code：从官方 Anthropic 市场安装受支持插件，例如 aws\-core；aws\-startup\-advisor 从本仓库市场安装。Codex：使用 codex plugin marketplace add aws/agent\-toolkit\-for\-aws 添加仓库，然后通过 /plugins 安装 aws\-core。Cursor：将仓库添加为团队市场，在插件面板中安装 aws\-core 插件。Devin：运行 devin auth login

## 部署与要求

- 安装技能需要 uv，包括 Kiro 和 fx 配置；API 调用和脚本执行需要本地配置凭证的 AWS 账户，但文档搜索或技能发现不需要；Devin 安装需要 devin auth login；插件目前适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 Devin，其他代理直接配置 AWS MCP Server 并从仓库安装技能。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

agentes\.chat is an open\-source, self\-hosted Slack alternative for team chat where AI agents are workspace members alongside people\. Agents have roles, owners, budgets, routines, memory, and access to MCP tools; they work in channels and DMs, use a connected computer and browser, and ask for approval before sensitive actions\. The same codebase powers agentes\.chat Cloud and self\-hosted deployments, with web, desktop, and phone apps\.

## Key Features

- People and agents share channels, threads, and DMs; agents answer when it is their turn and hand work back and forth\.
- Approval cards let merges, deploys, rollbacks, or connector\-marked sensitive actions wait for the agent owner or an admin; the approved action runs once, exactly as approved\.
- Each agent has a role, instructions, a model, a monthly budget checked before every call, and an owner who receives approvals and budget alerts\.
- Connectors use MCP servers, with each agent receiving only its granted scopes; official servers such as Linear, Sentry, Notion, and Stripe can be connected, and any MCP server can be added by URL\.
- Routines run on a schedule or event and deliver to a channel, DM, or Drive; agents also keep memory from conversations and can propose changes to their instructions\.
- Agents can use a computer that runs the runner and a browser; the browser is in beta and can be watched live, taken over for login or captcha, and handed back\.

## Use Cases

- Engineering: an agent reads Sentry errors, finds the commit behind an issue, prepares a rollback, and waits for a person to approve before production changes\.
- Finance: a scheduled agent matches invoices with bank payments in read\-only mode and turns mismatches into assigned tasks\.
- Support: agents answer simple tickets from the wiki, route harder ones to a person with a summary, and suggest wiki updates for recurring issues\.
- Team chat and handoff: agents work visibly in channels and DMs, with roles, owners, and budgets recorded per agent\.

## Getting Started

- Sign up for the hosted cloud option at agentes\.chat\.
- On a Linux server, use the one\-line install script; it installs missing dependencies such as Docker after asking and sets up agentes\.chat on a Tailscale network with private HTTPS in about 10 minutes\.
- Each organization adds its own model key in the app, choosing from providers such as Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Z\.ai, MiniMax, Command Code, or OpenRouter\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Cloud hosting requires no server management; creating a workspace is described as taking minutes with nothing to install, update, or watch\.
- Self\-hosting uses Docker Compose and PostgreSQL; the README lists Postgres as the only dependency, with migrations on boot\.
- The quick\-start path targets a Linux server; the installer can install missing Docker after asking and can place the app on a Tailscale network with HTTPS, or use a public domain with Caddy\.
- Web, desktop, and phone apps connect to the server; desktop apps are available for macOS, Windows, and Linux, and phone apps for iPhone and Android\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The hosted product is currently in open beta\.
- The agent browser is explicitly labeled beta\.
- Self\-hosting depends on a Linux server and uses PostgreSQL as the only database dependency\.
- Beta desktop builds may require an extra first\-open confirmation because the macOS build is not notarized and the Windows installer is not signed\.
- Agents use the organization's own AI plan or keys, making model access an external dependency\.

projects.content:
## Overview

agentgateway is an open source HTTP and gRPC gateway that handles traditional application traffic and AI\-native protocols in one data plane\. It provides routing, security, observability, governance, and cost controls for services, LLM provider traffic, MCP tools, and agent\-to\-agent communication, reducing the need to stitch together separate gateways\.

## Key Features

- One data plane for HTTP, gRPC, and TCP services, LLM providers, self\-hosted inference, MCP, and A2A traffic\.
- LLM gateway with OpenAI\-compatible API support, provider routing and failover, token budgets, semantic caching, and prompt redaction\.
- MCP gateway capabilities including server discovery, tool\-call signing and scoping, versioning, and audit trails\.
- A2A routing across frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, and ADK with identity and tracing on every hop\.
- Security controls including JWT/OIDC, API keys, external authorization, request authorization, TLS/mTLS, CORS/CSRF, and rate limiting\.
- Observability and cost management with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger, token metrics, realized USD cost, virtual keys, budgets, and an admin dashboard\.

## Use Cases

- Consolidate north\-south and east\-west service traffic with AI and agent traffic behind a single gateway\.
- Govern LLM provider access with budgets, virtual keys, cost tracking, and prompt guards\.
- Manage MCP server discovery, tool permissions, and audit trails for agent tool use\.
- Route agent\-to\-agent invocations between frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, ADK, and custom runtimes\.

## Getting Started

- Install the agentgateway binary using the published install script\.
- Follow the standalone or Kubernetes quick start, which the site describes as taking less than 5 minutes\.
- Use the MCP connectivity guide to connect agentgateway to MCP servers with discovery and auth\.
- Try the LLM playground from the admin UI to test a model route before shipping it\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Deployment options include a binary, Docker, or Kubernetes\.
- Standalone and Kubernetes documentation and quick starts are provided\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The LLM gateway is designed to sit in front of external model providers and self\-hosted models, so deployments depend on the configured upstream providers and credentials\.
- Prompt guards can perform pattern and model\-based checks and redact sensitive content before it leaves the environment\.
- Rate limiting is available to protect backends from abuse and runaway agent loops\.

projects.content:
## Overview

This project is a Playwright and AI based multi\-task real\-time and scheduled monitoring and intelligent analysis system for Xianyu, with a web management UI for tasks, accounts, AI standards, logs, and results, helping users filter target products from Xianyu listings\.

## Key Features

- Web visual management supports task management, account management, AI standard editing, run logs, and result browsing; AI driven creation uses natural language to create tasks and multimodal models to analyze products; multi\-task concurrency lets each task independently

## Use Cases

- Continuously monitor Xianyu listings for target products matching keyword and price conditions; filter listings by region, free\-shipping status, and new listing time range to narrow results; use AI multimodal analysis of product details and images to judge whether they meet

## Getting Started

- Docker deployment is recommended: clone the repository, copy \.env\.example to \.env, fill in the configuration, and run docker compose up \-d\. The default Web UI runs on port 8000 at 127\.0\.0\.1\. On first use, log in to the Web UI, use the Chrome extension in Xianyu account

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker deployment requires a prepared \.env configuration; AI model access requires OPENAI\_API\_KEY, OPENAI\_BASE\_URL, and an image\-input\-capable OPENAI\_MODEL\_NAME\. Local development requires Python 3\.10\+, Node\.js and npm, Playwright CLI and Chromium, and an available Chrome/Edge

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

## 核心功能

projects.description: An open-source AI job application framework built on Claude Code that evaluates job postings, tailors CVs, writes cover letters, and prepares candidates for interviews. Fork it, add your profile, and run the workflow on your own machine.

projects.content:
## Overview

AI Job Search is a structured, local workflow that turns Claude Code into a job application assistant\. It covers self\-profiling, fit evaluation, and a drafter\-reviewer pipeline for tailored CVs and cover letters; the core workflow is language\- and country\-agnostic, while the shipped portal search skills target Denmark and can be extended for other markets\.

## Key Features

- Evaluates job postings against a candidate profile and returns fit scores, deal\-breaker vetoes, and ranked shortlists\.
- Drafts tailored CVs and cover letters in LaTeX through a drafter\-reviewer workflow, then compiles and visually inspects the PDFs\.
- Runs ATS parseability checks on the compiled CV text layer and verifies contact details, reading order, and keyword coverage without stuffing unsupported skills\.
- Prepares candidates for interviews with company research, STAR question mapping, gap\-aware bridge answers, and mock interviews\.
- Tracks applications and outcomes, archives submitted materials, drafts follow\-ups, and generates a self\-contained offline HTML dashboard\.
- Supports extension through job\-portal search skills, custom CV or cover\-letter templates, and configurable evaluation criteria\.

## Use Cases

- Job seekers who want a local, Claude Code\-based workflow for evaluating postings and preparing tailored applications\.
- Candidates targeting the Danish job market through the shipped Jobindex, Jobnet, Jobbank, and Jobdanmark search skills\.
- Users adapting the framework to another job market with /add\-portal or borrowing community portal skills\.
- Career planners using skill\-gap analysis and learning plans between applications\.

## Getting Started

- Fork or clone the repository, run python3 tools/install\_portal\_clis\.py to install the portal CLI tools, start Claude Code, and use /setup to populate a profile\.
- Use /scrape to search job portals, optionally /rank to batch\-score postings, and /apply with a job URL or pasted job description to run the full application workflow\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Claude Code CLI and either a Claude Pro/Max/Team subscription or Anthropic API credits\.
- Python 3\.10\+\.
- Bun for the job search CLI tools\.
- A LaTeX distribution with lualatex and xelatex; minimal TeX installs may need extra packages\.
- Optional pypdf for the ATS parseability check; Poppler pdftotext is a fallback\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The workflow depends on Claude Code, which has no free tier and requires a Claude subscription or Anthropic API credits\.
- Job postings are treated as untrusted input, but the agentic defenses are instruction\-level rather than a sandbox, so users should review fetched and written content on unfamiliar boards\.
- The LinkedIn search skill is intended for personal use only, and automated access is against LinkedIn's Terms of Service, so volume should be kept low\.
- The project is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or maintained by Anthropic\.

## 适用场景

- 希望使用本地 Claude Code 工作流评估职位并准备定制申请的求职者；通过随附的 Jobindex、Jobnet、Jobbank 和 Jobdanmark 搜索技能面向丹麦就业市场的候选人；使用 /add\-portal 或借用社区门户技能将框架适配到其他就业市场的用户；在申请间隙使用技能差距分析和学习计划进行职业规划的人。

## 快速开始

## 部署与要求

- Claude Code CLI，以及 Claude Pro/Max/Team 订阅或 Anthropic API 额度；Python 3\.10\+；用于职位搜索 CLI 工具的 Bun；包含 lualatex 和 xelatex 的 LaTeX 发行版，最小化 TeX 安装可能需要额外宏包；可选安装 pypdf 以执行 ATS 可解析性检查，Poppler pdftotext 可作为后备。

projects.content:
## Overview

ai\-memory is a self\-contained, self\-hosted solution for long\-term memory across AI coding agent CLIs\. It captures lifecycle observations, consolidates session summaries into a project wiki of ordinary Markdown files, and lets the next agent retrieve context or continue from a typed handoff across supported harnesses and machines\.

## Key Features

- Shared memory across more than twenty coding agent harnesses, with typed claim\-once handoffs between agents\.
- A git\-backed Markdown wiki is the source of truth, while the database is a derived index that can be rebuilt from the files\.
- Lifecycle hooks capture prompts, tool calls, and session boundaries silently, with a typed privacy boundary before storage\.
- Cross\-project profiles carry working habits into new repositories, and server\-hosted memory follows users across machines and teams\.
- The default path uses zero LLM calls for capture, search, handoffs, and aging operations such as decay, compaction, deduplication, and contradiction flagging\.
- Optional LLM consolidation, vector search, and dream\-style rewrites are off by default and never delete source versions\.

## Use Cases

- Continue work after switching from one coding agent to another in the same project directory\.
- Share project knowledge across a team using one server while keeping personal handoffs personal\.
- Resume project memory from a different machine through a self\-hosted server\.
- Bootstrap memory for an existing project that already has a long history\.

## Getting Started

- On Linux or macOS, run the install\.sh release script, then run ai\-memory setup\.
- On Windows PowerShell, run the install\.ps1 release script, then run ai\-memory setup\.
- Wire agents with install\-mcp and install\-hooks, or start harnesses with ai\-memory run for automatic wiring and session continuity\.
- Restart the agents and ask what they remember about the project to verify recall\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The product ships as one self\-contained binary, with Linux, macOS, and NixOS module support and Windows via WSL2\.
- Native Windows is listed as experimental in the support matrix\.
- Docker or Podman deployment is supported, and the published Docker image includes linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 variants\.
- The NixOS module requires git as a runtime dependency and provides a hardened systemd service\.
- For LAN or WAN binds, place TLS in front of the service; loopback binds may omit secrets and tolerate a missing environment file\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Native Windows support is marked experimental\.
- The Docker quick\-start can start without a bearer token\.
- NixOS settings are rendered into a world\-readable store path, so API keys should not be placed there\.

projects.content:
## Overview

The AI Website Cloner Template is a Next\.js\-based project that gives an AI coding agent a URL and asks it to recreate the website as a clean app\. It provides a clone\-website skill, agent instructions, source\-specific route and asset organization, and a comparison workflow for mapping, observing, building, and checking the result\.

## Key Features

- One\-command website cloning through an AI coding agent using the clone\-website skill with a target URL\.
- Four\-step workflow: map source URLs to local routes, observe desktop and mobile pages, build editable components, and compare source and local pages\.
- Supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and Cursor, with Claude Code and Opus 5\.5 recommended for best results\.
- Includes Next\.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS v4, and Lucide React foundations\.
- Organizes source\-specific components, extracted SVGs, images, fonts, videos, research notes, and comparison screenshots in the project structure\.
- Provides commands for development, production build, lint, typecheck, combined check, and Docker\-based app or development runs\.

## Use Cases

- Platform migration: rebuild a site you own from WordPress, Webflow, or Squarespace into a modern Next\.js codebase\.
- Lost source code: recover a live site in a modern format when the repository is gone, the developer left, or the stack is legacy\.
- Learning: deconstruct how production sites achieve specific layouts, animations, and responsive behavior by working with real code\.

## Getting Started

- Set up the project by asking an agent to clone the repository into a new folder, remove its origin remote, install dependencies, and run npm run check\.
- Alternatively, create a GitHub repository from the template, then ask the agent to clone it, install dependencies, and run npm run check\.
- Open the project in an agent with browser access enabled and run the clone\-website command with the target website URL\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 24 or later\.
- An AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, or Cursor\.
- Browser access enabled in the agent for cloning\.
- Docker Compose can build and run the app or run the app in development mode on port 3001\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

AI\-DLC Workflows, also called AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle, is a structured, gated methodology for AI\-driven software development\. It provides a harness\-neutral core that runs natively in Claude Code, Kiro CLI, Kiro IDE, Codex CLI, Cursor, opencode, and GitHub Copilot, keeping requirements, decisions, implementation, tests, and operational work connected through an audited lifecycle\.

## Key Features

- Five phases and 33 stages from initialization through operation\.
- Fourteen agents, including 11 domain experts, 2 reviewers, and an adaptive composer\.
- Eleven workflow profiles for features, bug fixes, infrastructure, security, proofs of concept, enterprise delivery, and other common work\.
- Human approval gates and source\-bound review evidence\.
- A 119\-event audit trail plus persistent state, team knowledge, and learned rules\.
- The same deterministic engine across every supported harness\.

## Use Cases

- Building software with AI\-assisted workflows\.
- Fixing bugs and delivering infrastructure or security work through focused workflow profiles\.
- Running proofs of concept and enterprise delivery with approval gates and audit evidence\.
- Onboarding teams through a guided first week and first workflow\.

## Getting Started

- Install AI\-DLC with the native installer for macOS, Linux, WSL, or Windows PowerShell\.
- From the project root, run aidlc config \-\-harness \<harness\>, replacing \<harness\> with claude, kiro, kiro\-ide, codex, cursor, opencode, or copilot\.
- Run aidlc doctor to check the setup\.
- Open the configured harness and invoke /aidlc with a work request; Codex CLI uses $aidlc\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The native installer sets up the aidlc command and every harness runtime; Bun and Node\.js are not required for the native install\.
- The manual\-copy alternative requires Bun and copying the complete runtime/\<harness\>/ directory into the project\.
- On Windows, run the installer from a normal PowerShell window and reopen any already\-open terminal or IDE before using aidlc\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\-0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Amazon Bedrock access depends on enabling the configured models and verifying AWS credentials and region\.
- On Windows, run the installer from a normal PowerShell window because an administrator\-opened session receives a warning and a prompt\.

projects.content:
## Overview

AiSOC is an open\-source, self\-hostable AI Security Operations Center for security telemetry ingestion, alert fusion, LLM\-agent triage, MITRE ATT&CK investigation, and human\-approved response\. Agent decisions are recorded in an investigation ledger and can be replayed, and a public eval harness runs in CI\. The project is MIT\-licensed, runs without requiring API keys, and ships an MCP server for Claude, Cursor, and Continue\.

## Key Features

- Agent decisions are recorded in an investigation ledger and can be replayed step by step\.
- A public eval harness provides a 200\-incident, CI\-gated regression suite over the AiSOC substrate\.
- LangGraph multi\-agent investigation uses recon, forensic, responder, and reporter agents\.
- Real\-time fusion runs on Kafka with Bloom\-filter dedup and ML scoring\.
- Detection engineering supports Sigma over OpenSearch and ClickHouse, YARA, KQL, and EQL, with an ATT&CK heatmap and purple\-team tooling\.
- Enterprise governance includes SAML 2\.0 and OIDC SSO, multi\-tenant Postgres RLS, RBAC, and an immutable audit log\.

## Use Cases

- Security operations teams can aggregate alerts, triage incidents with LLM agents, and review the reasoning behind each decision\.
- Organizations that need a self\-hosted SOC can run AiSOC without API keys using the bundled local model\.
- Detection engineers can migrate Splunk SPL, Sentinel KQL, and Elastic EQL rules or install Sigma, YARA, KQL, and EQL detections\.
- Purple teams can use Atomic Red Team parsing, Caldera execution, and ATT&CK coverage heatmaps\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository and run make up to start the core stack\.
- On Windows, or on a machine without prerequisites, use the PowerShell installer; on Linux or macOS, use the shell installer\.
- Without Docker, install aisoc\-sandbox and run aisoc\-sandbox demo to walk one alert through the agent funnel offline\.
- After startup, run make smoke to send a real event through ingest, detection, correlation, and Postgres, then read the alert back from the public API\.
- Run make doctor to check host tools, memory, disk, ports, and datastores\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker Compose v2 with 8 GB memory and 20 GB free disk in the Docker VM\.
- python3 3\.9\+ and bash\.
- The first run downloads a roughly 2 GB model into a volume that make clean clears\.
- Core profile uses 16 services and about 8 GB RAM; full profile uses 22 services and about 12 GB RAM\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- AiSOC is not a drop\-in SIEM replacement; long\-term log retention and compliance search remain separate concerns\.
- Response actions are not autonomous by default and require explicit policy authorization and a human approver\.
- Benchmark numbers are substrate self\-consistency measures, not live agent accuracy\.
- Collecting real cloud logs requires dedicated collectors rather than relying only on REST calls\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Amical is an open\-source, local\-first AI dictation and note\-taking app that runs on your machine\. It is powered by Whisper for speech\-to\-text and open\-source LLMs for intelligent processing, and it detects the active app to format speech for emails, chats, IDEs, and notes\. It supports macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS, with local or cloud model options\.

## Key Features

- Local and cloud models: choose cloud\-based AI models or run everything locally, switching between providers such as Ollama, OpenAI, and OpenRouter\.
- Context\-aware formatting: detects the active app and adapts tone and format, from professional Gmail emails to casual Instagram posts\.
- Custom vocabulary: recognizes industry terminology, jargon, and proper nouns for personalized transcription\.
- Multi\-language support: transcribe and dictate in 100\+ languages, including mixed\-language dictation\.
- Smart formatting and autocorrect: auto\-corrects grammar, fixes pronouns, and adds contextual emojis\.
- Privacy\-first offline use: works offline with one\-click setup of local models in\-app\.

## Use Cases

- Drafting and replying to emails in Gmail with automatically professional formatting\.
- Writing messages and posts in Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, or Instagram with appropriate casual tone\.
- Writing prompts and code comments in IDEs such as Cursor\.
- Taking structured notes and meeting notes in Notion or other note apps\.

## Getting Started

- Download Amical for macOS or Windows from the releases page, get the Android app on Google Play, or apply for the iOS beta\.
- On macOS, install via Homebrew using brew install \-\-cask amical\.
- For local development, clone the repository with submodules, enable Corepack, install dependencies with pnpm install \-\-frozen\-lockfile, and run the desktop app with pnpm turbo run dev \-\-filter=@amical/desktop\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The desktop app currently supports macOS and Windows; Linux is not supported because there is no Linux native helper\.
- Local Whisper transcription requires macOS 15 or later\.
- Development prerequisites include Node\.js 24\.x, pnpm 10\.15\.0, CMake 3\.20 or later, and Xcode or Xcode Command Line Tools with Swift 5\.9 or later on macOS\.
- On Windows, development requires Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with the Desktop development with C\+\+ workload and the \.NET 8 SDK\.
- No \.env file is required for local transcription; optional cloud, authentication, or telemetry integrations use apps/desktop/\.env configured from apps/desktop/\.env\.example\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The desktop app currently supports only macOS and Windows; Linux is not supported because a Linux native helper is not yet available\.
- The iOS mobile app is available as a beta\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Anatomy is a Claude Code skill that turns a one\-line idea into a live isometric figure of a real machine\. The skill invents the object, builds it from many solid parts, and makes every readout come from the same model that drives the motion\. Figures can be SVG, WebGL, or true 3D, and each is also available as a themeable React component or custom element\.

## Key Features

- Turns a one\-line idea into an interactive isometric figure of an invented machine\.
- Builds figures from dozens to hundreds of small solid parts, with depth\-sorted painting and one lit accent\.
- Supports optional interactive controls, WebGL shaders, and true 3D figures\.
- Ships every collection figure as a React component and a custom element, with five themes and customizable tokens\.
- Figures take keyboard focus, announce readout changes to screen readers, and go still under reduced motion\.
- Collection includes 33 live figures, and six complete examples ship with the skill\.

## Use Cases

- Explain technical concepts in documentation, articles, and landing pages\.
- Create interactive explainer diagrams for software and engineering ideas such as LRU caches, bloom filters, TCP handshakes, and turbofan engines\.
- Embed themeable live figures into React or Next\.js sites\.
- Build educational or technical illustrations from a natural\-language prompt\.

## Getting Started

- Add the skill to Claude Code with npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy\.
- Or download the skill ZIP and unzip it into your skills folder, such as ~/\.claude/skills\.
- Then open Claude Code in your project and ask for an explanatory figure, naming the idea rather than the drawing\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Claude Code environment\.
- Node\.js 20\.10 or newer, per the README badge\.
- No additional dependencies are reported\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- 3D figures are a beta feature and are slow to audit, so they are best requested only when a part must move in depth\.
- The skill favors detailed figures over speed and will not trade detail for speed on its own, so quick results should be requested explicitly\.
- Claude may build a figure that works but does not visually read correctly, so the first figure should be reviewed and refined\.
- Reference images are used for finish and mood, not for faithful copying of another drawing\.

projects.content:
## Overview

anidoodle is an open\-source skill that lets AI agents draw illustrations, animations, interactive web pages, launch videos, and films by writing code\. It provides 32 visual styles, code\-composed music, and deterministic rendering so the same source reproduces the same output at any size\.

## Key Features

- 32 visual styles, each with a matching drawing film and style recipe\.
- Hand\-drawn illustrations, motion graphics, explainer videos, launch videos, and interactive web art generated from code\.
- Music composed in code with 21 genres and optional recorded acoustic instruments\.
- Deterministic pure\-function rendering: the same source redraws the same picture on every machine and size\.
- Works as a standard skill folder with Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and other agents that read skills\.
- Exports PNG, MP4 with score, GIF, WebM, animated PNG, and self\-contained HTML\.

## Use Cases

- Creating brand\-consistent hero illustrations, spot art, empty states, and 404 pages for websites\.
- Producing explainer diagrams, animated infographics, storyboards, and launch films with original scores\.
- Building interactive illustrations such as mascots that follow the cursor or forms that react to input\.
- Teaching drawing through step sheets and captioned timelapses, or recreating a photo in a chosen style\.

## Getting Started

- In Claude Code, add the plugin marketplace with alexgreensh/anidoodle and install anidoodle@alexgreensh\-anidoodle\.
- In Codex, run codex plugin marketplace add alexgreensh/anidoodle, then use /plugins in the TUI to install anidoodle\.
- In Grok Build, run grok plugin marketplace add alexgreensh/anidoodle and grok plugin install anidoodle \-\-trust\.
- For other agents, copy the standard skill folder at skills/anidoodle/SKILL\.md into a harness that reads skills\.
- To drive the engine directly, scaffold a project, install dependencies, and run tools such as still\.mjs or render\.mjs\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node 20 or newer\.
- Stills require a browser; motion output also uses ffmpeg\.
- Direct engine use requires installing project dependencies and Playwright Chromium\.
- The optional sound pack is a 373 MB download that is verified by hash and unpacked\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The runtime requires Node 20 or newer\.
- The optional acoustic sound pack is a 373 MB download that must be verified and unpacked, and the agent asks before downloading\.

anidoodle 是一个开源技能，让 AI 智能体通过编写代码来绘制插画、制作动画、生成交互式网页、发布视频和影片。它提供 32 种视觉风格、由代码创作的音乐，以及确定性渲染，因此同一份源代码可以在任意尺寸下复现相同输出。

## 核心功能

- 主要功能包括：32 种视觉风格，每种风格配有对应的绘制影片和风格配方；通过代码生成手绘插画、动态图形、讲解视频、发布视频和交互式网页艺术；由代码创作音乐，包含 21 种音乐类型和可选的实录原声乐器；采用纯函数确定性渲染，同一份源代码可在不同机器和尺寸下重绘相同画面；可作为标准技能文件夹，在 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 以及其他读取技能的智能体中使用；可导出 PNG、带配乐的 MP4、GIF、WebM、动态 PNG 和自包含 HTML。

## 适用场景

- 可用于为网站制作风格统一的主题插画、功能点配图、空状态和 404 页面；制作讲解图、动态信息图、故事板和带原创配乐的发布影片；构建跟随光标或响应输入的表单伙伴等交互式插画；通过步骤图和带字幕的延时影片教授绘画，或按选定风格重现照片。

## 快速开始

- 在 Claude Code 中，先运行 /plugin marketplace add alexgreensh/anidoodle，再运行 /plugin install anidoodle@alexgreensh\-anidoodle。在 Codex 中运行 codex plugin marketplace add alexgreensh/anidoodle，然后在 Codex TUI 中使用 /plugins 安装 anidoodle。在 Grok Build 中运行 grok plugin marketplace add

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Node 20 或更高版本。生成静态图需要浏览器；生成动态内容还需要 ffmpeg。直接使用引擎时需要安装项目依赖和 Playwright Chromium。可选音效包为 373 MB 下载，需按哈希校验并解包。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.description: anydoc is an open-source Rust library that converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF documents into clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown, with Node.js, Python, browser, WebAssembly, and CLI bindings.

projects.content:
## Overview

anydoc is an open\-source Rust library by Firecrawl that converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF documents into GitHub\-Flavored Markdown\. It provides Node\.js, Python, browser WebAssembly, and CLI bindings, and its browser demo converts files locally\.

## Key Features

- Converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files into GitHub\-Flavored Markdown\.
- Uses one shared document model and Markdown serializer so output structure stays consistent across formats\.
- Detects formats from file bytes rather than extensions, so mislabeled files still convert\.
- Runs as pure Rust with no ML models or external services and reports median conversion under 5 ms\.
- Ships bindings for Rust, Node\.js, Python, browser WebAssembly, and CLI usage\.
- Preserves headings, lists, tables with merged cells, footnotes, speaker notes, and equations as LaTeX\.

## Use Cases

- Converting mixed office document collections into one consistent, structured Markdown output for LLM pipelines\.
- Converting documents locally in the browser so files never leave the user's machine\.
- Letting agents read office documents through the shipped Agent Skill\.
- Extracting text\-based PDFs locally without requiring an OCR service\.

## Getting Started

- Install anydoc for Rust with cargo add anydoc, for Node\.js with npm install @firecrawl/anydoc, for Python with pip install firecrawl\-anydoc, or for the browser with npm install @firecrawl/anydoc\-wasm\.
- Run the CLI with npx @firecrawl/anydoc report\.docx, or use the same conversion API from a path or bytes\.
- Stop at the document model when embedded assets need to be kept\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Pure Rust, no ML models, and no external services for local conversion\.
- Browser WebAssembly demo downloads a few MB of WebAssembly once\.
- Text\-based PDFs convert locally through pdf\-inspector; scanned or image\-only PDFs require opt\-in hosted OCR through Firecrawl Parse\.
- Hosted OCR can be used without signup; setting FIRECRAWL\_API\_KEY provides higher limits\.
- The Rust crate has no OCR option and never makes network calls\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Scanned or image\-only PDFs are not handled by local conversion and rely on Firecrawl Parse for OCR\.
- When hosted OCR is used, the entire document is sent off the machine because Parse has no page selection\.

## 项目简介

anydoc 是 Firecrawl 开发的开源 Rust 库，可将 Word、PowerPoint、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 文档转换为 GitHub 风格 Markdown。它提供 Node\.js、Python、浏览器 WebAssembly 和 CLI 绑定，官网演示在浏览器本地完成转换，文件不会离开用户设备。

## 核心功能

- 支持将 Word、PowerPoint、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 转换为 GitHub 风格 Markdown。
- 所有格式都解析为同一个文档模型，并通过同一个 Markdown 序列化器输出，标题、嵌套列表、合并单元格表格和脚注的表现保持一致。
- 根据文件字节而非扩展名识别格式，扩展名标注错误的文件也能正确转换。
- 使用纯 Rust 实现，不依赖机器学习模型或外部服务，官方称单文档转换中位耗时低于 5 毫秒。
- 提供 Rust、Node\.js、Python、浏览器 WebAssembly 和 CLI 多种使用方式。
- 保留标题、列表、含合并单元格与表头的表格、引用、脚注与尾注、演讲者备注等内容，Word 和 PowerPoint 的公式可转换为 LaTeX 数学标记。

## 适用场景

- 将来源混杂的办公文档批量转换为结构一致的 Markdown，供 LLM 流程使用。
- 在浏览器中本地转换文档，文件不离开本机。
- 通过随包发布的 Agent Skill 让智能体读取办公文档。
- 在无需 OCR 服务的条件下本地提取文本型 PDF 的内容。

## 快速开始

- Rust 用户可执行 cargo add anydoc 安装。
- Node\.js 用户可执行 npm install @firecrawl/anydoc 安装。
- Python 用户可执行 pip install firecrawl\-anydoc 安装。
- 浏览器 WebAssembly 版本可执行 npm install @firecrawl/anydoc\-wasm 安装。
- CLI 可直接运行 npx @firecrawl/anydoc report\.docx，将 Markdown 输出到标准输出。

## 部署与要求

- 本地转换使用纯 Rust，不需要机器学习模型，也不依赖外部服务。
- 浏览器 WebAssembly 演示页面需要一次性下载几 MB 的 WebAssembly。
- 文本型 PDF 通过 pdf\-inspector 在本地转换。
- 扫描件或仅有图像的 PDF 需要选择启用 Firecrawl Parse 提供的托管 OCR。
- 托管 OCR 无需注册即可使用，设置 FIRECRAWL\_API\_KEY 可获得更高额度。

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
