projects.content:
## Overview

AnyModelBot is an open\-source, local\-first AI agent application for Windows, macOS, and Linux\. Each bot has its own persona, default model, workspace, and memory, and can be reached in the app or through WeChat and Feishu\. Bots can read and write files, run commands, and operate the desktop, asking for confirmation before working outside their workspace\. Conversations, memories, files, and API keys stay on the device, while model requests are forwarded through Modelflare to the selected provider and billed by token usage\.

## Key Features

- Computer operation lets bots see the screen, open apps, read and write files, and run commands; only 24 actions are exposed, while script execution and process termination are not visible to the model, and operations outside the workspace require approval or can be switched to

## Use Cases

- File and invoice organization: ask a bot to open the Downloads folder, select invoices, and move them into a reimbursement directory; operations outside the workspace require confirmation\. Code review and automation: check for out\-of\-bounds errors, run tests or scripts, and

## Getting Started

- Download and install the package for your system, or use Docker to deploy on a server\. On first launch, sign in to or register for Modelflare in the browser; for Docker or remote deployment, paste an API key instead\. After connecting, choose a default model, which can be changed

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop support covers Windows, macOS, and Linux; installers cover Windows x64 and arm64, macOS Apple silicon and Intel, and Linux x64 and arm64\. Docker deployment is intended for NAS or servers, with images for x64 and arm64; the web console requires an access token, and port

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

AnyModelBot 是一款开源、本地优先的 AI 智能体应用，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。每个机器人拥有独立人设、默认模型、工作区和记忆，可在应用内或微信、飞书等渠道对话。它能读写文件、执行命令、操作桌面，越出工作区时会先询问用户。对话、记忆、文件和 API Key 保存在设备上，模型请求经 Modelflare 转发给所选厂商，按 token 用量计费。

## 核心功能

- 电脑操作：可看屏幕、打开应用、读写文件、运行命令；只开放 24 个动作，脚本执行和结束进程等对模型不可见，越界操作需确认或可切换只读。
- 长期记忆：机器人、群、团队三层记忆各自独立，存储为本机 Markdown 文件；密码、密钥、证件号等敏感信息自动拒存，长对话由上下文管家用指定的小模型整理。
- 多模型选择：一个 Modelflare Key 可使用 70 多个模型，覆盖 13 家厂商；可为每个机器人选择默认模型，并在对话中随时更换。
- 多渠道访问：可在桌面应用、本地网页控制台、微信和飞书中使用；Docker 部署可让机器人在 NAS 或服务器上持续在线。
- 成本与权限控制：App 内显示余额、低余额提醒和每日用量，可为每个机器人设花费上限；支持只读、工作区、完全权限三档权限。
- 图片和视频生成：说一句就生成，预计花费超过 0\.5 美元时会先询问使用哪个模型。

## 适用场景

- 整理文件与发票：让机器人打开下载文件夹、筛选发票并移动到报销目录；涉及工作区外的操作会先请求确认。
- 代码检查与自动化：检查函数越界等问题、运行测试或脚本，并自动执行重复任务。
- 日报与知识整理：把会议或群聊讨论整理成日报，提取决定和待办并存入长期记忆。
- 客服、翻译与写作：用不同机器人处理客服答疑、翻译、搜索、写作润色和创意草稿。

## 快速开始

- 下载并安装对应系统的安装包，或使用 Docker 命令部署到服务器。
- 首次启动时在浏览器登录或注册 Modelflare；Docker 或远程部署可改为粘贴 API Key。
- 连接后选择一个默认模型，之后可在对话中随时切换。
- 新建机器人，选择角色或模板并命名；每个机器人有独立人设、模型和工作区。
- 在微信或飞书中扫码接入后，可在手机上继续与同一个机器人对话。

## 部署与要求

- 桌面端支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux；安装包覆盖 Windows x64/arm64、macOS Apple 芯片/Intel、Linux x64/arm64。
- Docker 部署适用于 NAS 或服务器，镜像同时支持 x64 和 arm64；网页控制台需使用访问令牌，不要把 3600 端口直接暴露到公网。
- 从源码构建需要 Node\.js 22\.13\+ 和 Go 1\.26\.8\+。
- 模型来自 Modelflare，使用需联网并拥有 Modelflare 账号或 API Key；不支持本地模型。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- 使用时需要联网，模型由 Modelflare 提供，不支持本地模型。
- 模型请求会经 Modelflare 转发给所选模型厂商，日志保留期以 Modelflare 文档为准；电脑操作屏幕内容会作为输入发送给所选模型。
- Docker 网页控制台不应将 3600 端口直接暴露到公网。
- 微信渠道有回复次数限制：用户每条消息后 24 小时内，机器人最多回复 10 条。

projects.content:
## Overview

Apprise is a library with a CLI that provides one consistent URL format and notification interface for apps, automation, and infrastructure\. It supports sending notifications to almost all of the most popular notification services, delivers messages asynchronously, and can handle images and attachments where services accept them\. Messages go directly from your machine to each service, with no third party in between\.

## Key Features

- One consistent and intuitive notification URL syntax across supported services
- Core Python library and an apprise command line tool, with optional relay through Apprise API
- Broad service support including Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, and Gotify
- Asynchronous message delivery for responsive notification sending
- Tags to group services and notify only the destinations that need to know
- Support for images and attachments to notification services that accept them

## Use Cases

- System administrators and DevOps teams sending reliable alerts from infrastructure and automation
- Developers adding notifications to scripts, cron jobs, and automation workflows
- Library authors who want to include notification support without researching every service individually
- Teams centralizing notification delivery through Apprise API

## Getting Started

- Install from PyPI with: pip install apprise
- Define notification destinations using Apprise's URL format and consult the services documentation for exact syntax
- Send notifications with the apprise CLI or call the library from your own code
- Optionally relay notifications through Apprise API to centralize delivery

## Before You Adopt

- License: BSD\-2\-Clause\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Verify that Apprise supports your specific notification service, especially if you depend on a niche provider\.
- Adoption involves relying on one project to maintain integrations across a long list of notification services\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Archify is an open\-source Agent Skill for turning a system, process, or plan into a diagram\. The agent authors typed JSON, and Archify renders and validates a self\-contained interactive HTML artifact\. The Skill and renderers are licensed under MIT\.

## Key Features

- Five diagram types: architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, and lifecycle\.
- Four visual presets: Classic, Signal Flow, Blueprint, and Editorial\.
- Self\-contained HTML output with inline SVG and typed JSON source\.
- Dual dark and light themes in one file\.
- Exports PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, and WebM, with clipboard copy\.
- Validates authored diagrams with 9/9 checks per artifact\.

## Use Cases

- Diagram software systems, including services, databases, and security boundaries\.
- Map workflows and approval chains, such as leave plans or CI/CD pipelines\.
- Explain sequences, such as renting a flat or an API call chain\.
- Track lifecycles, such as job applications or deployments\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Skill with npx skills add tt\-a1i/archify \-g, or use an agent\-specific command\.
- Describe the steps, people, parts, or states to your agent\.
- Ask your agent to use Archify to draw it\.
- Open the generated HTML file in a browser and refine it in chat\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A supported AI agent: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, or GitHub Copilot\.
- Agent access to files\.
- A local Node\.js runtime\.
- Any tools needed for the requested export\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.description: Arize Phoenix is an open-source AI observability platform for tracing, evaluating, and improving LLM applications. It provides tracing via OpenTelemetry, LLM-based evaluations, prompt management, and experiments to compare changes. Built
projects.descriptionZh: Arize Phoenix 是 Arize AI 与开源社区共同打造的开源 AI 可观测性平台，用于追踪、评估和改进 LLM 应用。它基于 OpenTelemetry 和 OpenInference 提供追踪、评估、提示词管理和实验功能。
projects.content:
## Overview

Phoenix helps you understand and improve AI applications by giving you a workflow for debugging and iteration\. You can send detailed logging information, known as traces, from your app to see exactly what happened during a run, score outputs using evaluation tests to identify failures and regressions, iterate on your prompts using real production examples, and optimize your app with experiments that compare changes on the same inputs\. Phoenix is built by Arize AI and the open\-source community, on top of OpenTelemetry and powered by OpenInference instrumentation\.

## Key Features

- Tracing: See what happened during a single run of your AI application, step by step, capturing model calls, retrieval, tool use, and custom logic\.
- Evaluation: Score traces and spans with LLM\-based evaluators, code\-based checks, or human labels to track performance and identify failures consistently\.
- Prompt Engineering: Version prompts, test prompt variants across datasets, and replay calls to see how changes affect outputs before rolling them out\.
- Datasets & Experiments: Group traces into datasets, rerun them through different versions of your application, and compare evaluation results to confirm whether a change actually improved performance\.
- PXI (Phoenix Intelligence): An AI engineering agent built into Phoenix for debugging traces, iterating on prompts, and navigating the product\.
- Remote MCP Server: Connect Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients directly to your Phoenix instance's /mcp endpoint to query traces, datasets, experiments, and more\.

## Use Cases

- Debugging LLM applications by inspecting traces to understand behavior and identify where time is spent\.
- Measuring output quality with evaluations to track performance and identify failures consistently\.
- Iterating on prompts using real production examples and comparing prompt variants across datasets\.
- Optimizing applications with experiments that compare changes on the same inputs to confirm improvements\.

## Getting Started

- Start Phoenix in one terminal: \`uvx arize\-phoenix serve\` (or \`phoenix serve\` after pip install)\. It serves at http://localhost:6006\.
- Add tracing with a coding agent: run \`npx \-y @arizeai/phoenix\-cli setup\` or \`npm i \-g @arizeai/phoenix\-cli && px setup\` from your app's root directory\.
- Alternatively, follow the Python or TypeScript quick starts to send traces, measure performance, iterate on prompts, and optimize with experiments\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Phoenix container images are available via Docker Hub and can be deployed using Docker or Kubernetes via the Helm chart\.
- Deployment options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, and cloud platforms like Railway, Render, Google Cloud, Azure, and AWS\.
- The Google Cloud button builds Phoenix from source in Cloud Shell rather than deploying the prebuilt Docker Hub image\.
- The Azure template serves plain HTTP (Azure Container Instances does not terminate TLS) — front it with a TLS proxy such as an Application Gateway before production use\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Azure deployment template serves plain HTTP and requires a TLS proxy for production use\.

## Overview

ArtCraft is an open\-source studio for controllable AI image and video creation\. It is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers, built around visual control, ownership, and expression rather than text prompting alone\. ArtCraft can be used on the web or downloaded for desktop, with no subscription required and no aggregator middleman between the user and the models\.

## Key Features

- Image to Location: Place virtual actors into physical environments and plan multiple shots in a consistent room\.
- 2D and 3D compositing: Layer images, backdrops, foreground elements, props, background removal, and drawing tools to compose scenes with depth and precise layering\.
- Image to 3D Mesh: Turn images into 3D objects that can be positioned, rotated, and framed for scene blocking\.
- Character posing and identity transfer: Pose characters and set camera blocking before generating the final shot, and use a posed mannequin to guide character placement and pose\.
- Mixed asset crafting: Combine image cutouts, worlds, and 3D meshes in one canvas\.
- Prompt\-based generation and editing: Use text to image, prompted image editing, canvas image editing, and image to video with selected models\.

## Use Cases

- Artists, designers, and filmmakers can compose and block shots before generating final images or video\.
- Filmmakers can place virtual actors in physical environments and film multiple shots in one location without elements disappearing\.
- 3D scene blocking with kitbashing and mixed assets helps control camera angles, object placement, and depth\.
- Creators can start with a prompt for quick ideation, then refine using canvas and scene tools\.

## Getting Started

- Download the desktop studio for macOS or Windows\.
- Use ArtCraft on the web by launching the studio in your browser\.
- Build from source, including for Linux\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop builds are available for macOS and Windows\.
- The web version runs in the browser with no install needed\.
- Linux is supported through building from source\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Some catalog models are marked as currently disabled or restricted, and restricted models are not currently available in the desktop app\.
- Additional provider integrations for Kling, Google, Runway, and Luma are planned, and support for aggregator subscriptions such as OpenArt and Freepik is an expressed interest rather than a current feature\.

projects.content:
## Overview

ARTEMIS is an Android automation system that turns natural\-language instructions into end\-to\-end device workflows\. It provides a web console, an MCP server for AI IDEs, a developer CLI, and a Python SDK, and it captures logs and screenshots during execution\. It reports a 99%\+ task completion rate on Google Research's AndroidWorld benchmark\.

## Key Features

- Cross\-app automation from natural\-language instructions across Android testing workflows and everyday tasks\.
- Multimodal targeting with element indices, coordinate locating, and visual locating fallbacks for custom interfaces\.
- Model Context Protocol integration for AI IDEs to drive test devices and collect Logcat output and screenshots\.
- Flash execution profile with a reactive observe\-and\-act loop typically taking 3–5 seconds per step\.
- Pro execution profile with planning, pre\-execution safety checks, verification, and long\-running exploration\.
- Reported 99%\+ task completion on the AndroidWorld benchmark spanning 100\+ multi\-step tasks\.

## Use Cases

- Automating end\-to\-end Android app workflows and regression tests from natural\-language prompts\.
- Letting AI coding assistants in IDEs reproduce bugs and run tests on real devices or emulators\.
- Running exploratory stability tests and long\-running Android automation\.
- Integrating Android test execution into pytest\-style frameworks or CI/CD pipelines via the Python SDK\.

## Getting Started

- Ensure an Android device with USB debugging enabled or an emulator is connected\.
- Run start\.sh on macOS or Linux, or start\.bat in Windows PowerShell\.
- Use the browser console on port 8000 for device connection, screen mirroring, prompt sandbox, and execution replays\.
- For CLI use, run artemis with a prompt and select the flash or pro profile\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.12 or newer\.
- A connected Android device with USB debugging enabled, or an emulator\.
- The one\-click startup script installs ADB, scrcpy, FFmpeg, and uv dependencies\.
- The first device task installs the Artemis Accessibility Helper on the phone\.

## Before You Adopt

projects.content:
## Overview

ARTEX is a self\-hosted, LLM\-driven penetration testing platform\. A planner splits a goal into intents, workers execute them with real tools, and results are written back into two linked graphs: one for known target assets and one for test progress\. Findings can stay bound to captured assets and HTTP traffic so evidence supports the result\.

## Key Features

- Dual\-graph architecture separates the shared asset graph from each task's exploration graph and links them with anchors for coverage and audit trails\.
- Evidence\-bound findings use a recording MITM proxy and browser extension so findings, evidence quotes, and retests tie to exact request and response traffic\.
- Autonomy controls include human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, argv\-prefix rules, scope and deny gates, token and turn budgets, a target noise governor, and prompt\-injection framing on tool output\.
- Self\-hosted and model\-agnostic deployment uses one Go binary with an embedded Next\.js UI, PostgreSQL, and Anthropic, OpenAI\-compatible, or local Ollama endpoints\.
- Vulnerability retest loop re\-runs findings with optional fixed version or conditions and records still reproducible, fixed, or cannot confirm\.
- Reports, exports, task archives, asset coverage, and ScopeSentry sync support repeatable security engagements\.

## Use Cases

- Penetration testers and red teams that want automation without giving up an audit trail\.
- Security teams that need to justify findings to clients or teammates with captured request and response evidence\.
- Engagements against authenticated targets where a browser extension captures session traffic\.
- Repeatable security engagements using task categories, templates, relations, archives, and asset coverage\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository, copy \.env\.example to \.env, set POSTGRES\_PASSWORD and optionally an LLM key, then run docker compose up \-d \-\-build\.
- Open the UI on local port 8787 and complete first\-run setup with the one\-time setup token printed at startup\.
- Retrieve the setup token from the artex container logs and complete the setup page\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- PostgreSQL is required; exploration requires an LLM such as an Anthropic or OpenAI\-compatible endpoint, or a local Ollama instance\.
- Docker Compose is one installation path; other paths include an install script, prebuilt binaries, source builds, and release archives\.
- The UI listens on 127\.0\.0\.1 by default; remote access requires binding or a reverse proxy or SSH tunnel\.
- The Docker image includes a scanner toolchain such as nmap, nuclei, httpx, katana, ffuf, dalfox, sqlmap, ripgrep, curl, and npm\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Docker image is built from the local checkout, so there is no prebuilt image to pull and the first start can take longer\.

projects.content:
## Overview

A Claude Code skill that rewrites dense, ambiguous English into ASD\-STE100 Simplified Technical English\. It is aimed at AI agents and non\-native readers that must parse tool descriptions, error messages, inter\-agent instructions, and other agent\-facing English without a human to resolve ambiguity\.

## Key Features

- Applies ASD\-STE100 principles to rewrite ambiguous agent\-facing English\.
- Offers a strict mode for procedures, error messages, and tool descriptions\.
- Offers an STE\-flavored mode for READMEs, PR descriptions, and explanatory prose\.
- Flags rule violations such as ambiguous word choice, passive voice, complex tenses, long sentences, and dropped words\.
- Includes a deterministic linter for structural patterns such as semicolons, soft phrasal verbs, nominalizations, marketing adjectives, passive voice, and present\-perfect forms\.
- Outputs rewritten text without preamble, mode announcement, or change summary\.

## Use Cases

- Rewriting agent\-to\-agent messages and inter\-agent instructions\.
- Clarifying tool and function descriptions for machine readers\.
- Rewriting error messages and system prompts\.
- Checking structural STE patterns in Markdown or text files with the linter\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx skills add danyuchn/asd\-ste100\-skill from your project root to install the skill for the current project\.
- Clone the repository into ~/\.claude/skills/asd\-ste100 to make it available in every Claude Code project\.
- Trigger the skill by asking Claude to disambiguate, rewrite, or apply ASD\-STE100 to English text\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The skills CLI sends anonymous install telemetry\.
- The linter checks only structural patterns and does not verify meaning preservation\.
- The standard cannot be freely redistributed; reproduction requires ASD's written authority or an authorised organisation type\.
- The repository's own prose does not pass the linter; findings are examples, not defects\.
- The linter does not check noun\-cluster length, phrasal verbs outside its list, hedges, or modality\.

projects.content:
## Overview

AstrBot is an open\-source, all\-in\-one agent chatbot platform that integrates with mainstream instant messaging apps\. It provides reliable and scalable conversational AI infrastructure for individuals, developers, and teams, supporting personal AI companions, customer service, automation assistants, and enterprise knowledge bases\.

## Key Features

- AI LLM conversations with multimodal input, agent capabilities, MCP, skills, knowledge base, persona settings, and auto context compression\.
- Multi\-platform access to QQ, OneBot v11, Telegram, WeCom, WeChat Official Accounts, Feishu, DingTalk, Slack, Discord, LINE, Satori, KOOK, Misskey, and Mattermost\.
- Plugin extensions with 1000\+ plugins available for one\-click installation and a plugin\-driven architecture\.
- Agent sandbox for isolated, safe execution of code, shell calls, and session\-level resource reuse\.
- WebUI and Web ChatUI support for configuration, debugging, logs, plugin management, and chat\.
- Multi\-provider AI support including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio, Dify, Coze, and many speech services\.

## Use Cases

- Personal AI companion with emotional companionship, persona editing, long\-term memory, and proactive dialog\.
- Intelligent customer service and enterprise knowledge base assistants inside IM platforms\.
- Automation assistant for group operations, content workflows, and scheduled tasks with cron jobs\.
- Developer platform for building production\-ready AI applications on instant messaging workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Install uv, then run uv tool install astrbot \-\-python 3\.12, astrbot init for first\-time initialization, and astrbot run\.
- Deploy with Docker or Docker Compose by following the official documentation for a stable production setup\.
- Use the AstrBot desktop application or AstrBot Launcher for desktop usage and isolated multi\-instance deployment\.
- Use one\-click cloud deployment via RainYun for 24\-hour\-online deployment without managing servers\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- One\-click uv deployment requires uv to be installed and uses Python 3\.12\.
- Docker or Docker Compose is recommended for a more stable, production\-ready deployment\.
- Desktop application deployment is designed for desktop usage and is not recommended for server scenarios\.
- Launcher deployment is intended for desktop users who want fast deployment and isolated multi\-instance usage\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Desktop application deployment is intended for desktop use and is not recommended for server scenarios\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Astryx is an open source design system built on React 19\+ and StyleX\. It grew inside Meta over eight years and powers 13,000\+ apps\. It combines accessible React components, theming, templates, and CLI tooling so people and AI assistants can build with the same system\.

## Key Features

- 150\+ accessible and themeable React components with TypeScript support and dark mode\.
- Fully customizable themes delivered as CSS custom property overrides, with seven ready\-made themes\.
- No styling lock\-in: styles can be overridden with className using Tailwind, CSS modules, or plain CSS\.
- Open internals and swizzle support for ejecting component source into a project\.
- CLI and MCP support for scaffolding projects, browsing templates, generating themes, and accessing agent\-ready docs\.
- Production\-ready templates for common pages that can be populated with project content\.

## Use Cases

- Building accessible React application interfaces with a consistent component library\.
- Creating brand\-specific themes without forking or wrapping component source\.
- Scaffolding common pages such as table pages and detail layouts from templates and patterns\.
- Supporting workflows where people and AI assistants build from the same component reference and CLI\.

## Getting Started

- Install @astryxdesign/core, @astryxdesign/theme\-neutral, and @stylexjs/stylex, and install @astryxdesign/cli as a dev dependency\.
- Use a few CSS imports plus a theme provider; no build plugin, PostCSS, or Babel config is required for the simplest setup\.
- Optionally install @astryxdesign/cli globally so the astryx command works in any folder and coding agents know Astryx\.
- For reliable CLI access, add a package\.json script that runs the local CLI\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- React 19 or later is required; react and react\-dom are peer dependencies of @astryxdesign/core\.
- The simplest setup uses CSS imports and a theme provider and does not require a build plugin, PostCSS, or Babel config\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Astryx is currently in beta\.
- The chart packages have no stable release yet\.

projects.content:
## Overview

ATLAS (Adaptive Test\-time Learning and Autonomous Specialization) is a local coding agent that brings frontier\-style reasoning and verification to compact open models\. It puts planning, candidate generation, quality scoring, sandboxed testing, and repair around the model so smaller models can tackle software work on local hardware without a hosted API or per\-token fees\.

## Key Features

- Adds planning, candidate generation, quality scoring, sandboxed testing, and repair around compact open models\.
- Uses a multi\-phase V3 pipeline with structured planning, diverse sampling, budget allocation, repair, and refinement loops\.
- Scores candidate quality with an energy\-based Geometric Lens over the model's own embeddings, without an external oracle\.
- Runs generated code in an isolated sandbox that supports multiple languages and can run generated and existing test suites\.
- Provides local LLM inference through llama\-server on consumer GPUs, with grammar\-constrained decoding\.
- Includes a native terminal UI, an atlas\-proxy agent loop, and model\-agnostic support for compatible GGUF models\.

## Use Cases

- Running coding assistance entirely on your own hardware without a hosted API or per\-token fees\.
- Helping compact open models handle real software work through planning, verification, and repair\.
- Compiling, testing, and correcting generated code in an isolated execution environment before accepting it\.
- Using compatible GGUF models across NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, Vulkan, or CPU\-supported hardware\.

## Getting Started

- Use the one\-shot bootstrap installer; it detects the Linux distribution and GPU vendor, installs the appropriate runtime, downloads model weights, builds the ASA steering vector, and starts the stack\.
- After installation, run atlas in any project directory to launch the terminal UI\.
- For a pinned or reviewable install, use the bootstrap script at a signed release tag or download and inspect the script before running it\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- GPU with 16 GB or more VRAM; NVIDIA CUDA is supported, AMD ROCm is community\-tested, Apple Silicon Metal is supported through a native macOS hybrid path, and Vulkan is preview\.
- The prebuilt CUDA image targets Blackwell RTX 50xx; older NVIDIA GPUs require a one\-time local rebuild\.
- Runtime: Docker, with nvidia\-container\-toolkit for NVIDIA and standalone Docker for AMD, or Podman\.
- Python 3\.9 or newer\.
- About 20 GB disk for CUDA or about 22 GB for ROCm for model weights and container images\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- ATLAS is marked experimental, and the 3\.1 line has known verification gaps; the source advises reviewing outputs and running your own tests until fixes planned for 3\.2\.0\.
- No capability or reliability benchmark result is currently published for the release\.
- In versions 3\.1\.0 to 3\.1\.7, a failing V3 candidate may still be written and reported as verified when no candidate passes tests\.
- In versions 3\.1\.3 to 3\.1\.7, the lens reports calibration and active interventions but provides no usable signal with default settings\.
- Sandbox commands have outbound network access by default\.

projects.content:
## Overview

AudioGhost is an open\-source desktop app and web UI that uses Meta's SAM\-Audio to separate sounds described in English text prompts from audio or video\. Each requested sound gets its own track, with an Everything else track for the remainder, and the model does not generate new audio, voices, or music\.

## Key Features

- Text\-guided separation lets users describe sounds such as vocals, drums, a dog barking, or crowd noise, with each requested sound placed on its own track\.
- A mixer provides Only, Remove, and per\-track level controls, plus hold\-to\-hear\-original comparison and selected\-part adjustments\.
- Takes and seeds support repeatable results, while batch processing can apply the same sounds and mix to many files\.
- Video preview and export support replacing a video soundtrack with the new mix\.
- Local GPU processing uses consumer GPUs, with Small running in about 4\.2 GB of VRAM and long files processed in crossfaded chunks\.
- Exports include 24\-bit WAV, FLAC, MP3, ZIP archives of single tracks, and video with the new soundtrack\.

## Use Cases

- Isolate or remove background music, speech, sirens, baby crying, traffic, or other named sounds from recordings\.
- Create separate stems from songs or field recordings for remixing, selective muting, or closer listening\.
- Replace a video's soundtrack with a mix made from sounds already present in the recording\.
- Apply one separation recipe across multiple audio or video files with batch processing\.

## Getting Started

- On Windows, download the installer, run it, and let first start set up Python, PyTorch, FFmpeg, and SAM\-Audio, about 6 GB\.
- On macOS or Linux, install from GitHub using install\.sh and start services with start\.sh\.
- Accept Meta's SAM License on first run; model files download on first use\.
- Upload an audio or video file, type the sounds to separate in English, choose model and quality settings, then mix and export what you hear\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11 64\-bit with an NVIDIA GPU, Linux x86\_64 with an NVIDIA GPU, or an Apple Silicon Mac with CPU\-only support for now; Intel Macs are not supported by PyTorch 2\.9\.
- NVIDIA GPU memory guidance is 6 GB or more for Small, 8 GB or more for Base, and 12 GB or more for Large, with measured peaks of 4\.2, 5\.4, and 8\.9 GB using 25\-second chunks\.
- Source installation requires Anaconda or Miniconda, Node\.js 18 or later, and git, which are not needed for the Windows desktop app\.
- The planned cloud version runs in a browser on provider GPUs, with no graphics card needed and 100 free credits for new accounts\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Windows desktop app is labeled beta\.
- The Windows installer is not code\-signed, so Windows may show a protection warning that requires choosing More info and Run anyway\.
- On macOS the app currently runs on the CPU and may take minutes rather than seconds\.
- AudioGhost Cloud is not open yet; users can join a waitlist\.

## 项目简介

Augur 是本地优先的投资研究记忆系统，围绕 18 位投资大师人设提供独立分析与加权共识。系统为证据保留时间语义，使每次运行可复查，并通过 CLI、Dashboard 和 MCP 提供使用入口。

## 核心功能

- 18 位投资大师人设分别进行独立分析，并汇总为加权共识。
- 证据带时间语义，便于按时间理解与复查。
- 每次运行可复查，支持研究过程回溯。
- 提供 CLI、Dashboard 和 MCP 三种入口。
- 采用本地优先设计。

## 适用场景

- 对投资标的进行多视角分析，并查看 18 位投资大师人设的独立观点与加权共识。
- 需要保留研究证据时间线索，并在后续复查每次分析运行时使用。
- 通过 CLI、Dashboard 或 MCP 接入本地研究工作流。

## 快速开始

- 使用仓库提供的 install\.sh 一键安装脚本；脚本包含 Python 和 git 检查、完整安装或仅数据安装选择、PATH 提示与启动说明。
- README 提供快速开始文档，CLI 覆盖 skill、eval、risk\-review、ledger、verify\-pack 和研究记录相关子命令。

## 部署与要求

- 可通过仓库中的 Dockerfile、docker\-compose 和 Makefile 进行容器化或本地部署。
- augur serve 和 augur api 默认绑定 127\.0\.0\.1；绑定到其他地址时会打印警告。
- 使用 Dashboard 认证需配置 AUGUR\_API\_TOKEN 或多用户模式；REST API 服务器本身没有认证。
- v13\.0\.0 标注 Python 3\.10\+。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- Dashboard 认证依赖 AUGUR\_API\_TOKEN 或多用户模式配置；REST API 服务器没有认证，部署时需控制访问边界。
- 人物分析会访问 finance\.yahoo\.com 获取 VIX/SPY 宏观数据，运行环境需考虑该外部数据依赖。
- 某些共识权重混合结果在完成样本外前后对比前，不应直接视为改进。

projects.name: Auto Ontology
projects.tagline: Semantic graph reasoning layer for trusted agent analytics
projects.taglineZh: 面向可信智能体分析的语义图推理层
projects.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
projects.descriptionZh: Auto Ontology 是一个 Python 框架，用于在数据之上构建语义化、基于图的推理层，支持确定性查询生成、更好的上下文检索，并提升 LLM 与 agent 工作流的可解释性。
projects.content:
## Overview

Auto Ontology is an open Python library that builds a context layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes the resulting semantic, graph\-based reasoning layer to agent harnesses through MCP, CLI, and API\. It complements semantic models customers already own and supports discovery, grounding, validation, exposure, and learning\.

## Key Features

- Natural\-language querying of structured data translates questions to SQL and executes them against connected databases, powered by NVIDIA NIM\.
- Semantic catalog and ontology layer over relational sources, stored in Postgres alongside the catalog it describes\.
- Authentication and RBAC using Better Auth\.
- Web UI for chat, analysis, data catalog, analytics, and settings\.
- Flexible deployment through a Helm chart for Kubernetes or Docker Compose for a local stack\.
- Context exposure to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API\.

## Use Cases

- Grounding LLM and agent workflows with trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships\.
- Reconciling inconsistent definitions across systems so agents use shared, certified context\.
- Validating generated queries against certified definitions and lineage, with provenance returned with every answer\.
- Running natural\-language analytics over connected databases such as Databricks, Postgres, Snowflake, or DuckDB\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository and create a \.env file from \.env\.example, then fill in required values such as Postgres credentials, DEFAULT\_MODELS\_API\_KEY, and CONNECTION\_STRINGS\.
- Set AUTH\_SECRET and APP\_URL, which are required\.
- Build the images and start the local stack with Docker Compose\.
- Open the UI at localhost:3000; the backend API runs on port 3001 and pgAdmin on port 5050\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Local deployment requires Docker with Docker Compose v2, or Kubernetes using the provided Helm chart\.
- An NVIDIA API key is required for NVIDIA NIM chat and ingestion\.
- Connection details are required for source databases to query, such as Databricks, Postgres, Snowflake, or DuckDB\.
- Postgres with pgvector provides app metadata, the catalog and ontology, and the vector store\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Vault is off by default; a partial configuration is ignored with a warning and falls back to plaintext storage for connection credentials\.
- The FastAPI port is a trusted internal service boundary and must not be exposed publicly because its identity header is not independently verified by FastAPI\.
- Auto Ontology uses NVIDIA NIM endpoints for inference, which is an external dependency\.
- The project states it is currently not accepting external contributions\.

projects.description: Open-source AI video clipping app. Paste a link or local video, choose platforms, and AutoClip selects clips, frames speakers, adds subtitles, covers, and post copy for major short-video platforms. Editing and rendering run locally.
projects.descriptionZh: AutoClip 是开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，贴入 YouTube、B 站链接或本地视频并选择平台，即可自动完成挑片段、取景、字幕、封面和发布文案，输出适配抖音、小红书、B 站、TikTok、Reels、Shorts 与 YouTube 的成片。剪辑与渲染在本机完成，软件免费，云端模型按量计费。
projects.content:
## Overview

AutoClip is an open\-source AI video clipping desktop tool\. After you paste a link or local video and choose target platforms, it automatically clips footage, frames speakers, adds subtitles, and delivers videos, covers, and publishing copy\. It supports Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and YouTube\. Editing, framing, and rendering run on your computer, and the same production workflow is also available through CLI, MCP, and Docker\.

## Key Features

- Paste a link or local video, choose platforms, and automatically generate videos, covers, titles, descriptions, and hashtags, packaged as a ZIP release bundle\.
- Read the full transcript and select complete questions, answers, or points\. By default it automatically generates up to the 10 highest\-scored clips and lists the rest as alternatives\.
- Package by platform: Douyin and Xiaohongshu default to interview style, TikTok, Reels, and Shorts default to full\-screen podcast style, and Bilibili and YouTube use horizontal format\. Framing follows the speaker\.
- Use author\-provided subtitles, local Whisper or SenseVoice, or cloud transcription\. Choose Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT, Gemini, or local Ollama for analysis\.
- Desktop, CLI, and MCP share the same workflow and data directory\. CLI supports JSON output, MCP can be called by agents, and Docker can host a self\-built web service\.
- Clipping, framing, and rendering run locally\. The software is free, while cloud services are billed by the selected model or provider\.

## Use Cases

- Turn long interviews and podcasts into short videos for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Bilibili, or YouTube\.
- Batch process videos and feed CLI JSON output into scripts and pipelines\.
- Let MCP clients such as Claude, Cursor, and opencode call the same clip production workflow\.
- Run a self\-built web service on a server or NAS through Docker\.

## Getting Started

- Download and install the desktop version: choose the \.dmg for macOS Apple Silicon or the \-setup\.exe for Windows 10/11 x64\. The installer bundles Python and FFmpeg\.
- If the first launch is blocked, allow it in macOS Privacy & Security or click More info and then Run anyway in Windows SmartScreen\.
- In settings, choose a provider, enter an API key, select an analysis model, and test the connection\. For local models, start the service in Ollama or LM Studio and load the model first\.
- Use the sample project on the home page to see the result, then paste your own interview or podcast, preview the output, and download the release bundle or connect an account to publish\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop: macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon (M series), or Windows 10/11 x64\. Intel Macs do not have a desktop installer\.
- Docker: Docker and Compose v2 are required to self\-host a web service on a server or NAS\.
- CLI and MCP: Python 3\.10\+ (3\.11 recommended) and FFmpeg\.
- The desktop installer bundles Python and FFmpeg\. On Windows, the installer automatically downloads WebView2 if it is missing\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

## 项目简介

AutoClip 是一个开源的 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具。用户贴入链接或本地视频、选择目标平台后，它会自动剪片、取景、配字幕，并交付视频、封面和发布文案；支持抖音、小红书、B 站、TikTok、Reels、Shorts 与 YouTube。剪辑、取景与渲染在本机完成，也可通过 CLI、MCP 或 Docker 使用同一套出片流程。

## 核心功能

- 贴链接或本地视频，选择平台后自动生成成片、封面、标题、简介和话题，并打包为 ZIP 发布包。
- 自动读完整段字幕并挑选完整问答或观点片段，默认自动生成评分最高的 10 条，其余列为备选。
- 按平台包装：抖音和小红书默认访谈式，TikTok、Reels、Shorts 默认满屏播客式，B 站和 YouTube 为横版；画面跟随说话人。
- 支持作者字幕、本地 Whisper 或 SenseVoice、或云端转写；分析模型可选 Qwen、DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini 或本地 Ollama。
- 桌面应用、CLI 与 MCP 共用同一套流程和数据目录；CLI 支持 \-\-json 输出，MCP 可接入 Agent，Docker 可自建 Web 服务。
- 剪辑、取景与渲染在本机完成，软件免费，云端服务按所选模型或服务商计费。

## 适用场景

- 把访谈、播客等长视频剪成适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels、Shorts、B 站或 YouTube 的短视频。
- 批量处理视频，并通过 CLI 的 \-\-json 输出接入脚本和流水线。
- 让 Claude、Cursor、opencode 等 MCP 客户端调用同一条出片流程。
- 在服务器或 NAS 上通过 Docker 自建 Web 服务。

## 快速开始

- 下载并安装桌面版：macOS Apple Silicon 选 \.dmg，Windows 10/11 x64 选 \-setup\.exe；安装包自带 Python 和 FFmpeg。
- 首次打开如被系统拦截，按提示在 macOS 隐私与安全性中仍要打开，或在 Windows SmartScreen 点更多信息再仍要运行。

- 首页可先用示例项目查看效果，再贴自己的访谈或播客，预览并下载发布包或连接账号投稿。

## 部署与要求

- 桌面版：macOS 13 或更高，Apple Silicon（M 系列）；Windows 10/11 x64。Intel Mac 暂不支持桌面安装包。
- Docker：需要 Docker 与 Compose v2，可自建 Web 服务并运行在服务器或 NAS 上。
- CLI / MCP：Python 3\.10\+（建议 3\.11）与 FFmpeg。
- 桌面安装包自带 Python 和 FFmpeg；Windows 缺少 WebView2 时安装器会自动下载。

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- 桌面安装包尚未完成 Apple 公证和 Windows 代码签名，首次打开可能被系统拦截，需要按提示手动放行。
- 使用云端能力会发送字幕、文案、抽样画面或音频；本地分析与本地转写不需要对应云端 API。
- 软件本身免费且 MIT 开源，但云端分析、转写与生图按所选服务商计费。
- Intel Mac 暂无桌面安装包，需要改用 Docker 或 CLI。

projects.name: AutoSwarm
projects.tagline: All your agents, working as one
projects.taglineZh: 所有智能体，协同如一
projects.description: AutoSwarm is a lightweight plug-in that unifies supported AI agents, including Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Meta Muse Code, Grok, and Nanobot, so they share context and work as one coordinated team.
projects.descriptionZh: AutoSwarm 是一款轻量插件，可把 Codex、Claude Code、DeepSeek Harness、Meta Muse Code、Grok、Nanobot 等受支持的 AI 智能体统一为协同团队，让它们共享上下文与记忆，按能力选择智能体、并行执行任务并汇总结果。
projects.content:
## Overview

AutoSwarm turns fragmented agents into one coordinated team\. Given a task once, it selects agents by capability, shares context and memory, connects complementary tools and workflows, bridges data and application ecosystems, runs tasks in parallel, coordinates collaboration, and verifies and synthesizes results into one coherent answer\.

## Key Features

- Selects the right agents based on their capabilities\.
- Shares context and memory across agents\.
- Connects complementary tools and workflows and bridges data and application ecosystems\.
- Runs tasks in parallel and coordinates agent collaboration\.
- Verifies and synthesizes results into one coherent answer\.
- A lightweight plug\-in lets any supported agent serve as the entry point\.

## Use Cases

- Summarizing and comparing large document sets by delegating to multiple agents\.
- Coordinating coding, research, browsing, office work, writing, computer use, and social networking tasks across agents\.
- Running multi\-agent tasks in parallel for faster execution\.

## Getting Started

- Give AutoSwarm to an agent you already use and ask it to install or update AutoSwarm for that agent, reuse existing configuration, and verify which locally installed agents are available\.
- After installation, start a task by asking the agent to use AutoSwarm, for example to read 100 documents and summarize key approaches and disagreements\.
- For a first installation, obtain the official repository, install the package with uv tool install \-\-force \. or python \-m pip install \., and run autoswarm setup \-\-host with the appropriate host ID\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Python 3\.10\+ or uv for installation; setup installs the Skill, runtime, and host integration\.
- Works across Windows, macOS, and Linux\.
- Supports local command execution\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- AutoSwarm does not provide an automatic updater; updates are handled manually\.
- Users should not reuse the archived v1 environment\.
- Probing providers spends model calls to check a reply and native resume\.
- Version checks alone only establish executable discovery, not full provider verification\.
- Installing a missing provider CLI requires asking first and configuring only the agents needed\.

projects.name: AX
projects.tagline: Declarative orchestration for agentic workloads at scale
projects.taglineZh: 面向规模化智能体工作负载的声明式编排
projects.description: AX is Google's open agentic orchestration runtime that sandboxes tasks, configures workspaces, enforces network policies, and manages models so teams can run large numbers of agent workloads per cluster.
projects.descriptionZh: AX 是 Google 开源的智能体编排运行时，可对任务进行沙箱隔离、自动配置工作区、实施网络策略并集中管理模型，帮助团队在单个集群中运行大量智能体工作负载。
projects.content:
## Overview

AX is Google's open agentic orchestration runtime for running autonomous agent workloads in a cluster\. It uses declarative Task, Workspace, Gateway, and Model primitives to sandbox tasks, prepare workspaces, manage network policies and model configuration, and scale execution on Agent Substrate\.

## Key Features

- Declarative Task, Workspace, Gateway, and Model primitives expressed as ax\.io/v1alpha1 manifests and applied with one command
- Isolated task execution in a sandbox with CPU and memory limits; sandboxes are cheap to create, suspend, and throw away
- Workspace setup that can list Git repos, MCP servers, and skills or use a plain\-English goal to prepare the environment before the task starts
- Gateway network policies that lock traffic down to an explicit allowlist of hosts and ports and inject credentials into incoming requests
- Centralized model configuration for models, model parameters, and secrets, including key rotation or model version pinning with one apply
- Scaling on Agent Substrate with lightweight actors, sub\-second resumption, and dense multiplexing of tasks across worker resources

## Use Cases

- Running interactive coding agents, long\-running agent servers, Jupyter notebooks, headless browser testing, and custom tool runtimes
- Spinning up reproducible sandboxes for trajectory collection, reinforcement learning loops, and agent evaluation at scale
- Operating large fleets of isolated agent workloads per Kubernetes cluster with explicit network policies
- Using a single task per agent or composing as many tasks as an agent needs

## Getting Started

- Install Agent Substrate in the Kubernetes cluster and verify its Control API service is reachable\.
- Install the AX CLI with go install github\.com/google/ax/cmd/ax@latest and ensure the Go bin directory is on PATH\.
- Set AX\_IMAGE\_REPO to your registry, then run make images to build and push the ax\-server and ax\-task\-runner images\.
- Run make deploy to deploy the AX control plane\.
- Apply an example task with ax apply \-f examples/task\.yaml, inspect it with ax get tasks, and use ax ssh, ax suspend, and ax resume for lifecycle operations\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A Kubernetes cluster with Agent Substrate installed; Substrate must be running and expose its Control API at api\.ate\-system\.svc\.cluster\.local:443 before AX is deployed\.
- Go and kubectl\.
- Podman or Docker authenticated to a container registry your cluster can pull from\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- AX and several of its features are in heavy development, which is a maturity caution for adopters\.

## 项目简介

AX 是 Google 开源的智能体编排运行时，用于在集群中运行自主智能体工作负载。它通过 Task、Workspace、Gateway 和 Model 等声明式原语，对任务进行沙箱隔离、准备工作区、管理网络策略与模型配置，并在 Agent Substrate 上扩展执行。

## 核心功能

- 声明式 Task、Workspace、Gateway、Model 原语以 ax\.io/v1alpha1 清单表达，一条命令即可应用；在带 CPU 和内存限制的沙箱中隔离运行任务，沙箱创建、暂停和丢弃成本低；工作区可列出 Git 仓库、MCP 服务器和技能，或用自然语言描述目标，在任务开始前准备环境；Gateway 网络策略可将流量限制到明确的主机和端口允许列表，并向传入请求注入凭据；集中配置模型、模型参数和密钥，可通过一次应用完成密钥轮换或模型版本固定；基于 Agent Substrate 扩展，使用轻量 actor、亚秒级恢复和任务在 worker

## 适用场景

- 运行交互式编码智能体、长时间运行的智能体服务器、Jupyter 笔记本、无头浏览器测试和自定义工具运行时；为轨迹收集、强化学习循环和大规模智能体评估启动大量可复现沙箱；在具有明确网络策略的 Kubernetes 集群中运行大量隔离智能体工作负载；每个智能体使用单个任务，或按需组合多个任务。

## 快速开始

- 在 Kubernetes 集群中安装 Agent Substrate，并确认其 Control API 服务可访问。使用 go install github\.com/google/ax/cmd/ax@latest 安装 AX CLI，并确保 Go 的 bin 目录在 PATH 中。将 AX\_IMAGE\_REPO 指向你的镜像仓库，运行 make images 构建并推送 ax\-server 与 ax\-task\-runner 镜像。运行 make deploy 部署 AX 控制平面。使用 ax apply \-f examples/task\.yaml

## 部署与要求

- 需要已安装 Agent Substrate 的 Kubernetes 集群；部署 AX 前，Substrate 必须运行并在 api\.ate\-system\.svc\.cluster\.local:443 暴露 Control API。需要 Go 和 kubectl。需要 Podman 或 Docker，并已通过集群可拉取镜像的容器仓库认证。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

baoyu\-design packages Claude Design as a portable Agent Skill for local file\-capable coding agents\. It runs in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other supported agents, producing polished design artifacts as self\-contained HTML while keeping the work in the repository\.

## Key Features

- Portable Agent Skill that runs Claude Design in local coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Codex\.
- Produces polished UI mockups, interactive prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, dashboards, mobile apps, and slide decks as self\-contained HTML\.
- Includes built\-in skills for core design, decks, mobile and motion, web and campaigns, data and research, documents, 3D, illustration, design systems, import and export, and AI assets\.
- Ships starter components for device, browser, and social shells; design canvases; slide, animation, chart, document, file, and 3D stages; and a watercolor runtime\.
- Supports design\-system import and use from Figma \.fig files decoded offline, GitHub repositories, and existing HTML or CSS\.
- Exports standalone HTML, PDF, editable or screenshot PPTX, MP4 video, and handoff to Figma, Canva, or Claude Code\.

## Use Cases

- Creating hi\-fi UI variations, interactive prototypes, and wireframes for product screens\.
- Building slide decks with speaker notes and per\-element animations, then exporting to PowerPoint\.
- Turning a Figma \.fig kit, GitHub repository, or existing HTML or CSS into a reusable design system\.
- Building data\-backed dashboards or mobile app prototypes from local artifacts\.

## Getting Started

- Install with npx skills add JimLiu/baoyu\-design, optionally targeting Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex\.
- Describe a design task in plain language; the skill auto\-activates and asks clarifying questions\.
- Preview deliverables over localhost using the agent's browser preview or a local HTTP server such as python3 \-m http\.server 4311 \-\-directory designs\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A local file\-capable coding agent such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or another supported agent\.
- Claude Opus 4\.8 selected as the model for best results\.
- Node\.js for the npx installer; Python 3 is handy for the local preview server\.
- Deliverables are previewed over HTTP because multi\-file prototypes will not load from file paths\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The skill is tuned for strong models, with Claude Opus 4\.8 recommended for best output\.
- The project is an independent community repackaging and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic\.

projects.content:
## Overview

baoyu\-skills is a repository of skills shared by Baoyu for improving daily work efficiency with AI Agents such as Claude Code and Codex\. It organizes content generation, AI generation, and utility skills, with installation and update flows for agent environments\.

## Key Features

- Provides Agent Skills for Claude Code, Codex, and similar AI agents\.
- Organizes skills into Content Skills, AI Generation Skills, and Utility Skills\.
- Includes content creation skills for Xiaohongshu image cards, infographics, diagrams, cover images, slide decks, comics, and article illustrations\.
- Supports publishing workflows for X (Twitter) and WeChat Official Account\.
- Supports installation via npx skills add, plugin marketplace commands, and Codex project\-level skill directories\.
- Supports publishing individual skills to ClawHub / OpenClaw\.

## Use Cases

- Generate visual content for articles, including cover images, illustrations, diagrams, infographics, slide decks, and comics\.
- Create Xiaohongshu image card series from articles or direct content\.
- Publish content to X (Twitter) and WeChat Official Account\.
- Install selected skills in Claude Code, Codex, or other agent environments to support daily content and utility workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Install Node\.js and ensure you can run npx bun commands\.
- Quick install with npx skills add jimliu/baoyu\-skills\.
- For Codex project\-level install, copy or symlink each needed skill as a full directory under \.agents/skills\.
- Register as a plugin marketplace with /plugin marketplace add JimLiu/baoyu\-skills\.
- Install the baoyu\-skills plugin with /plugin install baoyu\-skills@baoyu\-skills\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js environment\.
- Ability to run npx bun commands\.
- For WeChat publishing, API credentials configured in the user\-level or project\-level \.baoyu\-skills/\.env file; remote API publishing also requires an SSH\-reachable server whose IP is on WeChat's allowlist\.
- For browser\-based WeChat publishing, Chrome and a login session\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Installing every skill in the repository can add unnecessary context overhead for the AI agent on each run, so only needed skills should be installed\.
- WeChat API credentials placed in project\-level environment files should not be committed to Git\.
- Fast WeChat publishing via API depends on API credentials and a local IP allowlisted in WeChat\.
- Remote API publishing requires an SSH\-reachable server whose IP is on WeChat's allowlist\.

## Overview

Beacon is a self\-improving memory layer for AI coding agents\. It captures agent sessions across multiple coding harnesses and turns them into a compounding knowledge layer\.

## Key Features

- Captures agent sessions across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and 20\+ other harnesses\.
- Turns agent session history into a compounding knowledge layer\.
- Uses Jev to identify valuable lessons buried in agent sessions and turn them into reusable skills\.
- Helps each agent start smarter than the last by carrying lessons across sessions\.
- Works with many popular coding agents and harnesses\.

## Use Cases

- Carry lessons from previous coding sessions into new agent sessions\.
- Reuse high\-signal workflows, corrections, and debugging patterns as skills across agents\.
- Work across multiple coding harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Beacon CLI with the provided install command\.
- Sign up for a free Beacon account; no credit card is required\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Beacon depends on Jev to evaluate agent sessions and identify valuable lessons for reuse\.

projects.name: Bernstein
projects.tagline: Open-source governance layer for AI agents
projects.taglineZh: 面向 AI 智能体的开源治理层
projects.description: Bernstein is an open-source governance layer for AI agents. A deterministic Python scheduler runs agents in parallel without a model in the coordination loop, enforces policy as code, and produces verifiable, replayable records.
projects.descriptionZh: Bernstein 是面向 AI 智能体的开源治理层。确定性的 Python 调度器让智能体并行运行，协调环路中不引入模型，并将策略作为代码强制执行，生成可验证、可重放的记录。
projects.content:
## Overview

Bernstein is an open\-source governance layer for AI agents\. You write policy as code defining who may do what, what needs approval, and what must be recorded; Bernstein enforces it and produces a verifiable record\. A deterministic Python scheduler runs agents in parallel without a model in the coordination loop, so the same plan can replay byte\-identically\. It supports CLI coding agents out of the box and governs other agent workloads whose deliverables can be diffs, reports, datasets, or audit evidence packs\.

## Key Features

- Policy\-as\-code enforcement: you write the rules, Bernstein enforces them, and produces the verifiable record\.
- Deterministic Python scheduler with no model in the coordination loop, enabling byte\-identical replay of the same plan\.
- Parallel agents run in isolated git worktrees behind merge gates; artifact\-mode tasks use separate working directories\.
- Offline verification through signed run receipts, HMAC\-chained audit logs, and a replay journal that surfaces divergence at the exact step\.
- Support for CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, plus more than 50 selectable adapters\.
- Runs on laptops, on\-prem, air\-gapped environments, Cloudflare Workers, and Kubernetes without forcing a SaaS hop\.

## Use Cases

- Running multiple CLI coding agents in parallel on a repository while verifying each diff with tests, lint, and type checks before merge\.
- Producing audit evidence packs with a declarative YAML workflow and signed lineage receipts\.
- Governing research reports, datasets, action logs, or operations results through artifact contracts\.
- Operating agent workloads on\-prem, air\-gapped, in Cloudflare Workers, or on Kubernetes\.

## Getting Started

- Install with uv tool install bernstein or pipx install bernstein\.
- Run bernstein init to create the \.sdd workspace and bernstein\.yaml\.
- Run bernstein doctor to check that a CLI agent is installed and authenticated\.
- Start a goal with bernstein \-g "fix the failing test in tests/test\_foo\.py"\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Deployment can be on a laptop, on\-prem behind a firewall, air\-gapped, Cloudflare Workers, Kubernetes, or a hybrid of those\.
- The air\-gap install profile and air\-gapped wheelhouse are documented\.
- Sandbox execution mode is supported with Cloudflare Sandbox and local Docker\.
- Python 3\.12\+ is indicated in the repository badges\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project describes itself as beta software maintained by one person\.
- Release numbers indicate release count rather than maturity, and minor versions may change interfaces; pin versions for dependent work\.
- Telemetry is opt\-in and defaults to local\-only; data leaves only according to the user's configuration\.

projects.name: billion-context
projects.tagline: Context-compression plugin for long coding sessions
projects.taglineZh: 面向长时间编码会话的上下文压缩插件
projects.description: billion-context is a context-compression plugin that lets agents work with small context windows, use about 5x fewer tokens, and sustain month-long single sessions handling billions of tokens.
projects.descriptionZh: billion-context 是一款上下文压缩插件，让智能体在小上下文窗口（10 万上下文即可）下工作，token 用量约为原来的五分之一，并能支撑持续数月、累计数十亿 token 的单次会话。
projects.content:
## Overview

billion\-context sits between an agent and its model API and rewrites Anthropic or OpenAI streams using acp\-kernel compression\. It compresses consumed conversation into layered summaries so a single session can run for days, with the model deciding when and what to compress rather than relying on a hard truncation limit\. Compression is described as incremental, reversible, and prefix\-cache friendly\.

## Key Features

- Compresses consumed conversation into layered summaries so one context window can support days\-long sessions and billions of tokens\.
- Works as a proxy between agents and model APIs, parsing Anthropic or OpenAI request shapes and rewriting streaming responses\.
- Injects context\-management tools: compress, decompress, search\_context, and acp\_status\.
- Keeps compression incremental, reversible, and prefix\-cache friendly, with summaries restorable on demand\.
- Offers native plugin, launcher, and base URL prefix usage modes across many coding clients\.
- Describes a healthy session as keeping a 95–97% prefix\-cache hit rate, with compression itself costing ≤2%\.

## Use Cases

- Long coding sessions that would otherwise exceed a model's context window\.
- Reducing token usage and cost during agent interactions\.
- Running a single agent session continuously for days or months while processing billions of tokens\.
- Adding context compression to clients such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi, Gemini CLI, and others\.

## Getting Started

- Install with npm install \-g billion\-context \-\-prefix=~/\.local on Linux or macOS, or npm install \-g billion\-context on Windows\.
- Choose a usage mode: native plugin with bili plugin install \<client\>, launcher with bili \<client\>, or URL prefix by starting bili and prefixing the client base URL with the local proxy's /bili/ path\.
- In native plugin mode, supported clients include pi, omp, opencode, dsh, kimi, hermes, and zcode\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Installation uses npm; the global package provides the bili command, with bili\-proxy kept as an alias\.
- On Linux or macOS, a user\-level npm prefix avoids sudo and permission errors; the Windows default npm prefix is user\-writable\.
- Native plugin mode requires a client with a plugin seam; clients without one use launcher or /bili/ prefix modes\.
- Some launcher modes use certificate\-based MITM or environment\-specific base URL rewrites, depending on the client\.
- A manual bili start uses port 8787; client lanes use a self\-managed zone starting at 18787 and hop by one on collisions\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Native plugins and standalone in\-process extensions are mutually exclusive; running both causes double compression\.
- Claude Desktop Code tab sessions bypass the proxy and therefore get neither bili compression nor native auto\-compaction\.
- Goose cannot use certificate\-based MITM because rustls trusts no CA file; it uses plain\-HTTP base URL redirects instead\.

## 核心功能

## Overview

brag is an agent skill that turns a project into a twenty\-second launch video\. It generates music, motion, and share copy from one command and is designed for agents such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode, Google Antigravity, and other Agent Skills\-compatible tools\.

## Key Features

- Generates a short launch video from a project with one command, including music, motion, and share copy\.
- Includes /brag\-slim, a lean single\-file version for Claude Opus 5\.5 that uses tools already on the machine without Hyperframes or bundled assets\.
- Offers /brag \-\-full for the classic Hyperframes workflow with bundled assets\.
- Supports tone steering with \-\-tone and optional voiceover with \-\-voice; voiceover is off by default\.
- Outputs a brag\-output folder containing the plan, composition brief, share copy, and rendered brag\.mp4\.
- Works across Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode, Google Antigravity, and other agents through standard skill discovery paths\.

## Use Cases

- Creating a shareable launch video for a newly built project\.
- Producing a 20\-second product teaser with music, motion, and social copy\.
- Using /brag\-slim in Claude Opus 5\.5 for a lean launch\-video workflow built with existing local tools\.

## Getting Started

- In Claude Code, add the latent\-spaces/brag plugin marketplace and install brag@brag\.
- For other agents, use the skills CLI to add the brag skill from its repository\.
- Run /brag inside any project\.
- Install or use /brag\-slim for the lean Opus 5\.5 workflow; it is included in the brag plugin from version 0\.4\.0\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- An agent that supports Agent Skills, such as Claude Code, opencode, Codex CLI, or an agent with custom instructions\.
- Node\.js 22 or later\.
- FFmpeg available on PATH\.
- Hyperframes CLI via npx hyperframes for the classic /brag workflow, checkable with npx hyperframes doctor\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The lean /brag\-slim workflow does not use Hyperframes or bundled assets\.
- Classic /brag voiceover relies on Kokoro through Hyperframes when enabled\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Browser Harness is a thin, self\-healing harness built directly on CDP\. It connects an LLM to a real browser through one editable CDP websocket, and the agent writes missing helpers as it works so the harness improves with every task\. It can run on local Chrome, stealth browsers, or a Browser Use Box, and it offers an MCP server for MCP clients\.

## Key Features

- Thin self\-healing harness built directly on CDP\.
- Connects an LLM directly to a real browser through one editable CDP websocket\.
- Agents write missing helpers mid\-task in their local workspace, so the harness improves with every task\.
- Protected core source stays separate while agents write reusable helpers\.
- MCP server browser\-harness\-mcp exposes browser control helpers as MCP tools over stdio\.
- Can run on local Chrome, stealth browsers, or 24/7 on your own Browser Use Box\.

## Use Cases

- Complete browser tasks such as opening a profile, finding the latest 20 video posts, and downloading them\.
- Handle logged\-in, personal browser work with a local browser\.
- Scale many browsers in parallel with live previews, proxies, stealth, and CAPTCHA solving through Browser Use Cloud\.
- Drive the browser from MCP clients such as Claude Code, Devin, and Cursor without writing a second CDP layer\.

## Getting Started

- Paste the provided setup prompt into Claude Code or Codex\.
- Install or upgrade browser\-harness to the latest stable version with uv using Python 3\.12\.
- Register the skill from browser\-harness skill and connect it to your browser\.
- On first setup, tick the checkbox in chrome://inspect/\#remote\-debugging so the agent can connect to your browser\.
- If setup or connection fails, follow install\.md\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- First\-time connection to a local browser requires enabling remote debugging in Chrome\.
- Local browser recordings are optional and default to off, with existing preferences preserved on upgrades\.
- Scaling to many parallel browsers depends on Browser Use Cloud for features such as live previews, proxies, stealth, and CAPTCHA solving\.

projects.description: BrowserOS neo, formerly BrowserClaw, is a free, open-source, local browser that AI agents such as Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, and Cursor drive using your logged-in accounts. Watch every step live, run agents in parallel, and replay any
projects.descriptionZh: BrowserOS neo，前身为 BrowserClaw，是一款本地开源浏览器，你的 AI 智能体（Claude、Cowork、Codex、Cursor）可使用你已登录的账户来驱动它。可观看每一步、并行运行多个智能体、回放任意会话。免费。
projects.content:
## Overview

BrowserOS neo is a local, open\-source browser designed for AI agents to drive with your logged\-in accounts\. It is a secondary browser that runs on your machine, lets agents work in parallel in their own tabs, and records sessions for live watching or replay\.

## Key Features

- Imports your logins, bookmarks, and extensions from Chrome in one click so agents can use your real accounts\.
- Connects to MCP\-compatible AI agents with one\-click setup, including Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Zed, and GitHub Copilot\.
- Runs multiple agents at once, each in its own isolated tabs, while you keep browsing in your tabs\.
- Records every session as a scrubbable video on your disk with a step\-by\-step action timeline for live watching or replay\.
- Keeps sessions, screenshots, history, and settings local under ~/\.browserclaw/ and never uploads them\.
- Uses compact page snapshots and batches actions to reduce token use compared with alternatives\.

## Use Cases

- Post content to social media and pull engagement numbers while signed in as you\.
- Clear an inbox and unsubscribe from junk email\.
- Update a CRM, file expenses, and pull reports from internal tools\.
- Plan a trip, book flights, or compare prices\.

## Getting Started

- Download BrowserOS neo for macOS or Windows, or install on macOS with Homebrew using brew tap browseros\-ai/tap and brew install \-\-cask browseros\-neo\.
- Import logins, bookmarks, and extensions from Chrome in one click\.
- Connect an MCP\-compatible agent such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, OpenClaw, or Hermes with one click\.
- Give the agent a task from your terminal or IDE, such as booking a flight, and watch it live or replay it later\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on macOS and Windows; system requirements match Google Chrome\.
- Requires an MCP\-compatible AI agent such as Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or GitHub Copilot\.
- You bring your own AI provider keys\.
- Runs locally on your machine and is not a cloud browser or headless driver\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- BrowserOS neo was renamed from BrowserClaw; the old name still appears in some places, including the GitHub repository and MCP server name\.
- BrowserOS neo sends anonymous product\-usage events by default, but never URLs, page content, prompts, tool results, or screenshots; this can be turned off in Settings\.
- Agents use your existing logged\-in sessions by default; per\-agent profile isolation is only on the roadmap, not shipped\.
- BrowserOS neo depends on an MCP\-compatible AI agent for control; other tools must connect via URL\.

## 项目简介

BrowserOS neo 是一款本地开源浏览器，专为 AI 智能体使用你已登录的账户进行驱动而设计。它是一款运行在你机器上的辅助浏览器，智能体可在各自独立的标签页中并行工作，会话会被录制下来，供实时观看或回放。

## 核心功能

- 从 Chrome 一键导入登录信息、书签与扩展，让智能体使用你的真实账户。
- 通过一键设置连接兼容 MCP 的 AI 智能体，包括 Claude Code、Cowork、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Zed 和 GitHub Copilot。
- 可同时运行多个智能体，每个智能体使用各自独立的标签页，你仍可在自己的标签页中继续浏览。
- 将每个会话录制为你磁盘上可拖动回放的视频，并附带分步操作时间线，便于实时观看或回放。
- 会话、截图、历史记录与设置都保存在本地 ~/\.browserclaw/ 下，不会上传。
- 使用紧凑的页面快照并批量执行操作，与替代方案相比可减少 token 消耗。

## 适用场景

- 以你的身份登录后，向社交媒体发布内容并获取互动数据。
- 清理收件箱，退订垃圾邮件。
- 更新 CRM、提交费用报销，并从内部工具中拉取报告。
- 规划行程、预订航班或比较价格。

## 快速开始

- 为 macOS 或 Windows 下载 BrowserOS neo，或在 macOS 上使用 Homebrew 安装：brew tap browseros\-ai/tap 和 brew install \-\-cask browseros\-neo。
- 从 Chrome 一键导入登录信息、书签与扩展。
- 使用一键操作连接兼容 MCP 的智能体，例如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、OpenClaw 或 Hermes。
- 在你的终端或 IDE 中给智能体下达任务，例如预订航班，并实时观看或稍后回放。

## 部署与要求

- 运行于 macOS 和 Windows；系统要求与 Google Chrome 相同。
- 需要兼容 MCP 的 AI 智能体，例如 Claude Code、Cowork、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Zed 或 GitHub Copilot。
- 你需要提供自己的 AI 服务商密钥。
- 完全在本地机器上运行，不是云浏览器，也不是无头驱动。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：AGPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: Buzz
projects.tagline: A self-hostable workspace for humans and AI agents
projects.taglineZh: 人类与 AI 代理可共同使用的自托管工作区
projects.description: Buzz is a self-hostable communication platform built on a Nostr relay, giving humans and AI agents shared channels, threads, workflows, git events, search, and an audit log in one workspace.
projects.descriptionZh: Buzz 是一个基于 Nostr 中继的自托管集体智能沟通与工作区平台，让人和 AI 代理共享频道、线程、工作流、Git 事件、搜索和审计日志。
projects.content:
## Overview

Buzz is a self\-hostable workspace and communication platform where humans and AI agents share the same rooms\. It is built on a Nostr relay, so messages, reactions, workflow steps, review approvals, and git events are signed events in one log with the same identity model and audit trail\.

## Key Features

- Shared channels, threads, direct messages, canvases, media, search, and an audit log for people and agents\.
- Agents have their own keys, channel memberships, and audit trail, so they can act as members rather than bots\.
- Git events use NIP\-34 for patches, repository announcements, and status, with a git hosting backend\.
- YAML workflows support message, reaction, schedule, and webhook triggers\.
- Desktop app built with Tauri and React, plus a buzz\-cli designed for agent\-first JSON input and output\.
- Search covers conversation, patches, workflow runs, and approvals because they are all events in the same log\.

## Use Cases

- Use an agent to search six months of project history and post the relevant threads, root causes, and fixes when someone asks whether an error has been seen before\.
- Let an agent triage a bug with its own identity and channel access rather than broad permission flags\.
- Turn a feature branch into a room where patches, CI, review, and the merge decision live together\.
- Run a release workflow where an agent reads merged pull requests, drafts release notes, posts them for human review, and ships after approval\.

## Getting Started

- Download a packaged build from the latest release for macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Linux x86\_64, or Windows x64\.
- By default the app connects to ws://localhost:3000; set BUZZ\_RELAY\_URL before launching or switch the relay inside the app to use another relay\.
- To run a hosted relay without managing servers, deploy a relay to Railway\.
- To build and run from source, install Docker and Hermit, clone the repository, activate Hermit, run just setup and just build, then run just dev\.
- For agents, set BUZZ\_PRIVATE\_KEY and use buzz\-cli, which accepts JSON input and returns JSON output for LLM tool calls\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Source builds require Docker and Hermit, or Rust 1\.88\+, Node 24\+, pnpm 10\+, and just\.
- Local development uses Docker services and migrations through just setup; just dev starts the relay and desktop app together\.
- A single\-node or VPS relay can use the production Compose bundle in deploy/compose with Docker Compose, Postgres, Redis, MinIO, and optional Caddy/TLS\.
- On Windows, the agent shell tool needs bash; install Git for Windows or set BUZZ\_SHELL to another bash\-compatible shell path\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- This repository is Buzz 0\.X and remains available and supported while Buzz 1\.0 is hosted separately\.
- The Buzz 1\.0 plugin API is a preview and can break with updates\.
- The Windows packaged build is not code\-signed and may trigger SmartScreen on first launch\.
- Workflow approval gates are partially implemented, with infrastructure present but integration still in progress\.
- The project states that it is not finished and distinguishes what works from what does not\.

## 项目简介

Buzz 是一个自托管的工作区与沟通平台，人类和 AI 代理共享同一批房间。它构建在 Nostr 中继之上，消息、反应、工作流步骤、评审批准和 Git 事件都是同一日志中的签名事件，并采用相同的身份模型与审计轨迹。

## 核心功能

- 为人和代理提供共享频道、线程、私信、画布、媒体、搜索和审计日志。
- 代理拥有自己的密钥、频道成员身份和审计轨迹，可作为成员而非机器人行动。
- Git 事件使用 NIP\-34 表示补丁、仓库公告和状态，并提供 Git 托管后端。
- YAML 工作流支持消息、反应、定时和 webhook 触发器。
- 桌面应用使用 Tauri 和 React 构建，并提供面向代理的 buzz\-cli，支持 JSON 输入和 JSON 输出。
- 搜索覆盖对话、补丁、工作流运行和审批，因为它们都是同一日志中的事件。

## 适用场景

- 当有人询问某个错误是否出现过，代理可搜索六个月的项目历史，并发布相关线程、根因和修复。
- 让代理用自己的身份和频道访问权限分诊缺陷，而不是依赖宽泛的权限开关。
- 把功能分支变成一个房间，让补丁、CI、评审和合并决定共处其中。
- 运行发布工作流：代理读取已合并的拉取请求，起草发布说明，提交人工评审，并在批准后发布。

## 快速开始

- 从最新发布版下载适用于 macOS Apple Silicon、macOS Intel、Linux x86\_64 或 Windows x64 的打包版本。
- 应用默认连接 ws://localhost:3000；启动前设置 BUZZ\_RELAY\_URL，或在应用内切换中继，即可使用其他中继。
- 若不想自行管理服务器，可将中继部署到 Railway，运行团队自用的托管中继。
- 如需从源码构建和运行，安装 Docker 与 Hermit，克隆仓库，激活 Hermit，运行 just setup 和 just build，然后运行 just dev。
- 供代理使用时，设置 BUZZ\_PRIVATE\_KEY 并使用 buzz\-cli；它接受 JSON 输入并为 LLM 工具调用返回 JSON 输出。

## 部署与要求

- 从源码构建需要 Docker 和 Hermit，或 Rust 1\.88\+、Node 24\+、pnpm 10\+ 与 just。
- 本地开发通过 just setup 使用 Docker 服务和迁移；just dev 会同时启动中继和桌面应用。
- 单节点或 VPS 中继可使用 deploy/compose 中的生产 Compose 套件，包含 Docker Compose、Postgres、Redis、MinIO，以及可选的 Caddy/TLS。
- 在 Windows 上，代理 shell 工具需要 bash；安装 Git for Windows，或将 BUZZ\_SHELL 设为其他兼容 bash 的 shell 路径。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: Bytebase
projects.tagline: Unified database governance for teams and AI agents
projects.taglineZh: 统一数据库治理，覆盖团队与 AI 代理
projects.description: Bytebase is an open-source database governance platform that gives teams and AI agents a single control plane to change, access, and audit databases across major database types and environments.
projects.descriptionZh: Bytebase 是一个开源数据库治理平台，为团队和 AI 代理提供单一控制平面，用于跨主流数据库类型与环境安全地变更、访问和审计数据库。
projects.content:
## Overview

Bytebase is an open\-source database governance platform that acts as a single control plane between users, including humans and AI agents, and databases\. It governs database change management, access control, and compliance so every change and query is reviewed, controlled, and recorded\. Bytebase supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis, MariaDB, TiDB, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Spanner, OceanBase, and more\.

## Key Features

- GUI\-based change workflow for requesting, reviewing, deploying, and rolling back database changes through a web console\.
- GitOps integration with native GitHub/GitLab support for database\-as\-code workflows\.
- SQL review with more than 200 lint rules to enforce SQL standards and best practices\.
- Access control with fine\-grained RBAC, just\-in\-time access grants with automatic revocation, and role\-based dynamic data masking\.
- Compliance capabilities including audit logging, codified policy through Terraform Provider and API, and data classification\.
- AI features including an MCP server for AI agents and IDEs, text\-to\-SQL in the SQL Editor, and a built\-in page agent for natural\-language workflow guidance or execution\.

## Use Cases

- For development teams: implement database schema version control, automate database deployments through CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate on database changes with review workflows\.
- For DBAs: centralize database management across all environments, enforce organization\-wide SQL standards and policies, and monitor and audit all database activities\.
- For security teams: control data access with column\-level permissions, implement data masking for sensitive information, and maintain compliance with audit trails\.

## Getting Started

- Run the Docker quick start: docker run \-\-init \-\-name bytebase \-\-publish 8080:8080 \-\-volume ~/\.bytebase/data:/var/opt/bytebase bytebase/bytebase:latest
- Run the Kubernetes quick start: helm install bytebase bytebase/bytebase
- Visit localhost:8080 and follow the setup wizard\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Self\-hosted Docker quick start uses the bytebase/bytebase image with port 8080 published and a data volume mounted at /var/opt/bytebase\.
- Self\-hosted Kubernetes quick start uses the bytebase/bytebase Helm chart\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- GitOps database\-as\-code workflows use GitHub or GitLab integration\.
- AI agent and IDE integration depends on the Model Context Protocol\.
