projects.content:
## Overview

Concat is a free, open\-source video editor positioned as a CapCut replacement\. It runs locally on a native Rust engine with a GPU compositor and supports macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and iOS\. It provides auto\-captions, text\-to\-speech, voice cloning, background removal, keyframes, effects, titles, multi\-track editing, and up to 4K export without watermarks, accounts, or subscriptions\.

## Key Features

- Offline auto\-captions using local Whisper, with styled captions placed on the timeline\.
- Text\-to\-speech and voice cloning, with generated speech added to the timeline\.
- Background removal for people or objects, or manual mask painting with a smart brush\.
- Keyframes with a curve editor for position, scale, rotation, opacity, volume, and effect parameters\.
- Titles with fonts, stroke, shadow, background plate, and presets\.
- 4K 10\-bit export in H\.264, HEVC, and AV1 up to 4K 60, without a watermark\.

## Use Cases

- TikTok, Reels, and Shorts edits
- YouTube videos, tutorials, and screen recordings
- Podcast clips
- Memes

## Getting Started

- Download the build for your platform from the website or GitHub Releases\.
- Install it, import footage, and edit in the editor window\.
- Optionally download AI models once from Settings for offline captions, voices, and cutout\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and iOS\.
- Minimum: any 64\-bit processor from 2013 or later, 4 GB of RAM, and 500 MB of storage, with no GPU required\.
- For smooth 1080p editing and quick 4K exports: 6 cores or more, a GPU with Metal, DirectX 12, or Vulkan, and 16 GB of RAM\.
- Optional AI models download once from Settings and work offline afterward\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project describes itself as still having rough edges\.
- Windows builds are not code\-signed, so SmartScreen may require manual approval\.
- macOS builds are unsigned and require clearing the quarantine flag after installation\.
- iOS is in beta and must be sideloaded rather than installed from the App Store\.
- AI models for captions, voices, and cutout are optional downloads and need to be fetched once before offline use\.

projects.taglineZh: 连接编码智能体与模型的控制平面
projects.description: Context Mode is a control plane between AI coding agents and model APIs. It folds tool output before the model reads it, archives full output, persists memory and skills across sessions, and enforces rules for commands and file reads.
projects.descriptionZh: Context Mode 是位于 AI 编码智能体与模型 API 之间的控制平面。它在模型读取前折叠工具输出并归档完整内容，跨会话保留记忆与技能，并对命令、文件读取和网页抓取执行规则。
projects.content:
## Overview

Context Mode is a control plane that sits between AI coding agents and model APIs\. It acts before requests go out, before tool calls run, and when results return, aiming to lower request costs, carry session memory across agents and machines, and enforce rules over what agents may run, read and fetch\.

## Key Features

- Folds test, build, log and large tool output before the model reads it while keeping the full output in an archive\.
- Runs scripts so only the answer returns to the model, and trims tool schemas\.
- Maintains active context with recent work unchanged and an index of older work\.
- Shares memory facts and skills across agents and machines, with session resume\.
- Protect checks commands, file reads, web fetches and tool\-server calls against team rules before execution\.
- The console shows tokens, cost, savings and blocks for each request\.

## Use Cases

- Reducing model costs for long agentic coding sessions and test\-fix loops\.
- Handling large logs, JSON files and API responses without sending entire outputs to the model\.
- Continuing long sessions after pauses or on another machine without compaction\.
- Blocking access to environment files, protected branches, destructive commands and restricted sites\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx @context\-mode/cli; it signs you in, asks which agents to connect, and keeps a backup of each file\.
- Restart your agent and start a new session\.
- Use the console to watch tokens, cost, saving and blocks for every request\.
- To leave, run npx @context\-mode/cli disconnect\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Your own Anthropic or OpenAI account pays the model; Context Mode adds no fee on tokens\.
- The CLI connects Claude Code and Codex by changing the base URL and writing configuration files\.
- Enterprise can run on Context Mode cloud, a dedicated instance, or the customer's own Cloudflare account\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Protect examines the tool call rather than the program, so script files or compiled programs can bypass its checks; the agent sandbox should stay on\.
- Model usage remains billed to the user's own Anthropic or OpenAI account\.
- Published benchmark comparisons include Claude Code on Opus 5\.5, and no Codex benchmark figure is provided\.

## 项目简介

Context Mode 是介于 AI 编码智能体与模型 API 之间的控制平面。它在请求发出前、工具调用执行前以及结果返回时介入，目标是降低请求成本、让会话记忆跨智能体和机器延续，并约束智能体可运行、读取和抓取的内容。

## 核心功能

- 在模型读取前折叠测试、构建、日志和大型工具输出，同时将完整输出保留在归档中。运行脚本后仅把答案返回模型，并精简工具模式。维护活动上下文：近期工作保持不变，较早工作以索引呈现。跨智能体和机器共享记忆事实与技能，并支持会话恢复。Protect 在执行前依据团队规则检查命令、文件读取、网页抓取和工具服务器调用。控制台显示每次请求的 token、成本、节省和拦截情况。

## 适用场景

- 降低长时间智能体编码会话和测试修复循环的模型成本。处理大型日志、JSON 文件和 API 响应时，无需把完整输出发送给模型。在暂停后或另一台机器上继续长会话，而无需压缩上下文。拦截对环境文件、受保护分支、破坏性命令和受限网站的访问。

## 快速开始

- 运行 npx @context\-mode/cli；该命令会登录、询问要连接哪些智能体，并为每个文件保留备份。重启智能体并开始新会话。使用控制台查看每次请求的 token、成本、节省和拦截情况。要退出，运行 npx @context\-mode/cli disconnect。

## 部署与要求

- 模型费用由你自己的 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 账户支付；Context Mode 不对 token 加收费用。CLI 通过更改基础 URL 并写入配置文件来连接 Claude Code 和 Codex。Enterprise 可运行在 Context Mode 云、专用实例或客户自己的 Cloudflare 账户中。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Other。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

CoOp:Anything catalogs co\-op projects for single\-player games\. The site lists mods, forks, ports, frameworks, official modes, decompilation ports, and emulator netplay options, with search and filters for kind, engine, quality, and connection method\. It also links to a playbook and MCP server for making a single\-player game co\-op with an AI agent, plus a Discord community and a GitHub submission flow\.

## Key Features

- Directory of 298 co\-op projects across 192 games, spanning mods, forks, ports, frameworks, official modes, decompilation ports, and emulator netplay\.
- Project labels for Playable, Partial, In development, Abandoned, and Wanted statuses\.
- Filters for kind, engine, quality, and connection method, with sorting and table or card views\.
- Latest releases feed plus per\-project release dates and last activity information\.
- Community submission through GitHub and Discord\-based developer login for editing listings\.
- Links to an open playbook, MCP server, and Discord community for making single\-player games co\-op with an AI agent\.

## Use Cases

- Find a co\-op mod or tool for a specific single\-player game\.
- Compare listed projects by co\-op completeness, quality, stage, engine, and connection method\.
- Track recent co\-op mod releases and updates\.
- Submit a missing co\-op mod or edit an existing listing as a mod developer\.

## Getting Started

- Search the directory by game name or use filters to narrow listings\.
- Use the Make your own game co\-op quick\-start playbook to work on co\-op support with an AI agent\.
- Submit a missing mod through the GitHub issue form, or log in with Discord as a mod developer to edit a listing\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Connection methods vary by project and can include dedicated server, hosted relay, Steam, direct IP, LAN or split\-screen, VPN, or not stated\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Many listed projects are still in development or prototype stage, so maturity varies\.
- Some projects are marked abandoned and may need revival\.
- Some connection methods require a VPN\.
- Connection requirements are not stated for many listings\.
- Some games are wanted entries with no co\-op mod yet\.

projects.content:
## Overview

CorridorKey 2\.0 is Corridor Digital's first official plugin release, a chroma keying tool for green and blue screens\. It runs locally in supported VFX and editing software, and a standalone app is included for bulk shots\.

## Key Features

- One\-click keying for most shots, with the plug\-in distinguishing background from subject\.
- Time awareness analyzes the whole video clip to reduce flicker and chattering mattes and to preserve fine details such as hair\.
- Predicts the color of semi\-transparent foreground objects, removing screen color for motion blur, bokeh, and hair\.
- AlphaHint inputs let artists guide what to include or exclude, including tracking markers, screen edges, and c\-stands\.
- Supports native 4K and higher, HDR, floating point color depth, any color background, and local processing\.
- Plugins for DaVinci Resolve, Nuke, After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Blender, plus an included standalone app\.

## Use Cases

- Keying green and blue screen shots in Resolve, Nuke, After Effects, Premiere Pro, or Blender\.
- Processing bulk shots with the included standalone app\.
- Preserving motion blur, bokeh, and hair on semi\-transparent or detailed foregrounds\.
- Using alpha hints to handle tracking markers, screen edges, and c\-stands without garbage masking\.

## Getting Started

- Set up an NVIDIA GPU environment with ffmpeg on PATH and CUDA\-enabled PyTorch, then download the model weights with python scripts/download\_weights\.py\.
- Use the drag\-and\-drop launcher, or run python run\_interactive\.py /path/to/clip\.mp4 for a guided session\.
- Run python infer\.py \-\-input /path/to/input\.mp4 \-\-output\_dir /path/to/output for native\-resolution inference with no external hint\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- NVIDIA RTX 30 series or newer is recommended; RTX 20 series is beta and still being validated\.
- 4 GB of GPU memory is required for shots up to 1440p, and 6 GB for 4K\.
- Windows 11 or Windows 10 22H2 is supported; Mac beta requires M\-series hardware and macOS 14 or newer\.
- Repository setup requires ffmpeg on PATH, a Python environment with CUDA\-enabled PyTorch, and about 5 GB of model weights; AMD GPUs and Linux are planned\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Coucou is a free, open\-source companion app that lives in the Mac notch or at the top of the screen on Windows and Linux\. It watches AI coding agent sessions, supports approvals and questions from the notch or a phone, provides AI chat with your own keys or subscription, offers dictation and call notes, and surfaces service integrations such as Stripe, GitHub, Vercel, and n8n\. iPhone and Android companions extend sessions, approvals, widgets, and service views beyond the desktop\.

## Key Features

- Watches live sessions for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Hermes, and other agents, showing reads, edits, commands, and diffs\.
- Approve or deny Claude Code and Codex permission requests from the notch, and answer Claude questions in the notch\.
- Chat with Anthropic, Google AI, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Moonshot, or local Ollama and LM Studio models using your own API keys or subscription\.
- Flow dictation pastes speech into any app, with offline Parakeet speech recognition on Apple silicon, a dictionary, snippets, and per\-app styles\.
- Notetaker records calls without a bot joining, produces person\-by\-person transcripts, summaries, and to\-dos, then deletes the audio after transcription\.
- iPhone and Android companions show sessions, approvals, services, widgets, and remote actions\.

## Use Cases

- Monitor multiple AI coding agent sessions and approve permission requests while working elsewhere\.
- Dictate text into any application and review local dictation statistics\.
- Record and summarize calls with transcripts, key points, and action items\.
- Keep up with Stripe, GitHub, Vercel, n8n, Notion, Cal\.com, and Resend from the notch or phone\.

## Getting Started

- Download the Mac app from GitHub releases, or use the Windows \.msi or \.exe installer, or the Linux AppImage, \.deb, or \.rpm package\.
- For iPhone, install Coucou via TestFlight and enable Settings → General → iPhone in the Mac app with the same Apple Account in iCloud\.
- For Android, install the signed APK and use Coucou on Windows or Linux, with both devices on the same Wi\-Fi\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS 15 or later\.
- Windows 10/11 with an \.msi or \.exe installer\.
- Linux packages include AppImage, \.deb, and \.rpm\.
- Android 11 or later and a Windows or Linux computer running Coucou 0\.4\.0 or later, both on the same Wi\-Fi\.
- The iPhone app is available via TestFlight and syncs through the user's private iCloud/CloudKit database\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Windows installer is not code\-signed yet, so SmartScreen may show a warning\.
- Flow dictation and Notetaker are currently available on the Mac, with Windows and Linux planned next\.
- The Android companion requires Coucou on Windows or Linux, not the Mac, and both devices must be on the same Wi\-Fi\.
- The offline Parakeet speech model requires a one\-time download of about 650 MB and Apple silicon\.
- Mac App Store and App Store availability is still forthcoming; current distribution is through GitHub and TestFlight\.

projects.content:
## Overview

CowAgent is an open\-source super AI assistant and Agent Harness\. It plans and executes tasks, uses tools and skills, maintains long\-term memory and a personal knowledge base, and can form multi\-agent teams\. It supports multiple model providers and chat channels and can run on a laptop or server\.

## Key Features

- Task planning that decomposes complex tasks and executes them step by step using tools and skills\.
- Three\-tier long\-term memory with Deep Dream distillation and hybrid keyword plus vector retrieval\.
- Personal knowledge base that auto\-curates structured knowledge into a Markdown wiki and evolving knowledge graph\.
- Skills system with one\-click installs from Skill Hub, GitHub, and ClawHub, plus conversational custom skill creation\.
- Built\-in tools for file I/O, terminal, browser, scheduler, memory retrieval, web search, vision, and native MCP integration\.
- Pluggable model providers, multi\-channel support across Web and IM platforms, and multi\-agent teams with distinct roles\.

## Use Cases

- Running a personal AI assistant 24/7 on a laptop or server\.
- Connecting an AI assistant to Web and IM channels such as WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and QQ\.
- Creating multi\-agent teams with distinct roles for group\-chat collaboration and task delegation\.
- Extending workflows with installable or custom Skills and MCP tools\.

## Getting Started

- Linux or macOS installer: bash \<(curl \-fsSL https://cdn\.link\-ai\.tech/code/cow/run\.sh)
- Windows PowerShell installer: irm https://cdn\.link\-ai\.tech/code/cow/run\.ps1 \| iex
- Docker deployment: curl \-O https://cdn\.link\-ai\.tech/code/cow/docker\-compose\.yml then docker compose up \-d
- Open http://localhost:9899 to access the Web console\.
- Download the CowAgent Desktop client for macOS or Windows; the backend is bundled\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Linux, macOS, Windows, and Docker deployment modes are supported\.
- The one\-line installer handles dependencies, configuration, and startup\.
- For server deployment, set web\_host to 0\.0\.0\.0, set web\_password, and open port 9899 in the firewall or security group\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Agent mode can consume substantially more tokens than regular chat, so users should choose models that balance quality and cost\.
- The Agent has access to the local operating system, so it should only be deployed in trusted environments\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Craft Anything is an open\-source software research and rebuild tool\. Point it at a website, app, game, or file, and it studies the original with inspection tools, has a coding agent build a new project, checks the result against the original, and refines it\. It is a clean\-room engine written in pure Rust and runs as a desktop app, CLI, and MCP server, with parts available in the browser as WebAssembly\.

## Key Features

- Studies websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games, and files with real inspection tools and evidence behind each answer\.
- Lets a coding agent build a new project in the language, framework, or engine named in the request, or a sensible default\.
- Checks builds against the original, including websites at three screen widths, a game's own self\-test, and app runs, then refines what does not match\.
- Offers Clean room and Deep modes; Clean room avoids reading the original's code, files, or page source and works from visible information\.
- Exposes every tool as a CLI subcommand and an MCP tool so an agent can study a target or run a rebuild without the app\.
- Includes a desktop app, CLI, and MCP server with 320 tools for native programs, \.NET, Java, Android, Apple, Electron/JavaScript, websites, firmware, packet captures, databases, and game files\.

## Use Cases

- Recreate a website's layout and behavior while checking responsiveness at three screen widths\.
- Study an existing game's gameplay and rebuild it in Unity, Unreal, or Godot\.
- Inspect an app or file to understand how it works, with evidence, confidence, coverage, and limitations\.
- Run agent\-driven rebuilds from the command line or through an MCP client without opening the desktop app\.

## Getting Started

- Requires Rust 1\.97 or newer\. Clone the repository, then run cargo run \-\-release \-p craft\-anything for the desktop app, or cargo install \-\-path apps/craft\-anything\-cli for the CLI, and run craft\-anything\-cli doctor to check the install, coding agents, and engines\. Building needs

## Deployment & Requirements

- Rust 1\.97 or newer is required to build from source\. On Debian or Ubuntu, the desktop app also needs libxkbcommon\-dev, libwayland\-dev, libx11\-dev, libxrandr\-dev, libxi\-dev, libgl1\-mesa\-dev, and libgtk\-3\-dev\. Building needs a coding agent installed and signed in on your computer;

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Craft Anything is in early alpha, with some capabilities working, some partial, and more planned\.
- Building requires a coding agent on your computer; Claude Code is supported first\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Crawl4AI is an open\-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents\. It converts websites into clean, LLM\-ready Markdown for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines\. It can be self\-hosted for free with Python, CLI, Docker, and MCP, or used through Crawl4AI Cloud with one API key\.

## Key Features

- Clean LLM\-ready Markdown with headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citation hints\.
- Structured data extraction with CSS, XPath, regex, or LLM strategies into typed JSON\.
- Browser control with persistent profiles, remote CDP connections, sessions, proxies, stealth mode, and Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit\.
- Deep crawling with BFS, DFS, best\-first strategies, crash recovery, adaptive crawling, and URL discovery\.
- Self\-hosting through the Python library, CLI, Docker REST API, MCP server, dashboard, and playground\.
- Crawl4AI Cloud adds hosted scrape, batch, search, answer, and extract APIs plus MCP for agents\.

## Use Cases

- Feed clean Markdown into RAG pipelines and AI agents\.
- Extract typed JSON records from websites with CSS, XPath, regex, or LLM extraction\.
- Run web search and direct answers through the hosted API\.
- Crawl many pages at scale for data pipelines and research\.

## Getting Started

- Install the open\-source library with pip install \-U crawl4ai and run crawl4ai\-setup\.
- Use the Python AsyncWebCrawler to fetch a URL and print result\.markdown\.
- For cloud use, get an API key and call the hosted scrape, search, answer, or extract endpoints with a Bearer token\.
- Add the cloud MCP server to agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode using one configuration line\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The library supports Python 3\.10 through 3\.13\.
- crawl4ai\-setup installs and sets up the browser; if it fails, install Playwright Chromium manually\.
- The Docker server requires CRAWL4AI\_API\_TOKEN; without a token it answers only inside its container\.
- Crawl4AI Cloud requires an API key and uses the hosted service instead of running browsers or proxies yourself\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The hosted answer endpoint is marked experimental\.
- Launch pricing is discounted for the first year and may change, while credit already held keeps its value\.
- The self\-hosted Docker server requires an API token; without one it only responds inside its container\.
- Enterprise compliance maturity is in progress: SOC 2 Type I is complete and Type II is under way\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Crit is an open\-source review surface for AI coding agents\. Your agent writes a plan or diff, Crit renders it in the browser like a pull request, and you comment on the exact lines you want changed\. The agent reads your comments and revises\. It runs locally, and nothing leaves your machine unless you click Share\.

## Key Features

- Separate review modes for markdown plans and docs, code diffs, running dev servers, and static HTML artifacts\.
- Inline comments on single lines or selected ranges, rendered after the referenced lines like a GitHub pull request review\.
- Round\-to\-round diffs in split or unified views show what changed after the agent revises\.
- Story mode adds a chaptered overview for larger branch, pull request, merge request, or range reviews\.
- Programmatic comments let agents add inline review comments with the crit comment command\.
- Integrations support Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Gemini, and other agents that can read a file and run a command\.

## Use Cases

- Reviewing an agent\-authored plan or markdown document section by section before implementation\.
- Reviewing branch or pull request changes and iterating with the agent across rounds\.
- Reviewing a running localhost app or static HTML artifact by clicking elements and pinning comments\.
- Sharing a review for asynchronous feedback before handing it back to the agent\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Crit binary, for example with brew install crit; Go, Nix, Arch Linux, and Windows options are also documented\.
- For Claude Code, add the plugin marketplace with claude plugin marketplace add tomasz\-tomczyk/crit and install with claude plugin install crit@crit\.
- After the agent does work, run /crit in the agent chat, or launch crit with a file, repository, localhost URL, or HTML file\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Crit runs locally from a single binary with no account, config, or dependencies required\.
- The server binds to 127\.0\.0\.1\.
- Sharing is optional and can use crit\.md or a self\-hosted crit\-web instance\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Crit runs locally and binds its server to 127\.0\.0\.1 with zero telemetry; review data leaves the machine only when you choose Share\.
- The Arch Linux AUR package is maintained outside the Crit project\.
- Sharing uploads review content explicitly to crit\.md or a self\-hosted crit\-web instance\.

projects.content:
## Overview

CrossDesk is free, lightweight open\-source remote desktop software that lets you connect to a remote computer from a desktop, browser, or mobile device and view and control multiple devices through DeskHub\. The project is based on MiniRTC and supports self\-hosting\.

## Key Features

- Cross\-platform remote control: Windows, macOS, and Linux desktops can control and be controlled; browser and native iOS/Android clients can access computers; HarmonyOS PC and mobile are in development\. DeskHub: real\-time preview of multiple devices, grouping, zoomed control,

## Use Cases

- Remotely access and operate a remote computer from another computer, phone, or browser\. Use DeskHub to centrally view and manage multiple devices for grouping, preview, group control, and file distribution\. Self\-host signaling and TURN relay services when you need to control

## Getting Started

- Prepare the controlled computer by installing and running CrossDesk, waiting until it shows connected to the server, and viewing the local ID and password in This Desktop\. On another computer, enter the controlled computer's 9\-digit ID in CrossDesk and click Connect; native

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows: Windows 10\+, x64; an \.exe installer is provided, and a portable build is supported\. macOS: macOS 14\.0\+; choose x64 or arm64 \.pkg for Intel or Apple Silicon\. Linux: Ubuntu 20\.04\+, glibc 2\.31 baseline; amd64/arm64 \.deb; choose Standard for an existing desktop, or Virtual

## Before You Adopt

- License: GPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

CrossDesk 是一款免费、轻量的开源远程桌面软件，可从电脑、浏览器或手机连接远端电脑，并通过桌面墙（DeskHub）集中查看与操控多台设备。项目基于 MiniRTC，支持自托管。

## 核心功能

- 跨平台远控：Windows、macOS、Linux 桌面互控，浏览器及原生 iOS / Android 客户端访问电脑；鸿蒙 PC 与移动端处于开发阶段。
- 桌面墙：多设备实时预览、分组、放大操控、群控和批量文件分发。
- 画面与声音：H\.264 / AV1、硬件编解码、远端音频，以及会话内画质和帧率调整；可用能力随平台与设备而异。
- 日常协作：多显示器切换、键鼠与组合键、文本剪贴板、文件传输。
- 部署与运维：P2P 直连、TURN 中继、SRTP 媒体加密、自托管，以及 Windows 登录前远控和 Linux 无头运行。

## 适用场景

- 从另一台电脑、手机或浏览器远程访问并操作远端电脑。
- 通过桌面墙集中查看和管理多台设备，进行分组、预览、群控和文件分发。
- 在需要自主控制数据流转的场景中，自托管信令与 TURN 中继服务。
- 在无人值守场景中使用 Windows 登录前远控和 Linux 无头运行。

## 快速开始

- 准备被控电脑：安装并运行 CrossDesk，等待显示“已连接服务器”，查看“本桌面”中的本机 ID 和密码。
- 发起连接：在另一台电脑的 CrossDesk 中输入被控电脑的 9 位 ID，点击“连接”；也可使用原生移动端或 Web 客户端。
- 验证密码：输入被控电脑当前的连接密码，等待远程画面出现；桌面端可勾选“记住密码”，后续从“近期连接”重连。

## 部署与要求

- Windows：Windows 10\+，x64；提供 \.exe 安装包，也支持便携构建。
- macOS：macOS 14\.0\+；按 Intel / Apple Silicon 选择 x64 / arm64 \.pkg。
- Linux：Ubuntu 20\.04\+、glibc 2\.31 基线；amd64 / arm64 \.deb；已有桌面选标准版，无桌面环境或需独立桌面选虚拟桌面版（Xfce）。
- iOS / iPadOS：iOS 16\.0\+，仅控制；发布包为未签名应用，需自行签名或使用 Xcode 构建安装。
- Android：Android 8\.0\+，arm64，仅控制；下载已签名 APK 安装，或自行构建。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：GPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: CUDA Rust
projects.tagline: NVIDIA's CUDA platform for Rust
projects.taglineZh: NVIDIA 面向 Rust 的 CUDA 平台
projects.description: CUDA Rust is NVIDIA's CUDA platform for Rust, with host-side runtime crates and device-side tools for writing GPU kernels in idiomatic Rust using SIMT and Tile models.
projects.descriptionZh: CUDA Rust 是 NVIDIA 面向 Rust 的 CUDA 平台，提供用于 CUDA 驱动的宿主端运行时 crate，以及用惯用 Rust 编写 GPU 内核的设备端 crate 和工具，支持 SIMT 与 Tile 两种内核编程模型。
projects.content:
## Overview

CUDA Rust is NVIDIA's CUDA platform for Rust\. It provides host\-side runtime crates for working with the CUDA driver and device\-side crates and tools for writing GPU kernels in idiomatic Rust\. The project includes cuda\-oxide for the traditional SIMT kernel programming model and cutile\-rs for the Tile programming model, plus shared runtime crates for driver bindings, contexts, streams, device buffers, events, and lazy composable device operations\.

## Key Features

- Host\-side runtime crates include cuda\-bindings, cuda\-core with cuda\-core\-derive, and cuda\-async, covering driver bindings, contexts, streams, device buffers, events, and lazy composable device operations\.
- cuda\-oxide provides a custom rustc codegen backend, cargo helper utility, and crates for the CUDA SIMT kernel programming model, giving access to device\-side CUDA programming details\.
- cutile\-rs provides a proc\-macro plugin and crates for the CUDA Tile programming model, partitioning tensors into sub\-tensors, computing on whole tiles, and letting the compiler map tiles to each architecture\.
- Both kernel programming models extend Rust ownership rules across the GPU launch boundary: mutable buffers are partitioned into disjoint pieces, immutable buffers are shared, and launchers keep borrows alive while GPU work is in flight\.
- Kernels from both models interoperate: a cutile\-rs Tile kernel and a cuda\-oxide SIMT kernel can run on the same stream over shared device buffers\.

## Use Cases

- Porting existing CUDA C\+\+ kernels or needing direct control over threads, warps, shared memory, TMA, or cluster operations\.
- Tensor computations and math over densely packed numerical data where the Tile model's abstractions fit naturally\.
- Sparse problems, pointer chasing, or mapping traditional data structures to the GPU, where SIMT offers more flexibility\.
- Applications that combine Tile and SIMT kernels on the same stream over shared device buffers\.

## Getting Started

- Start with the CUDA Rust documentation; cuda\-oxide and cutile\-rs each have a book with installation instructions, guides, and reference material\.
- Runtime crates cuda\-bindings, cuda\-core, and cuda\-async are documented in the cutile\-rs book\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- cuda\-oxide uses a pinned stable Rust toolchain (1\.99\.1) managed by cargo oxide\.
- cutile\-rs requires stable Rust 1\.89 or newer\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- CUDA Rust is an early\-stage research project, so users should expect bugs, incomplete features, and API breakage\.

CUDA Rust 是 NVIDIA 面向 Rust 的 CUDA 平台。它提供用于对接 CUDA 驱动的宿主端运行时 crate，以及用于以惯用 Rust 编写 GPU 内核的设备端 crate 和工具。项目包含面向传统 SIMT 内核编程模型的 cuda\-oxide 和面向 Tile 编程模型的 cutile\-rs，并提供共享运行时 crate，覆盖驱动绑定、上下文、流、设备缓冲区、事件以及惰性、可组合的设备操作。

## 核心功能

- 宿主端运行时 crate 包括 cuda\-bindings、cuda\-core（含 cuda\-core\-derive）和 cuda\-async，提供驱动绑定、上下文、流、设备缓冲区、事件以及惰性、可组合的设备操作。cuda\-oxide 提供自定义 rustc 代码生成后端、cargo 辅助工具和相关 crate，用于 CUDA SIMT 内核编程模型，并可访问设备端 CUDA 编程细节。cutile\-rs 提供过程宏插件和相关 crate，用于 CUDA Tile

## 适用场景

- 移植现有 CUDA C\+\+ 内核，或需要对线程、warp、共享内存、TMA 或 cluster 操作进行直接控制时。问题可自然表达为张量计算，尤其是对密集数值数据进行数学运算时，Tile 模型更合适。问题稀疏、涉及指针追逐，或需要把传统数据结构映射到 GPU 时，SIMT 提供更多灵活性。应用可在同一流上通过共享设备缓冲区组合 Tile 和 SIMT 内核。

- cuda\-oxide 使用由 cargo oxide 管理的固定稳定版 Rust 工具链 1\.99\.1。cutile\-rs 需要稳定版 Rust 1\.89 或更新版本。

projects.content:
## Overview

DSA is a research system that combines multi\-source market data, news and event context, technical indicators, fundamentals, and LLM reasoning to produce watchlist decision reports and daily market reviews\. It supports A\-share, Hong Kong, and US markets, offers strategy Q&A for individual symbols, and can deliver reports through several notification channels\.

## Key Features

- Cross\-market quotes for A\-share, Hong Kong, US stocks, and common ETFs through multiple data providers and fallback paths\.
- News, filings, search results, and social sentiment aggregated to provide context for earnings, themes, flows, and risk events\.
- LLM decision reports that turn quotes, news, technicals, and fundamentals into structured conclusions with score, trend, advice, risk alerts, and a checklist\.
- Agent strategy Q&A covering moving averages, Chan theory, wave theory, trend views, and follow\-up questions from Web, CLI, or Bot entry points\.
- Reports stored in SQLite for direction accuracy, simulated returns, portfolio review, and market\-review discipline checks\.
- Multi\-channel delivery of watchlist reports and market reviews through WeChat Work, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack, email, and more\.

## Use Cases

- Daily watchlist research: generate per\-symbol summaries, scores, trends, risk alerts, catalysts, and action checklists\.
- Market review: summarize indices, market breadth, sector strength, market temperature, and trading\-day status by market\.
- On\-demand strategy Q&A: ask about a symbol and combine quotes, indicators, news, and built\-in strategies into a research view\.
- Scheduled delivery: send watchlist and market reports to team chat, email, or other notification channels\.

## Getting Started

- Use GitHub Actions: fork the repository, configure Secrets for at least one AI key and one notification channel, set STOCK\_LIST, enable Actions, and run the Daily Stock Analysis workflow\.
- Run locally: clone the repository, create a Python virtual environment, install requirements, copy \.env\.example to \.env, and run python main\.py \-\-stocks AAPL,MSFT,NVDA\.
- Deploy with Docker: use the local Compose build or the official Docker Hub or GHCR images after setting STOCK\_LIST, an AI key, and a notification channel in \.env\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10\+ for local runs\.
- At least one AI model API key, such as Gemini, OpenAI\-compatible, Anthropic, or an Ollama local model for local or Docker deployments\.
- STOCK\_LIST configured with watchlist symbols\.
- At least one notification channel or local inspection path\.
- For Docker, use docker/docker\-compose\.yml or the official images\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Built\-in free quote sources can be affected by upstream rate limits, API changes, and network fluctuations, so stability is not guaranteed\.
- News\-source configuration materially affects the quality of sentiment, announcements, events, and catalyst analysis; at least one search service is recommended\.
- The project describes itself as a research system rather than investment advice\.

## 项目简介

DSA 是一个研究系统，融合多源市场数据、新闻与事件背景、技术指标、基本面以及 LLM 推理，生成自选股决策报告和每日市场复盘。它覆盖 A 股、港股和美股，支持针对单个标的进行策略问答，并可通过多种通知渠道推送报告。

- 跨市场行情覆盖 A 股、港股、美股和常见 ETF，通过多个数据提供方与回退路径获取行情。
- 新闻与事件聚合新闻、公告、搜索结果和社交舆情，为财报、主题、资金流和风险事件提供背景。
- LLM 决策报告将行情、新闻、技术指标和基本面转化为包含评分、趋势、建议、风险警报和检查清单的结构化结论。
- Agent 策略问答支持均线、缠论、波浪理论、趋势观点，并可从 Web、CLI 或 Bot 入口继续追问。
- 报告存入 SQLite，用于方向准确率、模拟收益、持仓复盘和市场复盘纪律检查。
- 多通道推送通过企业微信、飞书、Telegram、Discord、Slack、邮件等发送自选股报告和市场复盘。

## 适用场景

- 每日自选股研究：为每个标的生成摘要、评分、趋势、风险警报、催化因素和操作检查清单。
- 市场复盘：按市场汇总指数、市场宽度、板块强度、市场温度和交易日状态。
- 按需策略问答：针对某个标的提问，结合行情、指标、新闻和内置策略形成研究视图。
- 定时推送：将自选股报告和市场复盘发送到团队聊天、邮件或其他通知渠道。

## 快速开始

- 使用 GitHub Actions：Fork 仓库，配置至少一个 AI Key 和一个通知渠道的 Secrets，设置 STOCK\_LIST，启用 Actions，并运行 Daily Stock Analysis 工作流。

- 使用 Docker：在 \.env 中设置 STOCK\_LIST、AI Key 和通知渠道后，使用本地 Compose 构建或官方 Docker Hub / GHCR 镜像。

## 部署与要求

- 本地运行需要 Python 3\.10\+。
- 至少配置一个 AI 模型 API Key，例如 Gemini、OpenAI 兼容接口、Anthropic，或在本地 / Docker 部署中使用 Ollama 本地模型。

projects.content:
## Overview

DATAGEN is an AI\-powered data analysis and research platform that uses multiple specialized agents to streamline tasks such as data analysis, visualization, and report generation\. It uses LangChain, OpenAI's GPT models, and LangGraph to handle complex research processes and integrates diverse AI architectures\.

## Key Features

- AI\-driven hypothesis generation and validation, automated research direction optimization, and real\-time hypothesis refinement\.
- Multi\-agent system with specialized agents for hypothesis generation, process supervision, visualization, code writing, search, reporting, quality review, and note\-taking\.
- Robust data cleaning and transformation, scalable analysis pipelines, and automated quality assurance\.
- Interactive data visualization, custom report generation, and automated insight extraction\.
- Smart memory management with a Note Taker agent for efficient context retention and workflow integration\.
- Configurable agent model providers and models through agent\_models\.yaml, including openai, google, anthropic, ollama, groq, atlascloud, and orcarouter\.

## Use Cases

- Automating data analysis and complete graphical report writing from user\-provided data files\.
- Generating, validating, and refining research hypotheses while optimizing research direction\.
- Conducting literature and web searches as part of a multi\-agent research workflow\.
- Producing visualizations, research reports, and quality reviews with revision as needed\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository\.
- Create and activate a Conda virtual environment with Python 3\.10\.
- Install dependencies with pip install \-r requirements\.txt\.
- Rename \.env Example to \.env and fill all values, including required WORKING\_DIRECTORY, CONDA\_ENV, and CHROMEDRIVER\_PATH\.
- Place a data file in the data directory, set the user\_input in main\.py, and run python main\.py\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 or higher\.
- Conda environment, such as the datagen environment described in the source\.
- Required environment variables: WORKING\_DIRECTORY, CONDA\_ENV, and CHROMEDRIVER\_PATH\.
- API keys for model providers and web search are optional in the source, but sufficient API credits are needed because the system makes multiple API calls\.
- Configuration files are relative to CONFIG\_DIRECTORY, which defaults to config/\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The agent system may modify the data being analyzed, so the source recommends backing up data before use\.
- The system makes multiple API calls, so sufficient API credits are required\.
- A full research run may take time depending on task complexity\.
- Firecrawl API key is optional, but missing it may reduce query capabilities\.

projects.content:
## Overview

DeepInfer is the high\-performance inference framework that powers DeepSeek's large\-scale production services\. This open\-source release provides offline inference with the core features needed for serving at scale and supports DeepSeek\-V4\.1\-Flash\.

## Key Features

- Optimized kernels and model and sampler runtime for efficient inference\.
- Parallelism support including Attention DP or balanced CP and MoE EP with EPLB\.
- DSpark, confidence\-scheduled verification, and SWA bounded replay\.
- Asynchronous scheduling that overlaps CPU batch scheduling with device execution\.
- Batch\-invariant inference and deterministic sampling for repeatable results\.
- Structured outputs constrained by regex, JSON schema, or EBNF grammar\.

## Use Cases

- Running offline inference for DeepSeek\-V4\.1\-Flash\.
- Serving DeepSeek models at scale with optimized kernels and parallelism\.
- Generating regex\-, JSON schema\-, or EBNF\-constrained structured outputs\.
- Deploying inference on NVIDIA SM100 GPUs or Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs\.

## Getting Started

- Create and activate an empty Python 3\.12 environment before building DeepInfer\.
- Export DEEPINFER\_ACCELERATOR=nvidia or ascend as appropriate, then run \./build\.sh\.
- Run python examples/offline\_inference\.py\.
- The default DeepSeek\-V4\.1\-Flash checkpoint downloads to the Hugging Face cache on first run; set DEEPINFER\_HF\_MODEL\_DIR to run from a local copy instead\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Linux with GCC \>= 13\.0 and Python 3\.12\.
- NVIDIA SM100 GPUs with CUDA 13, or Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs with CANN 9\.2\.
- A complete inference service requires a KV cache system, VE/Prefill/Decode disaggregation, and load balancing across data\-parallel replicas for prefill and decode; these are not included in this release\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The current release is described as offline inference only for now\.
- A complete inference service requires additional components that are not included in this release\.

projects.content:
## Overview

DeepSeek Harness is an open\-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI and built on the Cordis plugin system\. It is in developer preview with source code available\. In DeepSeek Harness, every agent capability is implemented as a plugin that can be swapped or recomposed, and every run is recorded in an append\-only session log for traceability\.

## Key Features

- Everything is a plugin: models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling, and the UI are provided by Cordis plugins that can be selected, swapped, or extended in configuration\.
- Every run is traceable through an append\-only session log that records system prompts, reasoning, tool calls and results, subagent scheduling, and context injections\.
- Multiple runtime modes: Standard mode includes the full toolset; Code mode orchestrates multi\-step tool calls through the Code Mode SDK; Minimal mode keeps only a shell tool and a file editor; Creator mode supports runtime inspection and plugin experiments\.
- The Cordis kernel manages plugin mounting, unmounting, and dependencies, with Cordis services and events connecting plugins\.
- A Web UI and command\-line runtime are available, with quick launch through npx @deepseek\-ai/dsh web or source installation options\.

## Use Cases

- Building and customizing agent harnesses for tasks such as file editing, shell commands, file and web search, skills, planning, goals, subagents, and workflows\.
- Benchmarking models in a minimal environment with a two\-tool coding agent\.
- Creating custom agent presets and experimenting with Cordis plugins in Creator mode\.
- Inspecting, resuming, forking, searching, and replaying agent runs from session logs\.

## Getting Started

- Install Node\.js, then run npx @deepseek\-ai/dsh web to start the Web UI\.
- To run from source, clone the repository, run pnpm install, run pnpm run build, and then run pnpm dsh web\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js is required for the npm launch method\.
- Running from source requires pnpm, a repository checkout, and built artifacts prepared by pnpm run build before pnpm dsh web\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project remains in developer preview, is still being tested, and its core plugins and APIs will continue to evolve\.
- The append\-only session log records everything the model sees, including system prompts, reasoning, tool calls and results, subagent scheduling, and context injections, which is relevant when handling sensitive data\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

DeepSeek Harness 是 DeepSeek AI 开发的开源智能体框架（agent harness），基于 Cordis 插件系统构建，源代码随开发者预览一同发布。在 DeepSeek Harness 中，每一项智能体能力都以插件形式实现，可以替换或重新组合；每一次运行都会记录在只追加的会话日志中，便于追溯。

## 核心功能

- 一切皆插件：模型、工具、技能、会话、沙箱、存储、循环、调度和界面均由 Cordis 插件提供，可在配置中选择、替换或扩展，无需改动 DeepSeek Harness 源码。
- Cordis 内核负责插件的挂载、卸载与依赖管理，插件之间通过 Cordis 服务与事件协同工作。
- 每次运行都可追溯：模型看到的一切都会记录在只追加的会话日志中，包括系统提示、推理、工具调用与结果、子智能体调度以及每一次上下文注入。
- 轨迹视图可按来源查看这些记录，恢复、分叉、搜索和重放都基于同一事件流。
- 多种运行模式：标准模式包含完整工具集；代码模式通过 Code Mode SDK 暴露工具，让模型在一个 TypeScript 程序中组合多步操作；最小模式只保留 shell 与文件编辑器两个工具；创造者模式支持检查当前运行时、在内存中测试 Cordis 插件并组合成新模式。
- 提供 Web 界面与命令行运行时，可通过 npx @deepseek\-ai/dsh web 快速启动。

## 适用场景

- 构建和定制智能体框架，用于文件编辑、shell 命令、文件与网络搜索、技能、规划、目标、子智能体和流程等任务。
- 在最小环境中以两工具编码智能体对模型进行基准测试。
- 在创造者模式中创建自定义智能体预设，并试验 Cordis 插件。
- 通过会话日志检查、恢复、分叉、搜索和重放智能体运行过程。

## 快速开始

- 安装 Node\.js，然后运行 npx @deepseek\-ai/dsh web 启动 Web 界面，默认在本地 127\.0\.0\.1:3080 打开。
- 如需从源码运行，先克隆仓库，进入目录后依次执行 pnpm install、pnpm run build，再执行 pnpm dsh web；pnpm run build 准备构建产物，pnpm dsh web 直接使用这些产物而不再重新构建。

## 部署与要求

- 使用 npm 启动方式需要安装 Node\.js。
- 从源码运行需要 pnpm、仓库检出代码，以及由 pnpm run build 准备好的构建产物，之后才能执行 pnpm dsh web。

## 采用前须知

projects.content:
## Overview

DeepSeek\-V3 is a Mixture\-of\-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters and 37B activated per token\. It uses Multi\-head Latent Attention and DeepSeekMoE, an auxiliary\-loss\-free load balancing strategy, and a Multi\-Token Prediction objective\. It was pre\-trained on 14\.8 trillion tokens and then fine\-tuned and reinforced, with evaluations reporting strong performance on math and code tasks and a 128K context window\.

## Key Features

- Mixture\-of\-Experts architecture with 671B total parameters and 37B activated per token\.
- Multi\-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures\.
- Auxiliary\-loss\-free load balancing strategy for minimizing performance degradation\.
- Multi\-Token Prediction (MTP) training objective that can also support speculative decoding\.
- FP8 mixed precision training framework validated on an extremely large\-scale model\.
- Pre\-trained on 14\.8 trillion tokens with 128K context length and Base and Chat variants\.

## Use Cases

- Chatting with DeepSeek\-V3 through the official website or an OpenAI\-compatible API\.
- Running local inference and deployment with DeepSeek\-Infer Demo, SGLang, LMDeploy, TensorRT\-LLM, vLLM, or LightLLM\.
- Handling code and math tasks where DeepSeek\-V3 reports strong benchmark performance\.
- Researching MoE architectures, FP8 training, Multi\-Token Prediction, and reasoning distillation from DeepSeek\-R1\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the DeepSeek\-V3 GitHub repository and navigate to the inference folder\.
- Install dependencies from requirements\.txt, preferably in a fresh conda or uv virtual environment\.
- Download model weights from Hugging Face and place them in a local folder\.
- Convert Hugging Face model weights using convert\.py with the desired expert and model\-parallel settings\.
- Run interactive or batch inference with torchrun and generate\.py using the provided config\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- DeepSeek\-Infer Demo requires Linux with Python 3\.10 only; Mac and Windows are not supported\.
- DeepSeek\-Infer Demo dependencies include torch 2\.4\.1, triton 3\.0\.0, transformers 4\.46\.3, and safetensors 0\.4\.5\.
- FP8 weights are provided; BF16 weights can be generated with the provided fp8\_cast\_bf16\.py conversion script\.
- Hugging Face Transformers is not directly supported yet\.
- SGLang supports NVIDIA and AMD GPUs and multi\-node tensor parallelism in BF16 and FP8 modes\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- GitHub records the last push on 2025\-08\-28, at least 12 months before this listing was prepared; verify the current maintenance status before adoption\.
- DeepSeek\-Infer Demo has platform restrictions and supports only Linux with Python 3\.10; Mac and Windows are not supported\.
- Hugging Face Transformers is not directly supported yet, so users need another supported inference path\.
- MTP support is under active development within the community, so that capability may require community progress or contributions\.
- Only FP8 weights are provided, and BF16 weights require a conversion script for experimentation\.

projects.content:
## Overview

DiffSynth\-Studio is an open\-source Diffusion model engine developed and maintained by the ModelScope Community team\. It integrates mainstream open\-source Diffusion models covering image generation, video generation, audio generation, and image quality metrics models\. The framework is built around model aggregation, VRAM management, parameter quantization, and training support, including split training\.

## Key Features

- Integrates mainstream open\-source Diffusion models across image generation, video generation, audio generation, and image quality metrics models\.
- VRAM management dynamically schedules model parameters across disk, memory, and VRAM so consumer\-grade GPUs with low VRAM can run large\-model inference\.
- Parameter quantization converts model parameters to precisions such as NF4 and INT8, reducing VRAM requirements for inference and LoRA training\.
- Almost every model that supports inference also supports training, including base models, LoRAs, and Adapter models with additional inputs\.
- Split Training uses a computational graph inference engine to track every variable in the Pipeline and splits training into two stages for efficient training\.
- Companion projects include DiffSynth\-ComfyUI for workflow\-based inference and DiffSynth\-WebUI for lightweight LoRA training on consumer\-grade GPUs\.

## Use Cases

- Running large Diffusion image, video, or audio models for inference on consumer\-grade GPUs with limited VRAM\.
- Fine\-tuning base models, LoRAs, or Adapter models across supported Diffusion models\.
- Building ComfyUI workflows for model inference with DiffSynth\-ComfyUI\.
- Training LoRAs on consumer\-grade GPUs through DiffSynth\-WebUI or quantized training workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Install the package from PyPI with pip install DiffSynth, then consult the developer documentation, starting with the VRAM management, parameter quantization, model training, and split training guides\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Major version updates have left some old features unmaintained; the source advises using the last historical version before the major update if those features are needed\.
- The project states that development capacity is limited, so new feature progress and issue response may be slower\.
- CPU Offload Training is currently limited to single\-GPU training\.
- Training MiniMax\-H3\-Image is recommended at resolutions larger than 2048×2048\.

## Overview

- Agent: Autonomous agents with a sandbox to run commands, install software, and handle files\.

## Use Cases

- Use Dify Cloud for zero\-setup trial with 200 free GPT\-4 calls\.
- Self\-host Dify Community Edition in your environment\.
- Deploy Dify Enterprise for SSO, RBAC, and support SLAs\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Docling simplifies document processing by parsing diverse formats, including advanced PDF understanding, and providing seamless integrations with the generative AI ecosystem\. It offers a unified DoclingDocument representation and export formats such as Markdown, HTML, and lossless JSON\.

## Key Features

- Parses multiple document formats including PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB, Apple Pages, WAV, MP3, WebVTT, Box Notes, email formats, images, LaTeX, DocLang, and plain text\.
- Advanced PDF understanding including page layout, reading order, table structure, code, formulas, and image classification\.
- Unified DoclingDocument representation with export formats including Markdown, HTML, WebVTT, DocLang, DocTags, and lossless JSON\.
- Local execution for sensitive data and air\-gapped environments\.
- Plug\-and\-play integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Crew AI, and Haystack, plus MCP server and API server support\.
- Extensive OCR support, Visual Language Models, and Automatic Speech Recognition for audio\.

## Use Cases

- Convert documents into structured Markdown or JSON for generative AI and RAG pipelines\.
- Build RAG applications with integrations such as Haystack, LangChain, and LlamaIndex\.
- Extract information from PDFs, office files, emails, EPUB, and images with OCR\.
- Run document processing locally for sensitive or air\-gapped environments\.

## Getting Started

- Install Docling with pip install docling\.
- Use the Docling CLI to convert a document and generate a Markdown file with structured content\.
- Use the Python DocumentConverter to convert a source and export the document to Markdown\.
- Detailed installation and usage documentation is available\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 or higher is required; Python 3\.9 support was dropped in docling version 2\.70\.0\.
- Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows for x86\_64 and arm64 architectures\.
- Local execution is available for sensitive data and air\-gapped environments\.
- Can run as a service with the API server (docling\-serve)\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Python 3\.9 support was dropped in docling version 2\.70\.0, so deployments should use Python 3\.10 or higher\.
- Metadata extraction is listed as coming soon, indicating it is not currently supported\.
- Local execution is available for sensitive data and air\-gapped environments\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Doop is an open\-source alternative to Paper\.design and a multiplayer design canvas for humans and AI agents to design together live\. It combines a visual canvas, reusable components and tokens, design automations, built\-in image generation, import and export, and a built\-in MCP server so agents can design on the user's account and subscription\.

## Key Features

- A live multiplayer canvas that shows agent tasks and activity as agents design, edit frames, and review their own work\.
- A built\-in MCP server that connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot in VS Code, Claude, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, and other MCP clients to the canvas\.
- Reusable components and design tokens; agents compose screens from the system instead of redrawing, and changes to a main update every instance\.
- Design automations triggered by approvals or schedules, with agent tasks for ad sizes, localization, brand compliance, accessibility, and visual polish\.
- Import from URLs, HTML exports, Figma, Canva, PSD, or GitHub repositories as editable snapshots, and export to PNG, PDF, HTML, Canva, Figma, PSD, or live image links\.
- Built\-in image generation in the frame, using models such as GPT Image 2 and listing additional models as next up\.

## Use Cases

- Prototyping clickable flows and app screens with agents that generate and edit frames in place\.
- Producing ad sizes and localized variants through approval\-triggered automations\.
- Importing existing designs, HTML, or repositories and designing the next version beside the original\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Dossier is a self\-hosted job search application for one person\. It keeps career history in a single profile, matches postings against that profile, drafts tailored resumes and cover letters using only profile facts, and tracks applications from draft to offer\. It runs on your own server with your data in PostgreSQL and an AI model you choose\.

## Key Features

- One profile for basics, skills, languages, experience, projects, education, publications and references, with a strength meter\.
- Posting matching that shows covered requirements and gaps, then drafts a tailored resume and cover letter in a chosen tone\.
- Twelve resume themes and a live\-preview theme builder that prints to PDF on your server\.
- Job search through JSearch or Adzuna, startup job sources, and an optional daily job agent that never sends or applies\.
- Application tracking with a board, table, dashboard funnel, weekly chart and upcoming interviews\.
- Optional Gmail and Google Calendar integration plus a Claude connector, with confirmation required before anything is sent\.

## Use Cases

- Job seekers who want to apply to multiple roles while keeping career data and generated documents on their own server\.
- People who need tailored resumes and cover letters based only on verified profile facts\.
- Users who want to organize and monitor applications from draft through offer, including interviews\.
- Privacy\-conscious users who prefer a local AI model through Ollama or LM Studio, or a hosted model of their choice\.

## Getting Started

- Install Docker Desktop on macOS or Windows, or Docker Engine with its Compose plugin on Linux, with about 2 GB of free memory\.
- Create a folder for Dossier, fetch the production Compose file as compose\.yml, and generate POSTGRES\_PASSWORD and DOSSIER\_SECRET into a \.env file\.
- Generate a password hash with the Dossier hash\-password container, then add the argon2id line to \.env as DOSSIER\_PASSWORD\.
- Start the stack with docker compose up \-d, open the local app on port 3000, sign in, and choose an AI model in Settings → AI provider\.
- On Apple Silicon Macs, add a Compose override setting the app platform to linux/amd64 because the image is built for Intel and AMD processors\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Local use requires Docker Desktop on macOS or Windows, or Docker Engine with its Compose plugin on Linux, and about 2 GB of free memory\.
- Server self\-hosting requires your own domain with HTTPS and at least 2 vCPUs and 2 GB of memory\.
- Documented self\-hosting options include an Ubuntu server with Docker Compose and Caddy or Node\.js without Docker, Coolify, Dokploy, and CapRover\.
- Dossier expects one app instance per database; nightly backups, the AI job queue and the PDF browser run inside the app process\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Dossier is designed for desktop browsers, not phones\.
- It supports one password and one profile, with no accounts\.
- The application interface is English, while generated documents can be written in other languages\.
- Only one copy of the app should run per database\.
- A hosted AI model receives the content it writes from, unlike local models that keep profile, postings and documents on your hardware\.

projects.content:
## Overview

DSH Go is a community\-developed, unofficial mobile client built on DeepSeek Harness\. Its goal is to continue using and checking on coding agents from a phone\. The Android version is released\. The iOS project is in the repository, still in development and real\-device testing, and requires signing and compiling on a Mac\. It can also connect to DSH on a computer or server through SSH or DSHarness Remote\.

## Key Features

- Local runtime: install Ubuntu, Node\.js, and the DSH runtime inside the app, without root or a separate Termux installation\.
- Remote connection: use DSH on a computer or server through SSH or DSHarness Remote\.
- Chat and tools: switch models, send images, use voice input, and handle tool approvals and questions; supports chat interface and webpage mode\.
- Phone control: after you grant permissions, the local engine can read the screen, tap, and type, and you can stop it at any time\.
- Sharing and appearance: share, export, and replay conversations; adjust themes, icons, and desktop pets; pets can be shown outside the app\.
- Plugin interface: use native tool cards, forms, and panels adapted for DSH Go; the repository provides an SDK, tutorials, and examples\.

## Use Cases

- Check coding\-agent progress after leaving the desk, with pet status indicating when confirmation is needed\.
- Use DSH on a computer or server from the phone without installing the local runtime\.
- Run DSH directly on an Android phone through the local runtime and handle model switching, image input, and voice input\.
- Share conversations with share cards or end\-to\-end encrypted replay links\.

## Getting Started

- Download the APK for the correct architecture from GitHub Releases or the official download page, and allow that installation source when prompted\.
- On first launch, choose to install the local runtime or connect to a remote host\.
- Configure the model and required credentials for the selected host, then start a conversation; some remote channels require configuration on the host side\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Android 8\.0 (API 26) or newer\.
- The arm64 package on the release page is for common 64\-bit Android phones; the x64 package for x86\_64 devices and emulators is under Other version downloads at the end of the release notes; there is no 32\-bit ARM build\.
- Running DSH on the phone requires preparing the built\-in runtime and about 1 GB of free space; this is not needed if you only connect to DSH on a computer or server\.
- Phone control is available only for the local engine in normal mode and requires enabling accessibility and other permissions as described in the interface; Do Not Disturb mode also requires Android 14 or newer and Shizuku or self\-connected ADB\.
- iOS has no public installer and requires signing and compiling on a Mac; it is still in real\-device testing\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

## Overview

dsh\-superagent is a research prototype of a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository\. Packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness, it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu\. When an allowed user asks for work, it opens a work item, works in its own agent session and directory, and replies in the original conversation, for example with a pull request\. A web panel shows what needs a person\.

## Key Features

- Listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu for work requests\.
- Opens a work item and works on it in its own agent session and directory\.
- Replies in the original conversation, for example with a pull request\.
- Provides a web panel that shows what needs a person\.
- Acts only when asked or when a team\-written rule allows, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result\.
- Packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness and targets one GitHub repository\.

## Use Cases

- Taking on requested repository work from GitHub or Feishu, then returning a result such as a pull request\.
- Letting teams using DeepSeek Harness trial a proactive agent for one repository\.
- Reviewing work that needs human attention in a web panel\.
- Separating each work item into its own agent session and directory\.

## Getting Started

- Ask a coding agent to read SETUP\.md in the repository and set up dsh\-superagent with you\.
- During setup, the agent asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, then installs and configures everything\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness environment, because the project is packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness\.
- One GitHub repository for the agent to watch and work on\.
- Feishu integration is optional\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is a research prototype and is not an official DeepSeek product\.
- The code is not production\-ready and may contain bugs or inconsistent engineering practices\.
- Users should review and adapt the code before using it in their own environment\.

projects.content:
## Overview

DSPy is a Python framework for building AI systems\. Developers declare tasks as typed signatures and compose modules, then use optimizers to tune prompts and weights against a metric\. The documentation covers tools, RAG, agents, multimodal fields, evaluation, and deployment topics\.

## Key Features

- Structured signatures declare tasks as typed inputs and outputs instead of prompts\.
- Reusable modules such as Predict, ChainOfThought, and ReAct change execution strategy without rewriting the task\.
- Optimizers compile a program against a metric to improve output quality\.
- Programs can compose multiple signatures and modules using plain Python control flow\.
- Documented capabilities include tool use, RAG pipelines, agent loops, and image fields for multimodal tasks\.

## Use Cases

- Building simple classifiers, sophisticated RAG pipelines, and agent loops\.
- Extracting structured information from emails, support tickets, or other text\.
- Creating tool\-using agents with ReAct and function tools\.
- Handling multimodal tasks that use images as signature fields\.

## Getting Started

- Install DSPy with pip install dspy\.
- Follow the Getting Started documentation to build a first program and expand signatures\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Python 3\.10 or newer\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Some optimization capabilities are explicitly labeled experimental\.

## 核心功能

- 结构化签名将任务声明为类型化输入和输出，而非提示。可复用模块包括 Predict、ChainOfThought 和 ReAct，可在不改写任务的情况下改变执行策略。优化器依据指标编译程序，以提升输出质量。程序可用普通 Python 控制流组合多个签名和模块。文档涵盖工具使用、RAG 管道、智能体循环，以及用于多模态任务的图像字段。

## 适用场景

- 可用于构建简单分类器、复杂 RAG 管道和智能体循环；从电子邮件、支持工单或其他文本中提取结构化信息；借助 ReAct 和函数工具创建使用工具的智能体；处理以图像作为签名字段的多模态任务。

## 快速开始

- 使用 pip install dspy 安装 DSPy。按照入门文档构建第一个程序并扩展签名。

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Python 3\.10 或更高版本。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

dusk bot is a desktop app where AI helpers live as contacts\. Each bot has its own computer and editable memory, can run routines, use connected apps, and work alongside other bots\. It can run on your computer, on dusk cloud, or on your own server, using AI subscriptions, API keys, or local models\.

## Key Features

- Each bot has its own browser and desktop computer, which you can watch live and take control of for sign\-ins, captchas, or two\-step codes\.
- Bots keep editable memory notes about your preferences and the people involved, so they remember how you like work done\.
- Ask once to turn a task into a routine that runs on a schedule, an app event, or a webhook\.
- Several bots can share a room and hand work to each other, with you stepping in when one needs approval\.
- Connect 60\+ apps such as Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, Figma, and Stripe, and add MCP servers\.
- Use AI subscriptions, API keys, or local models, and assign a different model to each bot without losing its chats, files, or memory\.

## Use Cases

- Research and comparison: a researcher bot reads many sources and returns sources, a table, and a direct answer\.
- Inbox management: an inbox helper reads overnight email, drafts replies in your voice, and surfaces messages that need you\.
- Code work: a code reviewer picks up an issue, opens a pull request, and fixes findings from review\.
- Travel planning: a travel planner watches fares, holds good options, and checks you in the day before\.

## Getting Started

- Download and open the app; it runs as a normal app without an account or card\.
- Sign in to the AI provider you already pay for\.
- Create a bot by naming it and describing its job in plain words\.
- Give the bot a real task; it asks before risky actions\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux\.
- Personal use can run on your own computer, with bots, chats, files, and memory stored on your disk\.
- Bots can also run on dusk cloud or on a server you host yourself\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- On a sleeping computer, routines do not run; the desktop app keeps the computer awake before a due routine, and a missed run may start up to 12 hours late\.
- Local data stays on the user's disk; dusk cloud data lives on a private cloud computer\.
- Bots can use an API key or a locally run model instead of a subscription sign\-in\.

projects.descriptionZh: DwarfStar 是一个小型原生推理引擎，专注于在消费级硬件上运行 DeepSeek、GLM 和 Qwen 等精选大语言模型，支持 Metal、CUDA 和 ROCm。它要求使用项目自身产出的 GGUF 文件，并非通用 GGUF 运行器。
projects.content:
## Overview

DwarfStar is a small native inference engine designed to run a few excellent large language models on consumer hardware\. It focuses on specific models including DeepSeek V4 Flash and PRO, GLM 5\.2 and 5\.3, GLM 5\.3 Flash, and Qwen3\.8 Flash Next, and supports Metal, CUDA, and ROCm\. The project is self\-contained and deliberately narrow: it requires GGUF files produced by the project rather than serving as a general GGUF runner\.

## Key Features

- Native inference engine for selected DeepSeek, GLM, and Qwen models, including experimental vision support for some models\.
- Supported backends include Metal, NVIDIA CUDA, and ROCm\.
- Self\-contained codebase focused on project\-produced GGUF files, not a general GGUF runner\.
- Integration testing covers model loading, prompt rendering, tool calls, KV state, the HTTP server, and the coding agent\.
- Includes tools and data for GGUF, imatrix, quality, and speed\.
- Supports SSD streaming, tensor parallelism with RDMA between two 128 GB Macs, pipeline parallelism, and multi\-GPU CUDA setups\.

## Use Cases

- Run capable local models on a MacBook, DGX Spark, or Strix Halo system\.
- Use multiple CUDA cards as a multi\-user LLM server\.
- Use two 128 GB Macs connected with RDMA for tensor\-parallel inference\.
- Use pipeline parallelism to combine multiple systems and run larger models\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository and enter the ds4 directory\.
- Build with make for Metal on Apple Silicon, make cuda\-spark for DGX Spark, make strix\-halo for Strix Halo, or make cuda\-generic for one or more CUDA cards\.
- For a first run on a 96 or 128 GB machine, run \./download\_model\.sh ds4f\-q2\.
- Run \./ds4 for the default model, \./ds4 \-p "Explain Redis streams in one paragraph\." for a prompt, or \./ds4\-server \-\-ctx 32768 for the server\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Metal is the primary target; 64 GB Macs can run Qwen Flash Next, while 96 GB or more is recommended for DeepSeek and GLM\. Smaller machines can use SSD streaming\.
- NVIDIA CUDA support targets DGX Spark and multi\-GPU systems, including Ada Lovelace cards such as L40S\.
- ROCm is supported on Strix Halo systems such as the Framework Desktop\.
- Downloads go in gguf/\. Leave memory for the context and runtime buffers as well as the model\.
- Engram tables remain on disk in every mode, so a fast local SSD is needed\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- DwarfStar is described as beta quality and fast changing; despite QA runs, instabilities and regressions are possible\.
- Model support is intentionally opportunistic, and a supported model may be removed when a better replacement arrives\.
- Saved conversations and traces may contain private information\.
- Engram tables remain on disk in every mode, so a fast local SSD is required\.

projects.description: e2e is a customizable TypeScript end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps that combines AI agent actions with deterministic locators and assertions.
projects.descriptionZh: e2e 是可定制的 TypeScript 端到端测试框架，面向 Web 与移动应用，将 AI 代理操作与确定性定位器和断言结合。
projects.content:
## Overview

e2e is an open source end\-to\-end testing framework for web and mobile apps\. Tests combine natural\-language agent actions with precise locators and deterministic assertions in the same test\. Verified agent steps record their actions, and later runs replay them without model calls until the app changes\.

## Key Features

- Natural\-language goals let an AI agent drive the application while tests keep deterministic locators and assertions\.
- Verified agent actions are replayed on later runs without model calls until the app changes\.
- One shared API supports web and mobile testing\.
- Configuration lets teams choose the AI model, agent system prompt, and execution engine\.
- Tests without agent steps need no model\.
- Web execution supports Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit through Playwright; mobile execution drives iOS simulators and Android emulators through agent\-device\.

## Use Cases

- End\-to\-end testing for web applications and mobile apps\.
- Handling test steps that are hard to express with stable selectors by using an AI agent, while keeping deterministic assertions where precision matters\.
- Running tests in CI with cached agent actions replaying when nothing changed\.
- Migrating from Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Detox, or Maestro with migration guides\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx e2e init; it asks for a web or mobile engine and a model provider, then writes a config and an example test\.
- The docs quickstart covers the remaining setup\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Tests without agent steps need no model\.
- Model access can use the ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or SuperGrok subscription, a Vercel AI Gateway or OpenRouter key, or a local server pointed to by the runner\.
- Secrets stay in environment variables; the config references named credentials and the runner fills them at run time\.
- CI mode switches on automatically with one retry, a read\-only trace cache, and replay of verified agent actions without model calls when nothing changed\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is in active development on the way to 1\.0\.
- Agent\-driven tests depend on access to an AI model through a subscription, gateway key, or local server\.

## 核心功能

- 随包准备 Node\.js、npm 与 dsh 运行资源，启动本地 Web UI，普通使用无需单独安装 Node\.js。
- 在工作目录中发起任务，查看会话文件变更，并通过文件视图检查与还原修改。
- 请求路径上的上下文压缩与有界溢出恢复，为持续对话管理上下文空间。
- 聚合插件目录、安装与启停入口，配合保护中心的快照、体检和回滚能力。
- 通过 DPX 管理环境身份、默认数据路径与运行时变量，按发布通道分离环境。
- Tauri 原生窗口、托盘、单实例与退出策略，配合进程编排管理服务生命周期。

## 适用场景

- 已使用 DeepSeek Harness，希望获得带原生窗口、托盘和单实例行为的桌面工作台。
- 需要在项目工作目录中运行 Agent 任务，并检查或还原会话期间的文件修改。
- 需要管理长会话上下文，使用请求路径压缩与有界溢出恢复。
- 需要安装、启停插件，并借助快照、体检和回滚管理扩展风险。

## 快速开始

- 从 releases 页面下载对应平台安装包；Windows x64 提供 Full Setup 与 Lite Setup，Linux x64 提供 AppImage 与 deb，macOS arm64 提供 dmg。
- 可选安装 EAC\-Launcher v0\.1\.0 Windows x64，用于多实例与多内核管理，可与桌面端并存安装，自带 Node 24\.22\.1 运行时。

## 部署与要求

- 普通使用时，安装包随包准备 Node\.js、npm 与 dsh 运行资源，无需单独安装 Node\.js。

- 构建过程需要联网获取依赖。
- Linux 构建时设置 APPIMAGE\_EXTRACT\_AND\_RUN=1，Ubuntu 构建环境需安装 libwebkit2gtk\-4\.1\-dev、libappindicator3\-dev、librsvg2\-dev、patchelf、libfuse2、rpm。

## 采用前须知

- DPX 管理默认路径与环境变量，但不提供文件系统沙箱隔离。

## Overview

earshot is an open\-source, CPU\-only toolkit that gives AI coding agents the ability to hear, review and make sound\. It turns audio into evidence an agent can reason about and runs locally as a CLI, Python API and MCP server\.

## Key Features

- Describe audio files with calibrated tags, AudioSet labels and measurements\.
- Match descriptions, rank candidate files and find the best moments inside long recordings\.
- Compare sounds, assess real versus code\-synthesized audio, build listening timelines and generate annotated sheets\.
- Critique launch videos against a reference profile and provide timestamped fixes\.
- Generate and improve sounds in code with earshot forge and translate recordings into forge recipes with earshot fit\.
- Render sounds from a bank of 201 effects and build film sound kits without models or network access\.

## Use Cases

- Helping coding agents verify that generated demos, games or films sound right\.
- Searching a sound library with a text description and locating the best moment in a recording\.
- Building and checking sound effects and kits for code\-made films\.
- Reviewing a launch video soundtrack against professional reference films\.

## Getting Started

- Install Python 3\.10\+ and ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH, then clone the repository and create a virtual environment\.
- Install CPU PyTorch and the package with pip install \-e "\.\[mcp,llm,dev\]"\.
- Run python \-m earshot doctor \-\-load to check the install, models, data files and CPU settings\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10\+ and ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH are required\.
- The project runs on CPU only; no GPU is used\.
- First model use downloads two open models of about 1\.1 GB into a local cache\.
- Offline operation can be forced with EARSHOT\_OFFLINE=1, HF\_HUB\_OFFLINE=1 or TRANSFORMERS\_OFFLINE=1; missing models are then reported as an error\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The first model use requires downloading two open models of about 1\.1 GB into a cache inside the repository or EARSHOT\_HOME\.
- The optional Gemini audio\-LLM critique is used only with the user's own key and explicit consent\.

## 项目简介

earshot 是一个开源、仅用 CPU 的工具包，让 AI 编程智能体能够听见、审查并制作声音。它把音频转化为智能体可推理的证据，并以 CLI、Python API 和 MCP 服务器在本地运行。

## 核心功能

- 描述音频文件，给出校准标签、AudioSet 标签和测量值。按描述匹配、对候选文件排序，并在长录音中找出最佳片段。比较声音，判断真实录音与代码合成音频，构建聆听时间线和带标注的图页。依据参考配置评审发布视频，并给出带时间戳的修改建议。使用 earshot forge 以代码生成并改进声音，使用 earshot fit 将录音转换为 forge 配方。无需模型或网络，从 201 个音效库中渲染声音并构建影片声音套件。

## 适用场景

- 帮助编程智能体确认生成的演示、游戏或影片声音是否正确。用文本描述搜索声音库，并定位录音中的最佳时刻。为代码制作的影片构建和检查音效与套件。对照专业参考影片评审发布视频的配乐。

## 快速开始

- 安装 Python 3\.10\+ 以及 PATH 中的 ffmpeg/ffprobe，然后克隆仓库并创建虚拟环境。安装 CPU 版 PyTorch，并使用 pip install \-e "\.\[mcp,llm,dev\]" 安装软件包。运行 python \-m earshot doctor \-\-load 检查安装、模型、数据文件和 CPU 设置。

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Python 3\.10\+ 以及 PATH 中的 ffmpeg/ffprobe。项目仅使用 CPU，不使用 GPU。首次使用模型时，会将两个约 1\.1 GB 的开源模型下载到本地缓存。可通过 EARSHOT\_OFFLINE=1、HF\_HUB\_OFFLINE=1 或 TRANSFORMERS\_OFFLINE=1 强制离线运行；此时缺失的模型会作为错误报告。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

ECC is an open\-source toolkit that gives coding agents a shared engineering process across harnesses\. It combines skills, agents, hooks, memory, planning tools and security scanning so agents can plan, test, review, verify and retain useful lessons\. The open\-source project is MIT\-licensed, and a separate GitHub App adds repository workflow guidance and paid plans\.

## Key Features

- Includes 71 agents for planning, review, build repair, security, architecture and domain work\.
- Provides 311 skills covering TDD, research, security, docs, frontend, data, ML and operations\.
- Adds hooks, rules, unified memory and continuous learning for session summaries, handoffs and context controls\.
- Includes AgentShield scanning for prompts, hooks, MCP configuration, permissions, secrets and agent files\.
- Offers Plan Canvas for annotating plans in the browser and reviewing revisions in place\.
- Supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kimi Code, GitHub and other harnesses with native or adapter\-based integration\.

## Use Cases

- Reviewing code changes with a repeatable reviewer process\.
- Checking security surfaces such as permissions, inputs and exposed secrets\.
- Planning and coordinating work through annotated plans and a session overview\.
- Carrying context between agents with saved handoffs and searchable project memory\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx ecc\-universal@2\.2\.3 setup for guided package setup for Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code\.
- For a typical personal setup, choose Global user and Standard hooks, then confirm\.
- After setup, start a new Claude Code session and run /plugin list to verify that ecc@ecc is enabled\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The universal package requires Node\.js 18 or newer\.
- Claude plugin setup also requires Git and Claude Code 2\.1 or newer on PATH\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- AgentShield scanning is a review aid and does not guarantee that a repository or agent is safe\.
- Install only from official channels because third\-party re\-uploads and unofficial mirrors may contain malware\.
- Review requested GitHub permissions before installing the GitHub App\.
