projects.content:
## Overview

EdenText is a web\-based word processor for quick notes through full\-length books\. It opens and saves \.odt and \.docx files, supports real page layout and desktop\-suite features, and runs entirely in the browser with no server or account; documents stay on the user's machine\.

## Key Features

- Real page layout with A4 and Letter pages, margins, headers and footers, footnotes, columns, page and line numbering, watermarks, mirrored margins, and book\-style chapters\.
- Opens and saves \.odt and \.docx files, exports to PDF, reads and writes password\-protected files, and supports \.ott and \.dotx templates plus a DIN 5008 letter gallery\.
- Styles for paragraphs, characters, tables, and lists with inheritance and chapter numbering; tables support styles, sorting, and spreadsheet\-style formulas\.
- Thesis and long\-document tools including table of contents, captions, cross\-references, citations and bibliography, alphabetical index, and LaTeX formulas\.
- Review tools including track changes, threaded comments, compare and merge, printable markup, spell check, synonyms, and grammar check\.
- Private by design: processing runs locally, documents stay on the computer, and the app can work offline as an installable app\.

## Use Cases

- Drafting and editing letters, newsletters, theses, and book manuscripts with layout that aims to remain compatible with Word, LibreOffice, and WPS Office\.
- Opening \.docx or \.odt files locally without uploading them to a cloud service or installing a desktop suite\.
- Working offline or installing the editor as an app for recurring document work\.
- Reviewing documents with tracked changes, comments, and compare and merge tools\.

## Getting Started

- Open the hosted EdenText app in a browser, start typing, or open an existing \.odt or \.docx file\.
- Install it as an app for offline use if desired\.
- To run it yourself, use the published container image or host the built static files; development commands include npm install, npm run dev, npm test, and npm run build\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- No backend is required, and documents stay in the browser\.
- A container image is published for each release and can be run with docker run \-p 8080:80 ghcr\.io/stffnb/edentext, or the built static files can be hosted by any web server\.
- Serving over HTTPS is recommended; over plain HTTP some browser features such as offline use, app installation, direct save\-back, and copy buttons are disabled\.
- A community\-maintained Helm chart for Kubernetes is available\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project states that bugs cannot be ruled out at this stage\.
- The project advises keeping backups of documents you care about\.
- When enabled, the optional AI assistant sends requests to the provider chosen by the user\.
- Dictation uses browser speech recognition, which may send audio to its speech service\.
- Desktop installers are unsigned, so some operating systems may require extra steps to open them\.

EdenText 是一款基于网页的文字处理器，从速记笔记到整本书稿都能应付。它可以打开和保存 \.odt 与 \.docx 文件，具备真正的页面排版和接近桌面套件的功能，并且完全在浏览器中运行，既没有服务器也没有账户，文档始终留在用户自己的电脑上。

## 核心功能

- 支持真正的页面排版：A4 与 Letter 纸张、页边距、页眉页脚、脚注、分栏、页码与行号、水印，以及书籍式的镜像页边距和章首起于右手页。可打开和保存 \.odt 与 \.docx 文件，导出 PDF，读写两种格式的加密文件，并支持 \.ott 与 \.dotx 模板和基于 DIN 5008 的信函模板库。提供段落、字符、表格和列表样式及其继承关系与章节编号；表格支持样式、排序和电子表格式公式。面向论文与长篇文档的工具包括目录、题注、交叉引用、引文与参考文献、字母索引和 LaTeX

## 适用场景

- 起草和编辑信函、简报、论文和书稿，并让版式尽量与 Word、LibreOffice 和 WPS Office 保持一致。在本地打开 \.docx 或 \.odt 文件，无需上传到云服务，也不必安装桌面套件。离线工作，或把编辑器安装为应用以便经常处理文档。借助修订痕迹、批注以及比较合并功能审阅文档。

## 快速开始

- 在浏览器中打开托管版 EdenText（edentext\.app），即可开始输入或打开已有的 \.odt、\.docx 文件。如需离线使用，可将其安装为应用。若想自行运行，可使用已发布的容器镜像，或托管构建好的静态文件；开发命令包括 npm install、npm run dev、npm test 和 npm run build。

## 部署与要求

- 不需要后端，文档留在浏览器中。每次发布都会提供容器镜像，可用 docker run \-p 8080:80 ghcr\.io/stffnb/edentext 运行，也可由任意 Web 服务器托管构建出的静态文件。建议通过 HTTPS 提供服务；在纯 HTTP 下，离线使用、安装为应用、直接回存到已打开文件和复制按钮等部分浏览器功能会被禁用，在 localhost 上则一切如常。另有社区维护的 Kubernetes Helm chart。

projects.content:
## Overview

Edge0 is an open\-source streaming MoE inference framework for running large sparse models on consumer hardware\. It provides command\-line, local API server, and Edge0 Chat app access, with current 145B and 120B latent\-MoE models for a single NVIDIA GPU and a previous 35B release on the native engine\.

## Key Features

- Runs large sparse mixture\-of\-experts models on consumer hardware using latent MoE and SSD\-streamed expert weights\.
- Offers edge0\-infer, a GGML\-based unified inference engine with a shared C\+\+ API, CLI, OpenAI\-compatible local server, and chat app examples for desktop, Android, and iOS\.
- Supports on\-device inference so sensitive data stays on the hardware without being sent to a cloud model for processing\.
- Enables offline operation and low\-power, low\-memory deployment across phones, laptops, earbuds, glasses, toys, and other devices\.
- Includes language and voice models such as Edge0\-35B, Edge0\-8B, Audio8\-ASR\-3B, and Audio8\-TTS\-0\.6B\.
- Eliminates per\-use charges and token costs by running inference on hardware you already ship\.

## Use Cases

- Smart earbuds: an edge\-cloud voice SDK embedded in earbuds for natural commands and live readouts with zero hardware changes\.
- Robotics and embodied AI: edge\-cloud HRI SDK and robot chips plus edge voice models for natural\-language dialogue, command execution, and offline or weak\-network voice interaction\.
- Smart glasses: edge\-cloud coordination keeps frequent commands on\-device and complex tasks in the cloud to cut latency and cost\.
- Smart cockpit: a fully on\-device cockpit for low power and high performance, with voice interaction accuracy of 93% and command response latency under 200 ms, keeping data in the vehicle\.

## Getting Started

- For 145B and 120B, clone the Edge0 repository, build edge0\-strata and edge0\-infer using their build guides, and run edge0\-infer serve \-\-model /path/to/Edge0\-145B\-q3k from edge0\-infer\.
- The serve command prints a local listening address and exposes OpenAI\- and Anthropic\-compatible endpoints\.
- Use edge0\-infer chat \-\-model /path/to/Edge0\-145B\-q3k for an interactive session, or run Edge0 Chat on Windows by choosing a model folder such as Edge0\-145B\-q3k\.
- Pass one model folder, not the folder that contains several models; edge0\-infer identifies the model by model\_name in model\.json\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Latest 145B and 120B models run on Linux or Windows with an NVIDIA GPU and CUDA 13; build instructions target x64 or ARM64\.
- Platform support depends on model and engine: edge0\-35b native engine supports Linux CPU, Windows CPU or Vulkan, macOS Apple Silicon Metal or CPU, iOS Metal, and Android CPU\.
- The 8B checkpoint is available, with native\-engine support planned\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Model and platform support varies by engine; check the model\-and\-engine pairing before deployment\.
- The unified edge0\-infer engine replaces the earlier Python framework and per\-platform engines; older code is kept at a tag\.
- The 8B checkpoint is available, but native\-engine support is planned rather than current\.
- A 16 GiB VRAM plus 20 GiB RAM reading is a test constraint, not a minimum system requirement\.
- Apple M2 Ultra Metal measurements do not establish macOS release availability\.

projects.content:
## Overview

EdgeEver is an open\-source notes and knowledge base workspace that keeps the classic three\-pane productivity layout of tree view, note list, and editor while adding AI agent integration and open data architecture\. It supports rich text and Markdown editing, multi\-device sync, browser clipping, and deployment either within Cloudflare's free tier or through Docker on a VPS, NAS, or home server\.

## Key Features

- Classic three\-pane workspace with resizable panels, rich\-text and Markdown source toggle, focus mode, and custom CSS\.
- Companion AI sidebar with BYOK support and native MCP for external agents, plus ACP connections to local coding agents on desktop\.
- Official clients across Web, macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android, plus a browser web clipper for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox\.
- Native diagramming for mind maps, flowcharts, and architecture diagrams, with Mermaid and LaTeX support\.
- Data ownership through standard SQLite, lossless ZIP backup, and Markdown plus attachment export and import\.
- Flexible deployment on Cloudflare's free tier or one\-line Docker installation on a VPS or NAS\.

## Use Cases

- Personal note\-taking and knowledge management with fast full\-text search, tags, and offline\-first multi\-device sync\.
- A self\-hosted Evernote or Obsidian alternative for users who want open data and no device limits\.
- AI\-assisted research and writing where agents read, organize, and create notes through MCP or ACP\.
- Migrating existing note libraries from Evernote, Memos, Notion, or flomo using the provided migration guides\.

## Getting Started

- Try the public live demo, but note that it resets daily and is not intended for private content\.
- Deploy on Cloudflare with an AI agent by forking the repository, creating the required D1 and R2 resources, creating a Worker, setting the administrator password secret, verifying the deployment, and enabling the update workflow\.
- Deploy with Docker by running the GitHub\-hosted one\-line installer, which pulls the latest image, generates an administrator password, and starts EdgeEver with Docker Compose\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Cloudflare deployment requires a Cloudflare D1 database named edgeever, an R2 bucket named edgeever\-resources, a Worker named edgeever, and the runtime secret EDGE\_EVER\_AUTH\_PASSWORD, preferably at least 32 characters\.
- Cloudflare R2 requires activating an R2 subscription and adding a payment method before use, even for workloads expected to remain within the free allowance\.
- Docker deployment supports amd64 and arm64 and uses SQLite with local files or S3\-compatible attachment storage\.
- The iOS app requires an Apple ID from outside mainland China\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The public demo is not suitable for private data because it resets daily and restores sample notes\.
- Cloudflare R2 requires an active subscription and payment method before use\.
- Docker installations update automatically each day by default\.
- Using the iOS app depends on having an Apple ID from outside mainland China\.

## 项目简介

EdgeEver 是一款开源笔记与知识库工作区，沿用树状目录、笔记列表与编辑器组成的经典三栏布局，同时加入 AI 智能体集成和开放数据架构。它支持富文本与 Markdown 编辑、多设备同步、浏览器剪藏，并可部署在 Cloudflare 免费额度内，或通过 Docker 运行在 VPS、NAS 或家庭服务器上。

## 核心功能

- 经典三栏工作区，面板宽度可调，支持富文本与 Markdown 源码切换、专注模式和自定义 CSS。
- 伴随式 AI 侧栏，支持自带密钥（BYOK），原生 MCP 可供外部智能体读写笔记，桌面端还可通过 ACP 连接本地编程智能体。
- 官方客户端覆盖 Web、macOS、Windows、Linux、iOS 和 Android，并提供适用于 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 的网页剪藏扩展。
- 原生支持思维导图、流程图和架构图，兼容 Mermaid 与 LaTeX。
- 使用标准 SQLite，支持无损 ZIP 备份，以及 Markdown 与附件导出导入。
- 可部署在 Cloudflare 免费额度内，或通过一行 Docker 安装在 VPS 或 NAS 上运行。

## 适用场景

- 个人笔记与知识管理，具备全文搜索、标签和离线优先的多设备同步。
- 面向希望开放数据且不设设备上限的用户，作为自托管 Evernote 或 Obsidian 替代方案。
- AI 辅助研究与写作，通过 MCP 或 ACP 让智能体读取、整理和创建笔记。
- 使用迁移指南将现有笔记库从 Evernote、Memos、Notion 或 flomo 迁入。

## 快速开始

- 可先试用公共在线演示；演示每天重置，不适合存放私人内容。
- 在 Cloudflare 上通过 AI 智能体部署：Fork 仓库，创建所需的 D1 与 R2 资源，创建 Worker，设置管理员密码密钥，验证部署并启用更新工作流。
- 通过 Docker 部署：运行 GitHub 托管的一行安装程序，它会拉取最新镜像、生成管理员密码，并用 Docker Compose 启动 EdgeEver。

## 部署与要求

- Cloudflare 部署需要名为 edgeever 的 D1 数据库、名为 edgeever\-resources 的 R2 存储桶、名为 edgeever 的 Worker，以及运行时密钥 EDGE\_EVER\_AUTH\_PASSWORD，建议至少 32 个字符。
- 即使预计用量仍在免费额度内，Cloudflare R2 也需要先激活订阅并添加付款方式。
- Docker 部署支持 amd64 和 arm64，使用 SQLite，并可采用本地文件或兼容 S3 的附件存储。
- iOS 应用需要中国大陆以外地区的 Apple ID。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：AGPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

ego lite is a browser built for AI agents to run automation alongside your own browsing\. Agents work in isolated Spaces within the same browser, so they never interrupt you\. It inherits your Chrome data and uses code\-based tools for faster, cheaper runs\. It is free and requires no configuration\.

## Key Features

- Code\-based tools instead of CLI commands, enabling faster runs and fewer tokens for complex tasks\.
- Dedicated isolated Space for each agent, so you and your agents work in parallel without conflict\.
- Parallel multitasking: multiple agents can run different tasks in separate Spaces simultaneously\.
- High\-quality page snapshots that handle deeply nested iframes reliably\.
- Any agent CLI can drive the browser via the ego\-browser skill, exposing in\-page JavaScript tools\.

## Use Cases

- Running parallel data enrichment tasks, e\.g\., Claude Code enriching leads in multiple Spaces\.
- Scraping competitor websites with Codex in separate Spaces\.
- Automating repetitive browser workflows while you continue browsing normally\.

## Getting Started

- Download the macOS app from the provided links, or install the ego\-browser skill via npx skills add citrolabs/ego\-lite\. On first launch, choose to migrate Chrome data to inherit logins and cookies\. Then use /ego\-browser in your agent CLI to start tasks\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Currently supports macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)\. Windows closed beta is coming soon, with Linux on the roadmap\. Requires an agent CLI (e\.g\., Claude Code, Codex) to drive the browser via the ego\-browser skill\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Data stays on\-device with deliberately narrow collection\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Elephant\-Goldfish Model (EGM) is an open\-source plugin for AI assistants\. A drafting assistant that knows the goal, background, and earlier conversation helps write a plan\. Reviewers who do not see that conversation then read the plan and report what is missing or unclear, leaving the user to decide what to change\.

## Key Features

- A drafting assistant works with the goal, background, requirements, and earlier decisions to produce a written plan\.
- Fresh Goldfish reviewers examine the plan and referenced source material without the earlier conversation to expose unstated assumptions and blind spots\.
- The built\-in draft and design\-review workflow targets software specifications, while configurable reviewers and standards support other documents\.
- Skills cover brainstorming, drafting, resolving findings, bootstrapping documentation, reviewing, running a review loop, and reporting drift\.
- Drift reports compare checked\-in documents with the current source code and report where they diverge\.
- The user resolves trade\-offs, approves the design, and decides what to build before implementation\.

## Use Cases

- Develop a software specification from requirements and design decisions, then review it before implementation\.
- Review an existing design document, README, or PR plan against live code\.
- Check documentation for drift from the current source code\.
- Create or update documentation for an existing codebase with the Bootstrap skill\.

## Getting Started

- Choose a supported application, install the complete EGM plugin so its skills can read reviewer prompts and document standards, and start a new session\.
- Installation paths are listed for ChatGPT and Codex desktop, Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Claude Cowork, and ChatGPT Work\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- EGM runs as a plugin in supported AI assistant and coding\-agent applications\.
- Brainstorming and review require a session that can create fresh subagents\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Reviews depend on fresh subagent contexts and do not replace tests or human judgment\.
- Review feature support varies by host application\.
- The ChatGPT and Codex desktop plugin listing is desktop only\.
- The project is not an officially supported Google product\.

## 项目简介

Elephant\-Goldfish Model（EGM）是一个面向 AI 助手的开源插件。了解目标、背景和先前对话的起草助手帮助编写计划；未看到该对话的评审者随后阅读计划并报告缺失或不清晰之处，由用户决定要修改什么。

## 核心功能

- 起草助手结合目标、背景、需求和先前决策生成书面计划；全新的 Goldfish 评审者在不查看先前对话的情况下检查计划及所引用的源材料，以暴露未言明的假设和盲点；内置起草与设计评审工作流面向软件规格说明，可配置的评审者和标准可支持其他文档；技能覆盖头脑风暴、起草、处理评审发现、初始化文档、评审、运行评审循环和报告漂移；漂移报告将已检入文档与当前源代码比较并报告分歧；用户在实现前权衡取舍、批准设计并决定构建内容。

## 适用场景

- 从需求和设计决策出发编写软件规格说明，并在实现前评审；对照实时代码评审现有设计文档、README 或 PR 计划；检查文档与当前源代码之间的漂移；使用 Bootstrap 技能为现有代码库创建或更新文档。

projects.content:
## Overview

elizaOS is an open\-source TypeScript framework and product stack for autonomous AI agents\. The monorepo includes the core runtime, the Eliza app for web, desktop, and mobile, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, first\-party plugins, and Linux and Android distribution tooling\.

## Key Features

- Monorepo stack includes the core runtime, Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, native bridges, first\-party plugins, and Linux and Android distribution tooling\.
- The Eliza app supports chat, voice, memory, knowledge, document workflows, messaging and workspace connectors, personal\-assistant domains, browser and desktop automation, and scheduled workflows\.
- Native device bridges cover camera, phone, messages, contacts, and location\.
- Non\-custodial EVM and Solana wallet operations include approval boundaries\.
- A local inference path provides Eliza\-1 on\-device models and can route capabilities to local, direct\-provider, or Eliza Cloud backends\.
- Plugins can register actions, providers, evaluators, services, model handlers, routes, events, tests, and app views\.

## Use Cases

- Build and run personal AI agents that chat, remember context, manage calendars and reminders, and automate browser or desktop tasks\.
- Develop plugins using the runtime and plugin contracts to add actions, providers, services, routes, events, tests, or app views\.
- Run Eliza from source in a local\-first setup with your own provider keys, without Cloud sign\-in\.
- Evaluate providers and models with the Python benchmark orchestrator\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Bun and Node versions pinned in package\.json, clone the repository, run bun install, then bun run dev\.
- Use bun run dev:local for the app and API with the runtime chooser and your own provider keys; Cloud sign\-in is not required\.
- Use bun run start for the standalone agent host, which provides the API only and no UI\.
- For benchmarks, use Python 3\.11\+ and the suite dependencies, then run the benchmark orchestrator list and run commands from the repository root\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Install the Bun and Node versions pinned in package\.json\.
- Capability availability depends on the operating system, installed plugins, granted permissions, and configured model or service providers\.
- Benchmarks require Python 3\.11\+ and the dependencies required by the selected suite\.
- Live benchmarks require the selected provider's credentials and may incur usage costs\.
- Local inference uses hardware detection and model routing to select supported backends; eligible operations can run offline after required assets are downloaded\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Live benchmark runs depend on provider credentials and may add usage costs\.
- The repository is a large monorepo with many moving parts, so adopters should expect integration complexity\.
- Contribution scope excludes third\-party plugins and registry items\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Ember is an open source real\-time team chat application inspired by Slack and Campfire\. It runs entirely on Cloudflare, with messages kept in Durable Objects and files in R2, and can be deployed in one click to the user's own Cloudflare account\.

## Key Features

- Rooms, private rooms, DMs, threads with an option to also send replies to the room, mentions, quotes, reactions, editing, deletion, unread indicators, Activity filtering, and per\-room notification controls\.
- Rich text with lists, quotes, code blocks and syntax highlighting, link previews, inline images and video, and file sharing up to 250 MB\.
- Slack\-compatible incoming webhooks with Slack formatting, attachments, and Block Kit cards; bots can also answer when mentioned or messaged\.
- Optional Ember AI assistant and custom agents through Workers AI or Cloudflare AI Gateway models, able to read conversations and answer in rooms or DMs\.
- Search across messages and DMs with filters, an installable mobile web app with push notifications, and customization of branding, icons, and CSS\.
- Access options including join link and QR code, email invitations, email domain restrictions, open sign\-up with Turnstile, and Memberful integration\.

## Use Cases

- Small teams that want low\-cost, self\-owned team chat running on their own Cloudflare account\.
- Private communities and membership sites that need join links, email invites, domain restrictions, or Memberful\-based access\.
- Teams that want monitoring, CI, or other tools to post alerts through Slack\-compatible webhooks\.
- Teams that want an optional AI assistant or custom agents available directly inside chat\.

## Getting Started

- Enable R2 in the Cloudflare dashboard, then use the Deploy to Cloudflare button; name the Worker, bucket, and database, choose where messages live, set a setup password, and deploy\.
- Open the Worker address, enter the setup password, and create the community and its administrator\.
- Add the Update Ember workflow to your copy and trim the build API token permissions as described in the self\-hosting guide\.
- Invite the team with the join link on general's welcome card or by email\.
- For local development with Node 22\.22\.2\+, 24\.15\+, or 26\+, and pnpm 10, run pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm dev, and optionally pnpm seed\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A Cloudflare account with R2 enabled for shared files\.
- Each Ember deployment needs its own R2 bucket and database\.
- A small team can use the Workers Free plan; a team of more than about 100 people a day needs Workers Paid\.
- Local development requires Node 22\.22\.2\+, 24\.15\+, or 26\+, and pnpm 10\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Ember relies on the user's Cloudflare account and Cloudflare's pricing for hosting\.

## Overview

EmDash is an open source, full\-stack TypeScript CMS built on Astro, described as the spiritual successor to WordPress\. It combines typed content modeling, an admin panel, media and taxonomy management, and agent tooling, while plugins run in isolated sandboxes with declared capabilities\.

## Key Features

- Astro\-native CMS with content types defined in the admin and TypeScript types generated from the schema\.
- Drafts, revisions, scheduled publishing, preview links, and full\-text search\.
- Admin includes a visual schema builder, media library, navigation menus, taxonomies, widgets, and a WordPress import wizard\.
- Passkey\-first authentication with OAuth and magic link fallbacks, plus role\-based access control\.
- Built\-in MCP server, CLI, and REST API let AI agents and scripts manage content and schema\.
- Sandboxed plugin system with declared capabilities, hooks, storage, admin pages, custom blocks, and API routes\.

## Use Cases

- Build blogs, marketing sites, and portfolios using starter templates\.
- Migrate WordPress content, including posts, pages, media, and taxonomies\.
- Let AI assistants or coding agents draft, edit, search, and schedule content\.
- Extend a site with custom plugins, blocks, admin pages, and API routes\.

## Getting Started

- Run npm create emdash@latest to scaffold a new project\.
- Try the admin in the browser through the EmDash playground\.
- Deploy directly to a Cloudflare account using the Deploy to Cloudflare button\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on Cloudflare with D1, R2, and Workers, or on any Node\.js server with SQLite\.
- Database options include SQLite, D1, Turso/libSQL, and PostgreSQL; storage options include R2, AWS S3, S3\-compatible services, and local filesystem\.
- Plugins execute in sandboxed Cloudflare Worker isolates or in a workerd child process on Node\.js\.
- Sessions can use KV, Redis, or file\-based storage\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Core packages follow semantic versioning; breaking changes ship only in major releases and are called out in the changelog\.
- First\-party plugins and plugin tooling are still on 0\.x and may change between minor releases\.
- Cloudflare is the best\-supported runtime, but EmDash is not locked to it\.

EmDash 是一个基于 Astro 的开源全栈 TypeScript CMS，被称为 WordPress 的精神继任者。它将类型化内容建模、管理后台、媒体与分类法管理以及智能体工具结合起来，插件在隔离沙箱中按声明能力运行。

## 核心功能

- Astro 原生 CMS，内容类型在后台定义，并可根据模式生成 TypeScript 类型；支持草稿、修订、定时发布、预览链接和全文搜索；管理后台包含可视化模式构建器、媒体库、导航菜单、分类法、小部件和 WordPress 导入向导；采用优先使用通行密钥的身份验证，并提供 OAuth 和魔法链接备选方式，同时支持基于角色的访问控制；内置 MCP 服务器、CLI 和 REST API，让 AI 智能体和脚本可以管理内容与模式；插件系统支持声明能力、钩子、存储、管理页面、自定义块和 API 路由，并在沙箱中运行。

## 适用场景

- 使用入门模板构建博客、营销网站和作品集；迁移 WordPress 内容，包括文章、页面、媒体和分类法；让 AI 助手或编码智能体起草、编辑、搜索和安排内容；通过自定义插件、块、管理页面和 API 路由扩展站点。

- 运行 npm create emdash@latest 来搭建新项目；通过 EmDash 演练场在浏览器中试用管理后台；使用 Deploy to Cloudflare 按钮直接部署到 Cloudflare 账户。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

- First\-party skill sources are tracked as repository source and can be edited directly\.

- Dated audits cover first\-party skill guidance and routing for Zod 4\.5, Object Pascal, and Delphi\.

## Use Cases

- Maintaining reusable, project\-neutral agent skills across repositories\.
- Reviewing third\-party skill source, revision, license, date, and changed content before updating records\.
- Auditing first\-party skill guidance and routing for specific languages or frameworks\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Exact is a cross\-platform application runtime\. Developers describe the interface in Contract, a small declarative language, and write data logic in TypeScript or Rust\. The Contract compiler produces a plan; the web runs it as an ES module over the browser's DOM and CSS, while macOS, iOS, and Linux use a Rust runner, a CSS\-based layout kernel, and native drawing through AppKit, UIKit, or a GPU painter\. An AI agent can build, run, see, and test the app on each host\. Android and Windows are early and in progress\.

## Key Features

- Contract declarative UI language with typed shapes, state, derive, resources, mutations, actions, tasks, views, styles, and routes\.
- Cross\-platform hosts for web, macOS, iOS, and Linux, with Android and Windows early and in progress\.
- Agent\-native operations including tree, screenshot, tap, type, state, layout, logs, clock, prefer, and perf through one script\.
- Native rendering uses platform controls on Apple and Linux without a webview or JavaScript bridge in the UI\.
- Performance budgets target 100 ms p50 cold start and dev restart, with no app JavaScript before the first pixel\.
- Optional artifacts include GPU rendering, Markdown editor, text flow, browser SQLite, native modules, and a game engine add\-on\.

## Use Cases

- Building one app that runs on web, macOS, iOS, and Linux from a shared Contract view and TypeScript or Rust data logic\.
- Using an AI agent to create, drive, inspect, and test an app across multiple hosts without a person in the loop\.
- Shipping platform\-native desktop and mobile interfaces where unsaid presentation follows AppKit, UIKit, Linux, or the browser\.
- Creating example or template apps such as a todo app, Caltrain, or the Softwear demonstration store\.

## Getting Started

- Install Rust via rustup, Bun 1\.4\.2, Google Chrome, and Xcode 27\.1 or later for Apple builds\.
- Run bun scripts/exact\.mjs setup once\.
- Run bun host/web/dev\.mjs to start the Caltrain web example and edit apps/caltrain/app\.contract to see the dev loop\.
- Run bun host/apple/build\.mjs \-\-run for macOS, bun host/apple/build\.mjs \-\-ios \-\-run for an iOS Simulator, or cargo build \-\-profile host\-dev \-p caltrain\-linux for Linux\.
- Create a new app with bun scripts/exact\.mjs new \.\./hello, then run bun exact\.mjs web, bun exact\.mjs test web, bun exact\.mjs mac \-\-run, or bun exact\.mjs ios \-\-run\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Rust via rustup, Bun 1\.4\.2, and Google Chrome are required for the documented workflow\.
- Apple builds on macOS require Xcode 27\.1 or later; exact setup \-\-check checks it\.
- TypeScript apps on native hosts require Hermes installed once for each target before building\.
- iOS builds on Linux or WSL require Swift 6\.4\.2, xtool 1\.24\.0, LLVM 23, apple\-codesign 0\.29\.0, and an extracted Xcode 27\.1 SDK\.
- On Windows, use WSL 2 with Ubuntu 24\.04 for iOS builds\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Exact is pre\-1\.0 and changes daily, so APIs are not stable\.
- Android and Windows support is early and still in progress\.
- TypeScript apps on native hosts require Hermes to be installed for each target\.
- Apple builds require Xcode 27\.1 or later\.
- Feedback nudges and sends can be disabled for a machine\.

projects.tagline: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow.
projects.taglineZh: 无需重写整个应用，只把慢的那 5% 换成 Rust。
projects.description: fast-anything profiles an app, ranks functions by time and portability, and helps a coding agent port only the slow functions to Rust. It records real calls, verifies the port against them and extra edge cases, then swaps it in reversibly.
projects.descriptionZh: fast-anything 会分析运行中的应用，按耗时与可移植性排序函数，并协助编码代理只将较慢的函数移植到 Rust。它记录真实调用，用这些调用及额外边界用例验证移植结果，再以可逆方式启用替换。
projects.content:
## Overview

fast\-anything is a command\-line tool for profiling a running application, ranking functions by time spent and portability, and helping a coding agent port only the slowest suitable functions to Rust\. It records real calls, builds a one\-function Rust port, verifies it against recorded and derived cases, and can enable or disable the swap reversibly\. It supports Python, JavaScript and TypeScript runtimes, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Go, PHP, C, C\+\+, C\#, and R, and is available as an npm package or Rust crate\.

## Key Features

- Profiles a running app and ranks functions by time spent and how portable they are\.
- Records up to 500 real calls and creates a one\-function Rust crate plus a TASK\.md file for a coding agent\.
- Verifies the port by replaying recorded calls and deriving extra edge cases; nothing is enabled until every case matches\.
- Rejects a port that is correct but slower per call than the original because the Rust boundary costs more than the work saved\.
- Enables or disables the Rust swap through a single marked block; FAST\_ANYTHING\_DISABLE=1 runs the original\.
- Ships as a Claude Code plugin and an MCP server, and \-\-agent accepts claude, codex, or any command that reads a prompt on stdin\.

## Use Cases

- Teams with a real performance bottleneck in a supported language who want measurable gains without a months\-long migration\.
- Finding slow functions in Python, Node, TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Go, PHP, C, C\+\+, C\#, or R applications\.
- Using a coding agent or a TASK\.md handoff to port a hot deterministic function to Rust while preserving behavior\.
- Producing benchmark results and a PR\-ready report after enabling a port\.

## Getting Started

- Install globally with npm i \-g @el4cteo/fast\-anything or with cargo install fast\-anything\.
- Run the whole pipeline with fast\-anything go \-\-agent claude \-\- python app\.py, replacing the final runtime command as needed\.
- Use the step\-by\-step commands scan \-\- \<cmd\>, port \[id\], verify, enable, disable, bench, report, and doctor\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Ports are compiled with your Rust toolchain, so rustup must be set up\.
- Supported runtime versions include Python 3\.10\+, Node 22\+ with Bun or Deno 2\+, Ruby 3\.3\+, Java 22\+, Kotlin/JVM with JDK 22\+, Go 1\.22\+, PHP 8\.1\+, \.NET 8\+, R 4\.0\+, and gcc, clang, or Intel oneAPI for C and C\+\+\.
- PHP support uses the FFI extension; Go uses cgo; C and C\+\+ use LoadLibrary or dlopen; Ruby, Java, Go, PHP, C, C\+\+, C\#, and R need no headers, bindings, or extra tools beyond the C bridge\.
- With Intel oneAPI on Windows, run fast\-anything from a shell where setvars\.bat ran\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Compiling ports depends on the user's Rust toolchain being set up\.
- Correctness alone does not guarantee enablement; a port that is slower per call than the original is not enabled because the Rust boundary can cost more than the work saved\.
- SYCL kernels are not ported because they run on the device\.

projects.content:
## Overview

FastMCP is a full framework for building Model Context Protocol applications\. It provides one coherent API for servers, clients, and interactive apps, letting developers expose Python functions as MCP tools, connect to local or remote MCP servers, and return interactive interfaces from tools\. FastMCP manages schema generation, validation, transport, authentication, and protocol compatibility around application code\.

## Key Features

- Unified API for MCP servers, clients, and interactive apps
- Converts Python functions into MCP tools with generated schemas and input/output validation
- Connects clients to local or remote MCP servers with protocol negotiation, authentication, and connection lifecycle handling
- Lets tools return interactive interfaces such as forms, tables, and charts alongside ordinary MCP results
- Manages transport, authentication, and protocol compatibility for application code

## Use Cases

- Expose Python application logic as MCP tools, resources, and prompts
- Connect to local or remote MCP servers from Python, the command line, or another MCP application
- Build MCP tools that return forms, tables, charts, and other interactive interfaces alongside ordinary results
- Make documentation searchable by MCP\-compatible agents through an MCP server

## Getting Started

- Install FastMCP with uv add fastmcp\.
- Create a FastMCP instance, decorate a Python function with @mcp\.tool, and run the server with mcp\.run()\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Documentation may describe features that have not yet reached a stable release\.
- The complete documentation file may be too large for some context windows\.

## 项目简介

FastMCP 是用于构建模型上下文协议（MCP）应用的完整框架。它为服务器、客户端和交互式应用提供一致的 API，让开发者能把 Python 函数暴露为 MCP 工具、连接本地或远程 MCP 服务器，并从工具返回交互式界面。FastMCP 在应用代码之外负责模式生成、验证、传输、认证与协议兼容性。

## 核心功能

- 为 MCP 服务器、客户端和交互式应用提供统一 API；将 Python 函数转换为 MCP 工具，并生成模式、验证输入输出；连接本地或远程 MCP 服务器，处理协议协商、认证和连接生命周期；让工具在普通 MCP 结果之外返回表单、表格、图表等交互式界面；为应用代码管理传输、认证和协议兼容性。

## 适用场景

- 将 Python 应用逻辑暴露为 MCP 工具、资源和提示；从 Python、命令行或其他 MCP 应用连接本地或远程 MCP 服务器；构建能返回表单、表格、图表等交互式界面的 MCP 工具；通过 MCP 服务器让兼容 MCP 的代理搜索文档。

## 快速开始

- 使用 uv add fastmcp 安装 FastMCP。创建 FastMCP 实例，用 @mcp\.tool 装饰 Python 函数，并通过 mcp\.run() 运行服务器。

## 采用前须知

projects.description: Free, open-source file converter for Windows, macOS and Linux that converts images, PDFs, Office documents, HWP/HWPX, video, audio, e-books, archives and more locally on your PC without uploading files.
projects.descriptionZh: Filee 是一款免费开源的文件转换器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，可在本机转换图片、PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HWP/HWPX、视频、音频、电子书、压缩包等格式，无需上传文件，常见 Office 文件转换也无需安装 Office。
projects.content:
## Overview

Filee is a free, open\-source file converter for Windows, macOS and Linux\. It opens a donut of compatible formats at the cursor when you hold a key and drag files onto it\. Conversions run on the PC, so files are not uploaded, and Filee can convert images, PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP/HWPX, e\-books, video, audio, archives and other supported formats\.

## Key Features

- Drag\-and\-drop conversion: hold a modifier key, drag files, and drop them on a format in the donut that opens at the cursor\.
- Supports 244 formats in 17 categories, including images, vector graphics, PDF, documents, HWP/HWPX, spreadsheets, presentations, text, data, e\-books, video, audio, subtitles, archives, CAD, 3D models and fonts\.
- Runs locally and works offline; files are not uploaded to a server\.
- Converts Word, Excel, PowerPoint and HWP/HWPX files without Microsoft Office, Hancom Office or LibreOffice for built\-in formats\.
- Batch conversion processes files in parallel, a failed file does not stop the rest, and presets can merge output into one PDF or ZIP\.
- Command line and watch folders support automated conversions with presets, JSON output and exit codes\.

## Use Cases

- Convert HEIC, MOV, DOCX or other files to common formats such as JPG, MP4 or PDF without uploading them\.
- Convert DOCX, XLSX, PPTX or HWP/HWPX documents to PDF or other formats without Office or Hancom Office\.
- Batch\-convert mixed folders and merge documents into a single PDF or pack files into one ZIP\.
- Automate recurring conversions with watch folders or the filee command in scripts and scheduled tasks\.

## Getting Started

- Download Filee from the Releases page\.
- On Windows 10/11, run Filee\-\<version\>\-win\-Setup\.exe, or unzip the portable ZIP and run Filee\.exe\.
- On macOS or Linux preview builds, unpack the package and run \./install\.sh\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows 10/11 (64\-bit) is the stable release; macOS 14\+ and Linux x64/ARM64 builds are previews\.
- Windows installation requires administrator rights once; a portable ZIP is available if you cannot install programs\.
- Optional engines for formats such as video, audio, older Office files and rare e\-books can be selected during installation or downloaded later in the app\.
- On Linux, drag gestures require an X11 session; on Wayland, use the drop zone and the right\-click action\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- macOS and Linux builds are previews; macOS requires a one\-time Privacy & Security approval because the app is not notarized, while Linux drag gestures need X11\.
- Some formats rely on optional engines that are downloaded separately, including FFmpeg, LibreOffice, Calibre, Ghostscript and Pandoc\.
- Conversions are local, but Filee uses the internet to download optional engines and check for updates\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Filee 是一款面向 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的免费开源文件转换器。按住修饰键拖拽文件，光标处会展开可用格式的圆环菜单，把文件放到目标格式上即可转换。转换在本机完成，文件不会上传；支持图片、PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HWP/HWPX、电子书、视频、音频、压缩包以及其他受支持的格式。

## 核心功能

- 拖拽转换：按住修饰键拖拽文件，在光标处打开的格式圆环中放到目标格式上即可完成转换。
- 支持 17 类共 244 种格式，覆盖图片、矢量图、PDF、文档、HWP/HWPX、电子表格、演示文稿、文本、数据、电子书、视频、音频、字幕、压缩包、CAD、3D 模型和字体。
- 转换在本机运行并可离线使用，文件不会上传到服务器。
- 内置格式的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 和 HWP/HWPX 文件转换不需要 Microsoft Office、Hancom Office 或 LibreOffice。
- 批量转换会并行处理文件，单个文件失败不会中断其余任务，预设还可将输出合并为一个 PDF 或 ZIP。
- 命令行和监视文件夹支持使用预设自动转换，并可输出 JSON 和返回退出码。

## 适用场景

- 将 HEIC、MOV、DOCX 等文件转换为 JPG、MP4 或 PDF 等常用格式，无需上传。
- 将 DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 或 HWP/HWPX 文档转换为 PDF 或其他格式，无需 Office 或 Hancom Office。
- 批量转换混合文件夹，并将文档合并为一个 PDF 或将文件打包为一个 ZIP。
- 通过监视文件夹或 filee 命令在脚本和计划任务中自动执行重复转换。

## 快速开始

- 从 Releases 页面下载 Filee。
- Windows 10/11 可运行对应的 Filee Windows 安装程序，或解压便携 ZIP 后运行 Filee\.exe。
- macOS 或 Linux 预览版解压软件包后运行 \./install\.sh。

## 部署与要求

- Windows 10/11（64 位）是稳定版；macOS 14 及以上和 Linux x64/ARM64 构建为预览版。
- Windows 安装需要一次管理员权限；如果无法安装程序，可使用便携 ZIP。
- 视频、音频、较旧 Office 文件和少见电子书等格式所需的可选引擎，可在安装时选择，或稍后在应用内下载。
- Linux 上拖拽操作需要 X11 会话；在 Wayland 下可使用拖放区域和右键操作。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: Firecrawl
projects.tagline: The web data API to search, scrape, and interact at scale.
projects.taglineZh: 用于大规模搜索、抓取和交互的网页数据 API
projects.description: Firecrawl is a web data API for searching, scraping, and interacting with the web at scale. It extracts content as clean Markdown or structured data for AI agents and apps, and is open source with a hosted service.
projects.descriptionZh: Firecrawl 是一个用于大规模搜索、抓取和与网页交互的网页数据 API。它能将内容提取为干净的 Markdown 或结构化数据，供 AI 代理和应用使用，项目开源并提供托管服务。
projects.content:
## Overview

Firecrawl is the web data API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale\. It helps find sources, extract content, and turn it into clean Markdown or structured data that AI agents can use\. The project is open source and also available as a hosted service, with core endpoints for Search, Scrape, and Interact plus Agent, Crawl, Map, and Batch Scrape\.

## Key Features

- Search the web and get full page content from results\.
- Scrape any URL into Markdown, HTML, screenshots, or structured JSON\.
- Interact with a scraped page using AI prompts or code\.
- Use the Agent endpoint to describe the data needed and let the AI agent search, navigate, and retrieve it\.
- Crawl all URLs of a website, map all site URLs instantly, and batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously\.
- Connect to AI agents and MCP clients, with SDKs for Python, Node\.js, Go, Java, Elixir, Rust, Ruby, \.NET, and PHP\.

## Use Cases

- Build AI agents that need real\-time web data in clean Markdown or structured JSON\.
- Search the web and retrieve full page content for research, monitoring, or RAG pipelines\.
- Scrape single pages or crawl entire websites into LLM\-ready formats\.
- Automate data gathering with a prompt when URLs are not known in advance\.

## Getting Started

- Sign up on the Firecrawl website to get an API key\.
- Install an SDK, such as pip install firecrawl\-py for Python or npm install firecrawl for Node\.js\.
- Create a Firecrawl client with your API key and call endpoints such as search, scrape, agent, crawl, map, or batch scrape\.
- For MCP, configure an MCP server with npx \-y firecrawl\-mcp and set the FIRECRAWL\_API\_KEY environment variable\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A Firecrawl API key is required for the hosted service; sign up on the Firecrawl website to obtain one\.
- The project is open source and can be run locally; the contributing guide provides local setup instructions\.
- The project can be self\-hosted, with a separate self\-hosting guide\.
- The cloud version includes additional features compared with the open\-source version\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Users are advised to follow applicable privacy policies and terms of use, and Firecrawl respects robots\.txt directives by default\.
- Use of Firecrawl is subject to compliance with the stated scraping and privacy conditions\.
- When using the Agent endpoint, sending both the model and effort fields results in a 400 error\.

## 项目简介

Firecrawl 是一个用于大规模搜索、抓取和与网页交互的网页数据 API。它帮助查找来源、提取内容，并将其转换为 AI 代理可用的干净 Markdown 或结构化数据。项目开源，同时提供托管服务，核心端点包括搜索、抓取和交互，以及 Agent、Crawl、Map 和 Batch Scrape。

## 快速开始

- 在 Firecrawl 网站注册以获取 API 密钥。安装 SDK，例如 Python 使用 pip install firecrawl\-py，Node\.js 使用 npm install firecrawl。用 API 密钥创建 Firecrawl 客户端，并调用搜索、抓取、Agent、Crawl、Map 或批量抓取等端点。使用 MCP 时，配置 MCP 服务器，运行 npx \-y firecrawl\-mcp，并设置 FIRECRAWL\_API\_KEY 环境变量。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：AGPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: FlashMLA
projects.tagline: Optimized attention kernels for DeepSeek inference
projects.taglineZh: 面向 DeepSeek 推理的优化注意力算子
projects.description: FlashMLA is DeepSeek's library of optimized attention kernels for inference on NVIDIA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs, including sparse and dense attention kernels with FP8 or FP4 KV cache support.
projects.descriptionZh: FlashMLA 是 DeepSeek 的高性能注意力算子库，支撑 DeepSeek-V4.1 在 NVIDIA GPU 与华为昇腾 NPU 上的推理。它提供面向 prefill 与 decoding 的 token 级稀疏注意力算子（支持 FP8 或 FP4 KV 缓存）、融合 Q-norm、Q-RoPE、注意力、O-RoPE 与 FP8 转换的融合算子，以及用于 prefill 和反向传播的稠密注意力算子。
projects.content:
## Overview

FlashMLA is DeepSeek's library of optimized attention kernels, powering inference of DeepSeek\-V4\.1 on NVIDIA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs\. It includes token\-level sparse attention kernels for prefill and decoding with an FP8 or FP4 KV cache, a fused kernel that combines Q\-norm, Q\-RoPE, attention, O\-RoPE, and the cast to FP8, and dense attention kernels for prefill and backward\. The sparse kernels power DeepSeek Sparse Attention\.

## Key Features

- Token\-level sparse attention kernels for prefill and decoding with FP8 or FP4 KV cache
- Fused kernel combining Q\-norm, Q\-RoPE, core attention, O\-RoPE, and cast to FP8
- Dense attention kernels for prefill and backward
- Sparse kernels that power DeepSeek Sparse Attention
- Runs on NVIDIA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs

## Use Cases

- Inference of DeepSeek\-V4\.1 on NVIDIA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs
- Token\-level sparse attention for DSA decoding and prefill
- Dense multi\-head attention forward and backward computations
- Fused attention pipelines for DeepSeek\-V4\.1 attention with permuted Q\_b and Wv weights

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository, initialize submodules, and install with pip using \-\-no\-build\-isolation\.
- For DSA decoding, call get\_mla\_metadata once before the decoding loop, then call flash\_mla\_with\_kvcache in each decoding step\.
- For DSA prefill, call flash\_mla\_sparse\_fwd directly with the query, key\-value, indices, scale, and optional parameters\.
- For dense MHA prefill, use flash\_attn\_varlen\_func, flash\_attn\_varlen\_qkvpacked\_func, or flash\_attn\_varlen\_kvpacked\_func\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- For NVIDIA, requires SM100 or SM103 GPU, CUDA 13\.1 or above, and PyTorch 2\.10 or above\.
- For Huawei, requires Ascend 950 NPU, CANN 9\.2\.0 or above, torch\_npu, and PyTorch 2\.10 or above\.
- Installation requires \-\-no\-build\-isolation because setup\.py imports torch during the build and the repository does not declare it as a PEP 518 build requirement\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The 2026\.09\.30 release removed Hopper architecture and earlier DeepSeek model support and changed the FP8/FP4 KV cache format, making it incompatible with previous versions\.
- The fused norm\-RoPE\-attn\-RoPE\-cast kernel supports CUDA only and is not supported on Ascend\.
- DSA decoding supports only FP8 and FP4 KV cache formats; unquantized bfloat16 KV cache is not supported\.
- The DSA prefill kernel does not support a batch dimension\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

FlashMLA 是 DeepSeek 的优化注意力算子库，支撑 DeepSeek\-V4\.1 在 NVIDIA GPU 和华为昇腾 NPU 上的推理。它包含用于 prefill 和 decoding 的 token 级稀疏注意力算子（使用 FP8 或 FP4 KV 缓存）、将 Q\-norm（仅 V4 使用，V4\.1 不使用）、Q\-RoPE、核心注意力、O\-RoPE（共轭）和 FP8 转换融合在一起的算子，以及用于 prefill 和反向传播的稠密注意力算子。稀疏算子支撑 DeepSeek Sparse Attention（DSA）。

## 核心功能

- 面向 prefill 和 decoding 的 token 级稀疏注意力算子，支持 FP8 或 FP4 KV 缓存
- 融合 Q\-norm、Q\-RoPE、核心注意力、O\-RoPE（共轭）和 FP8 转换的融合算子
- 用于 prefill 和反向传播的稠密注意力算子
- 稀疏算子支撑 DeepSeek Sparse Attention（DSA）
- 可在 NVIDIA GPU 和华为昇腾 NPU 上运行

## 适用场景

- 在 NVIDIA GPU 和华为昇腾 NPU 上推理 DeepSeek\-V4\.1
- 面向 DSA 的 token 级稀疏注意力 decoding 与 prefill
- 稠密多头注意力的前向与反向计算
- 使用预排列的 Q\_b 和 Wv 权重的 DeepSeek\-V4\.1 融合注意力流水线

## 快速开始

- 克隆仓库、初始化子模块，并使用 pip 以 \-\-no\-build\-isolation 安装。
- DSA decoding 时，在 decoding 循环前调用一次 get\_mla\_metadata，然后在每个 decoding 步骤调用 flash\_mla\_with\_kvcache。
- DSA prefill 时，直接调用 flash\_mla\_sparse\_fwd，并传入 query、key\-value、indices、scale 及可选参数。
- 稠密 MHA prefill 可使用 flash\_attn\_varlen\_func、flash\_attn\_varlen\_qkvpacked\_func 或 flash\_attn\_varlen\_kvpacked\_func。

## 部署与要求

- NVIDIA 平台需要 SM100 或 SM103 GPU、CUDA 13\.1 及以上版本，以及 PyTorch 2\.10 及以上版本。
- 华为平台需要昇腾 950 NPU、CANN 9\.2\.0 及以上版本、torch\_npu，以及 PyTorch 2\.10 及以上版本。
- 安装时需要使用 \-\-no\-build\-isolation，因为 setup\.py 在构建期间导入 torch，而仓库未将其声明为 PEP 518 构建要求。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: Floccus
projects.tagline: Sync your bookmarks privately across browsers and devices
projects.taglineZh: 在浏览器和设备间私密同步书签
projects.description: Floccus is a browser extension that privately syncs native bookmarks across browsers and devices through storage you control, including Nextcloud, Git, WebDAV, Google Drive, Dropbox, Linkwarden, and KaraKeep.
projects.descriptionZh: Floccus 是一款浏览器扩展，可通过你掌控的存储，在浏览器和设备之间私密同步原生书签，支持 Nextcloud、Git、WebDAV、Google Drive、Dropbox、Linkwarden 和 KaraKeep。
projects.content:
## Overview

Floccus is a Web extension that syncs native browser bookmarks directly across browsers and devices\. Instead of storing bookmarks in a browser vendor's cloud, it routes sync data through a backend the user chooses, such as Nextcloud Bookmarks, Linkwarden, KaraKeep, Google Drive, Dropbox, any Git server, or any WebDAV\-compatible service\. It also offers a companion Android and iOS app for mobile access because most mobile browsers do not support extensions\.

## Key Features

- Syncs native browser bookmarks directly rather than requiring a separate bookmark manager\.
- Works in browsers that support Web extensions, including Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Opera, Brave, and Vivaldi; Safari is not yet supported\.
- Supports Nextcloud Bookmarks, Linkwarden, KaraKeep, Google Drive, Dropbox, any Git server, and any WebDAV\-compatible service as sync backends\.
- Allows multiple sync profiles with configurable sync strategy, interval, and synced folder\.
- Lets users export their configuration for replication or migration\.
- Provides companion Android and iOS apps for phone access\.

## Use Cases

- Keep the same native bookmarks available across multiple browsers and devices\.
- Store bookmark sync data in an existing Nextcloud instance, Git repository, WebDAV service, or cloud drive\.
- Use separate profiles for bidirectional sync and for one\-way backup to a Git repository\.
- Access bookmarks on a phone through the companion app when the mobile browser does not support extensions\.

## Getting Started

- Download the extension from the project site or your browser's extension store\.
- Read the project's getting\-started guides if you are new to the tool\.
- Choose a sync backend and create a sync profile with your preferred strategy, interval, and folder\.
- For mobile access, install the Floccus Android or iOS app; when sideloading the APK, verify the SHA\-256 fingerprint of the signing certificate\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A browser that supports Web extensions, such as Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Opera, Brave, or Vivaldi\.
- A chosen sync backend: Nextcloud Bookmarks, Linkwarden, KaraKeep, Google Drive, Dropbox, any Git server, or any WebDAV\-compatible service\.
- For phone access, the Floccus Android or iOS app, because most mobile browsers do not support the extension\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MPL\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Safari support is not currently available\.
- Most mobile browsers do not support the extension, so phone access depends on the companion app\.
- Nextcloud sync can hit error code 500 from MySQL or MariaDB emoji charset limitations\.

projects.name: Floorplan
projects.tagline: See how your app actually fits together.
projects.taglineZh: 看清你的应用究竟如何组合在一起。
projects.description: Floorplan is a Claude Code and Codex plugin that draws an interactive, plain-English map of a codebase; its live demo maps Brewline, a sample coffee-shop app with shop, staff app, server, jobs and services.
projects.descriptionZh: Floorplan 是 Claude Code 和 Codex 插件，可读取代码库并生成交互式、通俗易懂的应用地图。其在线演示绘制了 Brewline——一个包含在线商店、员工应用、主服务器、后台任务和外部服务的示例咖啡店应用。
projects.content:
## Overview

Floorplan is a Claude Code and Codex plugin that reads a codebase and draws an interactive map\. Every part, file and web request gets a plain\-English name, and connections between them are shown\. The live demo maps Brewline, a sample coffee\-shop app, while the plugin is used on your own project\.

## Key Features

- A zoomable map at every level: start with the whole app, then inspect parts, file groups, files and endpoints, including what each uses and what uses it\.
- Plain\-English labels and explanations throughout, with a switch to a developer view for technical terms\.
- Real connection matching across repos: Floorplan follows imports and matches frontend web requests to the server endpoints that answer them\.
- Screen\-based exploration: pick a page to see its parts, the requests it makes, the server code, data and outside services behind it\.
- Ask the map: questions return an answer plus a mini\-map of the involved pieces and a step\-by\-step walkthrough\.
- Health check and recent work: flag common security and configuration issues and highlight what the AI just changed, with notes on why\.

## Use Cases

- Understand an app you built with AI without reading all the code\.
- Onboard teammates from the big picture down to exact files and endpoints\.
- See which parts an AI change touched and why after each update\.
- Plan an app that has not been built yet from a PRD or spec as a blueprint\.

## Getting Started

projects.content:
## Overview

FlowGram\.AI, also called FlowGram, is a composable, visual, easy\-to\-integrate, and extensible workflow development framework and toolkit\. It provides built\-in tools for workflow development: flow canvas, node configuration form, variable scope chain, and ready\-to\-use materials such as LLM, Condition, and Code Editor\. It is not a ready\-made workflow platform; it is the framework and toolkit to build one\.

## Key Features

- Free layout canvas where nodes can be placed anywhere and connected using free\-form lines\.
- Fixed layout canvas where nodes can be dragged to specified positions, with support for compound nodes like branches and loops\.
- Form engine that manages CRUD operations of node data and provides rendering, validation, side effects, linkage, and error\-capturing capabilities\.
- Variable engine that supports scope constraints, variable structure inspection, and type inference for managing data flow\.
- Built\-in ready\-to\-use materials including LLM, Condition, and Code Editor\.

## Use Cases

- Build AI workflow platforms faster and simpler using the framework and toolkit\.
- Create visual workflows that iterate over lists, fetch real\-time weather via HTTP, parse temperatures with a Code node, generate outfit suggestions with an LLM, gate by a Condition, aggregate loop results, and use an Advisor LLM to pick a result before the End node\.
- Power AI agent development tools such as Coze Studio\.
- Support workflow\-based AI deployment tools such as NNDeploy and visual SSL certificate management tools such as Certimate\.

## Getting Started

- Create a new FlowGram project with npx @flowgram\.ai/create\-app@latest\.
- Choose the Free Layout Demo template when prompted\.
- Start the project by running cd demo\-free\-layout, npm install, and npm start\.
- Open localhost:3000 in the browser\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- FlowGram is not a ready\-made workflow platform, so adopters should expect to build their own platform using the framework and toolkit\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Free Claude Code (FCC) is an independent open\-source project that routes free, paid, subscription, and local models through a local proxy and Admin UI\. It supports 61 providers and 12 coding agents, letting users keep their preferred agent across terminal, desktop, IDE, browser, and messaging clients\.

## Key Features

- Supports 61 ToS\-friendly providers and more than 1\.3 billion free tokens per month in one searchable UI\.
- Runs 12 coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Cline, Aider, and VS Code Chat, against a shared model catalog\.
- Automatically tries the next configured model after retries are exhausted, across every client\.
- Offers native Codex browser sessions with real\-time and background support and provider or model switching within a session\.
- Provides optional RTK output filtering and Headroom tool\-result compression to reduce token usage by up to 90%\.
- Supports voice notes through local Whisper or NVIDIA NIM transcription and preserves streaming, tools, images, and interleaved thinking\.

## Use Cases

- Route coding agents through free\-tier, subscription, or local models from one shared catalog\.
- Keep a coding session running when a provider fails by configuring fallback models\.
- Access coding agents from a terminal, IDE, desktop app, browser session, Discord, or Telegram\.
- Use voice notes to prompt a coding agent with local Whisper or NVIDIA NIM transcription\.

## Getting Started

- Install using the provided macOS/Linux shell script or Windows PowerShell installer\.
- Start FCC from the desktop or Start menu on Windows, from Applications on macOS, or by running fcc\-server on Linux and keeping the terminal open\.
- Open the Admin UI, add a provider key such as NVIDIA NIM, select a model, and click Apply\.
- Run a launcher such as fcc\-claude, fcc\-codex, fcc\-pi, or fcc\-opencode\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Installers are provided for macOS/Linux and Windows PowerShell\.
- Provider credentials, such as an API key or OAuth connection, are configured in the Admin UI before selecting models; NVIDIA NIM is the default example\.
- Local model use requires a running LM Studio, llama\.cpp, or Ollama server and tool\-capable models with sufficient context\.
- Editor and app integrations require FCC to run on the same computer and in the same user environment as the client\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Free\-tier availability and limits are set by each provider and can change\.
- The project is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic; Claude and Claude Code are Anthropic trademarks\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Free My TV is an open\-source replacement home screen and screensaver for TVs\. It runs on Google TV and Android TV, and is available as an app for LG webOS and Samsung Tizen TVs\. It presents the user's apps on a shelf, trending picks from installed streaming apps, weather details, and optional crypto prices, with a day/night appearance that follows the local sunset\. Installation does not require root; the app uses the TV's own ADB from inside the TV, and users can switch back to the original home screen\.

## Key Features

- Ad\-free home screen with no sponsored rows, banners or autoplaying promos\.
- App shelf for the streaming apps a user actually uses, with app selection and order editable on the TV\.
- Trending picks refreshed hourly from TMDB, limited to apps already installed; Movies and Shows have separate tabs\.
- Weather drawer with hourly forecast, sunrise and sunset, plus optional Binance crypto prices\.
- Day and night appearance that follows the real local sunset, with a matching screensaver\.
- Measured 60 fps performance and lower memory use than the stock home screen on a tested TCL Google TV, plus one\-button restore to Original\.

## Use Cases

- Replacing an ad\-heavy stock home screen on Google TV or Android TV with a cleaner launcher\.
- Adding a similar home\-screen app to LG webOS or Samsung Tizen TVs\.
- Showing trending titles from the user's installed streaming apps without sponsored placements\.
- Checking weather, sunset times and optional crypto prices directly on the TV\.

## Getting Started

- On Google TV or Android TV, enable developer options and USB debugging, and note the TV's IP address\.
- Use an AI coding assistant or the manual build path; for manual installation, clone the repository, set city and TMDB key in config\.properties, run \./build\.sh, then install the APK with adb\.
- On LG TVs, install Developer Mode from the LG Content Store, enable Dev Mode Status and Key Server, build with python3 webos/build\.py, and install with python3 webos/install\.py\.
- On Samsung TVs, enable Developer mode with the computer's IP in Host PC IP, use TizenBrew Installer, and install from GitHub using simbasjungles/free\-my\-tv\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Google TV or Android TV (Android 8 or newer) and a computer on the same Wi\-Fi for installation\.
- For manual Android builds: JDK 17 or newer, Android SDK command\-line tools with build\-tools 34 and platform android\-34, and adb\.
- For LG: an LG TV with webOS 3 or newer, Python 3, a computer on the same Wi\-Fi, and a free LG developer account\.
- For Samsung: a Samsung TV from 2017 or newer (Tizen 3 or newer), a computer on the same Wi\-Fi, and TizenBrew Installer\.
- A free TMDB API key for trending picks; an optional free Watchmode key supports opening title pages in streaming apps\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- On LG TVs, the installation relies on LG Developer Mode, which must be extended periodically to keep the app available\.
- TCL TVs block background execution by default, so TCL installs need an extra app\-ops command to let Free My TV run in the background\.
- On Samsung TVs from 2023 and newer, installing requires a one\-time Samsung account sign\-in to sign the app for the TV\.
- The app has no accounts, analytics or tracking, but it contacts external services for picks, weather, prices and optional title links\.
- If the TV saved a Wi\-Fi network during first setup, the switch may ask the user to forget and reconnect the network before proceeding\.

projects.content:
## Overview

freehire indexes millions of tech jobs directly from company career boards, deduplicates them, and tags them by stack, seniority, and location\. It combines a hosted search site with a keyless public HTTP API, a CLI, an MCP server, and a Chrome side\-panel extension for search and application workflows\.

## Key Features

- Crawls job listings directly from company ATS platforms and career sites, links to original postings, and deduplicates reposts\.
- Provides faceted full\-text search over region, work mode, seniority, skills, and salary\.
- Exposes a keyless public HTTP API for jobs and companies\.
- Ships a CLI and an MCP server so AI agents and terminal users can search jobs without a browser\.
- Includes a Chrome side\-panel extension that reads postings, scores them against a CV, and fills application forms\.
- Supports self\-hosting with Go, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Meilisearch, Redis, and Docker Compose\.

## Use Cases

- Job seekers browsing and filtering tech roles indexed from company career boards\.
- Developers and AI agents querying the public API or using the CLI and MCP server to run job searches\.
- Teams self\-hosting their own instance of the job catalogue and search stack\.
- Candidates using the Chrome extension to assess and apply to postings on any site\.

## Getting Started

- Run make up to build and start the whole Docker stack, then check the health endpoint at localhost:8080/health and the jobs API at localhost:8080/api/v1/jobs\.
- Install the CLI using the published install script; the CLI ships with agent skills for Claude Code and MCP hosts\.
- For local development, start only the database with docker compose up \-d db and run the server on the host with make run\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker Compose for the full local stack: api, web, postgres, meilisearch, redis, and s3\.
- PostgreSQL with pgvector, Meilisearch, Redis, and S3\-compatible object storage as core dependencies\.
- JWT\_SECRET is required for the server to start; OAuth and LLM credentials are optional\.
- Migrations apply automatically on first Postgres volume init; changed migrations require recreating the volume or running make migrate\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.descriptionZh: FreeLLMAPI 将免费 LLM 提供商额度与自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点聚合到一个 /v1 API，并提供智能路由、自动故障转移、加密密钥和自更新目录。
projects.content:
## Overview

FreeLLMAPI is an open\-source, self\-hosted, single\-user router that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers and custom OpenAI\-compatible endpoints behind one OpenAI\-compatible /v1 API\. It stores provider keys encrypted, routes across models and providers, fails over when a provider is rate\-limited, and tracks per\-key usage to stay within free\-tier caps\. The sources cite roughly 7\.4 billion free tokens per month across the aggregated free tiers\.

## Key Features

- One OpenAI\-compatible /v1 endpoint covering chat, responses, completions, images, videos, audio, embeddings, and models, with streaming and non\-streaming support\.
- Anthropic Messages API compatibility at /v1/messages, plus native Gemini /v1beta and opt\-in Ollama emulation surfaces\.
- Smart routing with six strategies, automatic failover on 429/5xx, cooldowns, key rotation, and unified model profiles with fallback chains\.
- Per\-key RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD rate tracking that learns provider\-reported ceilings to keep requests under free\-tier caps\.
- Provider keys are AES\-256\-GCM encrypted in SQLite and decrypted in memory per request; applications see one unified bearer token\.
- Self\-updating signed model catalog, an admin dashboard with analytics, and an MCP server with an OpenAPI viewer\.

## Use Cases

- Point OpenAI\-compatible SDKs and clients at a local router to use free provider tiers through one base URL and unified key\.
- Run coding agents and CLIs such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, OpenCode, and Aider against the aggregated pool\.
- Experiment with multi\-model synthesis through the virtual fusion model, which fans a prompt to diverse free models and synthesizes one answer\.
- Generate images, video, and speech through supported media endpoints, including custom OpenAI\-compatible media endpoints\.

## Getting Started

- Run the Docker\-based install script, open the local dashboard on port 3001, add provider keys on the Keys page, reorder the Fallback Chain, and copy the unified API key\.
- For supported coding agents, use the provided npx freellmapi setup commands with the local router URL and unified key to merge configuration automatically\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker is required for the one\-liner installer\.
- The router runs anywhere Node 20\+ runs, including Windows, macOS, Linux servers, or a small ARM SBC such as a Raspberry Pi\.
- Desktop builds are available for macOS 12 Monterey or later and for Windows through installers from Releases\.
- Provider keys are stored in a local SQLite database and encrypted at rest\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is intended for personal, single\-user use and should not be exposed publicly\.
- Free\-model availability depends on provider allowances and temporary promotions, so access can vary\.
- The stated scope is personal experimentation only\.

projects.content:
## Overview

FreeToken is an edge\-native Mixture\-of\-Experts (MoE) serving engine designed for running frontier\-scale open\-weight models on personal and consumer hardware\. It treats GPUs, CPUs, host memory, and interconnects as a unified, elastic inference platform\.

## Key Features

- Fast edge\-native MoE runtime with bandwidth\-adaptive CPU–GPU co\-execution, full\-layer double\-buffered prefill streaming, global LRU expert caching, graph\-compatible execution, and the FTW fast weight format\.
- Semantic\-aware caching with semantic anchor checkpoints for recurrent state and KV caches, helping avoid redundant context recomputation during agentic context edits\.
- Elastic memory management that dynamically re\-allocates VRAM between expert caches and KV memory at runtime without engine restarts or weight reloading\.
- Broad MoE and ecosystem support across parameter scales and quantization formats including MXFP4, NVFP4, FP8, and BF16\.
- Anthropic/OpenAI\-compatible APIs for integration with coding and tool\-calling agents\.
- Runs across consumer laptops, gaming desktops, and workstation GPUs, with native support for NVIDIA RTX 30, RTX 40, and RTX 50 series GPUs\.

## Use Cases

- Running frontier\-scale open\-weight MoE models locally on gaming PCs and consumer desktops\.
- Serving models to coding and tool\-calling agents through Anthropic/OpenAI\-compatible APIs\.
- Using the desktop GUI to run models, chat, and tune the engine\.
- Experimenting with local model serving across heterogeneous edge resources such as GPUs, CPUs, and host memory\.

## Getting Started

- Download the Windows or Linux desktop app from the project website; it sets up the engine and provides a GUI for running models, chatting, and tuning the engine\.
- Install the CLI with uv using uv pip install "freetoken\[accel\]" or with pip\.
- Build from source by cloning the repository, creating a uv virtual environment, activating it, and running uv pip install \-e "\.\[accel\]"\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app is available for Windows or Linux\.
- CLI installation is supported with uv, recommended, or pip, and the project can be built from source\.
- Native GPU support is provided for NVIDIA RTX 30, RTX 40, and RTX 50 series GPUs\.
- The engine targets consumer laptops, gaming desktops, and workstation GPUs\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

FreeVideo is a local inference engine for MiniMax H3 on consumer GPUs, built on OpenVDN's 8\-step VDN\-H3 model with Video DeltaNet hybrid attention\. It coordinates VRAM, system memory, and disk to adapt weight placement, compute precision, and attention kernels to available hardware, and it runs as a ComfyUI plugin with launchers for Windows, macOS, and Linux\.

## Key Features

- Hardware\-adaptive execution chooses int8 on GeForce RTX 30, 40, and 50 series and other Ampere cards, FP8 on newer workstation and datacenter cards, and probes available attention kernels\.
- Low\-memory inference uses weight streaming, asynchronous prefetching, and chunked computation to enable inference with as little as 8 GB of VRAM and 16 GB of RAM\.
- Multimodal inputs include text prompts, first and last frames, and image, video, and audio references\.
- ComfyUI integration provides a creative workspace with two\-pass sampling, batch generation, creation history, and a node view for adding LoRAs or customizing workflows\.
- One\-click deployment launchers set up ComfyUI, the runtime environment, and models, reuse existing models, and support offline installation\.
- Community LoRAs can be used in MiniMax H3 workflows inside ComfyUI\.

## Use Cases

- Generate MiniMax H3 videos locally on consumer NVIDIA GPUs with as little as 8 GB of VRAM and 16 GB of RAM\.
- Preview a half\-resolution render before committing to a full video, then finish only selected clips\.
- Customize results with MiniMax H3 LoRAs inside a ComfyUI workflow\.
- Generate still images up to 16 MP locally with H3 Image\.

## Getting Started

- On Windows, download and run FreeVideo\.exe, select an existing ComfyUI folder or install a new one, then click Install & launch\.
- On macOS Apple silicon, download FreeVideo\-Mac\-arm64\.dmg, drag FreeVideo\.app into Applications, select or install ComfyUI, then click Install & launch\.
- For an existing ComfyUI installation, clone the FreeVideo repository into ComfyUI/custom\_nodes, restart ComfyUI, open Workflow, Browse Templates, FreeVideo, FreeVideo\-All\-in\-One, and complete setup in FreeVideo Settings\.
- On Linux desktop, download FreeVideo\-Linux\-x86\_64\.AppImage, make it executable and open it, then follow the Windows steps; terminal or server users can clone the repository, run \./setup\.sh, and later type freevideo to open it again\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Full local inference requires an NVIDIA graphics card with compute capability 8\.0 or higher, such as an RTX 30 series or newer, including professional cards\.
- Low\-memory inference can run with as little as 8 GB of VRAM and 16 GB of RAM\.
- Apple silicon Macs run a preview; the preview has been tested on an M5 Mac with 24 GB of unified memory\.
- A ComfyUI installation is needed, or the launcher can set up ComfyUI, the runtime environment, and missing models\.
- Offline installation needs the four model packs (video model, text encoder, video and audio decoder, and sampling caches) plus the environment package for a new ComfyUI installation; the audio reference cache is optional\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- macOS support is a preview and the app is not Apple\-notarized, so macOS blocks first launch until the user approves it\.
- Apple silicon support is a preview tested on a specific Mac configuration with 24 GB unified memory\.
- Security software may block the Windows executable or quarantine project files, requiring checksum verification, file restoration, and an exclusion entry\.

projects.content:
## Overview

GBrain is an MIT\-licensed, self\-hostable memory system for existing AI agents\. It stores explicit facts with their sources, supports corrections and withdrawal, and makes the same memory available across agents\. It combines keyless keyword retrieval with optional semantic search, typed graph traversal, cited synthesis with gap analysis, background enrichment, and configurable schema packs\.

## Key Features

- Explicit fact memory with sources, corrections, withdrawal, and shared access across agents\.
- Keyless keyword retrieval plus optional semantic search, reranking, and cited synthesis with gap analysis\.
- Typed knowledge graph with breadth\-first relationship walks and auto\-linking on trusted local page writes\.
- Cron\-driven background enrichment that deduplicates people pages, fixes citations, scores salience, and finds contradictions\.
- Bundled schema packs plus custom schema detection and authoring for different knowledge layouts\.
- MCP connectivity for supported AI clients and CLI operations for search, synthesis, import, and health checks\.

## Use Cases

- Giving an existing coding or personal agent durable, portable memory with provenance\.
- Preparing for meetings by retrieving sourced context and identifying gaps or stale information\.
- Operating a shared company brain with source and operation grants plus visibility filters\.
- Organizing personal or team knowledge across notes, people, companies, meetings, email, and other sources\.

## Getting Started

- Install GBrain with bun install \-g github:garrytan/gbrain\#stable, then run gbrain setup claude\-code or gbrain setup codex\.
- For CLI\-only use, initialize with gbrain init \-\-pglite \-\-no\-embedding, import Markdown, search, and verify health with gbrain doctor\.
- Connect MCP clients through gbrain setup or publish a local brain with gbrain mcp expose\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Bun 1\.4\.4 or newer is required\.
- PGLite is the default for personal brains up to about 50K pages; Postgres with pgvector is for shared, large, or multi\-machine brains\.
- Always\-on ingestion and overnight enrichment need a server with 8GB\+ RAM and its own API usage\.
- Keyless PGLite setup needs no server or Docker\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- GBrain is not distributed through npm; installation should use the documented Bun/GitHub method\.
- Optional cloud embedding, reranking, extraction, and synthesis providers may receive text; keyless keyword search avoids a model API\.
- For shared company brains, grants and filters constrain remote clients, but authorization tests cover specific access paths rather than a universal no\-leak guarantee\.
- Always\-on ingestion and overnight enrichment need their own server compute and API usage\.
- Database\-only pages, unresolved facts, history, and operational state require a database backup\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Gemini\-API is a reverse\-engineered asynchronous Python wrapper for the Google Gemini web app (formerly Bard)\. It provides a simple, elegant interface inspired by Google Generative AI's official API and supports asynchronous generation, streaming, multi\-turn conversations, media outputs, Gemini Gems, extensions, and deep research\.

## Key Features

- Persistent cookies with automatic background refresh for always\-on services\.
- Native image generation and editing, plus video and audio/music generation\.
- Deep research workflow with plan creation, status polling, and result retrieval\.
- System prompts through Gemini Gems and support for Gemini extensions such as YouTube and Gmail\.
- Classified outputs for text, thoughts, images, videos, and audio, with streaming mode for partial results\.
- Asynchronous client and standalone CLI for quick interactions\.

## Use Cases

- Building always\-on services and chatbots that need automatic cookie refresh\.
- Creating multi\-turn conversational applications with history handling and streaming responses\.
- Generating and saving images, videos, and audio through natural\-language prompts\.
- Running deep research workflows and retrieving structured results\.

## Getting Started

- Install or update the package with pip: pip install \-U gemini\_webapi\.
- Optionally install with browser support using pip install \-U gemini\_webapi\[browser\] to import cookies from a local Firefox browser\.
- Log in to Gemini, copy the \_\_Secure\-1PSID and \_\_Secure\-1PSIDTS cookie values, initialize GeminiClient, and call init with desired timeout and refresh settings\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.11 or higher\.
- Valid Gemini web cookies (\_\_Secure\-1PSID and \_\_Secure\-1PSIDTS) unless browser\-cookie3 cookie import is used\.
- Optional browser\-cookie3 dependency for automatic cookie import; currently only Firefox is supported\.
- In containerized deployments, set GEMINI\_COOKIE\_PATH to a writable path to persist auto\-refreshed cookies\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is a reverse\-engineered wrapper rather than an officially documented Gemini web API client\.
- Image generation availability can vary by region and account\.
- Video and audio generation may require an active subscription\.
- Cookie extraction may be more reliable with Firefox because recent Chromium\-based browsers can limit cookie renewal\.
