projects.content:
## Overview

Horizon is an open\-source AI\-powered news radar that gathers stories from multiple sources, filters and ranks them with configurable profiles, and produces daily briefings in English and Chinese\. It adds summaries, background, and community discussion, then publishes or delivers briefings through Markdown, GitHub Pages, email, webhooks, and WeChat\.

## Key Features

- Collects items from RSS/Atom, Hacker News, Reddit, Telegram, Twitter/X, GitHub, OpenBB, OSS Insight, GDELT, and Google News\.
- Uses profiles to define scoring rubrics, thresholds, deduplication, summaries, context, solutions, and takeaways for different content types\.
- Generates English and Chinese daily briefings with ranked items, summaries, background, and community discussion\.
- Caps digest length and category share so one busy topic does not crowd out other interests\.
- Delivers briefings as Markdown, GitHub Pages, email, webhook notifications, and WeChat\.
- Supports CLI runs, Docker deployment, a setup wizard, an MCP server, and an AI assistant skill for configuration and operation\.

## Use Cases

- Following technology news with impact and community discussion using the tech\-news profile\.
- Tracking engineering deep dives for background, solution, and practical takeaways using the tech\-blog profile\.
- Curating AI creator material with summary, timely hooks, and content angles using the ai\-creator profile\.
- Running a self\-hosted daily news briefing delivered to email, GitHub Pages, or chat webhooks\.

## Getting Started

- Install locally by cloning the repository and running uv sync, or build the Docker image with docker compose build\.
- Configure Horizon with the interactive wizard (uv run horizon\-wizard) or copy \.env\.example and data/config\.example\.json for manual setup, then add API keys and sources\.
- Run the pipeline with uv run horizon locally or docker compose run \-\-rm horizon in Docker\.
- Optionally schedule daily runs with the GitHub Actions workflow template\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A local Python environment using uv or pip is supported, with Docker and Docker Compose as alternatives\.
- An AI provider must be configured, with API key environment variables such as OPENAI\_API\_KEY or GOOGLE\_API\_KEY\.
- Node\.js 22\.20 or newer is required only for the Agent Skill command npx skills add\.
- The optional OpenBB financial\-news source needs its extra, and the Twitter/X extra requires a Playwright browser and system packages that the current Dockerfile does not install\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- WeChat delivery has platform reply limits\.
- The optional Twitter/X source requires a Playwright browser and system packages that the current Dockerfile does not install\.
- The project describes itself as maintained in spare time\.

## Overview

HQBase is an open\-source shared email workspace for teams that runs in the customer's Cloudflare account\. It provides shared mailboxes, team access controls, multi\-domain setup, drafts, audit history, and an OAuth\-protected remote MCP server for AI clients\. Mail and credentials remain in infrastructure the customer controls\.

## Key Features

- Shared mailboxes with team access controls for managing permissions by mailbox\.
- Multiple domains and mailboxes in one workspace, with drafts and audit history\.
- Email via MCP: AI clients connect over OAuth to search, draft, reply, and send\.
- A desktop and mobile PWA client with self\-hosted push notifications for access anywhere\.
- Runs in the customer's Cloudflare account, so the Worker, D1 mail index, and R2 attachments stay theirs\.
- Installation, update, backup, and recovery operations with release verification and rollback support\.

## Use Cases

- Teams that need shared mailboxes while keeping mail and credentials in infrastructure they control\.
- Organizations managing multiple domains and team mailboxes from one workspace\.
- Teams that want AI clients to search, draft, reply, and send email through an OAuth\-protected MCP server\.
- Users who need desktop and mobile access to shared team email through a PWA\.

## Getting Started

- Deploy HQBase to Cloudflare or read the product documentation\. For local development, run pnpm install, pnpm db:migrate:local, pnpm db:seed:local, and pnpm dev\. Before the optional seed command, add BETTER\_AUTH\_SECRET and HQBASE\_LOCAL\_SEED\_PASSWORD with 8 to 128 characters to

## Deployment & Requirements

- Enable Workers Paid, activate the R2 subscription, and have an active domain using Cloudflare DNS\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

HumanLayer is a multiplayer coding agent IDE and cloud that brings agent sessions, plan artifacts, and code diffs together in one workspace\. It runs coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex on local or remote machines and lets teams collaborate on tasks, plans, and reviews from desktop, web, or mobile\.

## Key Features

- Tasks group agent sessions, artifacts, and worktrees in one shared workspace\.
- The QRSPI workflow moves from Questions and Research through Design, Structure, Plan, and Implement with checkpoints\.
- Comment\-driven design reviews let humans and agents discuss and resolve issues before implementation\.
- Full session visibility exposes thinking messages, subagent tool calls, and code changes\.
- A local daemon runs many agent sessions in parallel, while cloud daemons support long\-running work\.
- The same UI is available on web, desktop, and phone, with sessions synced through the HumanLayer API\.

## Use Cases

- Teams collaborating on complex changes in large enterprise codebases\.
- Running background coding agent sessions that continue after you close your laptop\.
- Reviewing design documents and implementation plans before code is written\.
- Managing multi\-repo workspaces with worktrees and multiple agent sessions\.

## Getting Started

- Install the CLI with brew trust humanlayer/humanlayer, then brew install humanlayer/humanlayer/humanlayer\.
- Download the macOS app, or follow the Linux/Windows install instructions for remote daemons\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Source builds require Bun and Docker; building the native desktop app also requires Rust\.
- Self\-hosting guides are in progress; the Docker Compose starter uses default or simple passwords that should be updated before deployment\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- HumanLayer uses bring\-your\-own\-key authentication for AI providers rather than billing tokens through HumanLayer\.
- Self\-hosting documentation is not complete yet, although the cloud service runs this code\.
- The provided Docker Compose self\-hosting starter requires changing default credentials before deployment\.
- A source build disables Sentry, PostHog, and WorkOS integrations when their environment variables are unset\.

projects.tagline: Dual-system cognitive memory for self-evolving LLM agents.
projects.taglineZh: 面向自演化 LLM 智能体的双系统认知记忆引擎。
projects.description: Production-grade dual-system cognitive memory engine and Python SDK for self-evolving LLM agents, with dedicated Chat, Working, and Coding memory pipelines, plus MemHub for local-first cross-application recall.
projects.descriptionZh: 生产级双系统认知记忆引擎与 Python SDK，面向自演化 LLM 智能体，提供 Chat、Working 与 Coding 专用记忆流水线，并包含 MemHub 以支持本地优先的跨应用记忆召回。
projects.content:
## Overview

Hy Memory is a production\-grade dual\-system cognitive memory engine and Python SDK (hy\-memory) for self\-evolving LLM agents\. It provides specialized memory pipelines across three task scenes: hierarchical long\-term cognitive memory for Chat, two\-layer fact and reusable\-experience memory for Working, and version\-evolution diff\-chain tracking for Coding\. Built on top of Hy Memory, MemHub is a local\-first desktop and CLI product that unifies conversation history and coding traces from user\-authorized AI applications into a single managed runtime and local data directory, enabling governed cross\-application memory recall\.

## Key Features

- Dual\-process cognitive memory architecture: personal memory is organized into an 8\-layer hierarchy spanning raw dialogues, atomic facts, summaries, schemas, and prospective intentions, with conflict reconciliation and cross\-domain schema induction\.
- Three memory scenes selected through a scene router: chat for hierarchical memory L0\-L7, working for two\-layer session facts plus reusable experiences, and coding for the same two\-layer memory plus a code version\-evolution diff chain\.
- Working memory records exactly one fact per session describing the task, approach, and result, alongside zero or more reusable experiences that must pass a value threshold\.
- Coding memory reuses the working pipeline but records exact code coordinates instead of pasting code, stores data in isolated cv collections, and attaches every revision of touched code through a diff chain built with zero LLM calls\.
- Three operating modes: lite for raw\-only embedding writes and searches with no LLM calls, pro adding LLM extraction and reconciliation, and ultra adding System 2 schema induction and a cross\-domain sweeper triggered by evolve()\.
- Python SDK with pluggable storage backends: ChromaDB, Qdrant, or FAISS vector stores, Kuzu or Neo4j graph stores, and local SQLite metadata, plus automatic scene routing, source isolation, and CRUD and evolution APIs\.

## Use Cases

- Building long\-term personal memory for chat assistants, including preference recall, profile abstraction, summaries, and prospective intentions with expiry\.
- Supporting productivity work such as documents, spreadsheets, research, financial analysis, content creation, and computer operation by remembering session facts and reusing proven approaches\.
- Assisting software engineering tasks like coding, debugging, testing, builds, APIs/SDKs, scripts, and SQL, while tracking how each piece of code changed across versions\.
- Unifying conversation history and coding traces from user\-authorized AI applications such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and Qwen Code into a single governed local runtime via MemHub\.

## Getting Started

- Install the SDK from PyPI with pip install hy\-memory==2\.0\.2 for the core package including ChromaDB and Kuzu, or select extras such as \[qdrant\], \[faiss\], \[graph\], \[mysql\], \[rerank\], or \[all\]\. Configuration requires only an LLM and an embedding endpoint, and any OpenAI\-compatible

## Deployment & Requirements

- An LLM endpoint and an embedding endpoint are required; any OpenAI\-compatible service works, and the OpenAI defaults can be used with a single key\.
- Vector stores supported are ChromaDB (default), Qdrant, and FAISS; graph stores used in ultra mode are Kuzu (default) and Neo4j\.
- Working and Coding metadata is stored in local SQLite\.
- Graph usage in pro mode is optional and controlled by MEMORY\_ENABLE\_GRAPH, which is off by default\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The SDK depends on external LLM and embedding services, so an OpenAI\-compatible endpoint and credentials must be supplied\.
- Working and Coding scene memory only takes effect in pro or ultra mode and requires writes to carry a tool\-call trace\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Hy Memory 是面向自演化 LLM 智能体的生产级双系统认知记忆引擎和 Python SDK（hy\-memory）。它针对三类任务场景提供专用记忆流水线：Chat 的层级式长期认知记忆、Working 的两层事实与可复用经验记忆，以及 Coding 的版本演化差分链追踪。基于 Hy Memory 构建的 MemHub 是一款本地优先的桌面与 CLI 产品，将用户授权 AI 应用中的对话历史和编码轨迹统一到单个受管运行时和本地数据目录中，实现受治理的跨应用记忆召回。

## 核心功能

- Hy Memory 采用双过程认知记忆架构，将个人记忆组织为覆盖原始对话、原子事实、摘要、图式和前瞻意图的 8 层层级，并支持冲突调和与跨域图式归纳。它通过场景路由器选择三种记忆场景：chat 对应 L0\-L7 层级记忆，working 对应两层会话事实与可复用经验，coding 在相同两层记忆之上增加代码版本演化差分链。Working 记忆每次会话精确记录一条描述任务、方法和结果的事实，并附带零条或多条必须通过价值阈值的可复用经验。Coding 记忆复用 working 流水线，但记录精确代码坐标而非粘贴代码，数据存放在隔离的 cv 集合中，并通过零

## 适用场景

- Hy Memory 可用于为聊天助手构建长期个人记忆，包括偏好召回、画像抽象、摘要以及带过期时间的前瞻意图。它可支持文档、电子表格、研究、财务分析、内容创作和计算机操作等生产力工作，通过记住会话事实并复用已验证的方法来提升效率。它可协助编码、调试、测试、构建、API/SDK、脚本和 SQL 等软件工程任务，同时追踪每段代码在不同版本间的变化。通过 MemHub，它还能将用户授权的 AI 应用（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、OpenCode 和 Qwen Code）中的对话历史和编码轨迹统一到单个受治理的本地运行时中。

## 快速开始

- 安装核心包可使用 pip install hy\-memory==2\.0\.2，其中包含 ChromaDB 和 Kuzu；也可选择附加组件，如 \[qdrant\]、\[faiss\]、\[graph\]、\[mysql\]、\[rerank\] 或 \[all\]。配置仅需 LLM 和嵌入端点，任何 OpenAI 兼容服务均可使用，可设置 MEMORY\_LLM\_API\_KEY、MEMORY\_LLM\_BASE\_URL、MEMORY\_LLM\_MODEL、MEMORY\_EMBEDDER\_API\_KEY、MEMORY\_EMBEDDER\_BASE\_URL、MEMORY\_EMBEDDER\_M

## 部署与要求

- 部署 Hy Memory 需要 LLM 端点和嵌入端点，任何 OpenAI 兼容服务均可使用，也可使用 OpenAI 默认值并仅提供一个密钥。向量存储支持 ChromaDB（默认）、Qdrant 和 FAISS；ultra 模式使用的图存储支持 Kuzu（默认）和 Neo4j。Working 与 Coding 元数据存储在本地 SQLite 中。pro 模式下图的使用是可选的，由 MEMORY\_ENABLE\_GRAPH 控制，默认关闭；ultra 模式下图存储始终开启。lite 模式不使用图数据库。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Other。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

HyperFrames is an open\-source framework and video editor built for agents\. It turns HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos that can be authored locally with the CLI, through AI coding agents with skills, or through hosted authoring workflows\. The project also provides a desktop Studio app, a catalog of reusable blocks and components, and packages for rendering, previewing, and editing compositions\.

## Key Features

- HTML\-native compositions use HTML files with data attributes for timing, tracks, and media instead of a proprietary timeline format\.
- Agent skills teach coding agents the HyperFrames production loop: plan the video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render\.
- Deterministic rendering seeks each frame in headless Chrome and encodes the result with FFmpeg, so the same input produces the same video\.
- Adapter\-based animation supports GSAP, CSS animations, Lottie, Three\.js, Anime\.js, WAAPI, or a custom runtime\.
- CLI workflows include init, lint, check, snapshot, preview, render, publish, and doctor commands, plus cloud and AWS Lambda rendering paths\.
- A desktop Studio app and catalog provide previewing, editing, and reusable blocks or components for transitions, overlays, captions, charts, maps, and effects\.

## Use Cases

- Product launch videos and feature announcements\.
- PR walkthroughs with animated code diffs, narration, and captions\.
- Data visualizations, chart races, and map animations\.
- Social videos with kinetic captions, overlays, and music\.

## Getting Started

- With an AI coding agent, install the versioned plugin using claude plugin marketplace add heygen\-com/hyperframes and claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes, or use npx skills add heygen\-com/hyperframes for standalone skills\. Manually with the CLI, run npx hyperframes init

## Deployment & Requirements

- CLI use requires Node\.js 22\+ and FFmpeg\. Desktop builds are available for macOS and Linux, while Windows and Windows ARM64 are coming soon\. Enterprise deployment is available\. AWS Lambda rendering is available for distributed render stacks, and rendering can run locally or in

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Ian Xiaohei Illustrations is a Codex Skill that guides AI agents to generate body illustrations for Chinese articles, posts, blogs, Notion documents, and methodology content\. It is not a generic illustration prompt or a PPT infographic template\. Its core approach is to first understand cognitive anchors in an article, then turn one judgment, process, structure, state, or metaphor into a memorable 16:9 hand\-drawn explainer image\. The default visual IP is Xiaohei: a solid black character with white dot eyes, thin legs, and a blank expression that must take part in how the system works\. It is made by Ian, a product designer exploring possibilities for tomorrow\.

## Key Features

- Default output is 16:9 horizontal body illustrations and a 4\-8 image shot list for an article\. Each image includes a theme, core meaning, structure type, Xiaohei action, and Chinese annotation suggestions; final PNGs are saved to the workspace's assets folder in an illustrations

## Use Cases

- Writing Chinese articles, posts, blogs, Notion documents, or methodology content that needs body illustrations and article visuals\. Creating knowledge content, methodology content, or AI workflow content and wanting to turn abstract judgments into concrete metaphors\. Using Codex

## Getting Started

- Clone the ian\-xiaohei\-illustrations repository and enter the directory\. Copy the ian\-xiaohei\-illustrations subdirectory from the repository into the Codex skills directory, for example $\{CODEX\_HOME:\-$HOME/\.codex\}/skills/\. After installation, call $ian\-xiaohei\-illustrations in

## Deployment & Requirements

- The subdirectory ian\-xiaohei\-illustrations/ in the repository is what needs to be installed into Codex\. The installation location is $\{CODEX\_HOME:\-$HOME/\.codex\}/skills/\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.tagline: Independent auditing for AI agents
projects.taglineZh: AI 智能体的独立审计层
projects.description: iFixAi is an independent auditing layer for AI agents. It runs agents through simulated business scenarios, sends real-world requests, and grades behavior and misalignment that evals may miss, with reports and an A–F score.
projects.descriptionZh: iFixAi 是面向 AI 智能体的独立审计层。它让智能体在模拟业务环境中处理真实一天可能出现的请求，并由独立评审模型逐条评分，揭示常规评估可能遗漏的错误、盲区与偏离，同时提供证据、A 到 F 评级以及 JSON 和 Markdown 报告。
projects.content:
## Overview

iFixAi is an independent auditing layer for AI agents\. It runs an agent in a simulated business environment, sends requests a real day brings, including requests that push beyond its role, and has a judge grade every reply\. The goal is to surface mistakes, blind spots, and misalignment that conventional evals can miss, and to show what was asked and what the agent did\.

## Key Features

- Independent auditing layer for AI agents that surfaces mistakes, blind spots, and misalignment beyond user\-written evals\.
- Simulates a business environment, sends requests a real day brings, including requests that push past the agent's role, and has a judge grade every reply\.
- Reports a pass or fail for each inspection with evidence, an A\-to\-F grade across five core pillars, and mandatory minimums that cap the grade at D when failed\.
- Default run covers 10 quick chat\-based inspections; \-\-full\-run adds all 61 inspections and sets aside inapplicable checks with reasons\.
- Integrates with coding agents through Claude Code and Codex plugins and a skill for Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, and others\.
- Produces JSON and Markdown reports for run comparison and CI gating with \-\-min\-score\.

## Use Cases

- Auditing customer support or other agents that perform consequential actions such as refunds, account changes, and authorization\-sensitive operations\.
- Finding green eval checks that should not be green when an agent may be misaligned or hiding problems\.
- Running security and governance checks for prompt injection, policy violations, privacy leakage, and destructive actions\.
- Comparing audit runs or gating CI using JSON and Markdown reports and the min\-score option\.

## Getting Started

- Install iFixAi with pip install ifixai using Python 3\.10 or newer\.
- Run the built\-in demo without an API key by authoring and validating reference\.yaml, then running iFixAi with the mock provider in self eval mode\.
- To audit your own agent, install the Claude Code or Codex plugin, or install the skill for supported coding agents and invoke it\.
- Use the guided CLI to describe the agent, build and validate its simulation environment, run ifixai setup, and use \-\-dry\-run before the billed run\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 or newer is required\.
- The agent must expose a chat endpoint; an OpenAI\-compatible endpoint works as is, while other endpoints require a few lines of Python\.
- A judge model from a provider other than the agent's provider is used; supported options include OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, and OpenRouter\.
- Real audits need the judge provider's API key and the agent's own token\.
- Use a staging copy of the agent because probes are real requests\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Real audits rely on an external judge model from a provider different from the agent's provider\.
- Audit probes are real requests, so the documentation advises using a staging copy of the agent endpoint\.

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Python 3\.10 或更高版本。智能体必须提供聊天端点；OpenAI 兼容端点可直接使用，其他端点需要少量 Python 代码。评审模型来自与智能体不同的提供商；支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Azure、Bedrock、OpenRouter 等。真实审计需要评审提供商的 API 密钥和智能体自身的令牌。应使用智能体的暂存副本，因为这些探测是真实请求。

projects.taglineZh: 从单张参考图重建可动画的 Three.js 程序化模型
projects.description: Open-source image-to-3D studies that rebuild an object from one reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model, with token-efficient staged generation and review.
projects.descriptionZh: img2threejs 是一个开源图像转 3D 项目，可将参考图中的对象重建为仅用代码编写的程序化 Three.js 模型，支持质量门禁、动画运行时层级与分阶段生成审查。
projects.content:
## Overview

img2threejs is an open\-source image\-to\-3D project that reconstructs the object in a reference image as a procedural Three\.js model written in TypeScript\. It generates a THREE\.Group factory from primitives, procedural shaders, and generated geometry, adding a runtime hierarchy of pivots, sockets, and colliders so the model is ready to animate\. The gallery shows live code\-only demos running in the browser, and the project uses deterministic Python scripts for validation and gating while model tokens are reserved for visual judgment and code generation\.

## Key Features

- Generates TypeScript THREE\.Group factories from a single reference image using primitives, procedural shaders, and generated geometry rather than mesh files\.
- Runs a staged sculpting pipeline from blockout through optimization, with vision\-reviewed passes and self\-correction until identity\-defining features clear their thresholds\.
- Supports object, character, and hybrid subjects, including an anatomy\-aware character track and optional likeness and multi\-view silhouette workflows\.
- Includes deterministic Python scripts for image probing, spec validation, material evidence, pass orchestration, rendering review, and strict\-quality gating\.
- Uses a detail inventory and strict\-quality gate to map identity\-defining details to real components or materials before code generation\.
- Works with Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode and can be extended through domain plugins such as character, cs2, environment, hello\-cube, and img2glb\.

## Use Cases

- Rebuilding a photographed object or character as an animation\-ready Three\.js model for browser\-based 3D scenes\.
- Studying procedural modeling examples and generated source in the live demo gallery\.
- Adding domain\-specific reconstruction workflows for CS2 weapon skins or rigged characters through plugins\.
- Experimenting with an agent\-driven, token\-efficient image\-to\-3D pipeline\.

## Getting Started

- Install Node\.js 18 or newer, Git, Python 3\.10 or newer, and one supported agent such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or Hermes\.
- Run npx \-\-yes img2threejs@latest install to link the skill into every agent it finds\.
- Run npx \-\-yes img2threejs@latest doctor to check managed installations\.
- Restart the agent and invoke the img2threejs skill with a reference image and a request to rebuild the object as a procedural Three\.js model following the quality gates\.
- Optionally install the img2 harness with npx \-\-yes @img2threejs/img2@latest install \-\-yes and add only the plugins you need, such as character or cs2\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 18 or newer, Git, and Python 3\.10 or newer\.
- One of Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or Hermes as the agent host\.
- Python scripts use only the Python 3\.10\+ standard library and require no additional packages\.
- Plugin workflows require the separate img2 harness; the private environment plugin additionally requires authorized GitHub access\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Running the installer or doctor does not prove visual likeness or animation quality; the reconstruction's render and domain gates must pass\.
- The private environment plugin is not publicly accessible; it requires authorized GitHub access and working Git credentials\.
- Installing the skill alone does not perform a reconstruction; the agent must validate the image, write an assessment and spec, generate the factory in passes, and review rendered comparisons\.

img2threejs 是一个开源图像转 3D 项目，可将参考图中的对象重建为用 TypeScript 编写的程序化 Three\.js 模型。它从基础几何体、程序化着色器和生成几何生成 THREE\.Group 工厂，并加入由枢轴、插槽和碰撞体组成的运行时层级，使模型可直接用于动画。项目画廊展示在浏览器中运行的纯代码演示；确定性 Python 脚本负责校验与门禁，模型 token 主要用于视觉判断和代码生成。

## 核心功能

- 从单张参考图生成 TypeScript 的 THREE\.Group 工厂，使用基础几何体、程序化着色器和生成几何，而不是网格文件。
- 采用从粗模到优化的分阶段雕刻流程，逐轮进行视觉审查，并在身份特征达到阈值前自我修正。
- 支持 object、character 和 hybrid 主题，包含解剖感知角色轨道，以及可选的人脸相似度和多视图轮廓工作流。
- 提供确定性 Python 脚本，用于图像探测、规格校验、材质证据、阶段编排、渲染审查和严格质量门禁。
- 在代码生成前通过细节清单和严格质量门禁，将身份定义细节映射到真实组件或材质。
- 兼容 Hermes、Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode，并可通过 character、cs2、environment、hello\-cube、img2glb 等领域插件扩展。

## 适用场景

- 将拍摄对象或角色重建为适用于浏览器 3D 场景、可动画的 Three\.js 模型。
- 在实时演示画廊中研究程序化建模示例和生成源码。
- 通过插件增加 CS2 武器皮肤或绑定角色等领域特定重建流程。
- 试验由代理驱动、节省 token 的图像转 3D 流程。

## 快速开始

- 安装 Node\.js 18 或更新版本、Git、Python 3\.10 或更新版本，以及 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 或 Hermes 等受支持代理之一。
- 运行 npx \-\-yes img2threejs@latest install，将技能链接到检测到的各代理。
- 运行 npx \-\-yes img2threejs@latest doctor，检查受管理安装。
- 重启代理，并向 img2threejs 技能提供参考图，要求按照质量门禁重建为程序化 Three\.js 模型。
- 可选：运行 npx \-\-yes @img2threejs/img2@latest install \-\-yes 安装 img2 工具链，再只添加需要的插件，例如 character 或 cs2。

## 部署与要求

- Node\.js 18 或更新版本、Git 和 Python 3\.10 或更新版本。
- Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 或 Hermes 之一作为代理宿主。
- Python 脚本仅使用 Python 3\.10\+ 标准库，无需额外安装包。
- 插件工作流需要独立的 img2 工具链；私有 environment 插件还需要获得授权的 GitHub 访问权限。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Impeccable is a design skill and plugin for coding agents\. It supplies design vocabulary for creating interfaces from scratch, improving existing UI, and staying aligned with a project’s design system\. It includes commands for tasks such as polish, audit, critique, typeset, and distill, plus a design hook that checks UI edits and reports findings back to the agent\. The detector runs in code without an AI model or API key\.

## Key Features

- Provides design commands for creating, evaluating, refining, and polishing interfaces, including polish, audit, critique, typeset, distill, clarify, layout, colorize, animate, delight, bolder, quieter, harden, and onboard\.
- Detects and removes AI slop with 62 checks, catching defaults before they become the design\.
- Respects existing design systems by scanning tokens, components, and rules, and loading DESIGN\.md\.
- Stores user and product context in PRODUCT\.md and records visual systems in DESIGN\.md\.
- Includes a design hook that checks UI edits and sends findings back to the agent; it runs in code without an AI model or API key\.
- Supports multiple coding tools, including Codex CLI, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes Agent, Devin, and Replit Agent\.

## Use Cases

- Build a new interface from scratch with agent\-provided design expertise\.
- Improve or polish an existing page while preserving the project’s colors, components, and design rules\.
- Review UI with critique and audit to identify hierarchy, clarity, and craft issues\.
- Catch AI slop in UI edits before shipping, using the detector or design hook\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx impeccable install in your project folder and follow the prompts\.
- In Claude Code, add the marketplace with /plugin marketplace add pbakaus/impeccable, open /plugin, choose Discover, and install Impeccable\.
- Alternatively, run npx skills add pbakaus/impeccable\.
- After installation, reload the coding tool, run /impeccable init, and enable automatic checks with /impeccable hooks on\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A supported coding agent environment, such as Codex CLI, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or another listed integration\.
- Permission for the coding tool to run hooks; complete the tool’s hook approval or workspace trust steps\.
- For Codex, review and trust Impeccable’s PostToolUse and Stop hooks in Settings → Hooks or /hooks\.
- The design detector runs in code without an AI model or API key\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Automatic design checks depend on the coding tool allowing hooks and on completing hook approval or workspace trust\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Inbox Zero is an AI email assistant and email client for Gmail, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Outlook accounts\. The assistant works in the background to organize your inbox, pre\-draft replies in your tone and style, and manage your calendar, while the email client offers a fast split\-inbox experience on web, desktop, and mobile\. It is open source, with the AI assistant, web app, and desktop email app published on GitHub, and it can also be self\-hosted for full control of your data\.

## Key Features

- AI personal assistant that organizes your inbox and pre\-drafts replies in your tone and style
- AI rules for email configured in plain English
- Reply Zero tracking of emails to reply to and those awaiting responses
- Bulk unsubscribe and bulk archive tools for cleaning up your inbox
- Cold email blocker that automatically blocks cold emails
- Email analytics that track your activity and trends over time

## Use Cases

- Individuals, entrepreneurs, and executives who want to buy back time spent on email
- Power users and teams handling high email volumes who need integrations and shared analytics
- Founders, small businesses, creators, realtors, customer support, and e\-commerce teams managing busy inboxes
- People who want to self\-host their email assistant and email client for full control

## Getting Started

- Use the hosted version of Inbox Zero at getinboxzero\.com
- Connect your Google or Microsoft email account; smart categories are set up automatically and you can use the provided categories or create your own
- Self\-host by running the one\-time setup wizard with npx @inbox\-zero/cli setup, then start containers with npx @inbox\-zero/cli start, and open http://localhost:3000
- Verify a Gmail or Outlook email account to link in two clicks and start organizing and drafting in minutes

## Deployment & Requirements

- Self\-hosting requires Docker and Node\.js v24 or later
- Self\-hosting via the CLI prerequisites are Docker and Node\.js v24\+; complete self\-hosting instructions, production deployment, OAuth setup, and configuration options are in the Self\-Hosting Docs
- Inbox Zero supports Gmail, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Outlook email accounts
- The iOS App Store app can connect to your own server URL if you self\-host

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Android app is described as an older React Native app and is due for an update, so Android users may not have parity with the iOS app\.
- The iPhone app is not currently open source, though the project says it plans to open it; the AI assistant, web app, and desktop email app are open source\.
- Starting the AI assistant trial requires a credit card even though the email app itself is free to use\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Infinite Canvas is an open\-source workbench for image and video creation\. It brings canvas orchestration, AI image generation, reference\-image editing, a chat assistant, a prompt library, and asset management into one interface\. Users can generate, connect, and recompose images, text, and shapes on the canvas, turning creation from single generations into continuous iteration\. It supports visual creation workflows and multi\-Agent collaboration\.

## Key Features

- Infinite canvas: multiple canvas projects, node drag and zoom, connections, minimap, undo and redo, and import and export\.
- AI creation: the browser front end connects directly to configured OpenAI\-compatible interfaces for text\-to\-image, image\-to\-image, reference\-image editing, text Q&A, audio, and video generation; compatible with channels such as chatgpt2api, grok2api, flow2api, and newapi\.
- Canvas assistant: converse and generate images around selected and upstream nodes, then insert results back into the canvas\.
- Local Agent and Codex app plugin: connect Codex or Claude Code through the local Canvas Agent so the Agent can operate the current canvas via MCP; the Codex plugin registers MCP automatically and attempts to launch the local Agent\.
- Plugin system and custom interfaces: install, enable, update, and uninstall remote node plugins by URL; use the TypeScript SDK to develop canvas node plugins; customize image and video interface calls\.
- Prompt library: includes seven open\-source prompt sources and supports custom standard JSON sources, connected directly by the browser front end and cached in IndexedDB\.

## Use Cases

- Exploring visual directions and iterating continuously: generate, connect, and recompose images, text, and shapes on the same canvas, and save reusable prompts, reference styles, and result images\.
- Creating posters, presentations, infographics, and other visual assets: prompt library examples cover Apple\-style posters, Zootopia posters, gradient glass\-style PPT slides, cartoon infographics, and city posters\.
- Reference\-image editing and style replication: edit with reference images, including generating posters from reference styles, replicating PPT styles, and applying the same filter effect to photos\.
- Video generation and local Agent collaboration: generate video, and connect Codex or Claude Code through the local Canvas Agent to operate the current canvas via MCP\.

## Getting Started

- For local development, clone the repository, enter the web directory, run bun install, and then run bun run dev\.
- For Docker, run docker compose up \-d in the repository root; the default port is 3000\.
- After first opening the app, go to settings in the top\-right corner and enter your OpenAI\-compatible Base URL and API Key\. If the default OpenAI interface call method does not match your API, customize the image or video script calls\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A working OpenAI\-compatible interface is required, with Base URL and API Key configured\.
- AI API keys, Base URLs, canvas data, assets, and generation records are stored in the browser locally by default\.
- Docker deployment uses default port 3000\.
- The browser front end connects directly to configured OpenAI\-compatible interfaces\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

## 项目简介

无限画布是一款面向图片与视频创作的开源工作台。它把画布编排、AI 图片生成、参考图编辑、对话助手、提示词库和素材沉淀放在同一个界面里，让用户可以在画布上生成、连接和重组图片、文字与图形，把创作从单次生成变成连续推演。

## 核心功能

- 无限画布：支持多画布项目、节点拖拽缩放、连线、小地图、撤销重做和导入导出。
- AI 创作：浏览器前台直连配置的 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持文生图、图生图、参考图编辑、文本问答、音频和视频生成；兼容 OpenAI 接口生态，支持 chatgpt2api、grok2api、flow2api、newapi 等渠道接入。
- 画布助手：围绕选中节点和上游节点对话、生图，并把结果插回画布。
- 本地 Agent 与 Codex App 插件：通过本机 Canvas Agent 连接 Codex / Claude Code，让 Agent 通过 MCP 操作当前画布；Codex 插件可自动注册 MCP 并尝试拉起本地 Agent。
- 插件系统与自定义接口：支持通过 URL 安装、启用、更新、卸载远程节点插件，提供 TypeScript SDK 开发画布节点插件，并可自定义生图/视频接口调用方式。
- 提示词库：内置 7 个开源提示词来源并支持自定义标准 JSON 来源，由浏览器前端直连并缓存到 IndexedDB。

## 适用场景

- 视觉方案探索与连续迭代：在同一画布中生成、连接和重组图片、文字与图形，保存和复用稳定出图的提示词、参考风格与结果图片。
- 海报、PPT、信息图等平面视觉创作：提示词库示例覆盖苹果风格海报、疯狂动物城海报、渐变玻璃风格 PPT、卡通信息图和城市海报等场景。
- 图片参考编辑与风格复刻：支持参考图编辑，示例包括参考图片风格生成海报、复刻 PPT 风格、给照片加滤镜效果等。
- 视频生成与本地 Agent 协作：支持视频生成，并可通过本地 Canvas Agent 连接 Codex/Claude Code，由 Agent 通过 MCP 操作当前画布。

## 快速开始

- 本地开发：克隆仓库后进入 web 目录，运行 bun install，再运行 bun run dev。
- Docker 运行：在仓库根目录执行 docker compose up \-d，默认端口 3000。
- 首次打开后进入右上角配置，填入 OpenAI 兼容的 Base URL 和 API Key；如默认 OpenAI 接口调用方式不适用，可自定义生图/视频脚本调用。

## 部署与要求

- 需要准备可用的 OpenAI 兼容接口，并在配置中填写 Base URL 与 API Key。
- AI API Key、Base URL、画布、素材和生成记录默认保存在浏览器本地。
- 使用 Docker 运行时默认端口为 3000。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- 项目处于开发阶段，本地存储格式可能调整，历史数据兼容性没有保证。
- 配置和创作数据默认保存在浏览器本地，使用前需了解本地存储与自有 API 密钥的依赖。
- 使用 Codex 插件或手动添加 MCP 会增加 token 消耗；仅启动本地 Agent 不会自动安装 MCP。

- 长篇生产管线：按规划、上下文编排、写作、审稿记录和原子提交推进章节，并维护角色、伏笔、章节摘要等结构化状态。
- 多形态创作：支持长篇小说、独立短篇、剧本、分镜、同人番外、仿写续写、互动影游、开放世界与翻译。
- 专业 Skills 与检索：内置 19 个专业 Skills，故事记忆、材料库和 Skill 参考资料共用 SQLite FTS5/BM25 检索投影。
- 多模型服务与路由：支持 Google Gemini、Moonshot、MiniMax、DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Ollama 等服务，并可按 Agent 配置不同模型。
- 可靠性机制：章节工作区先校验后原子提交，自动状态快照、文件锁、Action 队列和 Zod schema 校验降低半完成或坏数据风险。

## 适用场景

- 连载长篇小说创作：从创作简报到世界观、角色、卷纲和章节意图，持续写作、审稿与修订。
- 独立短篇与封面制作：通过 Studio Chat 或 CLI 生成完整短篇包，包括正文、大纲、审稿记录、简介卖点与封面提示词。
- 互动叙事与开放世界：用自然语言定义世界契约、时间推进、角色与物品规则，生成可继续游玩的互动内容。
- 多语言内容与翻译交付：支持英文小说写作设置以及长文翻译等跨语言创作任务。

## 快速开始

- 安装需要 Node\.js 22\.16 或更高版本，然后运行 npm i \-g @actalk/inkos 全局安装。
- 初始化项目并启动 Studio：运行 inkos init my\-novel，进入目录后运行 inkos，从启动日志中的本机地址打开 Studio。
- 在 Studio 的模型配置中选择服务商、协议，粘贴 API Key 并测试连接，选择可用模型后保存。
- 创建书籍并写作：运行 inkos book create \-\-title "吞天魔帝" \-\-genre xuanhuan，再运行 inkos write next 吞天魔帝。

## 部署与要求

- 运行环境需要 Node\.js 22\.16 或更高版本。
- 需要配置可用的 LLM 服务与 API Key；Studio 使用可视化服务配置，CLI、daemon 和部署环境支持 env 覆盖。
- Studio 默认本地服务只接受同源浏览器请求，自定义嵌入或反向代理需通过 allowedOrigins 配置可信来源。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：AGPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- 2\.0 分支为开发版本，需使用本地构建进行验证。
- kkaiapi 是本地开发与真实生产验收所依赖的外部服务。
- Studio 默认本地服务只接受同源浏览器请求。

projects.name: Jev Chat Assistant
projects.tagline: Reads chats, judges intent, drafts replies you send
projects.taglineZh: 先读聊天，判断意图，起草回复，发送由你决定
projects.description: Jev Chat Assistant is an open-source chat copilot for Android, Windows, and macOS. It reads visible chats, judges intent and danger level, drafts ranked replies, and fills a chosen reply into the input box; you decide whether to send.
projects.descriptionZh: Jev Chat Assistant 是一款面向 Android、Windows 和 macOS 的开源聊天辅助工具。它读取屏幕上的聊天，判断对方意图与风险等级，生成并排序回复草稿，将选中的回复填入输入框，是否发送由你决定。
projects.content:
## Overview

Jev Chat Assistant is an open\-source chat copilot for Android, Windows, and macOS\. It reads visible chat messages, judges intent and danger level, drafts ranked reply options, and fills the chosen reply into the input box for the user to review and send\. The project emphasizes user\-controlled sending, local storage for keys and notes, and bring\-your\-own model endpoints\.

## Key Features

- Reads visible chats through Android accessibility, with OCR fallback for missing text, and captures desktop chat windows on Windows and macOS\.
- Judges true intent, danger level from 0 to 9, what the other person needs, whether to reply with substance, next action, subtext, and tension resolution\.
- Drafts and ranks three reply options, then fills the selected option into the input box without sending automatically\.
- Supports local notes and contact profiles, with pinned notes included and matched notes or recent history used only when enabled\.
- Lets users configure separate judge, reply, and vision model endpoints, with presets for OpenRouter, Bocha Jev, TypeSafe, DeepSeek, and Qwen\-compatible APIs\.
- Open\-source MIT project with Android, Windows, macOS editions and a source\-only iOS keyboard\.

## Use Cases

- Choosing wording for sensitive or ambiguous personal messages before replying\.
- Reviewing possible intent and conversational risk in one\-to\-one chats\.
- Drafting ranked reply options in supported apps such as QQ, X/Twitter DMs, Feishu/Lark, WhatsApp, or other apps via manual OCR\.
- Keeping suggested replies consistent with locally stored notes and contact context\.

## Getting Started

- Download the Android APK from the GitHub project page and install it on an Android 11\+ arm64\-v8a device\.
- In Settings, add an OpenRouter API key to the judge endpoint; leave the reply and vision endpoints blank to inherit that key, and use the connection tests\.
- Grant accessibility, display\-over\-other\-apps, autostart, and unrestricted battery permissions; after an upgrade, toggle accessibility off and on again\.
- Windows and macOS editions are listed on the GitHub project page with separate setup instructions\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Android 11\+ on arm64\-v8a devices; accessibility and overlay permissions are required, and autostart plus unrestricted battery are needed on some Android skins\.
- Windows 10 1903 or later, or Windows 11\.
- macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon\.
- A configured model endpoint and API key for judging, drafting, and optional vision requests; provider charges may apply\.
- The iOS keyboard has no App Store build and must be built from source with Xcode\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Chat text is sent to the model endpoint you configure during analysis; the author runs no server and other data stays local\.
- Model calls require your own API key and may incur charges from the model provider\.
- Judgments are mainly calibrated on English and close\-relationship conflicts, so Chinese, group, and work chats may be less accurate\.
- Some Android skins can freeze the app and make the floating bubble disappear; autostart and unrestricted battery settings help\.
- Using the app inside third\-party messaging apps may violate their terms and risk account restrictions or bans\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Jev Chat Assistant 是一款面向 Android、Windows 和 macOS 的开源聊天副驾驶。它通过读取屏幕上可见的聊天内容，判断对方意图和危险等级，生成并排序多条回复草稿，再把选中的一条填入输入框，由用户自行决定是否发送。项目强调发送权归用户、密钥与笔记保存在本地，并允许用户自带模型端点。

## 核心功能

- 在 Android 上通过无障碍服务读取当前聊天；文本缺失时使用设备端离线 OCR，在 Windows 和 macOS 上则捕获聊天窗口内容。
- 判断真实意图、0 到 9 的危险等级、对方需要什么、是否应给出实质回复、下一步行动、是否存在潜台词以及紧张是否已化解。
- 生成三条回复并按匹配度排序，可复制或填入输入框，但不会自动发送。
- 支持本地笔记和联系人资料；置顶笔记会随每次请求发送，其他笔记按标签或标题匹配，历史记录默认关闭，开启后对方近期消息会一并使用。
- 可分别配置判断、回复和视觉模型端点，提供 OpenRouter、Bocha Jev、TypeSafe、DeepSeek 官方和兼容 Qwen 的 API 预设，并支持一键连接测试。
- 采用 MIT 开源许可，提供 Android、Windows、macOS 版本，以及仅提供源码、需自行构建的 iOS 键盘。

## 适用场景

- 在回复敏感或含义不明的私人消息前，帮助斟酌措辞。
- 在一对一聊天中参考对方可能的意图和对话风险。
- 在 QQ、X/Twitter 私信、飞书/Lark、WhatsApp 等受支持应用中生成排序后的回复选项，也可通过手动 OCR 处理其他应用。
- 让回复建议与本地保存的笔记和联系人背景保持一致。

## 快速开始

- 从 GitHub 项目页下载 Android APK，安装到 Android 11\+ 且为 arm64\-v8a 的设备。
- 在设置中把 OpenRouter API Key 填入判断端点；回复和视觉端点留空即可继承该密钥，并可用一键连接测试检查。
- 授予无障碍、悬浮窗、自启动和不限制电量权限；升级后需在系统设置中关闭再开启无障碍服务。
- Windows 和 macOS 版本在 GitHub 项目页提供，分别按照对应项目的说明安装和配置。

## 部署与要求

- Android：Android 11\+，arm64\-v8a 设备；需要无障碍和悬浮窗权限，部分定制系统还需自启动和不限制电量。
- Windows：Windows 10 1903\+ 或 Windows 11。
- macOS：macOS 13\+，Apple Silicon。
- 需要配置模型端点和 API Key，用于判断、起草以及可选的视觉请求；模型调用可能产生提供商费用。
- iOS 键盘没有 App Store 版本，需要用 Xcode 从源码构建。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.description: Jev Ultrafast is Browser Use's fast, low-cost web agent, built with TypeSafe. It uses structured page state and a dynamic action space to complete natural-language tasks; Browser Use offers cloud browser access for AI agents at $0.02 an
projects.descriptionZh: Jev Ultrafast 是 Browser Use 与 TypeSafe 推出的浏览器智能体，采用动态索引操作空间和结构化页面状态，接收自然语言目标并选择操作与目标元素，仅在需要输入文本时调用小型 LLM。Browser Use 还面向 AI 智能体提供云端浏览器访问，价格为每小时 0.02 美元。
projects.content:
## Overview

Jev Ultrafast is a browser agent with a dynamic, indexed action space from Browser Use and TypeSafe\. It takes one natural\-language goal, reads an element table from the page, selects an operation and target, and calls a small LLM for text only when the operation is TYPE\_TEXT\.

## Key Features

- Dynamic indexed action space with the operations CLICK, TYPE\_TEXT, SELECT, SCROLL\_UP, SCROLL\_DOWN, WAIT, DONE, and BLOCKED\.
- One TypeSafe request per decision cycle for operation and target selection\.
- No screenshots in the default agent loop; the agent consumes structured page state\.
- Atomic DOM snapshot with indexed controls, freshness guards, and target validation\.
- A small LLM generates text only when the operation is TYPE\_TEXT\.
- Local inspector shows numbered elements, operation probabilities, target probabilities, and executed actions\.

## Use Cases

- Search Google Flights for one\-way Zurich to London flights on September 20, 2026 for one adult in economy\.
- Find and open the Wikipedia article about Gödel’s incompleteness theorems\.
- Run a local hotel search and filter task\.
- Inspect operation probabilities, target probabilities, and executed actions in a local inspector\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository and run uv sync\.
- Copy \.env\.example to \.env and add TYPESAFE\_API\_KEY and TEXT\_MODEL\_API\_KEY\.
- Run uv run jev\.
- Open the local inspector on port 8766, then click Start demo and Run automatically\.
- Use Choose next to pause before execution\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python environment managed with uv\.
- TYPESAFE\_API\_KEY and TEXT\_MODEL\_API\_KEY\.
- Chrome connected through Browser Harness, which uv sync installs\.
- Allow remote debugging in Chrome when prompted\.
- The example configuration uses an OpenRouter key for TEXT\_MODEL\_API\_KEY\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The current release is an MVP with several browser features outside its scope\.
- The DOM reader covers common controls but not the full accessible\-name specification\.
- Some examples and recording workflows incur paid API usage\.
- Browser tabs used by the agent share the existing Chrome profile\.
- Reported timing results come from a narrow repeated test rather than a general reliability benchmark\.

projects.name: Keploy
projects.tagline: Record anything. Replay anywhere.
projects.taglineZh: 随处录制，随处回放。
projects.description: Keploy captures real application traffic and turns it into editable tests and dependency mocks, enabling developers to replay and verify changes in isolated environments locally, in CI, or on Kubernetes.
projects.descriptionZh: Keploy 捕获真实应用流量并将其转化为可编辑测试和依赖模拟，让开发者可在本地、CI 或 Kubernetes 的隔离环境中回放并验证变更。
projects.content:
## Overview

Keploy is an open\-source platform for creating safe, isolated production sandboxes for API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing\. It records real request and response flows, virtualizes downstream dependencies, and replays them deterministically to verify changes\.

## Key Features

- Captures real API traffic from production, staging, or local environments with zero code changes and records request and response flows\.
- Creates isolated mocks for databases, Kafka, Redis, and third\-party APIs so downstream dependencies can be replayed as\-is\.
- Deduplicates flows and filters volatile fields such as timestamps, IDs, and random tokens for deterministic replay\.
- Generates editable test artifacts with assertions for schemas, status codes, and key fields, and can run them as API, integration, end\-to\-end, or contract suites\.
- Replays tests in CI/CD, Kubernetes, or local environments with mock dependencies and time\-freeze controls\.
- Provides coverage reports, regression alerts on Slack, email, or webhooks, and AI\-assisted bug detection\.

## Use Cases

- Verify application changes against recorded production traffic before merging or releasing\.
- Run deterministic API and integration tests in CI/CD or Kubernetes without shared infrastructure bottlenecks\.
- Generate and maintain API test suites using real traffic, schemas, and application context\.
- Surface regressions and likely root causes with coverage reports, alerts, and automated assertions\.

## Getting Started

- Use the Keploy documentation and quickstarts to get up and running\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs locally, in CI/CD, or across Kubernetes\.
- Supports self\-hosted and Kubernetes deployment options\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Captured traffic can be kept inside your environment by running a self\-hosted data plane\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Keploy 是一个开源平台，用于为 API、集成和端到端测试创建安全、隔离的生产沙箱。它记录真实请求与响应流，虚拟化下游依赖，并以确定性方式回放，以验证变更。

## 核心功能

- 从生产、预发布或本地环境捕获真实 API 流量，无需改动代码即可记录请求与响应流。
- 为数据库、Kafka、Redis 和第三方 API 创建隔离模拟，使下游依赖可按原样回放。
- 对流量去重并过滤时间戳、ID、随机令牌等易变字段，以支持确定性回放。
- 生成可编辑的测试制品，并为模式、状态码和关键字段生成断言，可作为 API、集成、端到端或契约测试套件运行。
- 在 CI/CD、Kubernetes 或本地环境中回放测试，支持模拟依赖和时间冻结控制。
- 提供覆盖率报告、通过 Slack、电子邮件或 Webhook 发送的回归告警，以及 AI 辅助的缺陷检测。

## 适用场景

- 在合并或发布前，用已记录的生产流量验证应用变更。
- 在 CI/CD 或 Kubernetes 中运行确定性的 API 与集成测试，避免共享基础设施瓶颈。
- 利用真实流量、模式和应用上下文生成并维护 API 测试套件。
- 通过覆盖率报告、告警和自动断言发现回归及可能的根本原因。

## 快速开始

- 可参考 Keploy 文档和快速入门，以完成初始配置并开始使用。

## 部署与要求

- 可在本地、CI/CD 或 Kubernetes 中运行。
- 支持自托管和 Kubernetes 部署选项。

projects.name: Kev
projects.tagline: Small Jev-like decision models to train and run yourself.
projects.taglineZh: 可自行训练和运行的小型 Jev 式决策模型。
projects.description: Kev is a family of small decision models built on Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8, based on Jev's architecture. Use pretrained weights or train your own, with yes/no, multiple-choice, and rating questions in one request.
projects.descriptionZh: Kev 是建立在 Qwen3.5 和 Qwen3.8 之上的小型决策模型家族，基于 Jev 架构。可使用预训练权重或自行训练，并在一次请求中处理是/否、多选和评分问题。
projects.content:
## Overview

Kev is a family of small decision models built on Qwen3\.5 and Qwen3\.8 and based on the architecture described in Jev's Architecture Unmasked\. It ships as Kev 1\.0 with four sizes, from a 0\.8B model that runs on a laptop to a 27B model for a single data\-centre GPU\. You can use the pretrained weights or train your own, and the API matches TypeSafe's System One so their Python SDK can point at a local Kev server\.

## Key Features

- Yes/no, multiple\-choice, and rating questions can be asked in one request; questions share the text but cannot read each other\.
- Calibrated probabilities are provided by default, with each checkpoint shipping with a fitted temperature\.
- The TypeSafe Python SDK works against a Kev server unchanged for drop\-in Jev compatibility\.
- Four sizes are versioned together as Kev 1\.0: Kev\-0\.8B, Kev\-4B, Kev\-9B, and Kev\-27B\.
- Documents of up to 65,536 tokens are supported, with validated context documented per model and execution on CUDA, ROCm, and Apple Silicon through MLX\.
- You can fine\-tune on your own labelled examples and deploy an HTTPS endpoint that scales to zero when idle\.

## Use Cases

- Routing support tickets by department and assessing escalation or customer frustration from text\.
- Classifying or scoring documents and short text with calibrated probabilities for automation thresholds\.
- Fine\-tuning decision questions on domain\-specific labelled data such as routing categories, escalation rules, or another language\.
- Running local or self\-hosted decision\-model inference for applications that already use the TypeSafe System One API\.

## Getting Started

- Try the hosted Hugging Face Space to run Kev\-4B and Kev\-0\.8B in the browser with nothing to install\.
- For local use, install Python 3\.12 or 3\.13 and uv, clone the repository, run uv sync \-\-extra serve, then start the server with uv run \-\-extra serve python \-m kev\.serve \-\-run jaredpalmer/kev\-4b \-\-port 8009\.
- Send requests to POST /v1/systemone with a state and questions, or use the TypeSafe Python SDK included by uv sync \-\-extra serve\.
- Fine\-tune with kev\.train using JSONL examples, or use the kev\-finetune coding\-agent skill; deploy with the kev\-deploy skill or a Modal app\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Local serving requires Python 3\.12 or 3\.13, uv, and a supported accelerator; the default device selection probes CUDA or ROCm, then MPS, then CPU\.
- Kev\-0\.8B runs on a 4 GB GPU or any Apple Silicon Mac; Kev\-4B and Kev\-9B target L40S or H100 class GPUs; Kev\-27B needs an 80 GB GPU and serves in bf16 at about 66 GB resident with serving buffers\.
- For an HTTPS endpoint, a Modal account is required; the deployment scales to zero when idle and the first request after idle waits about 35 seconds for a container to start\.
- The local server binds to 127\.0\.0\.1 by default and can require a bearer key with KEV\_API\_KEY\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Thresholds should be validated on local data before relying on calibrated confidence\.
- Fine\-tuning gains are measured in distribution and do not establish performance on unrelated tasks\.
- Modal HTTPS deployments scale to zero, but the first request after idle incurs a cold\-start wait\.
- Kev\-27B has substantial serving memory requirements and needs an 80 GB GPU\.
- The lower\-latency Modal path keeps a paid GPU container warm even when idle\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Kev 是建立在 Qwen3\.5 和 Qwen3\.8 之上的小型决策模型家族，基于 Jev's Architecture Unmasked 所述架构。它以 Kev 1\.0 发布四个尺寸，从可在笔记本运行的 0\.8B 到适合单张数据中心 GPU 的 27B。你可以使用预训练权重或自行训练；其 API 与 TypeSafe 的 System One 匹配，因此 TypeSafe 的 Python SDK 可指向本地 Kev 服务器。

## 核心功能

- 一次请求可包含是/否（noul）、多选（choice）和评分（score）问题；问题共享文本，但不能互相读取。默认提供校准概率，每个检查点附带拟合温度。TypeSafe Python SDK 可直接对 Kev 服务器工作，兼容 Jev。四个尺寸以 Kev 1\.0 一起版本化：Kev\-0\.8B、Kev\-4B、Kev\-9B 和 Kev\-27B。支持最长 65,536 token 的文档，各模型卡片记录已验证上下文；可在 CUDA、ROCm 和 Apple Silicon 上通过 MLX 执行。可在自有标注样本上微调，并部署空闲时缩容到零的 HTTPS 端点。

## 适用场景

- 按部门路由支持工单，并从文本评估升级需求或客户挫败感。对文档和短文本进行分类或评分，用校准概率设置自动化阈值。在领域特定标注数据上微调决策问题，例如路由类别、升级规则或另一种语言。为已使用 TypeSafe System One API 的应用运行本地或自托管决策模型推理。

## 快速开始

- 可先在 Hugging Face Space 浏览器试用 Kev\-4B 和 Kev\-0\.8B，无需安装。本地使用需 Python 3\.12 或 3\.13 和 uv；克隆仓库后运行 uv sync \-\-extra serve，再用 uv run \-\-extra serve python \-m kev\.serve \-\-run jaredpalmer/kev\-4b \-\-port 8009 启动服务器。向 POST /v1/systemone 发送包含 state 和 questions 的请求，或使用 uv sync \-\-extra serve 包含的

## 部署与要求

- 本地服务需要 Python 3\.12 或 3\.13、uv 和支持的加速器；默认设备选择依次探测 CUDA 或 ROCm、MPS，最后 CPU。Kev\-0\.8B 可在 4 GB GPU 或任何 Apple Silicon Mac 上运行；Kev\-4B 和 Kev\-9B 面向 L40S 或 H100 级 GPU；Kev\-27B 需要 80 GB GPU，以 bf16 服务时约 66 GB 常驻（含服务缓冲区）。若需 HTTPS 端点，需要 Modal 账户；部署空闲时缩容到零，空闲后首个请求需等待约 35 秒启动容器。本地服务器默认绑定

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Kilo Code is an open\-source AI coding agent and agentic engineering platform available in VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, the CLI, cloud, Slack, and a desktop app\. It provides specialized agents, model selection across 500\+ models, and workflows for coding, planning, debugging, and code review\.

## Key Features

- Open\-source coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, CLI, cloud, Slack, and desktop\.
- 500\+ models with mid\-task switching and provider\-rate pricing with zero markup\.
- Specialized Code, Plan, Ask, and Debug agents, plus custom agents\.
- Auto Model routing with Efficient, Frontier, and Free options\.
- Kilo Marketplace for agents, skills, MCP servers, and plugins\.
- Autonomous mode for CI/CD through kilo run \-\-auto\.

## Use Cases

- Generate and edit code across multiple files from natural language\.
- Plan complex features and review implementation plans before coding\.
- Debug and trace issues in a codebase\.
- Run autonomous coding tasks in trusted CI/CD pipelines\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Kilo Code extension in VS Code or from the VS Code Marketplace, then create an account\.
- Install the CLI via npm, pnpm, bun, Homebrew, AUR, or the curl install script, then run kilo in a project directory\.
- Install the Kilo Code plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace or search for Kilo Code in Settings → Plugins\.
- Use the Cloud Agent from the web or set up automated code reviews for pull requests\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Kilo Desktop is marked as beta\.
- Autonomous mode auto\-approves permission prompts unless a rule denies the action and should only be used in trusted environments\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Kimi Code is a developer\-focused intelligent coding service in Kimi membership, based on Kimi's flagship models\. It provides code reading, file editing, and command execution through desktop, CLI, and VS Code extension products, and lets subscribers use an API Key to connect Kimi Code model capabilities to third\-party development tools and platforms\. The CLI can also run as an AI coding agent in the terminal\.

## Key Features

- Desktop, CLI, and VS Code extension clients are available; other editors can connect through the CLI's ACP protocol\.
- Code reading, file editing, command execution, and result verification can be completed in conversation\.
- Built on the K3\.1 Pro series models with up to 1M context and standard and high\-speed model options\.
- The API is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic protocols and can be configured in Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and other third\-party tools\.
- The CLI supports video input, MCP configuration, plugins and Agent Skills, subagents, and lifecycle hooks\.
- The CLI can drive sessions in ACP\-compatible editors such as Zed and JetBrains\.

## Use Cases

- Open a local project in the desktop app and use AI conversation to complete code reading, file editing, command execution, and result verification\.
- Use the CLI in a terminal to let AI complete development tasks autonomously, and continue sessions in IDEs such as Zed or JetBrains through ACP\.
- Use the VS Code sidebar for code completion, file editing, web search, and automation tasks\.
- Configure an API Key in third\-party tools such as Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex to use Kimi Code model capabilities\.

## Getting Started

- Choose Kimi Code Desktop, Kimi Code CLI, or Kimi Code for VS Code and install it using the corresponding official method\.
- After installing an official client, sign in with a Kimi account; no manual API Key management is needed\.
- After installing the CLI, run kimi in the terminal and use /login on first use to sign in to the Kimi Code platform\.
- For API access to third\-party tools, create an API Key in the Kimi Code console and configure the corresponding Base URL and API Key\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Kimi Code Desktop supports macOS, Windows, and Linux\.
- On Windows, install Git for Windows before first CLI launch; if Git Bash is installed in a custom location, set KIMI\_SHELL\_PATH to the absolute path of bash\.exe\.
- For API access to third\-party tools, create an API Key and configure either the Base URL or the full Endpoint as required by the tool\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.name: kimi-k3-in-c
projects.tagline: 2.78T-parameter Kimi K3 inference in portable C99
projects.taglineZh: 用 C99 在单 CPU、8 GB 内存上运行 2.78 万亿参数 Kimi K3
projects.description: Runs Kimi K3, a 2.78-trillion-parameter model, on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM by streaming the model from disk instead of holding it in memory. Portable C99 with no BLAS, framework, or GPU.
projects.descriptionZh: 通过从磁盘流式读取模型而非全部载入内存，kimi-k3-in-c 可在单 CPU、8.24 GB 峰值内存下运行 2.78 万亿参数的 Kimi K3。项目使用可移植 C99，不依赖 BLAS、框架或 GPU。
projects.content:
## Overview

kimi\-k3\-in\-c is a portable C99 inference engine for the Kimi K3 model\. It keeps a small working set in memory and streams the dense trunk and routed experts from disk, allowing a 2\.78\-trillion\-parameter model to run on one CPU with measured peak memory of 8\.24 GB\.

## Key Features

- Runs Kimi K3, a 2\.78\-trillion\-parameter mixture\-of\-experts model, on a single CPU without a GPU\.
- Streams model data from disk instead of holding the full 1\.56 TB checkpoint in memory, with a measured peak RSS of 8\.24 GB\.
- Uses portable C99 with no BLAS and no framework, and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows builds\.
- Multiplies routed experts directly from packed 4\-bit form, which ships at 0\.53125 bytes per weight\.
- Uses KDA recurrent state and MLA shared latent caching to reduce attention memory\.
- Includes test gates and cache simulation tools for verifying engine output and expert cache capacity\.

## Use Cases

- Running Kimi K3 inference on consumer laptops or desktops with limited RAM\.
- Experimenting with large mixture\-of\-experts inference and disk\-streaming techniques on a single CPU\.
- Validating an inference engine against a PyTorch reference using the repository test suite\.
- Measuring memory use, token speed, and expert cache behavior across RAM budgets\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository, run make \-j, and run make test to verify the engine without downloading a checkpoint\.
- Run scripts/k3\-doctor\.sh to check the toolchain, size RAM to a preset, and measure storage\.
- Set HF\_TOKEN and run scripts/download\-model\.sh to fetch and verify the 1\.56 TB checkpoint\.
- Run scripts/pack\-trunk\.sh to pack the 93 dense layers into a trunk file\.
- Run bin/k3 with the model directory, trunk path, tokenizer, preset, prompt, and generation options\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Storage: about 1\.7 TB free for the 1\.56 TB checkpoint plus 109 GB packed trunk, ideally on fast local disk\.
- RAM: 8 GB and up; every preset works, and more memory is faster but never changes output\.
- OS: Linux x86\-64 is the reference; macOS/arm64 and Windows/x86\-64 also build and pass every gate\.
- CPU: AVX2 and FMA on x86\-64, or NEON on arm64; AVX\-512 is unnecessary\.
- Toolchain: GCC 9 or newer, or Clang 10 or newer, with GNU make or CMake, and Python 3\.9 or newer for download, pack, and analysis tools\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Deployment is gated by storage: the checkpoint and packed trunk require roughly 1\.7 TB free, ideally on a fast local disk\.
- A partial checkpoint download can produce wrong tokens, so per\-shard verification should be treated as a hard stop on failure\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

kimi\-k3\-in\-c 是面向 Kimi K3 模型的可移植 C99 推理引擎。它把常驻工作集留在内存中，并将稠密主干与路由专家从磁盘流式读取，使 2\.78 万亿参数模型可在单 CPU 上运行，实测峰值内存为 8\.24 GB。

## 核心功能

- 支持在单 CPU、无 GPU 环境下运行 2\.78 万亿参数的 Kimi K3 混合专家模型；从磁盘流式读取模型数据，而不是把 1\.56 TB 检查点全部放入内存，实测峰值 RSS 为 8\.24 GB；使用可移植 C99，不依赖 BLAS 和框架，支持 Linux、macOS 与 Windows 构建；路由专家可直接从打包的 4 位形式参与乘法，该形式以每权重 0\.53125 字节发布；采用 KDA 循环状态和 MLA 共享潜变量缓存来降低注意力内存；提供测试门和缓存模拟工具，用于校验引擎输出与专家缓存容量。

## 适用场景

- 在内存有限的消费级笔记本或台式机上运行 Kimi K3 推理；在单 CPU 上试验大型混合专家推理与磁盘流式读取技术；使用仓库测试套件将推理引擎与 PyTorch 参考实现进行校验；测量不同内存预算下的内存占用、token 速度与专家缓存行为。

## 快速开始

- 克隆仓库后运行 make \-j，并运行 make test，在没有检查点的情况下验证引擎；运行 scripts/k3\-doctor\.sh 检查工具链、按预设评估内存并测量存储；设置 HF\_TOKEN 后运行 scripts/download\-model\.sh 获取并校验 1\.56 TB 检查点；运行 scripts/pack\-trunk\.sh 将 93 个稠密层打包为 trunk 文件；运行 bin/k3，并提供模型目录、trunk 路径、分词器、预设、提示词与生成选项。

## 部署与要求

- 存储：约 1\.7 TB 可用空间，用于 1\.56 TB 检查点加 109 GB 打包 trunk，最好放在快速本地磁盘；内存：8 GB 及以上，所有预设均可工作，更多内存只提升速度而不改变输出；操作系统：Linux x86\-64 为参考平台，macOS/arm64 与 Windows/x86\-64 也可构建并通过全部门禁；CPU：x86\-64 需 AVX2 与 FMA，arm64 需 NEON，AVX\-512 并非必需；工具链：GCC 9 或更新版本，或 Clang 10 或更新版本，配合 GNU make 或 CMake，下载、打包与分析工具需要

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: Kitesurf

projects.taglineZh: 面向 Agent 的无状态 Cloudflare Workers 浏览器引擎
projects.description: Kitesurf is an experimental browser engine on Cloudflare Workers. It fetches pages, runs JavaScript, lays them out and paints them, and speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol without a Chromium process or container.
projects.descriptionZh: Kitesurf 是运行在 Cloudflare Workers 之上的实验性浏览器引擎。它获取页面、执行页面 JavaScript、完成布局与绘制，并支持 Chrome DevTools Protocol，因此现有工具可直接驱动它，且无需 Chromium 进程或容器。
projects.content:
## Overview

Kitesurf is an experimental browser engine that runs on top of Cloudflare Workers\. It fetches a page, runs its JavaScript, lays it out, and paints it, and it speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol so existing tools can drive it\. There is no Chromium process or container behind it, and the project describes a stateless web browser built for agents\.

## Key Features

- Runs as an experimental browser engine on Cloudflare Workers with no Chromium process or container\.
- Fetches pages, executes page JavaScript, lays out content, and paints rendered output\.
- Speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol, so CDP clients such as Puppeteer can drive it\.
- Provides a stateless browser built for agents, with DevTools inspection of the DOM, console, and network while rendering\.
- Produces screenshots, PDFs, and rendered HTML from real pages\.
- Includes a terminal client that can render with kitty graphics where supported or plain text elsewhere\.

## Use Cases

- Inspecting page rendering in Chrome DevTools, including the DOM, console, and network\.
- Driving page navigation and screenshots through CDP clients such as Puppeteer\.
- Generating screenshots, PDFs, or rendered HTML from real pages\.
- Browsing the web from a terminal with the Kitesurf terminal client\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository and install dependencies with pnpm install \-\-frozen\-lockfile\.
- Build and start the local engine with pnpm run dev; the local engine listens on port 8787 and the health endpoint confirms it is running\.
- Connect a CDP client such as Puppeteer to the local browser WebSocket endpoint at port 8787\.
- Install the terminal client with brew install cloudflare/cloudflare/kitesurf and start it with kitesurf \-m ansi\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A Cloudflare Workers Paid plan is required to run Kitesurf on Cloudflare\.
- Local development uses wrangler dev; deployment builds with Bazel and uploads with Wrangler using wrangler login or CLOUDFLARE\_ACCOUNT\_ID and CLOUDFLARE\_API\_TOKEN\.
- Deployments need an authentication layer such as Cloudflare Access because the engine has no authentication of its own\.
- Building requires Bazelisk installed as bazel, Node\.js 22 or newer, pnpm 9\.15\.4, and GNU tar on macOS; Rust via rustup is only needed to edit vendored crate patches\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project labels Kitesurf as experimental\.

projects.description: KnowNote is a local-first AI knowledge base and NotebookLM alternative for questioning your own documents. It runs parsing, splitting, embedding and vector search inside the app, and answers include the source passage behind them.
projects.descriptionZh: KnowNote 是一款本地优先的 AI 知识库与 NotebookLM 替代工具，可用于向自己的文档提问。解析、切分、嵌入和向量检索都在应用内运行，答案会保留所依据的原文段落。
projects.content:
## Overview

KnowNote is a desktop application that turns PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint files and web pages into a knowledge base you can question\. Parsing, splitting, embedding and vector search run inside the app, so retrieval works offline\. Answers keep references to the source passages, including where each passage sat in the extracted text\.

## Key Features

- Local retrieval runs in\-process and keeps working offline; documents, notebooks and embeddings stay on the machine\.
- Traceable answers keep the source passages and record where each passage sat in the extracted text\.
- Bring your own chat model through OpenAI\-, Anthropic\- or Google\-compatible endpoints or a local server such as Ollama\.
- Import PDF, Word, PowerPoint and web pages, with each format parsed to preserve page, heading and slide structure\.
- Save structured notes beside sources and turn a notebook into a mind map\.
- Serve a notebook read\-only over stdio MCP so local agents can search documents with provenance\.

## Use Cases

- Research: question a set of papers and inspect the cited passages behind each answer\.
- Study: build notes from course readers, slides and other source documents\.
- Agent\-assisted reading: let a local MCP client search an existing library instead of pasting documents\.

## Getting Started

- Download the Windows setup executable or the macOS Apple Silicon disk image from GitHub Releases\.
- On macOS, open the disk image, drag KnowNote into Applications, and run sudo xattr \-rd com\.apple\.quarantine /Applications/KnowNote\.app once before launching\.
- On Windows, if SmartScreen appears, choose More info and then Run anyway\.
- On first run, open Settings, add at least one model connection under Models, then start asking questions\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app for Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon; no Linux build is available\.
- No Docker, no server and no account are required\.
- At least one model connection must be configured; it can be any OpenAI\-, Anthropic\- or Google\-compatible endpoint or a local server such as Ollama\.
- The local embedder downloads once and then runs on the machine, while notebooks, notes and embeddings stay local\.
- The macOS build is unsigned and requires a one\-time quarantine\-clearing step; Windows may show a SmartScreen prompt\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: GPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Unsigned, non\-notarised builds trigger first\-launch security prompts on macOS and Windows\.
- There is no Linux build, and macOS support is limited to Apple Silicon\.
- When asking a question, only the retrieved context for that request is sent to the configured model endpoint\.

projects.name: Kornia

projects.taglineZh: 面向 PyTorch 的可微分计算机视觉库
projects.description: Kornia is a differentiable computer vision library for PyTorch, offering batched, GPU-accelerated operators for image processing, geometry, feature matching, augmentation, and pretrained models for spatial AI.
projects.descriptionZh: Kornia 是构建于 PyTorch 的可微分计算机视觉库，提供覆盖几何、特征匹配、滤波、颜色、增强、损失与预训练模型的 1,200 多个算子，支持批处理与设备无关执行，服务于研究与机器人实时感知。
projects.content:
## Overview

Kornia is a differentiable computer vision library built on PyTorch\. It provides 1,200\+ differentiable operators across geometry, feature matching, filtering, color, augmentation, losses, and pretrained models, with batched and device\-agnostic execution for research and real\-time perception on robots\.

## Key Features

- 1,200\+ differentiable operators for geometry, feature matching, filtering, color, augmentation, losses, and pretrained models\.
- Batched, device\-agnostic operators that run where the tensor lives, with GPU acceleration\.
- Differentiable geometry for warping, registration, camera models, homographies, Lie groups, RANSAC, and depth\-to\-3D\.
- AugmentationSequential applies one sampled transform to images, masks, boxes, and keypoints together, in 2D or 3D\.
- Pretrained model families include YuNet faces, RT\-DETR objects, SAM masks, DexiNed edges, LoFTR, and LightGlue\.
- Nearly all probed operator configurations run under torch\.compile, and over 1,000 export to ONNX\.

## Use Cases

- Image matching, registration, stitching, denoising, face detection, and visual prompting workflows\.
- Training AI models with complex 2D or 3D augmentation pipelines\.
- Optimizing pose, depth, and camera parameters through differentiable geometry\.
- Exporting vision operators to ONNX graphs for ONNX Runtime on CPU or CUDA\.

## Getting Started

- Install Kornia with pip install kornia\.
- Use the browser playground, tutorials, and examples to explore workflows\.
- Process a whole batch in one call, for example kornia\.filters\.sobel(images\.cuda())\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Built on PyTorch and integrates into PyTorch\-based AI workflows\.
- Operators run on the input tensor's device, allowing GPU execution when tensors are on the GPU\.
- ONNX\-exported graphs can run on ONNX Runtime on CPU or CUDA without Python\.
- kornia\-rs is available for edge devices\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- On the small overlap with torchvision on the same GPU, eager Kornia is slower\.
- CUDA and MPS half\-precision are not covered by CI, and CPU half\-precision results do not establish support on those backends\.

projects.content:
## Overview

LangChain is a framework for building agents and LLM\-powered applications\. It provides create\_agent, a minimal, highly configurable agent harness\. The harness is everything around the model loop: the prompt, the tools, and any middleware that shapes behavior\. LangChain supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more\. Its agents are built on top of LangGraph, and LangSmith can trace, debug, and evaluate agent behavior\.

## Key Features

- Standard model interface for chat models, embeddings, and more across providers, letting teams switch models with minimal code changes\.
- create\_agent provides a minimal, highly configurable harness composed from model, tools, prompt, and middleware\.
- Built on top of LangGraph, enabling durable execution, human\-in\-the\-loop support, persistence, and more\.
- LangSmith integration for tracing requests, debugging agent behavior, and evaluating outputs\.
- Real\-time data augmentation by connecting LLMs to diverse data sources and external or internal systems\.
- Model interoperability and rapid prototyping through a modular, component\-based architecture\.

## Use Cases

- Building agents and LLM\-powered applications\.
- Composing a customizable agent harness from model, tools, prompt, and middleware\.
- Connecting LLMs to diverse data sources and external or internal systems for real\-time data augmentation\.
- Swapping models across providers to find the best choice for application needs\.

## Getting Started

- Install LangChain with uv add langchain\.
- Initialize a chat model with init\_chat\_model and invoke it, for example with openai:gpt\-5\.5\.
- See the Installation instructions and Quickstart guide to start building agents and applications\.
- Use LangSmith to trace requests, debug agent behavior, and evaluate outputs by setting LANGSMITH\_TRACING=true and your API key\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Tracing, debugging, and evaluation capabilities rely on LangSmith and an API key, an external dependency for observability\.
- LangChain agents depend on LangGraph as the underlying orchestration layer for durable execution, human\-in\-the\-loop support, and persistence\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Langfuse is an open\-source platform for agent evals and observability\. It connects tracing, monitoring, datasets, experiments, and evaluation in one continuous loop, enabling teams to trace every LLM call, manage prompts, evaluate, and experiment from prototype to production scale\.

## Key Features

- Hierarchical traces capture every LLM call, tool invocation, and retrieval step, filterable by user, session, cost, latency, or custom metadata\.
- Evaluation with LLM\-as\-a\-judge, heuristic functions, or human review, run on production data or during experiments\.
- Prompt Management separates prompts from code with one\-click deployments and rollbacks\.
- Playground to test prompts on real production inputs and compare models side\-by\-side\.
- Experiments to define test cases, run experiments, and compare results side by side\.
- Cost & Latency monitoring with dashboards and automated alerts\.

## Use Cases

- Chat agents: session\-level tracing, evals, and cost visibility for chat support and assistant experiences\.
- Coding agents
- Workflow automation

## Getting Started

- Start by following the 'Get Started with Tracing' guide to ingest your first trace using OpenAI, LangChain, or the SDKs\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Self\-hosting is supported via Docker Compose, Kubernetes (Helm), and Terraform for AWS, GCP, and Azure\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

- 也可直接使用在线试用版，在浏览器中导入 MP4、写笔记并生成 AI 分析包；在线版不含本地转码和自动搜字幕。
- 开发者可安装依赖后运行 npm run dev，打开终端提示的本地地址使用完整开发功能。

## 部署与要求

- 一键启动脚本会自动准备运行环境；手动开发要求 Node\.js 20\.19\+ 或 22\.12\+，并使用 Chrome 内核浏览器（Chrome 或 Edge）。
- ffmpeg 为可选依赖，安装后才支持 RMVB/AVI/HEVC 等格式自动转码，H\.264 MP4 不需要。
- 自动转码和自动搜索字幕依赖开发服务器本地接口，需用 npm run dev 或启动脚本运行；静态部署时这两项降级为手动操作。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- 在线试用版缺少本地转码和自动搜字幕，完整功能需下载完整版。
- 免费 AI 可能因截图数量过多而处理不完整，需要重试或改用付费或其他 AI。
- 工具声明仅供个人学习和研究，并要求使用拥有合法访问权的影片。
- 网络字幕来自公开字幕站，字幕版权归原作者所有，不可用于商业用途。

projects.content:
## Overview

Lastbook is a desktop offline survival library for macOS, Windows, and Linux\. It stores manuals, PDFs, videos, offline encyclopedias, an offline map, and short practical guides on one computer; after setup it works without internet\. Its sidebar opens Videos, Map, and Chat, and Chat can answer questions using the library and link to sources\.

## Key Features

- Short curated guides for urgent needs, each pointing to real library pages with page numbers and noting gaps curators found\.
- A full offline library of manuals and PDFs with whole\-PDF view, videos, offline encyclopedias, keyword search everywhere, and meaning\-based search on Windows\.
- An offline map with world and US base maps plus a detailed state map selected during setup, including local streets, buildings, terrain, crops, water, help and resource points, and offline address search in that state\.
- Optional local AI chat that answers questions in plain words and cites library pages; without it, Chat still finds relevant pages\.
- One\-download setup with Small, Medium, or All packs, state map selection, checked downloads, and support for using an existing library folder or pack zip\.
- Cross\-platform desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with no account and no telemetry\.

## Use Cases

- Preparing a household or personal computer with offline references for emergencies when internet and mobile service are unavailable\.
- Looking up first aid, water purification, food preservation, repair, and power generation guides from stored manuals and videos\.
- Finding local streets, water sources, medical points, fire stations, and shelters offline using a chosen state map\.
- Asking plain\-language questions and getting answers linked to pages in the offline library, with optional local AI\.

## Getting Started

- Download the Ubuntu 24\.04 or 26\.04 Linux package, then install it with apt so Ubuntu resolves dependencies\.
- Open Lastbook from the application menu; first\-run setup downloads the chosen library, state map, and optional local AI\.
- To run from source, use Python 3\.11 or later with a data folder and the platform\-specific requirements file, then run app/main\.py with a data path\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later; Windows requires 64\-bit Windows 10 or later; Linux packages target Ubuntu 24\.04 or 26\.04 LTS on Intel/AMD x86\_64\.
- Running from source needs Python 3\.11 or later and a data folder containing library\-data/catalog\.json\.
- Windows source runs additionally need three WebView2 files from Microsoft\.Web\.WebView2 1\.0\.3856\.49 placed in app/webview2/\.
- Linux source runs must use packaging/linux/run\_source\_linux\.sh and a virtual environment with system site packages; video playback requires GStreamer and an AV1 decoder for many library videos\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The iPad version is a development preview available only as source for contributors to build and sign themselves\.
- The Linux release has limited validation: testing covered Ubuntu 24\.04\.5 in WSL2, and native GPU performance and other distributions were not validated\.
- The local AI is optional and setup offers it only when the measured fit indicates sufficient memory for the model and context\.
