projects.name: Laya
projects.tagline: Typed decisions with calibrated probabilities in one pass
projects.taglineZh: 单次前向完成类型化决策并给出校准概率
projects.description: Laya is a non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine for typed choice, score, and yes/no questions over text. It returns calibrated probabilities in one forward pass across 100+ languages and routes requests to the right checkpoint.
projects.descriptionZh: Laya 是面向类型化选择、评分和是/否问题的非自回归 System 1 决策引擎。它对文本等进行单次前向推理，返回经过校准的概率，覆盖 100 多种语言，并由 Router 将请求路由到合适的检查点。
projects.content:
## Overview

Laya is a multilingual, non\-autoregressive decision model\. Given a state such as text, email, ticket, or JSON and typed questions, it returns typed answers with calibrated probabilities in a single forward pass\. It does not generate text; the Router detects language and script and dispatches to the appropriate English or multilingual checkpoint\.

## Key Features

- Typed choice, score, and yes/no (noul) questions over text, email, tickets, or JSON are answered in one forward pass\.
- The Router detects scripts and languages in sub\-milliseconds and dispatches to the optimal checkpoint; the multilingual checkpoint covers 100\+ languages\.
- Trained with RLCD against strictly proper scoring rules so reporting honest probabilities maximizes reward, with no generated text to parse or hallucinate\.
- Fine\-tuning on domain decisions can improve accuracy; the fine\-tuned laya\-typed\-decisions checkpoint scores 0\.766 on the typed\-decisions benchmark versus 0\.362 for the base English checkpoint\.
- Self\-hostable via Python SDK, optional HTTP server laya\-serve, and extras for MCP, LangChain, ONNX, and a GPU fast path\.
- Supports long documents with laya\-multilingual via max\_len=8192\.

## Use Cases

- Routing and triaging customer support emails or tickets by department, urgency, and churn risk\.
- Guardrails and moderation decisions that require calibrated yes/no probabilities\.
- Structured classification over multilingual text where generated text is undesirable\.
- Domain\-specific decision workflows after fine\-tuning, such as invoice processing, security incidents, customer service, and agent\-trace observability\.

## Getting Started

- Install with pip install laya; Python 3\.10 or newer is required\.
- Use from laya import Router; create Router() or Router(preload=True), then call router\.predict(state, questions)\.
- For long documents with laya\-multilingual, pass model="multilingual" and max\_len=8192\.
- Self\-host with pip install "laya\[serve\]" and LAYA\_DEVICE=cuda LAYA\_PRELOAD=1 laya\-serve; it binds 0\.0\.0\.0:8000 and preloads the checkpoints\.
- Use laya\.load with subfolder="multilingual" or subfolder="typed\-decisions" for single\-checkpoint mode\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 or newer\.
- Optional extras include laya\[serve\] for the HTTP server, laya\[mcp\], laya\[langchain\], laya\[onnx\], and laya\[fast\]\.
- The Router lazy default keeps two checkpoints resident; Router(preload=True) preloads all checkpoints; max\_loaded controls resident memory\.
- laya\-serve binds 0\.0\.0\.0:8000 with no authentication unless LAYA\_API\_KEY is set\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The base checkpoints are near chance zero\-shot on typed\-decisions; the 0\.766 score comes from a fine\-tuned checkpoint\.
- High\-cardinality choice questions can lose accuracy at default token budgets; raising head\_max\_len and max\_len or using hierarchical choice is recommended\.
- The noul yes/no primitive can follow its option labels instead of the state on the English checkpoint; validate outputs or use a neutral two\-option choice\.
- action\.act\_probability is not currently a usable signal; gate on confidence instead\.
- The model ships over\-confident; temperature fitting on your own data is advised before trusting probabilities\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Laya 是多语言、非自回归决策模型。给定文本、邮件、工单或 JSON 等状态以及类型化问题，它在单次前向推理中返回带校准概率的类型化答案。它不生成文本；Router 检测语言和文字系统，并分派到合适的英语或多语言检查点。

## 核心功能

- 支持对文本、邮件、工单或 JSON 进行类型化选择、评分和是/否（noul）问题的单次前向推理。
- Router 在亚毫秒级检测文字系统和语言，并分派到最优检查点；多语言检查点覆盖 100 多种语言。
- 基于 RLCD 和严格适当评分规则训练，诚实报告概率才能最大化奖励，且不生成文本，因此无需解析，也不存在生成内容幻觉。
- 在自有领域决策上微调可提升准确率；微调后的 laya\-typed\-decisions 检查点在 typed\-decisions 基准上得分 0\.766，而基础英语检查点为 0\.362。
- 可通过 Python SDK 自托管，并提供可选 HTTP 服务器 laya\-serve，以及 MCP、LangChain、ONNX 和 GPU 快速路径等扩展。
- laya\-multilingual 支持通过 max\_len=8192 处理长文档。

## 适用场景

- 按部门、紧急程度和流失风险路由并分流客户支持邮件或工单。
- 需要校准是/否概率的防护栏和审核决策。
- 不希望对多语言文本生成内容的结构化分类。
- 微调后的领域特定决策流程，例如发票处理、安全事件、客户服务和代理轨迹可观测性。

## 快速开始

- 使用 pip install laya 安装；需要 Python 3\.10 或更高版本。使用 from laya import Router；创建 Router() 或 Router(preload=True)，然后调用 router\.predict(state, questions)。对于 laya\-multilingual 的长文档，传入 model="multilingual" 和 max\_len=8192。使用 pip install "laya\[serve\]" 和 LAYA\_DEVICE=cuda LAYA\_PRELOAD=1

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Python 3\.10 或更高版本。可选扩展包括用于 HTTP 服务器的 laya\[serve\]、laya\[mcp\]、laya\[langchain\]、laya\[onnx\] 和 laya\[fast\]。Router 的懒加载默认保留两个检查点常驻；Router(preload=True) 会预加载所有检查点；max\_loaded 控制常驻内存。除非设置 LAYA\_API\_KEY，否则 laya\-serve 绑定 0\.0\.0\.0:8000 且不进行身份验证。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: LayerFS
projects.tagline: Ephemeral workspaces, durable shared history
projects.taglineZh: 临时工作区，持久共享历史
projects.description: LayerFS gives every AI agent a complete writable filesystem workspace over shared committed history. Agents work in parallel, commit deduplicated checkpoints, then branch, rewind or merge.
projects.descriptionZh: LayerFS 为每个 AI 代理提供基于共享已提交历史的完整可写文件系统工作区；代理可并行工作，将变更提交为去重检查点，再进行分支、回退或合并。
projects.content:
## Overview

LayerFS is the substrate under AI agents\. Each agent mounts a complete, writable Workspace over shared committed history, performs its work, commits what changed, and goes away\. One SQLite file holds every Branch, Commit and content object without a database server\.

## Key Features

- Ephemeral computing: compute exists only while a command runs; each Bash call mounts a Workspace, executes, commits and unmounts\.
- Decentralized agents on different computers share one serverless Store, with no database server\.
- Multi\-agent coordination through branches: each tool call is a commit, same\-file clashes are refused as Conflict, and blame shows which step wrote each line\.
- Recursive filesystem forks any Commit at any depth; a fork is metadata and copies no files\.
- Storage optimization through content deduplication and compression, while dependencies and ignored files stay available on mount\.

## Use Cases

- Parallel multi\-agent software development with isolated writable Workspaces over shared history\.
- Agent workflows that need checkpoints, rewind, branching and merge\.
- Recursive exploration and branching for RL training or agent search\.
- Running agents across multiple computers against one shared Store\.

## Getting Started

- Try LayerFS through LayerFS × DSH, the dsh\-layerfs plugin for DeepSeek Harness, using the DSH install guide\.
- Consult the LayerFS documentation and core ideas before setup\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Linux, macOS through DSH, and Windows through WSL2 are listed as supported platforms\.
- The Store is a single SQLite file opened directly by each daemon and SDK process; no database server is required\.
- Running LayerFS × DSH requires the dsh\-layerfs plugin for DeepSeek Harness\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The FUSE view intentionally omits certain POSIX node types and metadata\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

LayerFS 是 AI 代理之下的基础层。每个代理在共享已提交历史之上挂载一个完整、可写的工作区，完成工作后提交变更并退出。一个 SQLite 文件保存所有分支、提交和内容对象，不需要数据库服务器。

## 核心功能

- 临时计算：计算只在命令运行期间存在；每次 Bash 调用都会挂载工作区、执行、提交并卸载。
- 去中心化代理：不同计算机上的代理共享同一个无服务器存储，无需数据库服务器。
- 多代理协作通过分支进行：每次工具调用都是一次提交，同一文件的冲突会被拒绝为 Conflict，blame 可显示每一行由哪一步写入。
- 递归文件系统：可在任意深度对任意提交进行分支；分支只涉及元数据，不复制文件。
- 存储优化：通过内容去重和压缩降低占用，同时依赖和忽略文件在挂载时仍然可用。

## 适用场景

- 基于共享历史的并行多代理软件开发，每个代理使用隔离的可写工作区。
- 需要检查点、回退、分支和合并的代理工作流。
- 面向强化学习训练或代理搜索的递归探索与分支。
- 多台计算机上的代理针对同一个共享存储运行。

## 快速开始

- 通过 LayerFS × DSH 试用 LayerFS，这是 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh\-layerfs 插件，可参考 DSH 安装指南。
- 在安装前查阅 LayerFS 文档和核心概念。

## 部署与要求

- 支持平台包括 Linux、通过 DSH 使用的 macOS，以及通过 WSL2 使用的 Windows。
- 存储是一个 SQLite 文件，由每个守护进程和 SDK 进程直接打开，不需要数据库服务器。
- 运行 LayerFS × DSH 需要 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh\-layerfs 插件。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: LCU

projects.taglineZh: 把 Codex 计算机使用能力从 Codex 应用解耦
projects.description: LCU exposes the original Codex computer-use runtime from the installed ChatGPT desktop app to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi, and custom harnesses without Codex sign-in, with setup, harness integration, and original approvals.
projects.descriptionZh: LCU 把已安装的 ChatGPT 桌面应用中的原始 Codex 计算机使用运行时提供给 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Pi 及自定义智能体框架，无需 Codex 登录；它负责安装配置、适配器接入，并保留原始审批流程。
projects.content:
## Overview

LCU exposes Codex's original computer\-use runtime to agent harnesses without requiring Codex authentication\. The official ChatGPT desktop app remains installed locally and supplies the runtime and instructions, while LCU handles setup and harness integration for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi, or custom clients\.

## Key Features

- Reads and controls desktop app windows: read windows, click, type, and take screenshots\.
- Provides opt\-in Chrome tab control through the official extension, with site approval\.
- Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Pi, and offers a shared JavaScript client for other harnesses\.
- Uses the original runtime and byte\-identical instructions from the installed ChatGPT desktop app, preserving original approval prompts\.
- Supports Apple Silicon macOS and Linux on ARM64 or x86\-64\.
- Includes native app approval handling in Claude Code and macOS commands to list, allow, or revoke always\-allowed apps\.

## Use Cases

- Letting an agent read a Calendar window, type a note into TextEdit, save it, and open a repository in Chrome\.
- Adding computer\-use capabilities to an existing Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Pi workflow\.
- Running controlled Chrome tab operations only after enabling the official extension and approving sites\.
- Managing per\-app approvals on macOS from the terminal without opening the Codex app\.

## Getting Started

- Copy the installation prompt into your agent; it checks OS, architecture, and prerequisites, installs the latest release, and guides required permissions\.
- Restart the harness, ask it to use LCU to take a screenshot of a harmless window, and approve the request as a first check\.
- For manual installation, download the archive and matching checksum file for the machine, verify the checksum, extract it, and follow the installation guide\.
- On Apple Silicon macOS with Claude Code, add the LCU plugin marketplace and install lcu through the plugin manager\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Install the official ChatGPT desktop app first; it supplies the runtime and instructions, and LCU does not install it\.
- Install and sign in to a supported harness such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Pi\.
- For Codex CLI, update before setup to get the required mcp\_tool hook support\.
- On Apple Silicon macOS, approve Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions on first use\.
- On Linux ARM64 or x86\-64, use an Ubuntu 24\.04\-compatible glibc system with an active X11 desktop and D\-Bus\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

LCU 将 Codex 原有的计算机使用运行时提供给智能体运行框架，无需进行 Codex 身份验证。官方 ChatGPT 桌面应用仍需安装在本地，由它提供运行时和指令；LCU 负责安装配置和框架集成，支持 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Pi 或自定义客户端。

projects.content:
## Overview

LearnHarness is an open\-source AI learning application that uses agents to plan and teach lessons from a learner’s current understanding to a goal\. It measures understanding, builds a dependency map, teaches step by step, and supports practice with a persistent knowledge graph\.

## Key Features

- AI agents measure current understanding before teaching and use answers, confidence, and reasoning to decide where to start\.
- The agent plans a dependency map from the starting point to the learner’s goal, and the lesson adapts when understanding turns out differently\.
- Teaching builds one reasoning step at a time: learners predict, receive an explanation, and check understanding, with confusions repaired before moving on\.
- Practice sessions pose varied problems and adapt problems and hints to the learner’s reasoning\.
- A persistent knowledge graph stores propositions and reasoning chains, links back to source sessions, and can carry learning across future teaching and practice sessions\.
- The desktop app supports attaching PDFs, photos, or other files by path, and the agent can research questions, create visual explanations, mark up images, and build interactive demonstrations\.

## Use Cases

- Learning difficult topics from a current level of understanding toward a specific goal\.
- Finding gaps where a learner may think they understand a topic but cannot solve a new problem\.
- Carrying learning and review across sessions through a persistent knowledge graph\.
- Studying from PDFs, photos, notes, and interactive demonstrations in a desktop learning session\.

## Getting Started

- Download LearnHarness from learnharness\.ai or GitHub Releases\.
- On macOS Apple Silicon, use the signed and notarized DMG and drag the app to Applications\.
- On Windows x64, run the installer\.
- On Linux x64, make the AppImage executable and open it, or install the Debian/Ubuntu \.deb\.
- Choose models, then start a session with what you want to understand\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows (x64), or Linux (x64) desktop environment\.
- A configured model provider: provider API keys, supported subscription connections in the desktop app, an installed Claude Code CLI, or a custom OpenAI\-compatible endpoint, including a local model server\.
- Optional dictation and web search use separate service keys\.
- Web research can use a Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, or Ollama key in Settings → Providers → Search; Ollama search uses its hosted service, not a local model server\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Windows installer is currently unsigned, so Windows may display an unknown publisher or SmartScreen warning\.
- The live cost meter only estimates known API costs and does not cover subscription, CLI, or custom\-endpoint charges\.
- Local storage does not mean offline processing, because model requests, web research, and dictation can contact external services\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Lightpanda is a headless browser engine written in Zig, built from scratch for automation, crawling, and AI agents\. It executes JavaScript without graphical rendering, offering a minimal memory footprint and high speed compared to traditional headless browsers like Chrome\.

## Key Features

- Built from scratch in Zig, not a Chromium fork\.
- Headless operation with JavaScript execution, no rendering overhead\.
- CDP and Webdriver Bidi support for Puppeteer and Playwright compatibility\.
- Agent mode with PandaScript for LLM\-driven browser automation\.
- Native MCP server with session isolation\.
- Benchmarked 9x faster and 16x less memory than headless Chrome\.

## Use Cases

- Web scraping and crawling at scale\.
- AI agent navigation and task automation\.
- Running Puppeteer/Playwright scripts with lower resource usage\.
- Server\-side page dumping to HTML, Markdown, PNG, or PDF\.

## Getting Started

- Install via curl script, Homebrew, Arch AUR, Docker, or nightly binaries\. Then run \./lightpanda fetch \-\-dump html \<url\> or start a CDP server with \./lightpanda serve\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Linux and macOS binaries available; Windows via WSL2\. Docker images for amd64 and arm64\. Linux binaries require glibc; musl\-based distros need a glibc base image\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Linux binaries are linked against glibc and fail on musl\-based distros like Alpine\.
- Telemetry is enabled by default and can be disabled via environment variable\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Linger is an open\-source personal agent that runs fully on a user's PC\. It combines local model inference, persistent wiki\-style memory, proactive assistance, desktop and browser use, and agent teams so everyday Macs and PCs can run their own AI\.

## Key Features

- Local model inference through PolyStrata keeps a model's busiest experts on the GPU and the rest in RAM or on SSD; the 125B Qwen3\.8\-Flash\-Next example runs on a 12 GB card with 64 GB of RAM\.
- Model Autopilot detects GPU, VRAM, RAM and bandwidth, recommends the smartest model that fits with at least 64K context, installs it, and counts it as installed only after it answers a real question\.
- Wiki and memory files mail, chats and meetings into wiki pages each night for every agent to search, and the project reports 95% on the LoCoMo memory benchmark\.
- Proactive Another Me watches inbox, calendar and Slack, follows up on work, speaks up only when something needs the user, and rewrites its decision rules nightly through Dreaming\.
- Desktop and browser use lets agents open apps on Mac, Windows or Linux and click and type; on Mac and Windows they work in the user's everyday Chrome with existing sign\-ins\.
- Agent teams, background task delegation and model scheduling coordinate multiple agents and long\-running work while keeping interactive chat responsive\.

## Use Cases

- Run a personal AI assistant fully on a consumer Mac or PC without cloud token fees for local inference\.
- Turn email, chat, calendar, meeting and file context into searchable personal wiki memory shared by agents\.
- Use desktop and browser agents to operate everyday apps and Chrome with the user's existing sign\-ins\.
- Coordinate multi\-agent work and long background jobs, and record meetings with live transcripts and follow\-ups\.

## Getting Started

- Install the desktop app for macOS 14\.0 or later on Apple silicon, Windows x64, or Linux x64 with glibc 2\.35 or newer, and check downloads against SHA256SUMS\.txt from the same release\.
- On the desktop app setup screen, use Quick Install to set up a Linger server on the same computer\.
- For a shared server or source build, use Docker Compose: clone the repository, copy \.env\.example to \.env, run docker compose up \-\-build \-\-detach \-\-wait, create an owner account, open the local app on port 3000, and sign in\.
- On the connected computer, run the guided installer for macOS/Linux or the PowerShell installer for Windows; it checks hardware, installs and verifies a local model after approval, and connects linger\-computer to the Linger server\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop packages are provided for macOS 14\.0 or later on Apple silicon, Windows x64, and Linux x64 with glibc 2\.35 or newer; there is no package for Intel Macs\.
- Docker Compose deployment requires Docker with Compose and at least 5 GiB of memory for its virtual machine\.
- The Compose containers run only the Linger server; models and agents run on the computer connected to it through the guided installer\.
- Automatic port override for busy Compose ports requires Docker Compose 2\.24\.4 or later\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Intel Mac users must use Docker Compose because no desktop package is provided for that platform\.
- The Compose containers do not run local models or agents; those run on the connected computer\.
- Linger depends on several third\-party open\-source projects for core capabilities\.
- Memory is kept on the user's device rather than in a provider account\.

- 提供 A 股实时行情、历史 K 线、集合竞价、财务报表、估值快照与交易日历等数据查询能力。
- 覆盖指数与板块、公募基金、公开期货与公开期权、资讯及涨跌停、龙虎榜等特色数据。
- 支持 REST API、MCP、CLI、Python SDK 和 Agent Skill 等多种接入方式。
- CLI 可整合远端取数、本地 DuckDB、认证和结构化输出，并支持批量导出。
- 提供按 A 股、指数、基金、期货、期权、港股新股等数据域配置的 MCP 服务。
- 支持本地 DuckDB 初始化、同步、校验、修复、SQL 查询和导出。

## 适用场景

- 让 AI Agent 自动查询和分析金融数据。
- 在量化研究与回测中准备历史行情和财务数据。
- 让网站、App 或后台服务通过 REST API 集成金融数据。
- 在终端或自动化任务中统一取数、批量导出并维护本地数据库。

## 快速开始

- 获取 API Key，或在 CLI 中使用 OAuth 登录。
- 安装 CLI：运行 npm install \-g @hithink\-tech/hithink\-finance\-cli，然后执行 hithink\-finance auth login 和 hithink\-finance capabilities \-\-format json。
- 调用 REST 接口时，在请求头中携带 X\-api\-key。
- 在支持 MCP 的客户端中按数据域配置 MCP 服务地址，并在请求头中加入 X\-api\-key。
- 安装 Python 子项目可使用 python \-m pip install \-e \./python，并可运行 Python toolkit 脚本查询数据。

## 部署与要求

- Python SDK 需要 Python 3\.11\+。
- CLI 需要 Node\.js 22\.12\+。
- REST、MCP、Python 及 CLI 的 API Key 方式需要在 API Key 管理页获取 Key。
- MCP 客户端需支持 MCP，并按服务配置结构设置 type、url 和 X\-api\-key 请求头。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- 公开接入方式有明确的数据边界，不提供分钟 K、tick、Level\-2、港股或美股行情、宏观数据、新闻公告原文、研报原文、基金申赎交易和投资推荐。
- 数据权限和实际可访问能力受官网与账号授权约束，未支持的数据不能用模拟或静态示例冒充真实结果。
- API Key 不应写入代码、文档、Issue、日志、产物或 Git，本地持久化应使用用户级安全存储方式。
- 项目不设置累计调用次数上限，但调用方需避免短时间集中请求或过高并发，触发动态限流后应降低频率和并发度并延迟重试。
- 离线文档、测试和帮助信息只能证明支持范围，线上可用性需要通过实际授权请求验证。

projects.descriptionZh: 用 C/C++ 实现 LLM 推理，以最简设置和一流性能在本地和云端的各种硬件上运行。
projects.content:
## Overview

llama\.cpp enables LLM and VLM inference with minimal setup and state\-of\-the\-art performance on a wide range of hardware, locally and in the cloud\. It is built on top of the ggml library\.

## Key Features

- Plain C/C\+\+ implementation without any dependencies
- Optimized for Apple silicon via ARM NEON, Accelerate, and Metal frameworks
- Integer quantization from 1\.5\-bit to 8\-bit for faster inference and reduced memory use
- Custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA GPUs, with AMD via HIP and Moore Threads via MUSA
- Vulkan and SYCL backend support
- CPU\+GPU hybrid inference for models larger than VRAM

## Use Cases

- Run LLM and VLM models locally from Hugging Face
- Launch an OpenAI\-compatible API server
- Use the built\-in web UI for interactive sessions
- Accelerate large models with hybrid CPU\+GPU inference

## Getting Started

- Visit https://llama\.app and follow the instructions
- Run with Docker (see Docker documentation)
- Download pre\-built binaries from the releases page
- Build from source by cloning the repository (see build guide)
- Example: llama cli \-hf ggml\-org/Qwen3\.5\-0\.8B\-GGUF

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supports a wide range of hardware backends including CPU, NVIDIA GPU (CUDA), AMD GPU (HIP), Apple Silicon (Metal), Intel GPU (SYCL), Vulkan, WebGPU, and more
- No external dependencies for the core implementation
- Can be deployed via Docker or pre\-built binaries

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The OpenVINO backend is marked as in progress, indicating incomplete support\.

projects.content:
## Overview

llm\-d is an open\-source, Kubernetes\-native stack for distributed LLM inference\. It orchestrates model servers such as vLLM and SGLang to provide production\-grade serving across a cluster and supported accelerators\.

## Key Features

- Intelligent routing with prefix\-cache and load\-aware balancing, plus experimental predicted\-latency scheduling\.
- Advanced KV\-cache management, including tiered offloading to CPU or disk and global indexing of KV\-cache state\.
- Serving large models with prefill/decode disaggregation and wide expert parallelism over fast accelerator interconnects\.
- Operational features for production, including flow control for multi\-tenant serving and SLO\-aware autoscaling\.
- Batch processing with OpenAI\-compatible Batch APIs and asynchronous processing for offline inference\.
- Portability across GPUs, TPUs, XPUs, CPUs, and emerging NPUs\.

## Use Cases

- Deploying an optimized baseline for production LLM serving on Kubernetes\.
- Routing requests by predicted latency or precise prefix\-cache awareness\.
- Scaling large models such as DeepSeek\-R1 and GPT\-OSS with disaggregation and wide expert parallelism\.
- Running large\-scale offline inference with OpenAI\-compatible Batch APIs\.

## Getting Started

- Follow the Quickstart Guide to deploy an optimized inference service on Kubernetes\.
- Set up the llm\-d stack, configure the intelligent router, and validate performance with production\-ready benchmarks\.
- Most users begin with the Optimized Baseline well\-lit path\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A Kubernetes cluster\.
- Supported accelerators including GPUs, TPUs, XPUs, CPUs, and emerging NPUs\.
- Model servers such as vLLM, SGLang, or others as part of the inference stack\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- llm\-d is a CNCF Sandbox project, indicating early\-stage project maturity within the CNCF\.
- Predicted\-latency scheduling is described as experimental\.
- The batch gateway is labeled experimental in release notes\.

projects.content:
## Overview

llmfit is a terminal\-first tool for matching local large language models to a machine's CPU, system RAM, discrete or integrated GPU, VRAM, and unified memory\. It inspects hardware, scores catalog models across memory fit, estimated speed, quality, and context, and presents recommendations through an interactive TUI, classic CLI, web dashboard, or HTTP API\.

## Key Features

- Hardware auto\-detection for CPU cores, system RAM, discrete/integrated GPUs, VRAM, and unified memory across NVIDIA CUDA, Apple Silicon, AMD ROCm, and Intel OneAPI\.
- Model compatibility scoring for parameter counts, context lengths, and quantization formats including GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ, and EXL2, with projected memory footprints and tokens\-per\-second estimates\.
- Interactive TUI plus a feature\-rich web dashboard for browsing, filtering, planning, simulating hardware, downloads, and benchmarks\.
- REST API endpoints /api/v1/system and /api/v1/models for integration into orchestrators, dashboards, and automated deployment pipelines\.
- Support for multi\-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization selection, speed estimation, and local runtime providers such as Ollama, llama\.cpp, MLX, Docker Model Runner, and LM Studio\.
- Community benchmark sharing via llmfit bench \-\-share, with locally saved runs replacing estimates in the fit table and merged submissions shipped in later releases\.

## Use Cases

- Choosing which local LLM and quantization will fit a laptop, workstation, or multi\-GPU system before downloading a model\.
- Planning deployments by estimating storage needs for a set of runnable models and checking hardware fit\.
- Feeding JSON recommendations into scripts, agents, or orchestrators that select models automatically\.
- Benchmarking real tokens\-per\-second and TTFT on a local runtime and sharing results with the community\.

## Getting Started

- Install on macOS or Linux with Homebrew: brew install AlexsJones/llmfit/llmfit; Windows users can use winget install \-\-exact \-\-id AlexsJones\.llmfit or scoop install llmfit\.
- Alternatively install with uv: uv tool install \-U llmfit, or run without installing with uvx llmfit\.
- Launch the interactive TUI by running llmfit, or use commands such as llmfit recommend \-\-json, llmfit fit, llmfit bench, llmfit doctor, and llmfit serve\.
- Run the container with docker run \-it \-\-rm ghcr\.io/alexsjones/llmfit \-\-tui for the TUI, or docker run \-d \-p 8787:8787 ghcr\.io/alexsjones/llmfit serve for the Web UI and API server\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux (x86\_64 and ARM64), and Windows (x86\_64)\.
- A multi\-architecture Docker image is provided at ghcr\.io/alexsjones/llmfit for interactive CLI/TUI and headless Web UI/API server modes\.
- The API and web server can be started with llmfit serve \-\-host 0\.0\.0\.0 \-\-port 8787\.
- Building from source uses git clone, cd llmfit, and cargo build \-\-release; the binary is at target/release/llmfit\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.name: LMCache
projects.tagline: KV cache management layer for scalable LLM inference
projects.taglineZh: 面向可扩展 LLM 推理的 KV 缓存管理层
projects.description: LMCache is an open-source KV cache management layer for LLM inference that stores, compresses, searches, and reuses KV cache across GPU, CPU, local storage, and external backends to reduce repeated prefill and improve time-to-first-token.
projects.descriptionZh: LMCache 是面向 LLM 推理的开源 KV 缓存管理层，可在 GPU、CPU、本地存储和外部后端之间存储、压缩、搜索并复用 KV 缓存，减少重复预填充并降低首 token 延迟。
projects.content:
## Overview

LMCache is a vendor\-neutral KV cache management layer for LLM inference\. It turns KV cache into reusable AI\-native memory that can be stored, compressed, searched, transferred, and observed across GPU memory, CPU memory, local storage, and external backends\. LMCache is designed for workloads where long prompts, conversation history, and retrieved content are reused across requests\.

## Key Features

- Persistent, tiered KV cache offloading and reuse across requests, sessions, and engine instances\.
- Engine\-independent deployment, including a standalone multiprocess server mode that isolates KV cache management from the inference engine\.
- Pluggable storage and transport backends including CPU RAM, local disk, Redis/Valkey, Mooncake, InfiniStore, S3\-compatible object storage, NIXL, and GDS\.
- Non\-prefix KV reuse with CacheBlend, which can reuse cached KV blocks at any position in the prompt and selectively recompute tokens for quality recovery\.
- KV cache transfer for prefill\-decode disaggregation over NVLink, RDMA, or TCP through transport layers such as NIXL\.
- Production\-level KV cache observability metrics for health, performance, cache hits, lifecycle, and usage\.

## Use Cases

- Long\-context agentic workloads and multi\-turn conversations where context is repeatedly reused\.
- Knowledge\-augmented workloads such as RAG that reuse retrieved content across requests\.
- Distributed inference deployments that need to move KV cache across workers or between prefill and decode stages\.
- Teams that want to switch serving engines or storage backends while reusing stored KV caches\.

## Getting Started

- Install LMCache with pip: pip install lmcache\.
- For setup options and examples, consult the installation, quickstart, recipes, CLI reference, benchmarking guide, production deployment, and FAQ documentation\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- No architectural changes are required; choose the deployment mode that matches your setup\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- LMCache is an independent open\-source project\.
- LMCache grew out of systems research at the University of Chicago and continues to evolve as an open\-source project\.

## 项目简介

LMCache 是厂商中立的 LLM 推理 KV 缓存管理层。它把 KV 缓存转化为可复用的 AI 原生内存，可在 GPU 内存、CPU 内存、本地存储和外部后端之间存储、压缩、搜索、传输和观测，面向长提示、对话历史和检索内容在多次请求中重复使用的工作负载。

## 核心功能

- 支持持久化、分层 KV 缓存卸载与复用，覆盖请求、会话和引擎实例之间的复用。支持与推理引擎无关的部署，包括以独立多进程服务器模式将 KV 缓存管理与推理引擎隔离。支持可插拔存储和传输后端，包括 CPU RAM、本地磁盘、Redis/Valkey、Mooncake、InfiniStore、兼容 S3 的对象存储、NIXL 和 GDS。通过 CacheBlend 支持非前缀 KV 复用，可复用提示中任意位置的缓存 KV 块，并选择性重算 token 以恢复质量。支持预填充\-解码分离场景下的 KV 缓存传输，可通过 NIXL 等传输层经

## 适用场景

- 适用于长上下文智能体工作负载和多轮对话，其中的上下文会被反复复用。适用于 RAG 等知识增强工作负载，可在请求之间复用检索内容。适用于需要在工作进程之间或在预填充与解码阶段之间迁移 KV 缓存的分布式推理部署。适用于希望在复用已存储 KV 缓存的同时切换推理引擎或存储后端的团队。

- 可通过 pip 安装 LMCache：pip install lmcache。设置选项与示例可查阅安装、快速开始、部署配方、CLI 参考、基准测试指南、生产部署和 FAQ 文档。

projects.content:
## Overview

LobeHub is a platform that organizes your AI agents into 7×24 operations\. It acts as a Chief Agent Operator, hiring, scheduling, and reporting on your entire AI team\. The platform treats agents as the unit of work, offering a space where humans and agents co\-evolve\. It includes features for creating agents, collaborating in groups, and evolving personal memory\.

## Key Features

- Operator: Bring all your agents under one roof with an IM Gateway for chat\-based interaction\.
- Create: Agent Builder with auto\-configuration, unified access to any model, and 10,000\+ skills via MCP\-compatible plugins\.
- Collaborate: Agent Groups for parallel collaboration, Pages for shared context writing, Schedule for timed runs, Project organization, and Workspace for team visibility\.
- Evolve: Personal Memory with continual learning and white\-box, editable memory for transparency\.
- Self\-Hosting: Deploy via Vercel, Zeabur, Sealos, Alibaba Cloud, or Docker for private control\.

## Use Cases

- Managing a personal AI team across multiple models and tools in one unified workspace\.
- Automating scheduled tasks and workflows while you are away\.
- Collaborating with agents in shared workspaces for team projects and content creation\.
- Building custom agents with specific skills and memory for evolving needs\.

## Getting Started

- Deploy with one\-click on Vercel, Zeabur, Sealos, or Alibaba Cloud by providing your OpenAI API Key\. Alternatively, use Docker: create a folder, run the setup script, and start with docker compose up \-d\. For local development, clone the repo, run pnpm install, then pnpm dev for

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires an OPENAI\_API\_KEY environment variable for LLM access\. Optional variables include OPENAI\_PROXY\_URL for API proxy and OPENAI\_MODEL\_LIST for model customization\. Docker deployment needs a storage folder and the setup script from lobe\.li/setup\.sh\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Third\-party API proxies carry validity and security risks, as stated in the README disclaimer\.
- The plugin system is under active major development, with phases still being completed\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Locally Uncensored is a free, open\-source desktop AI studio that combines chat, coding, image generation, and video generation in one application\. It installs like a normal desktop app without a command line or Docker, and its first\-start wizard detects local AI engines and helps install suitable models\. Local mode keeps chats on the user's computer, while LU Cloud is an optional hosted service for browser or phone use\.

## Key Features

- All\-in\-one desktop studio for chat, coding, image generation, and video generation in one interface\.
- Installs like a normal app with no command line or Docker; the first\-start wizard checks local AI engines and can download a suitable model\.
- Chat supports local and optional cloud providers, file upload with vision, thinking mode, and 20\+ provider presets\.
- Create tab offers twelve image and video modes, including image, edit, cutout, enhance, erase, video, animate, character, lipsync, music, extend, and motion\.
- Coding Agent reads project files, explains findings, and shows changes as a diff before applying them; it includes 14 MCP tools\.
- Agent Mode can search the web, write files, and run steps for a goal, while Remote access lets a phone use the PC as the compute host\.

## Use Cases

- Private local chat and photo\- or document\-assisted Q&A without an account or usage limit after setup\.
- Creating character art, images, and short video clips from text or an existing image\.
- Diagnosing bugs and building small websites with the Coding Agent and Agent Mode\.
- Using the desktop studio from a phone through QR code and passcode remote access\.

## Getting Started

- Download the Windows, macOS, or Linux installer and install it like a normal app; the app keeps itself up to date\.
- On first start, let the wizard detect local AI engines and download a model recommended for the PC\.
- Pick a model and begin in Chat, Code, or Create; an optional LU Cloud account can be added later in settings\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows 10/11 x64; Linux x64 via AppImage, \.deb, or \.rpm\.
- macOS is beta on Apple Silicon with macOS 14 or newer; Intel Macs are not supported\.
- Text chat needs 8 GB RAM\.
- Image generation needs an NVIDIA card, or an AMD card with ROCm on Linux, from 6 GB VRAM with the starter checkpoint and 8 to 10 GB for FLUX\. Video generation starts at 6 GB for AnimateDiff and FramePack F1, 8 GB for the Wan 2\.1 starter, and 12 GB or more for Wan 2\.2 and

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The macOS desktop build is in beta and only supports Apple Silicon on macOS 14 or newer; Intel Macs are not supported\.
- Voice is a beta feature and currently speaks English\.
- Computer control is beta, off by default, and not fully tested on Mac\.
- Remote access over the internet is relayed by Cloudflare and is not end\-to\-end encrypted, so Cloudflare could read traffic\.

projects.description: LoopForge is an open-source, self-hosted platform for AI software delivery. It orchestrates coding-agent workflows with cloud sandboxes, scripts and human approval gates, and offers Local workflows for coding assistants.
projects.descriptionZh: LoopForge 是开源的 AI 软件交付自托管平台，用云沙箱、脚本与人工审批门禁编排编码智能体工作流，并为编码助手提供 Local 工作流。
projects.content:
## Overview

LoopForge is a self\-hosted workspace where teams ship software with coding agents\. A Main Bot can open Docker sandboxes, check out repositories, delegate to project roles, and open PRs; repeatable SOPs define agents, scripts and human gates so delivery follows the same reviewed path\.

## Key Features

- Main Bot chat workbench with per\-conversation executor, model and permission mode; roles, skills, requirements, SOPs and repositories can be referenced with @\.
- Conversation workspaces use on\-demand Docker sandboxes with repositories checked out and project roles as subagents; runs can be paused, resumed or taken over\.
- Visual SOP designer supports Agent, Script, Human gate, Sub\-SOP and Preview nodes, rework\-on\-failure edges, validation, version history and publishing\.
- Hard gates use build, unit test and lint exit codes; failed checks attach logs and send work back for automatic rework\.
- Scheduled GitHub Issue sync and issue autopilot can pull issues, run fixes in parallel and resolve merge conflicts on the integration branch\.
- Post\-run review scores runs and generates one\-click updates for SOP steps, role guides and quality gates\.

## Use Cases

- Teams that want repeatable delivery workflows with fixed stages and human sign\-off can run SOPs instead of relying on ad\-hoc agent chats\.
- Developers can use Main Bot chat for exploration, quick fixes and iterative work in a Docker sandbox with project repositories\.
- Product and engineering teams can track requirements from request to PR/MR, whether work is delivered by chat or an SOP\.
- Teams can schedule GitHub Issue sync and run routine bug fixes in the background with human review\.

## Getting Started

- Install Git and clone the repository, then run \./start\.sh\.
- Open the printed address and create the first account, which becomes the administrator\. The service listens on 0\.0\.0\.0:8090 by default\.
- Configure model API keys and GitHub authorization after startup\. For LoopForge Local, run npx \-y loopforge\-cli@latest install claude inside the target project, then use /start\-devflow\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Platform edition requires Docker with Compose and Python 3, plus Git to clone the repository\.
- LoopForge Local requires Node\.js 20\+ and Python 3\.8\+ with a supported coding assistant\.
- Package and image downloads require internet access; first\-use installs of some executors need npm or provider access\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The default Compose setup uses Docker socket access and is intended for trusted teams, not untrusted multi\-tenant isolation\.
- New installations listen on all interfaces and are designed for a trusted team, with signed\-in users able to read project data across the instance\.
- Package and image downloads depend on internet access\.
- The management pages support English and Chinese, while the chat workbench is currently Chinese only\.

projects.taglineZh: 在浏览器中绘制 Material 3 Expressive 界面并生成 AI 编程提示词
projects.description: M3E Canvas is a browser-based canvas for sketching Material 3 Expressive screens, linking and previewing them, and exporting a natural-language prompt for AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor.
projects.descriptionZh: M3E Canvas 是一个浏览器画布，用来绘制 Material 3 Expressive 界面，将屏幕相互连接并在预览中点击浏览，然后把设计导出为自然语言提示词，交给 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具使用。
projects.content:
## Overview

M3E Canvas lets you sketch Material 3 Expressive screens in the browser, link them together, tap through them in a preview, and copy the result as a prompt for an AI coding tool\. It works with any tool that accepts a prompt, including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor\. Designs are saved in the browser with localStorage and there is no backend\.

## Key Features

- Drag\-and\-drop parts drawn to Material 3 Expressive, including buttons, icon buttons, FABs, split buttons, FAB menus, chips, app bars, navigation bars, floating toolbars, tabs, search bars, cards, lists, dialogs, snackbars, text fields, dropdowns, switches, checkboxes, radio
- Magnetic connections that fuse two nearby buttons or list items into one connected group whose corners soften where they meet\.
- Phone and desktop screens: add and name as many screens as you like, switch any screen between a 412×892 phone and a 1280×800 desktop from its label, and mix both sizes in one design\.
- Tap and swipe navigation: give tappable parts, app bar icons or navigation bar destinations a target screen or back action with slide, fade, expand or no transition, then tap through it in the preview\.
- A theme panel covering the four M3 Expressive axes: color with seven presets or one seed color, light and dark, three contrast levels and a dynamic\-color switch; shape corners as square, rounded or full; Roboto, Roboto Flex, Roboto Serif or the system font; and standard or
- Prompt output that turns a whole design or a single screen into a concise natural\-language prompt in Japanese, English, Chinese or Korean, targeting Android by default or the web, plus PNG export and prompt copying\.

## Use Cases

- Sketching a Material 3 Expressive app screen and handing the generated prompt to Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor to build the app\.
- Previewing a multi\-screen flow by tapping through linked screens with slide, fade or expand transitions\.
- Experimenting with color, shape, type and motion combinations before implementing them\.
- Copying a share link that opens a design on someone else's canvas, or asking a coding agent to sketch what you described and reply with such a link (beta)\.

## Getting Started

- Install dependencies with npm install\.
- Start the development server with npm run dev, which serves the app at http://localhost:3000\.
- Build a static export into \./out with npm run build\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The app is a static Next\.js export, so it can be hosted without a backend\.
- To host it under a sub\-path, such as a GitHub Pages project site, set NEXT\_PUBLIC\_BASE\_PATH=/your\-repo at build time\.
- The included \.github/workflows/deploy\.yml sets the base path automatically and publishes out/ to GitHub Pages on every push to main\.
- Node\.js and npm are required to install and build the project\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The optional AI helper uses your own API key: the key stays in the browser and requests go directly to the chosen provider with no intermediary server\.
- Fonts are fetched from Google Fonts rather than bundled with the app\.
- The shape\-morphing loading indicator shapes and animation model are ported from material\-components\-android under Apache\-2\.0\.
- The full multi\-screen editor is intended for desktop browsers; on a phone you get a single fixed screen and a buttons\-only editor\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

M3E Canvas 让你在浏览器中绘制 Material 3 Expressive 界面，把屏幕连接起来，在预览中点击浏览，并复制生成的提示词交给 AI 编程工具。它适用于任何接受提示词的工具，例如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 和 Cursor。设计保存在浏览器的 localStorage 中，没有后端。

## 核心功能

- 拖放组件：按钮、图标按钮、FAB、拆分按钮、FAB 菜单、标签片、应用栏、导航栏、悬浮工具栏、标签页、搜索栏、卡片、列表、对话框、消息条、文本输入框、下拉菜单、开关、复选框、单选按钮、滑块、文本、图片、相机和地图占位符、徽标、容器框和分割线，全部按 Material 3 Expressive 绘制。
- 磁吸连接：把两个相邻的按钮或列表项靠近后会合并成一个相连的组，相接处的圆角随之融合。
- 手机与桌面屏幕：可添加并命名任意数量的屏幕，在标签上把屏幕于 412×892 的手机与 1280×800 的桌面之间切换，两种尺寸可以混用于同一个设计，同名屏幕会在提示词中写成同一个屏幕的两种宽度。
- 点击与滑动跳转：为可点击组件、应用栏图标或导航栏项目设置目标屏幕或返回操作，以及滑动、淡入、放大或无过渡效果，然后在预览中点击体验，返回时过渡反向播放。
- 主题面板覆盖 M3 Expressive 的四个维度：配色提供七套预设或一个基准色、浅色与深色、三档对比度和动态配色开关；形状可设为方形、圆角或全圆；字体可选 Roboto、Roboto Flex、Roboto Serif 或系统字体以及强调样式；动效提供标准或富有表现力的弹簧方案，并作用于预览过渡。
- 提示词输出：把整个设计或单个屏幕转成简洁的自然语言提示词，支持日文、英文、中文和韩文，默认目标为 Android 或 Web，并支持复制提示词与把屏幕导出为 PNG。

## 适用场景

- 绘制 Material 3 Expressive 应用界面，并把生成的提示词交给 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 或 Cursor 来构建应用。
- 通过点击带滑动、淡入或放大过渡的已连接屏幕，预览多屏流程。
- 在实现之前尝试不同的配色、形状、字体与动效组合。
- 复制一个能在他人画布上打开设计的分享链接，或让编程代理画出你描述的草图并回复这样的链接（测试版）。

## 快速开始

- 使用 npm install 安装依赖。运行 npm run dev 启动开发服务器，应用地址为 http://localhost:3000。运行 npm run build 将静态导出输出到 \./out。

## 部署与要求

projects.content:
## Overview

Macro is an open\-source unified workspace that brings email, chat, docs, tasks, calls, agents, and CRM into one interface\. It uses bidirectional @linking and shared team\-level memory so teams and agents can work from the same context\.

## Key Features

- Unified workspace combining email, chat, docs, tasks, calls, CRM, and agents in one interface\.
- Bidirectional @linking connects messages, docs, tasks, emails, CRM records, and agent work\.
- Shared team\-level memory built from team conversations, emails, tasks, and calls, and available to external agents via MCP\.
- Multi\-account email with a unified inbox, keyboard shortcuts, shared inboxes, and Gmail support\.
- Channels and direct messages designed for focused technical discussions, with readable threads and channel\-based permissions\.
- Real\-time markdown\-native docs built on CRDTs, with live collaboration, history, offline editing, and agent edits\.

## Use Cases

- Small companies and teams looking for a single operating system for email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, and CRM\.
- Engineering and product teams that want tasks, docs, chat, and coding\-agent work linked together\.
- Customer\-facing teams that want CRM records connected to email threads, conversations, and follow\-ups\.
- Organizations that want AI agents to use shared team context across work surfaces\.

## Getting Started

- Sign up for the hosted app and connect your Gmail or Google Workspace account\.
- Use Macro in a modern browser or install the iOS app\.
- Follow the getting started guide, which is described as taking about 15 minutes from a fresh account to a working setup\.
- Point Claude Code, Codex, or another MCP client at the workspace using the MCP setup documentation\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Hosted use runs in any modern browser; an iOS app is available for mobile\.
- A Gmail or Google Workspace account is connected during hosted onboarding\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Document version control is still at a v1 stage and is not yet described as Git\-equivalent\.
- An Android app is not yet available; mobile support is listed for iOS and web\.

projects.content:
## Overview

magpie is a menu bar app and local gateway that lets you choose the model each AI coding agent uses\. It lists installed agents and their current models, rewrites the relevant config key when you pick another model, and routes requests through 127\.0\.0\.1:3425 so any agent can use any provider's model\.

## Key Features

- Menu bar panel lists each installed AI agent and its model; click a value to change it and magpie rewrites only that agent's key in its config file\.
- One local gateway at 127\.0\.0\.1:3425 translates OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, and Google Gemini APIs, including streaming, tool calls, and reasoning\.
- Surgical config edits preserve comments, ordering, and indentation in settings\.json, config\.toml, opencode\.jsonc, or config\.yaml; writes are atomic\.
- Signed\-in subscriptions from Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, and GitHub Copilot become providers that other agents can use without copying keys\.
- Provider presets and custom vendors are configured by pasting a key; model lists are fetched from the vendor and models\.dev, and keys stay in magpie\.
- Profiles snapshot every agent's settings, and routing groups can spread requests across multiple accounts or models with failover, rate\-limit, and quota handling\.

## Use Cases

- Run Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, and Gemini CLI on GLM from one menu bar picker\.
- Give OpenCode, Pi, Goose, or other agents access to a Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT plan without pasting credentials into each agent\.
- Centralize vendor keys and base URLs in one local gateway so agents do not hold provider credentials\.
- Route requests across multiple accounts or keys to handle rate limits, quotas, and failover\.

## Getting Started

- Download the desktop app for Windows or macOS, or install from the terminal with the provided install script\.
- Add a provider with magpie provider add deepseek sk\-\.\.\.; a preset needs only the key, and local servers such as Ollama need none\.
- Assign models with commands such as magpie codex deepseek/deepseek\-v4\-pro, magpie claude moonshot/kimi\-k3, or magpie gemini zhipu/glm\-5\.3\.
- Use magpie tui for the terminal app, magpie ls to list agents and their models, and magpie save work followed by magpie use work for profiles\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS 11 or later on Apple Silicon or Intel\.
- Windows 10 or later on x64 or ARM\.
- Linux with GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4\.1 on x86\-64 or ARM64\.
- Local gateway runs at 127\.0\.0\.1:3425; desktop app uses the system webview and is under 15 MB, with a 7 MB terminal\-only build\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- API keys must be added directly in magpie; it does not read keys from shell environment variables\.
- Vendor keys are kept in magpie and are not exposed to the agents it configures\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Mailcheap is a self\-hosted newsletter app built on Amazon SES\. It provides an editor, list management, signup forms, unsubscribe handling, bounce and complaint handling, stats, and a public archive in one Next\.js app\. One admin, no teams, and your list stays in your database\. It costs about $0\.10 per 1,000 emails sent\.

## Key Features

- Editor with a live email preview, slash commands, image uploads, boxes, Markdown, and raw HTML\.
- Checks before every send: subject, preview text, unsubscribe link, size under Gmail's 100 KB clip, postal address, and verified domain\.
- Test emails, scheduling, and sending in batches through QStash at a configured rate, with step sending to engaged readers first\.
- Several newsletters in one install, each with its own from address, reply\-to, postal address, signup form, and signup API\.
- SES events, a shared suppression list, automatic send pausing when bounces pass 2% or complaints pass 0\.08%, one\-click unsubscribe, and optional list cleanup\.
- Public archive for each newsletter with issue pages, author page, share images, sitemap, optional custom domain, overview stats, and campaign reports by mailbox provider\.

## Use Cases

- Self\-hosting a newsletter while using your own Amazon SES account and keeping subscriber data in your own MongoDB database\.
- Running multiple newsletters from one install with separate send identities, signup forms, and archives\.
- Sending to the most engaged readers first and growing each send over time while monitoring deliverability\.
- Publishing issues on a public archive and measuring delivery, open, click, bounce, complaint, and provider\-level campaign performance\.

## Getting Started

- Plan for about an hour, most of it waiting for DNS and for AWS to approve production access\.
- Create a MongoDB Atlas cluster, add a database user with read and write access, allow 0\.0\.0\.0/0, and copy the connection string with a database name as MONGODB\_URI\.
- Deploy to Vercel or run on any Node\.js host with npm ci && npm run build && npm start behind HTTPS; set MONGODB\_URI, ADMIN\_EMAIL, ADMIN\_PASSWORD with 12\+ characters, and SESSION\_SECRET with 32\+ characters\.
- Configure Amazon SES by verifying a sending domain, setting a custom MAIL FROM domain, adding DMARC, requesting production access, creating a configuration set, creating an SNS topic, sending SES events to it, creating an IAM user, and adding SES\_REGION, SES\_ACCESS\_KEY\_ID,
- Set up QStash, add QSTASH\_TOKEN, QSTASH\_CURRENT\_SIGNING\_KEY, and QSTASH\_NEXT\_SIGNING\_KEY, create a newsletter, then set SENDING\_ENABLED=true and redeploy to turn sending on\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- MongoDB for contacts, campaigns, and stats; the free tier works\.
- Amazon SES for sending; about $0\.10 per 1,000 emails\.
- Upstash QStash for background sending and scheduling; free tier to start, then pay per message, and one message sends 50 emails\.
- Vercel or any Node\.js host for hosting; free tier works\.
- Optional Upstash Redis for rate limits shared by every server instance; free tier\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is a one\-time release with no support and no planned updates\.
- New Amazon SES accounts start in a sandbox limited to 200 emails per day and verified recipients only until production access is granted\.
- Without Redis, rate limits are counted per server instance and are not shared or persistent on serverless hosts, so Redis is recommended before placing a signup form on a busy site\.
- Background sending through QStash requires the app to be reachable on the internet\.
- Image uploads in the editor require optional Vercel Blob storage\.

projects.description: Mailflare is a self-hosted, open-source email inbox for custom domains. It offers shared inboxes, multiple accounts, security, backups, and deployment on Cloudflare or Docker, keeping data on infrastructure you control.
projects.descriptionZh: Mailflare 是一个自托管、开源的自定义域名邮箱。它提供共享收件箱、多账户、安全与备份功能，可部署在 Cloudflare 或 Docker 上，让数据掌握在您自己的基础设施中。
projects.content:
## Overview

Mailflare is a self\-hosted, open\-source email inbox for custom domains\. It runs in your own Cloudflare account or as a Docker container, combining inbound routing, sending, storage, and a modern web interface\. It supports send and receive from custom domains, shared team accounts, security features, and data portability\.

## Key Features

- Send and receive from custom domains with attachments, rich formatting, signatures, drafts, folders, search, stars, and snoozing\.
- Create mailboxes and aliases across domains, including shared inboxes for team addresses\.
- Manage routing rules to store, forward, reject, or categorize incoming messages\.
- Protect accounts with spam filtering and two\-factor authentication using TOTP and recovery codes\.
- Schedule mailbox backups and import or export mail for portability\.
- Connect email apps via JMAP, integrate through API keys and webhooks, and use the built\-in AI assistant or MCP access\.

## Use Cases

- Professionals and teams that want custom\-domain email without recurring subscription fees\.
- Teams managing shared addresses such as hello@ or support@ without sharing passwords\.
- Developers and self\-hosters who want email running on infrastructure they control\.
- Applications and workflows that need to connect mail delivery through APIs and webhooks\.

## Getting Started

- Deploy the app to Cloudflare and keep the app name as mailflare\.
- Open the deployed app and follow /setup to check the installation and create your admin account\.
- Connect a domain managed by the same Cloudflare account; Mailflare configures its email routing and helps create the first mailbox\.
- For Docker self\-hosting, copy \.env\.docker\.example to \.env\.docker and run docker compose up \-d \-\-build\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Cloudflare deployment uses Workers, D1, R2, and Email Routing; the app running under the Worker name mailflare\.
- A scoped Cloudflare API token named CF\_TOKEN is required during deployment with permissions for Email Sending, DNS Settings, Email Routing Addresses, Email Routing Rules, and Zone Settings\.
- A paid Cloudflare Workers plan is required to send email and is recommended for a smooth experience\.
- Docker self\-hosting runs as one container with SQLite, local file storage, a built\-in SMTP listener for inbound mail, and any SMTP relay or Cloudflare Email Sending for outbound\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Cloudflare Worker deployment must keep the app name mailflare\.
- Cloudflare hosting is optional; Docker is supported as an alternative deployment\.
- Data location depends on the chosen deployment and remains under the operator's control\.
- Cloudflare usage may incur separate charges, although many personal installations fit within free allowances\.

projects.content:
## Overview

ManimGX is an open\-source 3D animation engine by Academa for creating math and 3D videos with Manim CE's Python API\. Its Rust and wgpu renderer produces native MP4 videos quickly, and a browser path uses npm, Pyodide, and WebGPU\.

## Key Features

- Compatible with Manim CE's Python API, including typed keyword arguments and \.animate chains\.
- Rust and wgpu renderer for native GPU rendering and WebGPU in the browser\.
- 2D and 3D scenes together, with surfaces, meshes, moving cameras, text, equations, and plots\.
- Browser embedding via npm install manimgx, Pyodide in a Web Worker, and WebGPU, with no render server\.
- Agent feedback through manimgx inspect, including storyboards and 2D layout checks at chosen play endings or times\.
- Text and math via LaTeX or Typst without a LaTeX installation, plus speech\-aligned animations with self\.say()\.

## Use Cases

- Creating explanatory math animations from Python scenes\.
- Rendering 1080p60 MP4 videos natively from scripts\.
- Embedding rendered scenes in web pages without a render server\.
- Letting coding agents generate and inspect 3D or math animations from prompts and llms\.txt setup instructions\.

## Getting Started

- Install with pip on macOS, Linux, or Windows using Python 3\.13\+: pip install manimgx\.
- Alternatively, paste the project's llms\.txt setup instructions into Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor so the agent handles setup\.
- Save a scene as scene\.py and render it with manimgx render scene\.py; the example produces Hello3D\.mp4 at 1080p60\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.13\+ on macOS, Linux, or Windows for pip installation\.
- Fonts, typesetting, and video encoding are included\.
- Native rendering uses wgpu; Linux wheels bundle Mesa's lavapipe for Vulkan rendering on CPU when no suitable GPU is available\.
- Browser use requires npm install manimgx, Pyodide in a Web Worker, and WebGPU\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Browser\-based execution relies on Python running in a Web Worker and WebGPU rendering\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Manufact is an MCP cloud platform for deploying, testing, observing, and publishing MCP servers and MCP apps\. It is built by the team behind the open\-source mcp\-use SDKs for TypeScript and Python and the open\-source MCP Inspector\. Deployments can originate from GitHub, the CLI, or Manufact's own MCP server, and the platform covers post\-deploy work such as cross\-client testing, MCP\-native analytics, and publishing checks for the ChatGPT Apps Store and Claude Cloud Connectors\.

## Key Features

- Deploy MCP servers and apps from GitHub, a template, or the CLI, with branch previews and custom domains\.
- Run cross\-client tests across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, and other clients, with LLM\-judged pass/fail results and CI gating\.
- Use the Cloud Inspector to trace, replay, and debug MCP traffic in production, and the open\-source MCP Inspector for tool testing, resource browsing, prompt testing, and JSON\-RPC logging\.
- Monitor MCP\-native analytics including tool calls, sessions, error rates, and p50/p95/p99 latency by tool, resource, and prompt\.
- Run publishing checks for the ChatGPT Apps Store and Claude Cloud Connectors, with fix guidance, E2E checks, and a generated submission pack\.
- Connect existing remote MCP servers by URL through the Manufact proxy to use chat, test suites, publish checks, and the submission pack without moving hosting\.

## Use Cases

- Teams deploying MCP servers or apps that need hosted endpoints, preview environments, and custom domains\.
- Developers validating MCP apps across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other clients before marketplace submission\.
- Operators monitoring production MCP traffic, tool\-call volume, latency, errors, and session timelines\.
- Publishers preparing ChatGPT Apps Store or Claude Cloud Connectors listings with compliance checks and submission assets\.

## Getting Started

- Start with the mcp\-use SDK by running npx \-y create\-mcp\-use\-app@latest, then run npm run dev in the generated project and open the local Inspector path\.
- Deploy from GitHub by connecting the GitHub App, deploy from a template, or run npx mcp\-use deploy from the CLI\.
- Connect an existing remote MCP server by URL through the Manufact proxy to use testing and publishing features without moving hosting\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Deploy from GitHub, the CLI, Manufact's own MCP server, a template, or an existing remote MCP server connected by URL\.
- TypeScript and Python are first\-class through the mcp\-use SDKs, with presets for FastMCP and other frameworks, plus a Dockerfile option for anything else\.
- OAuth ships with Auth0, Better Auth, Clerk, Keycloak, Supabase, and WorkOS, plus custom providers that support dynamic client registration; clients connect with OAuth 2\.1 with PKCE or bearer tokens\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Marketplace publication is subject to OpenAI and Anthropic reviewing and approving their own listings\.
- Branch preview deployments are available only on the Hobby plan and above\.
- Existing mcp\-use v1 projects have a documented migration path\.

projects.descriptionZh: 一个开放、结构化的中小学学习主题分类体系，覆盖八个学科的1590个微主题，以3221条先修依赖连成有向无环图，并对齐国家课程标准。
projects.content:
## Overview

Marble Skill Taxonomy is an open, structured taxonomy of what children learn across the primary/elementary years\. It decomposes learning into 1,590 fine\-grained micro\-topics across eight subjects, wires them into a directed acyclic prerequisite graph with 3,221 edges, aligns topics to national curriculum standards, and includes parent\-friendly domain summaries\.

## Key Features

- 1,590 micro\-topics, each with a plain\-language description, mastery evidence criteria, type, subject and domain, and approximate age range\.
- 3,221 prerequisite dependencies represented as a directed acyclic graph, with edges tagged hard or soft and carrying a one\-line reason\.
- Curriculum alignment linking micro\-topics to standards from NGSS, Common Core, the UK National Curriculum, and more\.
- 183 parent\-friendly one\-paragraph domain summaries per subject, domain, and age band\.
- Coverage across eight subjects: Science, Mathematics, English, History, Personal & Social Development, Life Skills, Computing, and Learning to Learn\.
- UTF\-8 JSON data files, JSON Schemas, and a manifest with counts and SHA\-256 checksums\.

## Use Cases

- AI tutoring and retrieval\-augmented generation systems that need structured curriculum knowledge\.
- Agent queries about what must be learned before a concept and what paths lead to a learning goal\.
- Knowledge\-gap diagnosis and personalized learning planning using assessment results and prerequisite relationships\.
- Curriculum analysis and exploration through a connected graph of learning topics\.

## Getting Started

- Load data/topics\.json and data/dependencies\.json as UTF\-8 JSON; no runtime or dependencies are required\.
- Build an ID map from topics and filter dependencies by topicId to retrieve prerequisites for a topic\.
- Validate structure and referential integrity with node scripts/validate\.mjs\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- No runtime or dependencies are required; the dataset is pure UTF\-8 JSON\.
- JSON Schemas are provided in schema/, and data/manifest\.json provides counts and SHA\-256 checksums\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: ODbL\-1\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Curriculum standards are extracted from third\-party frameworks, so users should account for the external origin of those standards\.
- The release deliberately omits semantic embeddings and any per\-child or user data\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Marketing Skills is a collection of AI agent skills focused on marketing tasks, built for technical marketers and founders\. It covers conversion optimization, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering, and works with coding agents that support the Agent Skills spec\.

## Key Features

- 50 open\-source marketing skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other compatible agents\.
- Skills are markdown files that give AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows for marketing tasks\.
- The product\-marketing skill is the foundation; every other skill checks it first to understand product, audience, and positioning\.
- Skills reference each other and build on shared context across SEO and content, CRO, content and copy, paid and measurement, growth and retention, sales and GTM, and strategy\.
- Includes installation paths such as the npx skills CLI, Claude Code plugin, OpenAI Codex plugin, clone\-and\-copy, Git submodule, SkillKit, and Claude Web ZIPs\.
- Partner integrations include Converly for server\-side conversion tracking and Ploy for an AI website and growth platform\.

## Use Cases

- Technical marketers and founders can ask AI coding agents to help with conversion optimization, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering\.
- Teams can install all skills or choose specific skills such as cro and copywriting for agent\-assisted marketing workflows\.
- Users can invoke skills directly, for example /cro, /emails, or /seo\-audit, when working on specific marketing tasks\.
- Agencies and service providers can run this work as a service, with Magister and Conversion Factory listed for done\-for\-you help\.

## Getting Started

- Install all skills with npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills\.
- Install specific skills with npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills \-\-skill cro copywriting\.
- Install via Claude Code plugin with /plugin marketplace add coreyhaines31/marketingskills and /plugin install marketing\-skills\.
- After installation, ask your agent to help with marketing tasks or invoke skills directly such as /cro, /emails, or /seo\-audit\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and any agent that supports the Agent Skills spec\.
- For Claude Code the CLI installs into \.claude/skills/; universal agents share \.agents/skills/\.
- For Claude Web skill ZIPs, account permissions and code execution must allow skills\.
- The /plugin command is only available in an interactive Claude Code CLI session, not in Claude Code on the web, GitHub Actions, or other non\-interactive or remote environments\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Upgrading from v1\.x to v2\.0 can leave stale old\-name skill folders alongside the new skills, requiring manual cleanup\.
- The /plugin command is only available in an interactive Claude Code CLI session, so non\-interactive or remote environments need an alternative\.
- Installing a Claude Web skill ZIP does not configure local CLIs, MCP servers, credentials, or related skills\.
- The web\-target archive uses a shorter description, and its manifest may list skills whose description still needs review; release notes summarize omissions\.

projects.content:
## Overview

MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility for converting various files to Markdown for use with LLMs and related text analysis pipelines\. It focuses on preserving important document structure and content as Markdown, including headings, lists, tables, and links\. The output is intended for text analysis tools rather than high\-fidelity human\-facing document conversion\.

## Key Features

- Supports conversion from PDF, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, images, audio, HTML, text\-based formats such as CSV, JSON, and XML, ZIP files, YouTube URLs, and EPubs\.
- Preserves important document structure and content as Markdown, including headings, lists, tables, and links\.
- Provides a command\-line interface and Python API, with optional format\-specific dependencies\.
- Supports third\-party plugins, which are disabled by default, for extending conversion capabilities\.
- Offers optional Azure Content Understanding and Azure Document Intelligence integrations for higher\-quality cloud conversion and structured field extraction\.
- Can use LLMs for image descriptions in PPTX and image files\.

## Use Cases

- Preparing documents and media as Markdown for LLM\-based text analysis and RAG workflows\.
- Converting office documents, PDFs, and web content into structured text\.
- Extracting text and metadata from images, audio, and other supported formats for downstream analysis\.
- Integrating document conversion into Python applications or command\-line workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Requires Python 3\.10 through 3\.14; using a virtual environment is recommended\.
- Install with pip install 'markitdown\[all\]', or install format\-specific extras such as pdf, docx, and pptx\.
- Convert a file from the command line with markitdown path\-to\-file\.pdf, optionally using \-o to specify an output file, or pipe content into markitdown\.
- Use the Python API by creating MarkItDown, calling convert on a file, and printing result\.markdown\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 through 3\.14 is required\.
- Docker deployment is supported by building an image and running the container with input redirected\.
- Optional Azure Document Intelligence conversion requires an endpoint and credentials, using AZURE\_API\_KEY or DefaultAzureCredential\.
- Optional Azure Content Understanding conversion requires a Content Understanding endpoint\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- It performs I/O with the current process's privileges and can access resources that process can access, so untrusted inputs should be sanitized\.
- Third\-party plugin support is available but disabled by default; enable it explicitly to use plugins\.
- Document Intelligence analysis add\-ons are not enabled by default and must be opted into explicitly\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Mastra is an open\-source TypeScript framework for building AI\-powered applications and agents\. It provides agents, workflows, memory, workspaces, and observability, and integrates with frontend and backend frameworks such as React, Next\.js, and Node, or can run as a standalone server\.

## Key Features

- Agents use LLMs and tools to solve open\-ended tasks, reason about goals, decide which tools to use, and iterate until a final answer or optional stopping condition is met\.
- Graph\-based workflows orchestrate complex multi\-step processes with control flow methods such as \.then(), \.branch(), and \.parallel(), including human\-in\-the\-loop suspend and resume\.
- Memory and context management combine conversation history, retrieval from APIs, databases, and files, plus observational memory and semantic recall\.
- Built\-in observability includes evals, metrics, datasets, traces, and signals for inspecting and improving agent runs\.
- Model routing connects to multiple AI providers through one standard interface, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini\.
- Applications can deploy as a standalone Hono\-powered server, integrate with React, Next\.js, or Node, or use existing Hono, Express, or Fastify server apps\.

## Use Cases

- Conversational agents for customer support, onboarding, or internal queries\.
- Domain\-specific copilots for coding, legal, finance, research, or creative work\.
- Workflow automations that trigger, route, and complete multi\-step processes\.
- Decision\-support tools that analyze data and provide actionable recommendations\.

## Getting Started

- Create a project with npm create mastra@latest \<project\-name\> \-\- \-\-llm \<provider\>, choosing a supported provider such as openai, anthropic, google, or xai\.
- Enter the project directory and start the development server with npm run dev\.
- Open Mastra Studio at http://localhost:4111 to build, test, and manage agents, workflows, and tools\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Mastra applications can be deployed to any Node\.js\-compatible environment\.
- Optional built\-in deployers support Vercel, Netlify, and Cloudflare\.
- Deploy as a standalone server powered by Hono, integrate with Next\.js, or use an existing Hono, Express, Fastify, or other server app\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Human\-in\-the\-loop workflow pause and resume depends on storage to remember execution state\.

## Overview

MCode Stack is the open\-source collection of workflows and skills the MiniMax Code team uses to build MiniMax Code\. The repository also acts as a plugin marketplace for installing stacks\.

- Skills for planning, context and tool budgets, long sessions and commands, review, experiments, and emergency changes

- Skills install into MiniMax Code and can be invoked with /skill\-name or loaded by the agent from its description

- The common SKILL\.md format means most skills also work in other agents that support skills

- Keep AI\-written code at a high bar with review, small PR, and change\-description skills

projects.content:
## Overview

MCP for Blender is an open source Blender addon and MCP server that lets an LLM control Blender through a socket\-based connection\. The AI can write Blender Python, create and modify objects, apply materials, inspect results through multiple views or renders, and search or import assets\. The project is a community plugin and is not affiliated with the Blender Foundation\.

## Key Features

- Two\-way communication between Blender and an LLM through a socket\-based server
- Create, modify, and delete 3D objects in Blender
- Apply and modify materials and colors
- Visual verification through viewport, camera, multi\-angle, wireframe, X\-ray, animation\-strip views, and renders
- Code execution where the AI writes Blender Python directly
- Asset and model generation using Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Poly Pizza, Tripo, Hyper3D Rodin, Hunyuan3D, and Meshy

## Use Cases

- Prompt\-assisted 3D modeling and scene creation
- Applying and modifying materials and colors
- Letting the AI inspect and verify its work with multi\-angle, camera, wireframe, X\-ray, animation\-strip views, and renders
- Importing assets or generating 3D models from supported sources

## Getting Started

- Run uvx mcp\-for\-blender setup if uv is already installed; otherwise use the one\-line installer for macOS/Linux or Windows\.
- Select which MCP clients to configure; setup adds a blender entry and saves a \.bak of each changed file\.
- Fully quit and reopen the AI app, open Blender, and ask it to build something\.
- For manual setup, install uv, add the MCP server to the client, run uvx mcp\-for\-blender install\-addon, enable Interface: MCP for Blender in Blender preferences, and start or connect the server\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Blender 3\.0 or newer
- Python 3\.10 or newer
- uv package manager, using the official installer rather than pip install uv
- An MCP client such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, OpenCode, or Antigravity
- Docker can host only the MCP server; Blender still runs on the host\. On Linux, use host networking and set BLENDER\_HOST to localhost\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The addon is an independent third\-party integration and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Blender Foundation\.
- The addon's socket server has no authentication or encryption\.
- By default, the AI can run any Python code in Blender\.

## Overview

mcp\-for\-blender\-pro is an AI assistant and MCP server for Blender\. It combines a visual chat workspace, scene tools, model choice, and agent workflows so users can inspect scenes, build objects, edit materials, find assets, and carry out multi\-step operations while continuing to work in Blender\.

## Key Features

- Scene and object inspection gives the assistant context before it acts\.
- A visual Studio workspace provides chat, scene objects, viewport snapshots, approvals, and a task board\.
- Users can connect supported cloud providers, local Ollama models, or compatible custom endpoints\.
- A single assistant can handle quick changes, while a team chain supports managers, workers, and reviewers for structured tasks\.
- A built\-in MCP server connects OpenCode and other clients supporting authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP\.
- 21 scene tools support creating, inspecting, editing, capturing, searching assets, consulting Blender APIs, and exporting scenes\.

## Use Cases

- Artists who want faster iteration in Blender\.
- Technical artists who automate repetitive work\.
- Developers connecting AI tools to Blender\.

## Getting Started

- Download mcp\-for\-blender\-pro\.zip from Releases\.
- In Blender, open Edit, then Preferences, then Get Extensions, then the menu, then Install from Disk\.
- Select the ZIP, enable mcp\-for\-blender\-pro, then open 3D Viewport and the N panel for MCP Pro\.
- Choose a provider, add connection details, and select a model\.
- Send a message in Blender or click Open Studio Window\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The release bundle targets Windows x64 with Blender 4\.2 or later\.
- Keep Blender open while using Studio or an external client\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Python tool validation is a guardrail, not a security sandbox\.
- Approval behavior for external MCP clients is managed by those clients\.
- Asset integrations may require service keys, and users must follow asset licenses\.
- Studio and external client use requires Blender to remain open\.
