projects.content:
## Overview

NOFX is a self\-hosted trading system with two modes: Frontier, where you work through a trade with AI, compare entry plans on a chart and explicitly approve execution, and Autopilot, where a configured trader reads the market, makes decisions and routes orders while running\. It uses your configured models and exchange accounts and runs locally via Docker\.

## Key Features

- Frontier supports AI\-assisted trade planning with market, limit, weighted ladder and TWAP entries, then requires explicit approval before execution\.
- Autopilot runs a configured model, exchange account and strategy continuously, with a Dashboard for positions, performance and decision history\.
- Frontier exposes Binance USDT perpetuals, Hyperliquid, OKX and Bitget; the broader runtime also includes Bybit, Gate, KuCoin, Aster and Lighter\.
- The installer uses published Docker images, generates missing environment keys and runs locally without Go or Node\.js setup\.
- Models and paid data can be accessed through Claw402, with usage settled in USDC on Base and kept separate from exchange trading funds\.
- Exchange credentials are stored encrypted by the NOFX server, and the model does not receive wallet private keys or exchange credentials in its prompt\.

## Use Cases

- Traders who want AI\-generated entry plans but want to review and approve each order before it is submitted\.
- Users who want a configured strategy to run continuously under Autopilot and monitor positions, performance and decision history\.
- Self\-hosters who want to browse public markets and compare plans before connecting an execution account\.
- Developers evaluating a local\-first trading stack with Docker\-based deployment and multiple supported venues\.

## Getting Started

- On Linux or macOS with Docker and Compose available, run the one\-line install script; the installer starts Docker if needed\.
- Open the local web interface at 127\.0\.0\.1 port 3000 in a desktop browser\.
- Create a local account, choose a model in Config, and if using Claw402 fund the AI fee wallet with USDC on Base\.
- Add a trading account, check equity and available balance, then open Frontier to select the exchange, account and market and generate plans\.
- For continuous trading, configure and start an Autopilot trader separately with a model, exchange account and strategy\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The installer\-based path assumes Linux or macOS with Docker and Compose; it starts Docker if needed and uses published Docker images\.
- Windows deployments use Docker Desktop and a Bash environment such as WSL2\.
- Remote deployments should use an SSH tunnel or an authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy; the frontend and API bind to 127\.0\.0\.1 by default\.
- For source builds, install Git and Docker with Compose; development without Docker uses the Go version in go\.mod, Node\.js 24 and TA\-Lib\.
- Keep the \.env file and data directory when upgrading an installer\-based installation\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Autopilot can place trades continuously without per\-trade approval while it is running\.
- Limit orders and scheduled TWAP slices may remain unfilled\.
- AI model requests can incur charges even if no trade is placed\.
- Stopping a process does not close exchange positions\.
- The project warns that automated trading and experimental AI strategies can lose money\.

## 项目简介

NOFX 是一个自托管交易系统，包含两种模式：Frontier 让你与 AI 一起处理一笔交易，在图表上比较入场计划并明确批准执行；Autopilot 让已配置的交易员读取市场、做出决策并在运行时路由订单。它使用你配置的模型和交易所账户，并通过 Docker 在本地运行。

## 核心功能

- Frontier 支持 AI 辅助交易计划，包括市价、限价、加权阶梯和 TWAP 入场，并在执行前要求明确批准。
- Autopilot 持续运行已配置的模型、交易所账户和策略，Dashboard 展示持仓、表现和决策历史。
- Frontier 支持 Binance USDT 永续、Hyperliquid、OKX 和 Bitget；更广泛的 NOFX 运行时还包括 Bybit、Gate、KuCoin、Aster 和 Lighter。
- 安装器使用已发布的 Docker 镜像，生成缺失的环境密钥，并在本地运行，无需安装 Go 或 Node\.js。
- 模型和付费数据可通过 Claw402 访问，使用 USDC on Base 结算，并与交易所交易资金分开。
- 交易所凭据由 NOFX 服务器加密存储，模型提示中不会收到钱包私钥或交易所凭据。

## 适用场景

- 希望获得 AI 生成的入场计划，但在订单提交前逐笔审核并批准的交易者。
- 希望用 Autopilot 持续运行已配置策略，并监控持仓、表现和决策历史的用户。
- 希望在连接执行账户前浏览公开市场并比较计划的自托管用户。
- 评估本地优先交易技术栈、Docker 部署和多交易所支持的开发者。

## 快速开始

- 在已安装 Docker 和 Compose 的 Linux 或 macOS 上运行一行安装脚本；安装器会在需要时启动 Docker。
- 在桌面浏览器打开 127\.0\.0\.1:3000 的本地 Web 界面。
- 创建本地账户，在 Config 中选择模型；如使用 Claw402，用 USDC on Base 为 AI 费用钱包充值。
- 添加交易账户，查看权益和可用余额，然后打开 Frontier 选择交易所、账户和市场并生成计划。
- 如需持续交易，单独配置并启动一个 Autopilot 交易员，设置模型、交易所账户和策略。

## 部署与要求

- 安装器路径假定 Linux 或 macOS 已具备 Docker 和 Compose；需要时会启动 Docker，并使用已发布的 Docker 镜像。
- Windows 部署使用 Docker Desktop 和 Bash 环境，例如 WSL2。
- 远程部署应使用 SSH 隧道或经过认证的 HTTPS 反向代理；前端和 API 默认绑定到 127\.0\.0\.1。
- 源码构建需安装 Git 和 Docker 与 Compose；不使用 Docker 的开发需使用 go\.mod 指定的 Go 版本、Node\.js 24 和 TA\-Lib。
- 升级安装器部署时保留 \.env 文件和 data 目录。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：AGPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Nogon is a private search engine for the pages you visit and the files you keep\. It indexes their full contents so you can find information again from a web interface, terminal, CLI, or an AI assistant connected through MCP\.

## Key Features

- Privacy focused, with no telemetry or mandatory cloud service and the option to run locally or on infrastructure you control\.
- Full\-text indexing of visited pages and local files, not only titles and URLs\.
- Automatic browser indexing through Firefox or Chrome extensions\.
- Powerful queries with field filters, phrases, wildcards, negation, aliases, and result priorities\.
- Optional semantic search through an embeddings endpoint you configure\.
- Web, terminal, CLI, and MCP clients, plus crawler and browser import and multi\-user support\.

## Use Cases

- Finding a phrase you remember from a page you visited or a file you kept when title and URL searches are insufficient\.
- Bringing existing content into the index by importing browser history, bookmarks, local directories, or files\.
- Searching from a terminal or an AI assistant instead of switching to a browser tab\.
- Running a shared Nogon server while keeping each user's documents and results separate\.

## Getting Started

- Download the binary for your platform and rename it to nogon (nogon\.exe on Windows)\.
- On Linux or macOS, make it executable with chmod \+x nogon\.
- Start the server with \./nogon listen on Linux or macOS, or \.\\nogon\.exe listen in PowerShell on Windows\.
- Open the local web interface at 127\.0\.0\.1:4433 and install the Firefox or Chrome browser extension\.
- Visit a page with the extension enabled, then search for a phrase from it in Nogon\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Run Nogon as a local server or on infrastructure you control; documents and search indexes are stored on that server\.
- Keep the server process running while using Nogon to index pages and search them\.
- Automatic browser indexing uses the Firefox or Chrome extension, which sends indexed page content only to the configured Nogon server, apart from downloading page favicons\.
- Alternative installation methods include Homebrew, Docker, and Nix\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The default Nogon configuration has no telemetry and no cloud sync\.
- Enabling optional semantic search sends document text to an external embeddings endpoint selected by the operator\.
- Browser indexing normally contacts the configured Nogon server, with favicon downloads as an exception\.
- The Nogon server process must stay running for indexing and search to work\.

## 项目简介

Nogon 是一个面向你访问的网页和保存文件的私有搜索引擎。它对这些内容进行全文索引，让你可以从网页界面、终端、命令行或通过 MCP 连接的 AI 助手再次找到信息。

## 核心功能

- 隐私优先：没有遥测，也不依赖强制云服务，可在本地或你控制的基础设施上运行。全文索引：搜索访问过的网页和本地文件的实际内容，而不只是标题和 URL。自动浏览器索引：通过 Firefox 或 Chrome 扩展保存新访问的页面。强大的查询：支持字段过滤、短语、通配符、否定、别名和结果优先级。可选语义搜索：通过你配置的嵌入端点按含义查找文档。多种客户端：可从网页、终端、命令行或 AI 助手搜索，并支持爬虫、浏览器导入和多用户。

## 适用场景

- 当你记得某段话但想不起出处时，可用内容搜索找回访问过的页面或保存文件中的信息，而不依赖标题和 URL 搜索。可导入浏览器历史、书签、本地目录或文件，让索引在开始使用时就有内容。可在终端或 AI 助手中搜索，不必切换到浏览器标签页。可在共享服务器上为多个用户保持各自的文档和搜索结果相互独立。

## 快速开始

- 下载对应平台的二进制文件并重命名为 nogon（Windows 上为 nogon\.exe）。在 Linux 或 macOS 上运行 chmod \+x nogon 使其可执行。在 Linux 或 macOS 上运行 \./nogon listen 启动服务器，Windows PowerShell 中运行 \.\\nogon\.exe listen。打开 127\.0\.0\.1:4433 的本地网页界面并安装 Firefox 或 Chrome 浏览器扩展。启用扩展后访问网页，再在 Nogon 中搜索页面中的短语以确认首条索引结果。

## 部署与要求

- 可将 Nogon 作为本地服务器运行，或部署在你控制的基础设施上；文档和搜索索引存储在该服务器上。使用 Nogon 进行索引和搜索时，服务器进程需要保持运行。自动浏览器索引使用 Firefox 或 Chrome 扩展，该扩展仅将索引的页面内容发送到你配置的 Nogon 服务器，下载页面图标除外。替代安装方式包括 Homebrew、Docker 和 Nix。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：AGPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

NVIDIA NemoClaw is an open source reference stack for running supported and qualified candidate AI agents more safely inside NVIDIA OpenShell sandboxes\. It installs OpenShell as part of NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, applies the selected agent integration layer and versioned blueprint, and provides guided onboarding, managed inference, network policy, managed integrations, and lifecycle operations\.

## Key Features

- Guided onboarding and an onboard wizard for setup\.
- Managed inference with credential custody provided by OpenShell\.
- Network policy and managed integrations\.
- Lifecycle operations for sandboxed agents\.
- Separation of qualification\-only candidate agents from supported agent runtimes\.
- Versioned blueprints and selected agent integration layers\.

## Use Cases

- Running supported and qualified candidate AI agents inside NVIDIA OpenShell sandboxes\.

projects.content:
## Overview

NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) is open\-source software that an AI factory installs to run a managed Kubernetes service on its own NVIDIA GPU infrastructure\. Operators call the NVKE API to create clusters for customers; NVKE provisions nodes, forms each cluster with its own control plane and etcd, and then operates it by scaling node pools, upgrading Kubernetes, replacing nodes, and renewing certificates\. It connects to an infrastructure provider through Cluster API and uses an NVKE node agent to configure nodes without SSH\.

## Key Features

- An API for managed clusters that lets operators request clusters by Kubernetes version, node pools, and network settings while hiding Cluster API, kubeadm, and node configuration behind the API and nvkectl\.
- Artifacts from pinned sources that operators can verify, including a reference node image built from the NVKE checkout and its pinned build inputs, with optional component and package artifacts from NVKR builds\.
- Bare\-metal node identity attestation through TPM and SPIFFE/SPIRE before a node receives a join credential, with optional etcd encryption at rest per cluster\.
- GPU\-aware day\-2 operations through node pools, including upgrades, node replacement, certificate renewal, and remediation requested when NVSentinel detects a GPU fault\.
- Built on upstream Kubernetes, kubeadm, and Cluster API, producing standard Kubernetes clusters that can be used with kubectl and clusterctl alongside nvkectl\.
- An OpenTelemetry\-based telemetry pipeline, NKTP, for metrics, logs, and traces from the management cluster and NVKE clusters\.

## Use Cases

- AI factory operators build artifacts with NVKR, install and run NVKE, and create and operate Kubernetes clusters for their customers\.
- AI factory customers receive a Kubernetes API endpoint and node pools from their operator and run AI workloads on them\.
- Evaluators and contributors try NVKE on one Linux machine against a simulated infrastructure provider, or build and change NVKE and NVKR\.

## Getting Started

- Evaluate locally with mock\-NICo on one Linux machine with at least 6 CPUs and 12 GiB of memory\.
- Run NVKE end to end on one machine\.
- For hardware installation, plan the installation, build and host node OS images, prepare nodes, bootstrap the management cluster, install the management plane, configure NICo as the infrastructure provider, and secure the NVKE API\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- NVIDIA GPU machines and the networks that connect them, managed by NICo\.
- Nodes for the management cluster prepared as described in the NVKE documentation\.
- A reference\-image build host with the required tools, an HTTP(S) boot\-artifact endpoint, and registries for container and package artifacts\.
- An identity provider that issues signed JWTs if NVKE API authentication is enabled\.
- At preview, NVIDIA Infra Controller (NICo) as the supported infrastructure provider\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- NVKE is a preview release; APIs, configuration, and behavior may change, and production use is not recommended\.
- At preview, NVKE's infrastructure\-provider support is limited to NVIDIA Infra Controller (NICo)\.
- API authentication, when enabled, depends on an external identity provider that issues signed JWTs\.
- Only NVKR Releases from the hosted pipeline are signed and carry build provenance; local Runs are unsigned\.
- No NVKR Release is qualified at preview\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Oat UI is an HTML and CSS semantic UI component library with a small JavaScript layer for a few dynamic WebComponents\. It styles semantic tags and attributes contextually without requiring classes, aiming to keep markup clean and reduce class pollution\. The project is designed for building decent\-looking web applications without a framework, build step, or dependency tree\.

## Key Features

- Ultra\-lightweight: approximately 10KB of CSS and JS combined\.
- Zero dependencies, with no framework or build step to configure\.
- Styles semantic HTML tags and attributes contextually without classes for base components\.
- Uses minimal JavaScript and WebComponents only for a few dynamic components\.
- Covers most commonly needed components and elements for everyday web application UI\.
- Designed to reduce markup class pollution and encourage meaningful HTML\.

## Use Cases

- Small projects and internal tools where page weight matters\.
- Projects where a full component framework or design system is overkill\.
- Developers who want clean semantic HTML and tiny bundles\.
- Manual, transparent front\-end setups using two included files and no build pipeline\.

## Getting Started

- Obtain the CSS and JavaScript files from the project repository\.
- Include the CSS in the HTML head and the JavaScript before the closing body tag\.
- Write semantic HTML and let the library style base components without classes\.
- Review the live demo and documentation to see available components and expected markup\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- No build step, bundler, compiler, config file, or dependency tree is required\.
- The library is shipped as a tiny CSS file and a tiny JS file included directly in the page\.
- The workflow is manual and transparent because no package manager step or build pipeline is described\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Oat UI is not intended to replace large component frameworks or full design systems with theming, complex data components, and a broad ecosystem\.
- The documented setup is deliberately manual because no package manager step or build pipeline is described\.

projects.description: Octomind is an open-source AI coding agent and agent runtime: one binary, any model, MCP-native. It runs in the terminal, CI, or as a daemon, with portable agents defined in TOML and policy in guardrails.
projects.descriptionZh: Octomind 是开源的 AI 编程智能体与智能体运行时：单个二进制文件，支持任意模型并原生集成 MCP，可在终端、CI 或守护进程中运行。智能体是可移植、可拥有的文件，策略写入脚本而非审批弹窗，因而能在无人值守时持续完成任务。
projects.content:
## Overview

Octomind is an open\-source coding agent harness and agent runtime\. It gives LLMs tools through MCP to read and edit files, run shells, search code, and delegate to sub\-agents\. The same session engine runs as an interactive CLI, a stdin pipe, a daemon, a WebSocket server, or an ACP agent\. Policy is written as deterministic TOML guardrails, and a supervising model plans and checks the work so sessions can run unattended\.

## Key Features

- Deterministic TOML guardrails provide pre\-call guards, post\-result hooks, and post\-turn validators\.
- Any supported model can be used and swapped mid\-session, including OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, Bedrock, and Ollama\.
- An agent is one TOML file containing models, tools, prompts, and guardrails that can be read, forked, and committed\.
- The runtime exposes the same harness through interactive CLI, non\-interactive structured output, daemon plus send, WebSocket server, and ACP\.
- Adaptive compression preserves decisions, errors, and file references while dropping noise, supporting sessions that resume across days\.
- Tools remain dormant and activate by meaning, limiting context to the relevant tools rather than preloading many\.

## Use Cases

- Running daily coding sessions in the terminal with packaged specialists such as developer:general\.
- Using non\-interactive JSONL or plain output in CI, shell scripts, and scheduled jobs\.
- Keeping a background agent alive for days and injecting new work with the daemon and send commands\.
- Chaining specialists into multi\-step workflows for research, writing, review, and polishing\.

## Getting Started

- Install with the provided one\-line script for macOS or Linux, the PowerShell command for Windows, Homebrew on macOS, Cargo, or a source build\.
- Run octomind once in a terminal to choose where models come from: Octomind hub, your own provider, or shipped defaults\.
- In a project, run octomind run developer:general to start a session with a packaged specialist\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The runtime is distributed as a single binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- The runtime works standalone with your own provider keys and does not require Octomind servers; signing in is a convenience\.
- Cloud execution is available as an optional Octomind Cloud offering\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Benchmark numbers are published historical results for a specific date, not a measurement of the current checkout\.
- API keys are intentionally not accepted in the config file and must come from the environment or a \.env file\.
- The first run of a specialist may install its tools and request credentials\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Octop is an open\-source, self\-hosted AI assistant platform for households and small teams\. It runs a single process serving a web dashboard, CLI, IM channels, cron automation, and APIs, with all data under ~/\.octop/ on your own machine\.

## Key Features

- Multi\-user and multi\-agent operation with JWT authentication, per\-user agents, and an admin role\.
- Self\-hosted local\-first design that keeps config, chats, workspaces, and credentials on your machine\.
- Web dashboard, CLI, desktop client, and HTTP/SSE/WebSocket API access\.
- IM channels include Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeChat, Telegram, Discord, and WeCom\.
- Expert library, MBTI persona templates, expert sharing, and AgentTeams beta for multi\-step work\.
- Knowledge base RAG, plugins, connectors with OAuth and MCP, and ACP integration for IDE workflows\.

## Use Cases

- Personal assistant for weekly reports, notes, scheduling, and persistent memory\.
- Family sharing with one admin account and different agents or experts per member\.
- Team helper that bridges IM platforms and routes tasks into group chats\.
- Developer boost through ACP delegation to OpenCode or Claude Code, terminal AI, and browser automation\.

## Getting Started

- Install on macOS or Linux with the one\-line installer, or use PowerShell or cmd installers on Windows\.
- Run octop init to create the SQLite database, JWT secret, and first admin account under ~/\.octop/\.
- Run octop run, then open the web dashboard on local port 8088\.
- For production, Docker Compose is recommended; first boot creates the admin account and writes credentials to /data/\.octop/credential\.txt unless OCTOP\_DEFAULT\_PASSWORD is set\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supported operating systems include macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- No pre\-installed Python is required; the installer uses uv to provision Python 3\.12 in an isolated venv under ~/\.octop/\.
- A modern multi\-core CPU with a few GB of RAM is recommended for the process plus model and embedding caches, with enough disk for the database, agent workspaces, and document corpora\.
- The control plane uses SQLite by default, with PostgreSQL optional; workspace backends can include local disk, Docker sandbox, PostgreSQL, or COS/S3\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

## 项目简介

Octop 是一个可自托管的开源智能协作伙伴，面向个人和团队。其 Octop Memory 组件为 LLM 智能体提供持久、可移植的记忆，可捕获、提取、回忆、存储和迁移对话上下文，并支持 Python 库、CLI 和 JSON\-RPC 桥接等方式接入。

## 核心功能

- 一次部署，人人有专属助手：一台机器运行一套服务，家人和同事可拥有只记得自己事情的助手，切换角色不必切换环境。
- 连接常用账号与工具：可授权腾讯文档、腾讯会议、Notion、邮箱等，用一句话完成信息整理，减少复制粘贴。
- 与编辑器和终端协作：复杂改动可通过 ACP 派给专业编程 Agent，由用户验收结果。
- 具备电脑操作能力：可在终端执行命令、在浏览器填写表单并自动截图，遇到阻碍才请求用户确认。
- 桌面宠物常驻：OctopPet 悬浮桌面，随叫随到，无需打开浏览器即可提问。
- Octop Memory 持久记忆：支持模型辅助提取、召回排序、实体页与情景组织、导出导入，以及 SQLite 或 PostgreSQL 存储。

## 适用场景

- 个人快速问答：通过桌面宠物或主界面随时向智能伙伴提问。
- 团队共享部署：一台服务为家人和同事提供各自独立上下文的专属助手。
- 会议与文档整理：连接腾讯会议、腾讯文档等账号后，把会议结论整理进文档。
- 编程协作：将复杂代码改动派给专业编程 Agent，用户负责验收结果。

## 快速开始

- 官网提供三步上手，可复制安装命令运行，程序会自动准备需要的东西。
- 支持一键安装、pip 安装、Docker 安装和下载客户端等方式。
- Octop Memory 可通过 pip install octop\-memory 安装，并使用 Python API 或 CLI 创建本地数据库。
- Octop Memory 可选安装 cli、postgres、langgraph、langgraph\-postgres 等依赖组。

## 部署与要求

- Octop Memory 要求 Python 3\.12\+，核心依赖为零，可使用 SQLite 本地起步，或使用 PostgreSQL 进行服务器部署。
- 自动提取、提升检查和页面再生成需要注入 LLMClient；仅安装软件包不会配置模型。
- Octop 支持自托管，数据可保留在本地；网站提供 Docker 安装方式。
- 向量检索默认未启用，使用需初始化索引并注入 vector\_index 和 embedding\_provider。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- Octop Memory 的自动提取、提升检查和页面再生成依赖外部注入的 LLMClient，单独安装不会配置模型。
- 向量检索接口与 Chroma/Qdrant 适配器虽在代码中存在，但真实集成尚未验证，且默认未启用。
- PostgreSQL 行为测试需连接真实测试服务器，跳过的 PG 用例不能证明兼容性。

projects.content:
## Overview

Octop Browser is a lightweight browser\-use style tool that makes an agent's browser usage more accurate and reliable\. It launches a real Chromium and communicates directly with the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) instead of routing every action through Playwright\.

## Key Features

- Direct CDP connection to a real Chromium browser without Playwright or an intermediate layer\.
- Stable ref\-based element targeting that survives layout reflows and re\-renders\.
- Token\-efficient multi\-level DOM builder that keeps prompts small\.
- Profile\-based login persistence across sessions\.
- A stateless browser\_tool with about 20 actions and a matching first\-class CLI\.
- Record and replay workflows as skill\-guided agentic execution, plus an MCP server for any MCP\-capable agent\.

## Use Cases

- Enabling AI agents to navigate, click, type, fill, and extract data from real web pages\.
- Automating browser workflows such as form filling, screenshots, tab management, and history navigation\.
- Recording a real browsing session and replaying it as skill\-guided agentic execution\.
- Exposing browser tools to any MCP\-capable agent through the built\-in MCP server\.

## Getting Started

- Install Python 3\.11 or newer and run pip install octop\-browser, then octop\-browser install\-browser to fetch a Chromium binary\.
- Use as a library with BrowserSession\.create(profile="default") or statelessly with browser\_tool(action="navigate", url=\.\.\., profile="work")\.
- Use as a CLI with commands such as octop\-browser \-\-help, octop\-browser navigate "https://example\.com" \-\-profile work, and octop\-browser dom\-tree \-\-profile work\.
- Record a workflow with octop\-browser record daemon\-start, record start, record stop, record generate\-skill, and replay run\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.11\+ (verified on 3\.11 and 3\.12)\.
- A Chromium or Chrome binary; install\-browser auto\-downloads one\.
- Optional environment configuration such as BROWSER\_USE\_MODE, BROWSER\_USE\_CDP\_WS\_URL, and BROWSER\_USE\_PROFILES\_DIR\.
- For remote or Docker Chrome, set BROWSER\_USE\_CDP\_WS\_URL to connect directly to an existing DevTools WebSocket URL and skip the launcher\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The no\-sandbox flag may be added automatically in container environments where the kernel denies unprivileged user namespaces\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Octop Gateway is a multi\-platform IM channel bridge that provides a unified message abstraction for AI agents and bots\. It connects to mainstream IM platforms and normalizes every inbound message into one processing pipeline, so agent logic is written once and runs across Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom, WeChat iLink, Yuanbao, Xiaoyi, MQTT, Telegram, and Discord\. The gateway handles transport, parsing, media, and delivery behind a common interface\.

## Key Features

- 10 platforms, one processor: Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom, WeChat iLink, Yuanbao, Xiaoyi, MQTT, Telegram, and Discord all behind one interface\.
- Unified abstraction turns each platform's quirks into a common InboundMessage and MessageEvent model\.
- Streaming events let the processor act as an async generator yielding MessageEvent for token streaming\.
- Pluggable media uses MediaBackend to store attachments, with FileSystemMediaBackend shipped by default\.
- Per\-channel constraints include rate limit, timeout, and typing indicator\.
- Push routing provides push\_text, push\_content, and push\_to\_all for proactive messages\.

## Use Cases

- Build one bot that reaches users across multiple IM platforms without writing platform\-specific code\.
- Run isolated channels for different teams or tenants from a single gateway\.
- Send proactive notifications to individual users or broadcast messages to many\.
- Connect agent logic to platforms such as Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom, Telegram, and Discord\.

## Getting Started

- Install the core library with pip install octop\-gateway\.
- For example and agent integration extras, use pip install "octop\-gateway\[examples\]"\.
- Prerequisites are Python 3\.12\+ and credentials for the platforms you connect to\.
- Copy \.env\.example to \.env for environment\-based configuration\.
- Define an async processor yielding MessageEvent, create a ChannelManager, and add platform channels\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.12\+\.
- Credentials for each platform you connect to\.
- Environment\-based configuration can be used by copying \.env\.example to \.env\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Discord integration requires enabling Message Content Intent in the developer portal\.
- QQ QR login keeps a one\-time decryption key in memory and leaves persistence of the returned channel config to the caller\.

projects.content:
## Overview

docx is a TypeScript library from Office Kit for reading, editing, and writing Word \.docx files\. It can build a document from scratch with createDocx or open an existing \.docx with openDocx, then change paragraphs, runs, lists, tables, images, headers, footers, comments, footnotes, endnotes, hyperlinks, bookmarks, and tracked changes\. It runs in Node\.js and modern browsers, and unmodeled elements are written back untouched\.

## Key Features

- Create \.docx files from scratch with createDocx and append headings, paragraphs, bullet and numbered lists, tables, inline images, headers, footers, footnotes, and a table of contents\.
- Open existing \.docx files with openDocx to replace text across the body, headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, and comments; swap images by alt text; and accept or reject tracked insertions and deletions\.
- Render a Docx value or raw bytes into a DOM element with the companion @office\-kit/docx\-preview package in the browser\.
- Supports page setup, styles, tables, fields, comments, bookmarks, hyperlinks, core and app properties, find and replace, outline, statistics, plain\-text extraction, and validate()\.
- Uses standalone tree\-shakeable functions, ships ESM\-only with bundled \.d\.ts types, has one runtime dependency, and works in Node\.js and browsers\.

## Use Cases

- Fill a Word template by opening an existing \.docx, replacing placeholders such as \{\{name\}\}, and saving the result\.
- Generate reports, contracts, letterheads, and other structured documents programmatically from Node\.js or browser code\.
- Edit existing documents by changing text, images, headers, footers, notes, comments, or tracked changes while keeping unmodeled content intact\.
- Preview Word documents in a web page without uploading the file by using the browser preview package\.

## Getting Started

- Install with npm i @office\-kit/docx, pnpm add @office\-kit/docx, or yarn add @office\-kit/docx\.
- Import createDocx to build a document from scratch, or openDocx to open an existing \.docx template\.
- Use functions such as appendParagraph, addBulletList, addTable, setPageSize, replaceTextEverywhere, and toUint8Array to construct or modify the document\.
- For browser preview, pair the library with @office\-kit/docx\-preview and call previewToDOM\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs in modern browsers and Node\.js\.
- Ships ESM\-only with bundled \.d\.ts types\.
- Has no Node\-only dependencies and works in browsers, including with the Blob and File APIs\.
- One runtime dependency: fflate for ZIP handling\.
- @office\-kit/docx\-preview wraps the OSS docx\-preview renderer and runs in the browser\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is pre\-1\.0; core functions are stable but details may change before v1\.
- The library has one runtime dependency, fflate, for ZIP handling\.
- Merged table cells, nested tables, floating images, text boxes, charts, a typed API for content controls, ISO/IEC 29500 Strict files, and PDF rendering are not yet supported\.

## 项目简介

docx 是 Office Kit 推出的 TypeScript 库，用于读取、编辑和写入 Word \.docx 文件。它可以通过 createDocx 从零构建文档，也可以用 openDocx 打开现有 \.docx，然后修改段落、文本运行、列表、表格、图片、页眉、页脚、批注、脚注、尾注、超链接、书签和修订。它可在 Node\.js 和现代浏览器中运行，未建模的元素会原样写回。

## 核心功能

- 使用 createDocx 从零创建 \.docx 文件，并追加标题、段落、项目符号和编号列表、表格、内联图片、页眉、页脚、脚注和目录。
- 使用 openDocx 打开现有 \.docx 文件，以替换正文、页眉、页脚、脚注、尾注和批注中的文本；按替换文本交换图片；并接受或拒绝修订插入和删除。
- 借助配套的 @office\-kit/docx\-preview 包，在浏览器中将 Docx 值或原始字节渲染到 DOM 元素中。
- 支持页面设置、样式、表格、域、批注、书签、超链接、核心和应用属性、查找替换、大纲、统计、纯文本提取以及 validate()。
- 使用独立的 tree\-shakeable 函数，仅提供 ESM 并附带 \.d\.ts 类型，有一个运行时依赖，可在 Node\.js 和浏览器中运行。

## 适用场景

- 填充 Word 模板：打开现有 \.docx，替换 \{\{name\}\} 等占位符，并保存结果。
- 从 Node\.js 或浏览器代码中以编程方式生成报告、合同、信头和其他结构化文档。
- 编辑现有文档：更改文本、图片、页眉、页脚、注释、批注或修订，同时保留未建模的内容。
- 使用浏览器预览包在网页中预览 Word 文档，无需上传文件。

## 快速开始

- 使用 npm i @office\-kit/docx、pnpm add @office\-kit/docx 或 yarn add @office\-kit/docx 进行安装。
- 导入 createDocx 从零构建文档，或导入 openDocx 打开现有 \.docx 模板。
- 使用 appendParagraph、addBulletList、addTable、setPageSize、replaceTextEverywhere 和 toUint8Array 等函数来构建或修改文档。
- 如需浏览器预览，请将库与 @office\-kit/docx\-preview 配对，并调用 previewToDOM。

## 部署与要求

- 可在现代浏览器和 Node\.js 中运行。
- 仅提供 ESM 并附带 \.d\.ts 类型。
- 没有仅限 Node 的依赖，可在浏览器中运行，包括使用 Blob 和 File API。
- 一个运行时依赖：用于 ZIP 处理的 fflate。
- @office\-kit/docx\-preview 封装了开源 docx\-preview 渲染器，并在浏览器中运行。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Office Kit's @office\-kit/pptx is a TypeScript library for reading, editing, and writing \.pptx presentation files\. It runs in Node\.js and the browser from a single ESM bundle, and preserves unknown parts like SmartArt and OLE objects on round\-trip\. The library validates output with Open XML SDK and ECMA\-376 schemas\.

## Key Features

- Read, edit, and write \.pptx files in Node\.js and the browser from a single ESM bundle\.
- Preserves unknown parts such as SmartArt, OLE objects, video, and vendor extensions on round\-trip\.
- Validates output against Open XML SDK's OpenXmlValidator and ECMA\-376 schemas in CI\.
- Supports all 16 ECMA\-376 chart plot types, shapes, tables, pictures, text, and review features\.
- Tree\-shakeable free\-function API with side\-effect\-free exports; only one runtime dependency (fflate)\.

## Use Cases

- Filling a designer\-made \.pptx template with data via token replacement or placeholder editing\.
- Editing an existing presentation from Keynote, Google Slides, or other apps and saving it back\.
- Auditing a deck: listing layouts, finding hyperlinks, or checking for empty titles\.
- Creating slides with AI using Claude Code or Codex through TSX authoring and live preview\.

## Getting Started

- Install with npm install @office\-kit/pptx\. To edit a template, load the file with loadPresentation, modify it, and save with savePresentation\. For AI\-assisted authoring, run npx \-\-yes @office\-kit/pptx\-dev@latest init my\-slides to create a project with a live preview; Node\.js

## Deployment & Requirements

- The library runs in Node\.js and modern browsers with no native modules\. The AI authoring workflow requires Node\.js 22\.18 or later and Git alongside Claude Code\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Office Kit's xlsx library reads, edits, and writes Excel \.xlsx workbooks from TypeScript in Node 22\+ and modern browsers\. It offers typed cell values, styles, formulas, charts, streaming, and byte\-for\-byte preservation of features it does not model\.

## Key Features

- Typed reading and writing for \.xlsx workbooks from bytes, files, Blob, or fetch responses, with cell values modeled as a discriminated union\.
- Write support for styles, number formats, formulas with cached values, Excel tables, data validation, conditional formatting, images, charts, and chartsheets\.
- Streaming reader and append\-only writer for large sheets, with bounded row buffering and shared\-string limits\.
- Round\-trip preservation of unmodeled parts including pivot tables, VBA projects, threaded comments, external links, and custom XML\.
- CI validation of generated OOXML against ECMA\-376 schemas plus semantic invariants\.
- Subpath imports with tree\-shakable ESM exports and no root barrel\.

## Use Cases

- Programmatically edit existing Excel reports or templates while keeping pivot tables, macros, and other unmodeled parts intact\.
- Generate large \.xlsx files with streaming writes to keep memory bounded\.
- Create typed Excel workbooks with formatting, charts, images, validation, and conditional formatting from TypeScript\.
- Read and validate uploaded \.xlsx files in Node services or browser applications with typed cell values and error classes\.

## Getting Started

- Install with pnpm add @office\-kit/xlsx or use npm, yarn, or bun\.
- Requires Node 22 or later; the package is ESM\-only and has no root barrel\.
- Load a workbook with loadWorkbook, edit cells with setCell, then save with workbookToBytes or saveWorkbook\.
- For large sheets, use createWriteOnlyWorkbook, append rows, then finalize\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node 22 or later is required; Node 18 and 20 EOL are not supported\.
- Runs in Node and modern browsers; only the @office\-kit/xlsx/node subpath touches fs, while the rest uses Web Streams, Blob, and Uint8Array\.
- The package is ESM\-only and its shipped types resolve under node16, nodenext, and bundler module resolution\.
- The full load and save path must stay under 120 KB minified and brotli\-compressed, and the streaming entry under 80 KB\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is pre\-1\.0 alpha, so APIs may shift before 1\.0; pin the version for long\-running projects\.
- Node 22 or later is required; Node 18 and 20 are EOL and not supported\.
- Only \.xlsx is supported; \.xls, \.xlsb, \.ods, and \.csv are out of scope\.
- The library has two runtime dependencies: fflate for ZIP and saxes for streaming XML\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Ollama is a tool for running open\-source large language models locally\. It supports a variety of models including Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt\-oss, Qwen, and Gemma\. With a simple CLI and REST API, you can download, run, and manage models on your own machine\.

## Key Features

- Supports a wide range of open models including Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt\-oss, Qwen, and Gemma\.
- Provides a simple CLI to run and chat with models\.
- Offers a REST API for programmatic access\.
- Includes official libraries for Python and JavaScript\.
- Available on macOS, Windows, Linux, and via Docker\.
- Can launch integrations with coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and more\.

## Use Cases

- Coding: Use Ollama to run local models for code assistance with integrations like Claude Code and Codex\.
- AI assistant: Turn Ollama into a personal AI assistant across messaging platforms using OpenClaw\.
- Chat with models: Run and chat with models like Gemma 4 directly from the terminal\.
- REST API: Integrate Ollama into applications via its REST API for chat and model management\.

## Getting Started

- Install Ollama on macOS, Windows, or Linux using the provided install scripts, or download the installer\. For Docker, use the official image\. After installation, run 'ollama' to get started, then use 'ollama run \<model\>' to chat with a model\. See the quickstart guide for more

## Deployment & Requirements

- Ollama can be deployed on macOS, Windows, Linux, or via Docker\. It requires a compatible system with sufficient resources to run models locally\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Ollama JavaScript Library is the official JavaScript client for Ollama, designed around the Ollama REST API\. It exposes methods such as chat, generate, pull, push, create, delete, copy, list, show, embed, webSearch, webFetch, ps, version, abort, and systemone\. It works in Node and the browser and supports streaming responses, cloud models, custom hosts and headers, and structured output\.

## Key Features

- Chat and generation APIs accept model names and message arrays and return assistant responses\.
- Streaming responses return an AsyncGenerator when stream is set to true\.
- Works in Node and browser, with browser usage available through the ollama/browser module\.
- Cloud model support offloads larger models while keeping the local workflow, and direct ollama\.com API access is available with an API key\.
- Supports images, tool names, structured JSON output, thinking levels, log probabilities, and keep\_alive controls\.
- Includes model management methods such as pull, push, create, delete, copy, list, show, embed, ps, version, and abort\.

## Use Cases

- Integrating JavaScript applications with locally running Ollama models\.
- Streaming model output to a CLI or web client as chunks arrive\.
- Using larger cloud\-hosted models from the same JavaScript client without rewriting code\.
- Building browser\-based frontends that call Ollama through ollama/browser\.

## Getting Started

projects.content:
## Overview

The Ollama Python Library is the official Python client for Ollama\. It wraps the Ollama REST API in idiomatic Python, with synchronous and asynchronous clients, typed chat responses, streaming, custom hosts and headers, and access to local or cloud models from Python 3\.8 and up\.

## Key Features

- Typed chat responses can be read like a dict or through attribute access\.
- Streaming responses are enabled with stream=True in sync calls and as an async generator with AsyncClient\.
- Client and AsyncClient support the same configuration fields for sync or async codebases\.
- Local and cloud models share the same client\.chat interface, with direct cloud access to Ollama's hosted API using an API key\.
- Custom clients can set host and headers, and extra keyword arguments pass through to httpx\.Client\.
- API coverage includes chat, generate, list, show, create, copy, delete, pull, push, embed, ps, and systemone\.

## Use Cases

- Build Python scripts or applications that chat with models served by a local Ollama instance\.
- Add streaming chat to synchronous or asynchronous Python services\.
- Prototype against local models and move to larger cloud models using the same chat interface\.
- Access Ollama cloud models directly with an API key when no local server should sit in the middle\.

## Getting Started

- Install and run Ollama, then pull a model such as gemma4 with ollama pull gemma4\.
- Install the library with pip install ollama\.
- Import chat from ollama, pass a model and a list of messages, and print response\['message'\]\['content'\] or response\.message\.content\.
- For streaming, set stream=True and iterate over chunks; for async, use AsyncClient and await the call\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.8 or later\.
- Ollama installed and running for local use\.
- A model pulled for use with the library, for example with ollama pull gemma4\.
- For the direct cloud API, set OLLAMA\_API\_KEY and point Client at the Ollama cloud host with an authorization header\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Local use requires Ollama to be installed and running, and a model pulled\.
- Direct cloud API access requires setting the OLLAMA\_API\_KEY environment variable\.
- System One confidence scores indicate probability concentration, not calibrated correctness\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Omnara is an open\-source managed agent platform for running AI agents in production\. It provides an API that handles execution and state while letting teams choose models, tools, machines, and how users interact with each agent\. It is available through Omnara Cloud or as a self\-hosted deployment\.

## Key Features

- Durable agents store state in a durable event log, can run indefinitely, and use no compute while idle\.
- Run agents on managed sandboxes, bring your own Blaxel, Daytona, or Unikraft Cloud account, or install the Omnara daemon on a laptop, VM, or container; the daemon connects outbound\.
- Access controls include human approval for risky tool calls, encrypted scoped secrets, role\-based access for people and API keys, and an append\-only audit history\.
- Agent\-ready APIs include a REST API, TypeScript SDK, and CLI for launching, steering, and observing agents and for changing their config mid\-conversation without redeploying\.
- Model\-agnostic support includes OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, Amazon Bedrock, Ollama, and compatible endpoints, including self\-hosted models\.
- Integrations connect MCP servers and reusable skills and let teams talk to agents through first\-party Slack, Discord, and GitHub integrations\.

## Use Cases

- Agents embedded in a product dashboard\.
- Internal Slack agents for a team\.
- Specialized agent workflows such as code review, SRE investigation, browser operations, and video generation\.
- Interactive CLI experiences\.

## Getting Started

- Sign in to Omnara Cloud; the first project includes a model provider and a default sandbox pool\.
- Save an agent configuration as agent\.yaml and launch it with the Omnara CLI; Node\.js 22 or newer is required\.
- Chat with the agent in the terminal using npx omnara agents chat \<agent\-id\>, or open it in the dashboard to watch tool calls and reply\.
- For programmatic use, create an API key, export it as OMNARA\_TOKEN, install @omnara/sdk, and use the org and project IDs printed by npx omnara config\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Self\-hosting requires Docker with Compose\.
- Start the app profile with docker compose \-f compose\.yaml \-\-profile app up \-d from a cloned repository\.
- A new self\-hosted instance has no models or machines; add a model provider and model, connect a computer under Machines, and share both with the project\.
- Sandboxes require the self\-hosted instance to have a public URL\.
- Local defaults are intentionally insecure; real deployments should follow the self\-hosting and configuration documentation\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Self\-hosted local defaults are intentionally insecure and should not be used as\-is for a real deployment\.
- A new self\-hosted instance starts without any models or machines, so these must be added before agents can run\.
- Managed agent platforms can lock models, machines, cloud, data, and pricing to one vendor\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Omnigent is an open\-source meta\-harness that provides a common orchestration layer over AI agent harnesses like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Pi, as well as custom agents\. It enables swapping or combining harnesses without rewriting code, enforces policies and sandboxing, and supports real\-time collaboration on live sessions from any device\.

## Key Features

- Built\-in multi\-AI agents: Polly (coding orchestrator) and Debby (model debate), plus custom agents defined in YAML\.
- Contextual policies: stateful spend caps, model routing, and risk\-based escalation\.
- Secure OS sandbox: restricts filesystem and network access, hides credentials, enables safe YOLO mode\.
- Composition: combine multiple models, harnesses, and techniques without rewriting code; switch between Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and custom agents with one\-line changes\.
- Collaboration: share live agent sessions via URL with full history, allowing teammates to review, comment, and steer in real time\.
- Cloud sandboxes: run agents in disposable cloud sandboxes from providers like Modal, Daytona, and others\.

## Use Cases

- Orchestrating multiple coding agents (e\.g\., Polly delegating to Claude Code, Codex, Pi) in parallel git worktrees\.
- Running model debates (Debby) to compare answers from different models side by side\.
- Collaborative debugging or investigation with teammates sharing a live session and co\-driving on the same machine\.
- Governing agent actions with policies for cost caps, tool access limits, and approval workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Install with \`curl \-fsSL https://omnigent\.ai/install\.sh \| sh\` or \`uv tool install omnigent\`\. Run \`omnigent\` to start a session, \`omnigent setup\` to configure models, and \`omnigent run examples/polly/\` to try built\-in agents\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Python 3\.12\+; Node\.js 22 LTS and npm/pnpm for coding\-harness CLIs and web UI; tmux for native terminal wrappers; bubblewrap on Linux for sandboxing\. For server deployment, use docker compose or one\-click deploys on Render, Railway, Fly\.io, etc\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Omnigent is in alpha stage and developed openly\.
- Telemetry is collected by default, but can be opted out\.
- Windows support is degraded; some features are unavailable\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OmniRoute is a free and open\-source AI gateway that presents many providers behind a single OpenAI\-compatible endpoint at localhost:20128/v1\. It provides automatic fallback, routing strategies, context compression, local\-first storage, MCP and A2A exposure, and a local dashboard for managing providers, combos, health, costs, and analytics\.

## Key Features

- One OpenAI\-compatible endpoint accepts OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Responses API requests at /v1\.
- Automatic fallback and 19 routing strategies help keep requests moving when a provider is unavailable or out of quota\.
- A 12\-engine compression pipeline reduces eligible context by 15–95%\.
- A local dashboard manages providers, combos, analytics, health, costs, quotas, and resilience controls\.
- A built\-in MCP server exposes 110 tools across 33 scopes, and an A2A server provides 6 skills over JSON\-RPC 2\.0\.
- Self\-hosted, local\-first storage keeps operational data on the host, with encrypted credentials and optional proxy and TLS fingerprint controls\.

## Use Cases

- Use one base URL across coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Copilot, and other OpenAI\-compatible clients\.
- Drain existing subscription or free\-tier quota before routing to paid APIs\.
- Reduce token costs with context compression and cost\-optimized routing\.
- Expose the gateway to MCP clients, A2A networks, or supported cloud coding agents\.

## Getting Started

- Install the omniroute npm package globally with npm install \-g omniroute\.
- Launch the gateway with omniroute; the dashboard and API serve on port 20128\.
- Point an OpenAI\-compatible client at http://localhost:20128/v1; the keyless auto route works on a fresh install\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Deployment options include npm, Docker, a desktop app, ARM devices, Android/Termux, PWA, a VS Code extension, an OpenCode plugin, and building from source\.
- The npm path installs the omniroute package globally; the Android/Termux path uses Node\.js via pkg install nodejs and npx \-y omniroute\.
- Docker deployment uses a multi\-arch AMD64 and ARM64 image\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The comparison is based on a public README and official documentation snapshot, so linked sources should be verified before purchase or deployment decisions\.
- Availability depends on configured upstream providers; when a target is unavailable or out of quota, the gateway selects the next healthy target\.
- In the self\-hosted setup, credentials are stored in local SQLite with AES\-256\-GCM encryption\.

## Overview

omp is a terminal coding agent that ships with the IDE wired in\. It is an agentic harness built on a native Rust core, with tools tuned against real sessions, and it runs natively on macOS, Linux, and Windows without a WSL bridge\. Originally built on Mario Zechner's Pi, omp adds code execution with tool\-calling, LSP awareness, real debugger control, subagents, shared sessions, memory, and more\. It is built by Stencil Labs\.

## Key Features

- Code execution with tool\-calling: persistent Python and a Bun worker can call back into the agent's own tools over a loopback bridge\.
- LSP wired into every write, so renames route through workspace/willRenameFiles and update re\-exports, barrel files, and aliased imports\.
- Real debugger support through DAP, attaching lldb, dlv, or debugpy for breakpoints, stepping, threads, stack, and variables\.
- Time\-traveling stream rules that abort a stream on a regex match, inject the rule as a system reminder, and retry from the same point\.
- First\-class subagents: task fans out into isolated worktrees and returns schema\-validated typed results\.
- Hashline editing by content hash, plus 60\+ providers, 31 built\-in tools, 14 LSP ops, 28 DAP ops, and roughly 80k lines of Rust core\.

## Use Cases

- Driving a full coding session from the terminal, including edits, reads, searches, and shell work\.
- Debugging native, Go, or Python processes from the agent instead of adding print statements\.
- Fanning a job out across parallel subagents and reading back structured, schema\-validated results\.
- Reviewing branches, single commits, or uncommitted work with P0\-P3 priorities and a ship verdict\.

## Getting Started

- macOS and Linux: curl \-fsSL https://omp\.sh/install \| sh
- Homebrew: brew install can1357/tap/omp
- Bun (recommended): bun install \-g @oh\-my\-pi/pi\-coding\-agent
- Windows (PowerShell): irm https://omp\.sh/install\.ps1 \| iex
- Nix: nix run github:can1357/oh\-my\-pi, or nix profile install github:can1357/oh\-my\-pi

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supported platforms are macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- Bun version 1\.3\.14 or newer\.
- On Alpine or musl, install libstdc\+\+ and libgcc first: apk add libstdc\+\+ libgcc

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The prebuilt musl binary links libstdc\+\+ and libgcc dynamically, which stock Alpine does not ship, so those packages must be installed first\.
- Several tools, including github, security\_scan, generate\_image, tts, checkpoint, rewind, and the memory tools, are setting\-gated and off by default\.

- Custom Agents with unique knowledge subsets, custom instructions, and the ability to take actions\.

- Secure Sandbox for code execution and intermediate artifacts in complex workflows\.

- Empower every member with secure access to GenAI and knowledge across the company\.

- Close more deals with instant access to every conversation and product update for sales\.
- Answer questions confidently across your entire product for support teams\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Open Code Review is an AI\-powered code review CLI that originated as Alibaba Group's internal AI code review assistant\. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM through an agent with tool\-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line\-level precision\. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and perform deep reviews\. It also provides ocr scan for reviewing entire files when there is no meaningful diff\.

## Key Features

- Hybrid architecture separating deterministic engineering from LLM agent reasoning for file selection, bundling, rule matching, comment positioning, and scheduling\.
- Precise line\-level comment positioning with a three\-tier progressive LLM strategy and a separate reflection module to intercept hallucinations and knowledge drift\.
- Multi\-model protocol support for Anthropic Messages API, OpenAI Chat Completions API, and OpenAI Responses API, with presets including Anthropic, OpenAI, DashScope, DeepSeek, and Z\.AI, plus custom endpoints\.
- Effort\-driven progressive review with low, medium, and high depth levels that converge when a pass surfaces no new risk\.
- Smart memory compression using three\-tier frozen, compress, and active context management for deep review\.
- Built\-in review rules covering 40\+ languages and file types, including checks for NPE, thread safety, XSS, and SQL injection\.

## Use Cases

- Individual developers embedding code review into local AI\-assisted development workflows for instant feedback\.
- Platform teams integrating the tool into internal systems with control over data flow and review policies\.
- ML researchers using it as a code quality verifier in RL training pipelines to provide reward signals for code generation models\.
- Auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories through full\-file scan when there is no meaningful diff\.

## Getting Started

- Install globally with npm i \-g @alibaba\-group/open\-code\-review\.
- Verify installation with ocr version\.
- Configure a provider and model with ocr config provider and ocr config model, or use Delegation Mode\.
- Run ocr review for workspace, branch\-range, or commit reviews, or ocr scan for full\-file review\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Git 2\.41 or newer is required\.
- An LLM must be configured before reviewing code unless Delegation Mode is used\.
- The CLI is installed globally via npm\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The tool depends on Git for diff generation, code search, and repository operations\.
- The project explicitly notes lower recall than general\-purpose agents as a trade\-off favoring precision over noise\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Open CoDesign is an MIT\-licensed desktop application for AI\-assisted design\. It turns a prompt into a polished prototype, slide deck, or marketing asset using the model provider you choose, while keeping designs, prompts, and settings on local disk\. Version 0\.2\.0 introduces Agentic Design with workspace\-backed sessions, permissioned local tools, lazy skills, and DESIGN\.md design systems\.

## Key Features

- Bring your own model: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, local Ollama, ChatGPT subscription login, or an OpenAI\-compatible relay\.
- Local\-first workspace: designs, prompts, and settings stay on disk, with sessions stored in JSONL and generated sources kept in real workspace files\.
- Agentic Design in v0\.2: each design is a long\-running session with a real workspace where the agent can read, edit, run permissioned tools, and preview its work\.
- Twelve built\-in design skill modules plus project\-level SKILL\.md support, with DESIGN\.md storing brand values and design tokens\.
- Region\-level comments, AI\-tuned sliders, instant switching among recent designs, and responsive desktop, tablet, and phone previews\.
- On\-device exports to HTML, PDF via local Chrome, PPTX, ZIP, and Markdown\.

## Use Cases

- Generate landing pages, dashboards, pricing pages, pitch slides, mobile app screens, chat UIs, calendars, blog articles, receipts, portfolios, and email designs from prompts\.
- Refine generated artifacts through inline comments and AI\-emitted sliders, then export to HTML, PDF, PPTX, ZIP, or Markdown\.
- Prototype connected local app journeys with navigation, shared records, validation, empty states, and success states\.
- Use a preferred API provider, ChatGPT subscription, or local Ollama for local\-first design work without subscription lock\-in\.

## Getting Started

- Install via Homebrew Cask on macOS, Scoop on Windows, or direct downloads for macOS, Windows, and Linux from GitHub releases\.
- On first launch, add a provider by signing in with ChatGPT, pasting an API key, or selecting local or keyless Ollama or an OpenAI\-compatible gateway\.
- Pick one of fifteen built\-in demos or describe your own prompt; a sandboxed prototype appears in seconds\.
- Refine with comments, sliders, and local files, then export the result\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on macOS 12\+ (Monterey or later), Windows 10\+, or Linux with glibc 2\.31 or later\.
- Requires one API key, ChatGPT subscription sign\-in, or local Ollama\.
- PDF export uses your local Chrome\.
- Credentials are stored in ~/\.config/open\-codesign/config\.toml and the ChatGPT OAuth token store under the app config directory\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Installers are not notarized or Authenticode\-signed yet, so macOS and Windows may show security warnings\.
- PDF export depends on the local Chrome installation\.
- No account is mandatory and telemetry is off by default\.
- Generated artifacts are interactive prototypes, not production services; data and service actions are simulated and state may reset on reload\.

projects.content:
## Overview

open\-computer\-use is an open\-source Computer Use service wrapped as MCP\. Any AI agent or MCP client can use it to run Computer Use on macOS, Linux, and Windows\. The project was inspired by OpenAI's Codex Computer Use and builds on Accessibility for non\-intrusive CUA\.

## Key Features

- Open\-source Computer Use service exposed as an MCP server for AI agents and MCP clients\.
- Runs Computer Use across macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- Inspired by Codex Computer Use and built on Accessibility for non\-intrusive CUA\.
- The npm package provides open\-computer\-use and the short ocu CLI alias\.
- Built\-in installers support Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, opencode, and DeepSeek Harness MCP setups\.
- Includes ocu js for one\-off JavaScript evaluation and ocu repl for a persistent interactive session\.

## Use Cases

- Connect an AI agent or MCP client to run Computer Use actions on desktop applications\.
- Install into Codex App, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, opencode, or DeepSeek Harness for agent\-driven desktop automation\.
- Use ocu js or ocu repl to script JavaScript automation with cua bindings\.
- On macOS, find controls by text or role without taking a screenshot using targeted query\.

## Getting Started

- Install globally with npm i \-g open\-computer\-use\.
- On macOS, run open\-computer\-use or ocu once, then grant Accessibility and Screen Recording\.
- Install into Codex with open\-computer\-use install\-codex\-mcp, or add the MCP server manually with command open\-computer\-use and args mcp\.
- Install the skill with npx skills add iFurySt/open\-computer\-use \-g \-a codex \-\-skill open\-computer\-use \-y\.
- Run open\-computer\-use doctor to check permissions\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS runtime requires macOS 14\.0 or later\.
- The npm launcher requires Node\.js 18 or newer\.
- macOS requires Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions; Windows and Linux do not need this step\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The macOS runtime has a minimum OS requirement of macOS 14\.0\.
- The npm launcher depends on Node\.js 18 or newer\.
- Windows and Linux do not require the macOS permission step\.
- Missing permissions can still exit with code 0, so permission status needs separate verification\.
- Permission diagnostics do not prove an operation succeeded, and permission changes may require a process restart\.

## 项目简介

open\-computer\-use 是一个以 MCP 封装的开源 Computer Use 服务。任意 AI 代理或 MCP 客户端都可以用它来在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上运行 Computer Use。项目受 OpenAI 的 Codex Computer Use 启发，并基于 Accessibility 构建非侵入式 CUA。

## 核心功能

- 开源 Computer Use 服务以 MCP 服务器形式提供给 AI 代理和 MCP 客户端；可在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上运行 Computer Use；受 Codex Computer Use 启发，并基于 Accessibility 实现非侵入式 CUA；npm 包提供 open\-computer\-use 以及短 CLI 别名 ocu；内置安装器支持 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、opencode 和 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 配置；包含用于一次性 JavaScript

## 快速开始

- 全局安装：npm i \-g open\-computer\-use。在 macOS 上先运行 open\-computer\-use 或 ocu 一次，然后授予辅助功能与屏幕录制权限。安装到 Codex：open\-computer\-use install\-codex\-mcp；也可手动添加 MCP 服务器，命令为 open\-computer\-use，参数为 mcp。安装 skill：npx skills add iFurySt/open\-computer\-use \-g \-a codex \-\-skill open\-computer\-use \-y。运行

## 部署与要求

projects.descriptionZh: Open Duet 是开源、可自托管的 AI 同事工作区，也是 Claude Duet 等付费 AI 代理产品的替代方案。它为具名代理提供指令、记忆、例行任务和独立隔离计算机，并在执行高风险操作前请求你批准，数据与凭据保留在自己的机器或服务器上。
projects.content:
## Overview

Open Duet is an open\-source, self\-hosted workspace for named AI coworkers\. Each agent can have a job, instructions, memory, a workspace and isolated computer, schedules, and a human approval step before risky actions\. Users interact through a browser, desktop app, or Telegram, while data and credentials stay on their own machine or server\. It is positioned as an alternative to Claude Duet and other paid AI agent products, but not yet a feature\-for\-feature replacement\.

## Key Features

- Named agents with a title, instructions, engine and model, workspace folder, approval mode, and exportable/importable agent files\.
- Per\-agent memory notes that load into conversations, with recall across conversations and undo\.
- Routines using cron, weekday, interval, one\-off, and webhook schedules with timezones, run history, missed\-run tracking, restart recovery, and in\-app notifications; routines never approve by themselves\.
- Approval modes including ask\-first, accept\-edits, and plan, with saved rules, decision log, safety floor, and Allow/Deny for risky actions\.
- Optional isolated Docker container as the agent's own computer so commands and file edits run there, not on the host machine; labeled experimental\.
- Multiple engines including Claude, Codex, Agent Client Protocol CLIs, and OpenAI\-compatible endpoints, with limit\-aware fallback; web, desktop, and Telegram channels share one API\.

## Use Cases

- Individuals and small teams that want self\-hosted AI coworkers while keeping data and credentials under their own control\.
- Recurring research, reporting, support triage, or other delegated work handled through named agents and scheduled routines\.
- Agents that need to read or write files or run commands in an isolated container, with human approval before risky actions\.
- Access to agents and routines from a browser, desktop app, or Telegram, including phone access to server\-hosted agents\.

## Getting Started

- For the desktop app, clone the repository, change into the desktop folder, and run npm run app; it performs first\-time setup, builds when needed, and opens Open Duet using local SQLite and OS secret storage\.
- On a server, use python \-m app\.server, the Docker image and compose file, doctor, backup, and restore, following the self\-hosting guidance; engines must be signed in on the server\.
- For development, run scripts/dev\.sh from the repository root to prepare configuration, start PostgreSQL through Docker when selected, install dependencies, run migrations, and start FastAPI, the optional Telegram bot, and the web UI\.
- Before creating or chatting with agents, confirm that at least one signed\-in engine is ready in Settings\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- At least one ready engine: a signed\-in Claude Code or Codex CLI, an Agent Client Protocol CLI, or an OpenAI\-compatible endpoint\.
- Desktop app: Node\.js 22\+, uv, and local SQLite; no \.env file is required, and its encryption key is kept in the operating system's secret storage\.
- Server: Linux, a domain, Docker or Node\.js and uv, a signed\-in engine on the server, and HTTPS through nginx or Caddy; authentication is single\-owner\.
- Development setup: uv, Node\.js 20\.9\+ and npm, Docker for PostgreSQL unless using experimental SQLite, and Bash for scripts/dev\.sh; Boat and Telegram are optional and need their own credentials\.
- Agents require LOCAL\_EXECUTION\_ENABLED=true on server or development setups; file edits and commands also require LOCAL\_TOOLS\_ENABLED=true and still ask for approval\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Open Duet is in active development, so evaluate the known limitations before running it for other people\.
- The project is positioned as an alternative to paid AI agent products but is not yet a feature\-for\-feature replacement\.
- Rooms and teams are not built, so those collaboration features should not be assumed\.
- Authentication is single\-owner: one passphrase per install plus paired devices, so use HTTPS beyond a trusted private network\.
- Desktop installers are unsigned, and macOS and Linux have not been run, so those builds should be treated cautiously\.

## 项目简介

Open Duet 是开源、可自托管的具名 AI 同事工作区。每个代理可以拥有岗位、指令、记忆、工作区和隔离计算机、日程安排，以及在高风险操作前等待人工批准的步骤。用户可通过浏览器、桌面应用或 Telegram 与代理交互，数据和凭据保留在自己的机器或服务器上。它被定位为 Claude Duet 及其他付费 AI 代理产品的替代方案，但尚不是这些产品的功能对等功能替代品。

## 核心功能

- 具名代理带有标题、指令、引擎和模型、工作区文件夹、审批模式和备注，并可导出和导入为可移植文件。
- 每个代理保存记忆备注，这些备注会载入对话，支持跨对话回忆和撤销。
- 例行任务支持 cron、工作日、间隔、一次性及 webhook 日程，并带时区、运行历史、错过运行跟踪、重启恢复和应用内通知；例行任务不会自行批准操作。
- 审批模式包括先询问、接受编辑和计划，并提供保存的规则、决策日志、安全底线，以及对高风险操作的允许或拒绝。
- 可选地为代理提供隔离的 Docker 容器作为其自己的计算机，使其命令和文件编辑在该容器中运行，而不是在主机上运行；该功能标记为实验性。
- 支持 Claude、Codex、Agent Client Protocol CLI 和 OpenAI 兼容端点等多种引擎，并具备限额感知回退；网页、桌面应用和 Telegram 机器人共用一个 API。

## 适用场景

- 希望自托管 AI 同事、同时将数据和凭据控制在自己手中的个人和小团队。
- 通过具名代理和计划例行任务处理重复性的研究、报告、支持分流或其他委托工作。
- 需要代理在隔离容器中读写文件或运行命令，并在高风险操作前获得人工批准的场景。
- 从浏览器、桌面应用或 Telegram 访问代理和例行任务，包括通过手机访问服务器上托管的代理。

## 快速开始

- 桌面应用：克隆仓库，进入 desktop 文件夹并运行 npm run app；它会完成首次设置、在需要时构建并打开 Open Duet，使用本地 SQLite 和操作系统密钥存储。
- 服务器：使用 python \-m app\.server、Docker 镜像和 compose 文件、doctor、backup 和 restore，并遵循自托管指南；引擎必须在服务器上登录。
- 开发环境：从仓库根目录运行 scripts/dev\.sh，准备配置，在选择 PostgreSQL 时通过 Docker 启动它，安装依赖，运行迁移，并启动 FastAPI、可选的 Telegram 机器人和网页界面。
- 创建或与代理聊天前，请在设置中确认至少一个已登录引擎已就绪。

## 部署与要求

- 至少一个就绪引擎：已登录的 Claude Code 或 Codex CLI、Agent Client Protocol CLI，或 OpenAI 兼容端点。
- 桌面应用：Node\.js 22 及以上、uv 和本地 SQLite；无需 \.env 文件，加密密钥保存在操作系统的密钥存储中。
- 服务器：Linux、域名、Docker 或 Node\.js 与 uv、服务器上已登录的引擎，以及通过 nginx 或 Caddy 提供的 HTTPS；认证为单所有者模式。
- 开发环境：uv、Node\.js 20\.9 及以上和 npm、用于 PostgreSQL 的 Docker，除非使用实验性 SQLite，以及运行 scripts/dev\.sh 所需的 Bash；Boat 和 Telegram 为可选，并需要各自的凭据。
- 代理在服务器或开发环境中需要 LOCAL\_EXECUTION\_ENABLED=true；文件编辑和命令还需要 LOCAL\_TOOLS\_ENABLED=true，且仍会请求批准。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Open Notebook is an open\-source, AI\-powered note\-taking and research platform that respects your privacy\. It combines AI with privacy controls, designed for researchers, students, and professionals\. It is an open\-source implementation of Notebook LM with more flexibility and features, supporting multi\-model AI, content integration, and podcast generation\.

## Key Features

- Privacy\-first self\-hosted: your data stays under your control with no cloud dependencies\.
- Multi\-model AI support: 18\+ providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio, and more\.
- Multi\-modal content support: PDFs, videos, audio, web pages, Office docs, and more\.
- Professional podcast generation: advanced multi\-speaker podcasts with Episode Profiles\.
- Intelligent search and context\-aware chat: full\-text and vector search across all content, with AI conversations powered by your research\.

## Use Cases

- Research and knowledge management for researchers and professionals\.
- Learning and note\-taking for students and self\-taught learners\.
- Generating podcasts from notes for engaging content creation\.

## Getting Started

- Quick start with Docker: download docker\-compose\.yml, set your encryption key, start services with docker compose up \-d, then configure your AI provider in the UI\. See the README for full instructions\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Docker Desktop and docker\-compose\. Uses SurrealDB as the database\. Can be deployed locally, in the cloud, or on\-premises\. Supports optional password protection for public deployments\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The encryption key must be changed from the default placeholder to secure API keys\.
- Citations are currently basic and will improve in future releases\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Open Ontologies is a Rust engine for production ontology change management\. It plans and applies changes with a blast radius report, reasons over OWL and RDFS, and produces derivation certificates that a separate Lean 4 checker can verify\. Tesseract Semantics describes a hosted platform built on the engine and positions it for enterprise data interoperability\.

## Key Features

- Change management for production ontologies: plan, blast radius, risk score, locked IRIs, apply, monitor, drift, and rollback\.
- Reason over OWL and RDFS, producing materialised inferences and a derivation certificate accepted by a proved Lean 4 checker\.
- Validate against SHACL with a reported measurement against the W3C suite\.
- Evaluate SWRL, RIF Core, or Horn rules and return a verdict word that distinguishes supplied rules from standard rules\.
- Load CSV, JSON, XML, YAML, XLSX, Parquet, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB into RDF\.
- Provide an MCP server so Claude or Cursor can operate the engine in conversation\.

## Use Cases

- Reviewing the consequences of an ontology change before it reaches production\.
- Giving auditors or reviewers a certificate they can re\-check independently\.
- Preparing ontology slices for RAG while tracking entailment preservation per claim\.
- Checking ontology satisfiability or inconsistency and validating data against SHACL\.

## Getting Started

- Build the Lean checkers from the lean directory with lake build; the build uses core Lean 4 and no Mathlib\.
- Run lake exe oo\-horn check with built\-in rules, asserted triples, and a conclusion file to verify entailment or refusal\.
- Load a TTL file with open\-ontologies \-\-data\-dir /tmp/oo\-demo/store load coffee\.ttl, then reason with \-\-profile rdfs \-\-certificate \./cert\.
- Re\-check a certificate with lake exe oo\-cert asserted\.tsv derivations\.tsv\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs entirely in your own environment; data never leaves the organisation\.
- Ships as one binary and does not require a JVM or Protégé\.
- The Lean checker builds with core Lean 4 and no Mathlib\.
- A container image is available from GHCR\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The no\-cost evaluation is time\-limited and capped at ten enterprise teams\.
- The tool is not an ontology editor; class hierarchy drawing is left to Protégé\.

## 项目简介

Open Ontologies 是面向生产本体变更管理的 Rust 引擎。它通过影响范围报告来规划并应用变更，支持 OWL 与 RDFS 推理，并生成可由独立 Lean 4 检查器验证的推导证书。Tesseract Semantics 描述了基于该引擎的托管平台，并将其定位为企业数据互操作性方案。

## 核心功能

- 生产本体变更管理：规划、影响范围、风险评分、锁定 IRI、应用、监控、漂移与回滚；对 OWL 和 RDFS 进行推理，产出物化推论以及经已证明的 Lean 4 检查器接受的推导证书；依据 W3C 测试套件报告 SHACL 验证的度量结果；评估 SWRL、RIF Core 或 Horn 规则，并返回区分自定义规则与标准规则的判定词；将 CSV、JSON、XML、YAML、XLSX、Parquet、PostgreSQL 和 DuckDB 加载为 RDF；提供 MCP 服务器，使 Claude 或 Cursor 可在对话中操作引擎。

## 适用场景

- 在生产变更上线前审查本体变更的后果；向审计人员或评审人员提供可独立复核的证书；为 RAG 准备本体切片，同时按声明跟踪蕴涵保持；检查本体可满足性或不一致性，并用 SHACL 验证数据。

## 快速开始

- 在 lean 目录中运行 lake build 构建 Lean 检查器；该构建使用核心 Lean 4，不需要 Mathlib。运行 lake exe oo\-horn check，配合内置规则、断言三元组和结论文件，验证蕴涵或拒绝结果。使用 open\-ontologies \-\-data\-dir /tmp/oo\-demo/store load coffee\.ttl 加载 TTL 文件，然后以 \-\-profile rdfs \-\-certificate \./cert 进行推理。使用 lake exe oo\-cert asserted\.tsv

## 部署与要求

- 完全在自有环境中运行；数据不会离开组织。以单个二进制形式发布，不需要 JVM 或 Protégé。Lean 检查器使用核心 Lean 4 构建，不需要 Mathlib。可从 GHCR 获取容器镜像。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenOrange is an open\-source project from Rivet that runs existing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Rivet Cloud, or your own servers\. It aims to preserve the Cloudflare developer experience, including Wrangler configuration, while removing Cloudflare runtime limits and changing the cost model\. It uses the orange CLI for local development, deployment, and migration, and maps Cloudflare services onto Rivet Actors with SQLite data stored in S3\-backed storage\.

## Key Features

- Runs existing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects without changing app code or Wrangler configuration\.
- Supports deployment on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Rivet Cloud, or self\-hosted and on\-prem servers\.
- Uses the orange CLI for development and deployment, including orange dev, orange login, orange link, and orange deploy\.
- Maps Cloudflare services to Rivet Actors and stores Durable Object SQLite data in S3\-backed storage\.
- Provides zero\-downtime migration for Durable Objects with orange migrate, while D1 migration requires a brief interruption\.

## Use Cases

- Migrate an existing Cloudflare Workers project to AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or your own servers without refactoring\.
- Run Workers and Durable Objects next to your database in a cloud region you choose\.
- Self\-host the platform on any cloud, Hetzner, on\-prem, or air\-gapped infrastructure\.
- Reduce metered compute and storage costs compared with Cloudflare pricing\.

## Getting Started

- Install the orange CLI globally with pnpm add \-g open\-orange\.
- Run orange dev in your Worker project; it reads your Wrangler configuration and serves locally at http://127\.0\.0\.1:8787\.
- Use orange login, orange link \-\-cluster \<name\>, and orange deploy to deploy to a Rivet cluster\.
- Use orange migrate to move Durable Objects and D1 databases from Cloudflare while the app keeps serving, with D1 copying interrupted briefly\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A Worker project with a wrangler\.jsonc, wrangler\.json, or wrangler\.toml file\.
- Node\.js 22 or later and pnpm\.
- Docker is required for deploying\.
- Deployment can target Rivet Cloud, BYOC on AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, or self\-hosted infrastructure\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- D1 migration is not zero\-downtime because Cloudflare does not provide live D1 migration, so requests to a D1 database are interrupted while its data copies\.
- Some Cloudflare bindings are not built yet, and calls to them throw an error naming the binding\.
- Multi\-region support for Durable Objects, including edge regions, is described as an upcoming Rivet update\.

## 项目简介

OpenOrange 是 Rivet 维护的开源项目，可在 AWS、Google Cloud、Azure、Rivet Cloud 或自有服务器上运行现有的 Cloudflare Workers 与 Durable Objects。它保留 Wrangler 配置和 Cloudflare 开发体验，同时解除 Cloudflare 运行时限制并改变成本结构。orange CLI 负责本地开发、部署和迁移；Cloudflare 服务映射为 Rivet Actors，Durable Object 的 SQLite 数据存放在基于 S3 的存储中。

## 核心功能

- 无需修改应用代码或 Wrangler 配置，即可运行现有 Cloudflare Workers 与 Durable Objects。
- 支持部署到 AWS、Google Cloud、Azure、Rivet Cloud，或自托管及本地服务器。
- 使用 orange CLI 进行开发和部署，包括 orange dev、orange login、orange link 与 orange deploy。
- 将 Cloudflare 服务映射为 Rivet Actors，并将 Durable Object 的 SQLite 数据存入基于 S3 的存储。
- 通过 orange migrate 为 Durable Object 提供零停机迁移；D1 迁移会出现短暂中断。

## 适用场景

- 将现有 Cloudflare Workers 项目迁移到 AWS、Google Cloud、Azure 或自有服务器，无需重构。
- 在你选择的云区域中，把 Workers 和 Durable Objects 运行在数据库附近。
- 在任意云、Hetzner、本地或隔离环境中自托管平台。
- 相比 Cloudflare 的计量定价，降低计算和存储成本。

## 快速开始

- 全局安装 orange CLI：pnpm add \-g open\-orange。
- 在 Worker 项目中运行 orange dev；它会读取 Wrangler 配置，并在本地 127\.0\.0\.1:8787 提供服务。
- 使用 orange login、orange link \-\-cluster 集群名 和 orange deploy 部署到 Rivet 集群。
- 使用 orange migrate 在应用继续服务时迁移 Durable Objects 和 D1 数据库；D1 复制期间会短暂中断。

## 部署与要求

- 需要包含 wrangler\.jsonc、wrangler\.json 或 wrangler\.toml 的 Worker 项目。
- 需要 Node\.js 22 或更高版本，以及 pnpm。
- 部署需要 Docker。

## Use Cases

- Self\-hosted AI chat interface for local and cloud models\.
- Team collaboration with role\-based access and shared channels\.
- Enterprise deployment with SSO, SCIM, and production observability\.
- Building custom agents with plugins, tools, and persistent memory\.

## Getting Started

- Install via pip: pip install open\-webui, then run open\-webui serve\. For Docker, use: docker run \-d \-p 3000:8080 \-v open\-webui:/app/backend/data \-\-name open\-webui \-\-restart always ghcr\.io/open\-webui/open\-webui:main\. Access at http://localhost:3000 (or localhost:8080 with
