projects.content:
## Overview

OpenAgent is an open\-source, self\-hostable personal AI assistant that combines LLMs, a RAG knowledge base, and autonomous agent loops in a single\-binary platform\. It supports MCP tools, 30\+ model providers, and multi\-channel messaging including Telegram, Discord, and WeCom\.

## Key Features

- Single\-binary deployment: download and run natively on Windows, macOS, or Linux without an installer, Docker, or WSL\.
- Full MCP support lets agents use tools, call APIs, and reason across multi\-step workflows with persistent memory\.
- Unified access to 30\+ model providers, including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, and Ollama\.
- RAG knowledge base ingests documents and retrieves context via vector search with pluggable embeddings and isolated stores\.
- Multi\-channel gateway deploys one agent across Telegram, Discord, and WeCom simultaneously\.
- Admin dashboard provides usage statistics, activity monitoring, tool management, and request logs\.

## Use Cases

- Build a self\-hosted personal assistant that can browse the web, run shell commands, and call MCP\-compatible tools\.
- Create a RAG knowledge base from PDFs, Word documents, and spreadsheets for semantic search and context\-aware answers\.
- Deploy a single agent across Telegram, Discord, and WeCom for multi\-platform chat access\.
- Automate multi\-step workflows with a visual BPMN\-style builder, conditional and parallel execution, and scheduling\.

## Getting Started

- Run the provided installer for macOS, Linux, or WSL, or the PowerShell installer for Windows\.
- Open the local dashboard on port 14000 after installation\.
- Alternatively, use Docker Compose or build from source with Go 1\.25\.0\+ and Node\.js 20\+ with Yarn 1\.x\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Pre\-built binaries are available for Linux, macOS, and Windows on x86\_64 and arm64\.
- Windows runs natively without WSL or Docker\.
- Docker deployment is available via docker\-compose up\.
- Building from source requires Go 1\.25\.0\+ for the backend and Node\.js 20\+ with Yarn 1\.x for the frontend\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Self\-hosting keeps data on the user's machine, which is relevant for privacy\-sensitive deployments\.
- The public playground resets data every five minutes, so it is not intended for persistent work\.

projects.content:
## Overview

The OpenAI Agents SDK is a production\-ready upgrade of Swarm, OpenAI's previous experimentation for agents\. It is a lightweight, Python\-first framework for building agentic AI apps with very few abstractions, including agents, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, tracing, and sandbox, realtime, and voice agent capabilities\.

## Key Features

- Agents configured with instructions, tools, guardrails, and handoffs, with a built\-in loop that continues until the task is complete\.
- Agents as tools and handoffs for delegating work across multiple agents\.
- Guardrails for input and output validation that run in parallel with agent execution\.
- Function tools, MCP server tool calling, hosted tools, and automatic schema generation with Pydantic\-powered validation\.
- Sandbox agents, realtime agents, and voice pipelines for isolated workspaces, low\-latency voice, and speech\-to\-text/agent/text\-to\-speech workflows\.
- Sessions for persistent memory and automatic conversation history, plus built\-in tracing for visualizing, debugging, and monitoring agentic workflows\.

## Use Cases

- Building multi\-agent workflows that coordinate and delegate work across multiple agents\.
- Running coding, review, or document agents inside real isolated sandbox workspaces\.
- Building low\-latency realtime voice agents and speech\-to\-text/agent/text\-to\-speech pipelines\.
- Adding guardrails, sessions, tracing, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls to agentic applications\.

## Getting Started

- Set up a Python environment with Python 3\.10 or newer\.
- Install the package with pip install openai\-agents\.
- Set the OPENAI\_API\_KEY environment variable\.
- Create an Agent with instructions and run it with Runner\.run\_sync\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 or newer is required\.
- Set the OPENAI\_API\_KEY environment variable before running examples\.
- For voice support, install the optional voice group with pip install 'openai\-agents\[voice\]'\.
- For Redis session support, install the optional redis group with pip install 'openai\-agents\[redis\]'\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Requires Python 3\.10 or newer\.
- The library has optional dependencies including websockets, SQLAlchemy, any\-llm, and LiteLLM for additional functionality\.
- External contributions are limited: pull requests are accepted only from repository collaborators\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenBot is an open\-source, fully customizable agent application for employees, running on infrastructure you own\. It is built on AG\-UI and accepts any AG\-UI endpoint as a coworker, with company knowledge, permissions, computer use, and an audit trail in one place\.

## Key Features

- A computer per Bot: each Bot gets its own container, workspace volume, and browser profile\.
- Governed tool and action gateway: every tool call is resolved, evaluated against policy, audited, and only then executed\.
- Company knowledge with real permissions: connects Google Drive and OneDrive; answers cite sources and permissions fail closed\.
- Computer use with human handoff: agents can sign in and drive interfaces while users watch, take control, and hand it back\.
- Bring your own AG\-UI agent: any AG\-UI endpoint can be registered as a Bot, on frameworks such as LangGraph, Mastra, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, or Google ADK\.
- Runs on your infrastructure: data, vectors, permissions, and conversations live in your PostgreSQL; admins supply model credentials, encrypted at rest\.

## Use Cases

- Company knowledge: answers policy and process questions from company documents and names its sources\.
- Warehouse analyst: queries the analytics warehouse and draws the answer rather than describing it\. Read\-only by construction\.
- Desk research: gathers context from the open web and drafts from it, keeping contradictory sources rather than quietly picking one\.
- Tool operator: signs in and works inside tools that have no API worth using, with the screen open so you can watch\.

## Getting Started

- Create \.env by copying \.env\.example and run bun install\.
- Run npx \-\-yes copilotkit@latest login and npx \-\-yes copilotkit@latest project select, then run bun scripts/setup\-learning\.ts\.
- Set OPENAI\_API\_KEY; generate KEY\_ENCRYPTION\_KEY with openssl rand \-base64 32\.
- Run bash scripts/start\.sh and open the app on localhost port 3010\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker, for PostgreSQL and the shipped Bots\.
- Bun 1\.3\+, for the app and API server\.
- A CopilotKit Intelligence project and license; a free plan is available, and Intelligence can be self\-hosted\.
- A model key\. The proof\-of\-concept Bot uses OpenAI; the LangGraph Bot can use OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google\.
- Docker Compose stands up a demo; Helm is the supported path to production\. One Docker image can carry the app, API, browser, and optionally PostgreSQL\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenBot is a template rather than a hosted product, and it is not published as a package to depend on\.
- The project is alpha and under active development\.
- A CopilotKit Intelligence project and license is an external dependency, though a free plan is available and Intelligence can be self\-hosted\.
- Data and conversations are stored in the deployment's PostgreSQL, and nothing is sent to destinations you did not configure\.
- No model is bundled; the built\-in agent remains unavailable until an administrator configures a provider, with no silent fallback\.

## 项目简介

OpenBot 是一个开源、可完全定制的智能体应用，供员工在自有基础设施上使用。它构建于 AG\-UI 之上，可将任何 AG\-UI 端点作为 AI 同事接入，并把公司知识、权限、计算机使用和审计轨迹放在一处。

## 核心功能

- 每个 Bot 拥有自己的计算机：独立容器、工作区卷和浏览器配置文件。

- 在自有基础设施上运行：数据、向量、权限和对话保存在你的 PostgreSQL 中，管理员提供加密存储的模型凭据。

## 适用场景

- 公司知识：根据公司文档回答政策与流程问题，并标明来源。
- 数仓分析：查询分析数仓并画图呈现答案，而不是只做描述；按设计为只读。

- 运行 bash scripts/start\.sh，然后在 localhost 3010 端口打开应用。

## 部署与要求

- Docker，用于 PostgreSQL 和随附的 Bot。

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenBot is a local\-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates\. Each agent has its own workspace, instructions and conversation, and agents can message one another, hand off tasks, share files and collaborate with people in shared channels\. It supports Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Grok, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline and other agents, plus custom OpenAI\-compatible endpoints, ACP agents and local model servers\.

## Key Features

- Persistent agents with independent workspaces, instructions and conversations, plus per\-agent model, reasoning and context settings\.
- Agent\-to\-agent and human collaboration through shared channels, messages, task handoffs, file transfers and approval steps\.
- Support for Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Grok, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline and other providers, plus custom OpenAI\-compatible endpoints, ACP agents and local model servers such as Ollama and LM Studio\.
- Workflows that combine agents, models and approval steps into reusable multi\-step processes\.
- A persistent embedded browser that agents can open, inspect and control, with optional Computer Use on macOS, Windows and Linux\.
- Local\-first storage keeps workspaces, conversations, attachments and browser data on the computer running OpenBot\.

## Use Cases

- Teams can run multiple AI agents with defined roles that review each other’s work, hand off tasks and complete multi\-step projects\.
- Developers can use coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and Cline in persistent workspaces with file sharing and browser access\.
- Teams can invite human teammates into shared channels where people and agents collaborate on the same projects\.
- Users can automate recurring work through workflows that combine agents, models and approval steps, such as weekly reports\.

## Getting Started

- Download OpenBot for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS or Android\.
- Connect a supported provider, such as Codex with a ChatGPT plan, Claude Code with a Claude plan, or Gemini with a Google AI Pro or Ultra plan\.
- Describe the agent you want in one prompt, review its instructions, save it, and send it work; messages wait in a queue until the agent is free\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app requirements: macOS 13 or newer on Apple silicon or Intel, Windows 10 or newer on x64, and Linux on x64 or arm64 as an AppImage\.
- Mobile apps are available for iPhone and Android and connect to your computer\.
- Always\-on server options include a Linux server install script and Docker containers for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64\.
- Remote desktop on Linux requires an X11 session; it does not work under Wayland, and the arm64 AppImage does not include it\.
- On Ubuntu 23\.10 or newer and Debian 13, install the AppArmor profile before launching the AppImage\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Agents can act on the computer without per\-action confirmation, so users should run only trusted tasks and keep backups\.
- OpenBot is local\-first but not offline\-only; the chosen AI provider receives prompt data and opened pages use the network\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenComputer is a background agent cloud for long\-running agents\. Agents are defined like serverless functions in TypeScript, deployed with one command, and run in managed sessions with schedules\. Each session runs on a full Linux VM with shell, filesystem, packages, and network access; sessions are durable, can be steered mid\-run, hibernate when idle, and resume where they left off\.

## Key Features

- Define agents as TypeScript functions with models, tools, and MCP servers\.
- Deploy with one command; every session gets a real computer\.
- Every session runs on a full Linux machine with shell, read\-write filesystem, package managers, and full network egress\.
- Sessions are durable: they stream, can be steered mid\-run, hibernate when idle, and resume where they left off\.
- Managed API keys stay outside the runtime; secrets are bound to one origin and injected after the request leaves the machine\.
- Schedules, managed sessions, streaming, MCP, and Slack are handled\.

## Use Cases

- Build a coding agent that edits a repository, runs checks, and opens a draft PR for review\.
- Use the Workbench example app with a connected GitHub repository\.
- Build a GTM engineer that finds prospects, content ideas, and market opportunities with public evidence, then researches and drafts before taking action\.
- Run scheduled agents, such as a weekday hygiene agent that runs weekdays at 9am and opens cleanup PRs\.

## Getting Started

- Install the CLI with npm i \-g @opencomputer/cli\.
- Sign in with opencomputer login\.
- Create your first agent by describing what you want it to do to your coding agent, or let the coding agent install the CLI, run opencomputer login, and deploy the first agent\.
- Alternatively, run npx @opencomputer/cli init my\-agent, cd my\-agent, npm install, and npx \-\-package @opencomputer/cli opencomputer login\.
- Watch agent code and deploy changes with npm run deploy \-\- \-\-watch\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- An OpenComputer account is required for the first agent template\.
- The Workbench example app requires connecting your GitHub repository\.
- The GTM engineer example requires an Exa key and is for research and drafting only\.
- The CLI uses the default app service unless another service is intentionally targeted with \-\-api\-url or OPENCOMPUTER\_API\_URL\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The TypeScript opencomputer CLI is separate from the legacy Go oc CLI\.
- The GTM engineer example depends on an external Exa key and is limited to research and drafting\.
- The Workbench example depends on connecting a GitHub repository\.
- The first agent template requires an OpenComputer account\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenDesign is an open\-source, local\-first desktop app and a Claude Design alternative\. It makes existing coding agents the design engine for producing design artifacts from briefs\.

## Key Features

- Open\-source and local\-first: native desktop apps for macOS and Windows, with Linux available from source\.
- Agent\-native and model\-agnostic: uses coding\-agent CLIs such as DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and others, or BYOK OpenAI\-compatible endpoints\.
- Produces prototypes, live dashboards and artifacts, decks, mobile apps, documents, images, video, and HyperFrames motion graphics\.
- Sandboxed iframe preview; exports to HTML, PDF, PPTX, MP4, ZIP, or Markdown\.
- Composable plugins, functional skills, design templates, and DESIGN\.md design systems; 151 design systems ship with the repository\.
- MCP server and per\-agent install scripts expose local OpenDesign project files to compatible coding agents\.

## Use Cases

- Generate web, desktop, or mobile prototypes from a brief, plugin, and active design system\.
- Create live dashboards, decision rooms, KPI walls, and data\-rich artifacts\.
- Build decks, pitch presentations, weekly updates, and magazine\-style slides\.
- Generate images and agent\-native motion graphics or video with HyperFrames\.

## Getting Started

- Download the desktop app for macOS or Windows from the official website or GitHub Releases; after install, it auto\-detects coding\-agent CLIs and loads skills, templates, and design systems\.
- Install into a coding agent with od mcp install \<agent\>, or use the hosted install script with sh \-s \<agent\>\.
- Run with Docker: clone the repository, change to open\-design/deploy, copy \.env\.example to \.env, add OD\_API\_TOKEN, run docker compose up \-d, and open port 7456\.
- Run from source: clone the repository, enable corepack, install with pnpm install, and start the web app with pnpm tools\-dev run web\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app supports macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, and Windows x64; no prebuilt Linux artifact is currently published in official releases\.
- Docker deployment uses the deploy directory, an OD\_API\_TOKEN, and Docker Compose; browser access can use open\-design as username and the token as password\.
- Sealos App Store template runs the published Docker image with persistent workspace storage and Basic Auth on the public proxy\.
- Running from source requires Node approximately 24 and pnpm 10\.33\.x\.
- For MCP integration, DeepSeek Harness requires the official dsh CLI first; automatic MCP configuration for Claude Desktop is currently supported on macOS and Windows only\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenDots is an open\-source, self\-hostable alpha template for building always\-on AI coworkers called Dots\. Each Dot has its own role, instructions, permissions, and computer, and can work across text, calls, and Slack\. Spaces provide a home for working documents with a searchable library and visual editor, while CopilotKit human\-in\-the\-loop review cards let users approve or decline saved work\.

## Key Features

- Specialist Dots with roles, instructions, and per\-Dot permissions for browser, files, shell, and memory\.
- Dot computers using OpenBot's container supervisor, with per\-Dot browser profiles, files, shell, takeover, and action records\.
- Spaces and pages with a searchable library, visual editor, slash commands, autosave, revision checks, and Markdown source mode\.
- Conversations across text, realtime calls, and Slack, with thread history and timeline receipts\.
- Human\-in\-the\-loop review before saving drafts, with Approve & save or Decline and retry recovery\.
- Background work with recurring schedules in the original conversation, pause and retry\.

## Use Cases

- Run specialist AI coworkers for research and writing, such as a researcher investigating a topic and a writer turning findings into a draft\.
- Keep project documents in Spaces and pages, with conversations connected to specific pages\.
- Reach Dots through text, voice calls, or Slack and continue the same thread later\.
- Schedule recurring background work and let each Dot run with its own computer and permissions\.

## Getting Started

- Use Node\.js 24 and npm\.
- Clone the OpenDots repository and change into the project directory\.
- Run npm ci to install dependencies\.
- Copy \.env\.example to \.env\.
- Run npm run dev, then open the local development address at port 5173\. You can create Spaces, write pages, and configure Dots before connecting services\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 24 and npm are required\.
- You run the application and configure its services\.
- Calls, Slack, and Dot computers each have their own setup guide\.
- Dot computers require the pinned OpenBot container supervisor and computer service; an unconfigured template does not execute commands on the host\.
- Service credentials stay on the server, and each Dot gets its own computer credential\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenDots is an alpha template rather than a hosted product, so operators run and configure its services themselves\.
- Running OpenDots requires Node\.js 24 and npm, and Calls, Slack, and Dot computers each require separate setup\.
- Service credentials are kept on the server, and each Dot receives a distinct computer credential\.
- Slack and spoken compute delegation still require connected\-service verification\.
- The template is single\-owner and does not include shared editing, invitations, file uploads, or interactive page embeds\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenDuet is a template for a proactive AI agent built on OpenBot and CopilotKit\. It starts with a morning brief, keeps working in its own browser, workspace, and shell while the user is away, and pauses for approval before sending, paying, signing, or deleting anything\. It is designed to be copied and customized, with its name, Bots, channels, model, and skills kept in one folder\.

## Key Features

- A morning brief summarizes what needs attention, what can wait, and today's calendar\.
- Each agent runs on its own computer with Chromium, a workspace, a browser profile, and a shell\.
- Approval gates pause actions that send, pay, sign, or delete, with Allow once, Always allow, and Refuse\.
- Passwords are entered through a masked box, and saved credentials are encrypted and write\-only\.
- Gmail and Google Calendar can be connected per person for mail reading and calendar\-aware briefs\.
- Skills and scheduled routines let users reuse instructions and run tasks on a schedule\.

## Use Cases

- Starting the day with a short brief that separates what needs a decision from what can wait\.
- Delegating a longer task that continues in its own browser and workspace while the user is away\.
- Connecting Gmail and Google Calendar so the agent can read mail and today's calendar\.
- Running scheduled routines that execute work as the user\.

## Getting Started

- Install Docker, Bun 1\.3 or newer, Node for npx, and have a model key plus a CopilotKit Intelligence project\.
- Clone the repository, copy \.env\.example to \.env, and run bun install\.
- Sign in with the CopilotKit CLI, select an Intelligence project, and run bun openbot/scripts/setup\-learning\.ts\.
- Set OPENAI\_API\_KEY or configure another supported provider and model in \.env\.
- Run bash scripts/start\.sh and open the local app on port 3010\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker, Bun 1\.3 or newer, Node for npx, a model key, and a CopilotKit Intelligence project are required\.
- The server will not start without the CopilotKit Intelligence key; the free Developer plan is enough\.
- Gmail and Google Calendar require a Google OAuth client registered once by an administrator\.
- Voice input requires a speech\-to\-text provider on the server\.
- PostgreSQL plus pgvector stores policy, approvals, audit records, and encrypted credentials\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project labels itself as early and in active development, so users should expect change\.
- CopilotKit Intelligence is an external requirement for threads and memory, and the server cannot start without its key\.
- There is no published hosted or deployment guide and no OpenDuet image yet, so Quick start is the supported route\.
- The runtime sends usage telemetry to CopilotKit unless it is disabled\.
- Gmail and Calendar integration depends on an administrator\-registered Google OAuth client\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenFilm is an open source video agent that turns coding agents into video agents\. A film is a folder of web pages cut together by film\.html; the agent writes it, and Studio lets you edit it\.

## Key Features

- One HTML file, film\.html, cuts animated web pages, footage, pictures, and sound together on tracks styled with CSS\.
- Shots are web pages that draw any moment with frame(t) using browser technologies such as three\.js, WebGL, canvas, SVG, CSS, GSAP, and video\.
- Works with any agent that can run a command, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Windsurf, Cline, Amp, and Devin\.
- Studio is a local browser\-based editor for changing text, layers, clips, timeline placement, look, volume, speed, and subtitles\.
- Renders every frame in parallel up to 4K and exports MP4, GIF, sound or stems, subtitles, stills, slides, transparent video, and timelines for Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve\.
- Local first: films are folders on disk, and making, editing, and rendering require no account\.

## Use Cases

- Video editing: talks and footage cut into highlights, with captions and motion graphics\.
- Music video: every sung word on screen, cut to the beat\.
- Commercial: generated footage with exact type and brand\.
- Social ad: vertical ads with three hooks for one product\.

## Getting Started

- Add the OpenFilm skill to a coding agent with npx skills add openfilm/openfilm, then ask the agent for a film\.
- If the agent has no skills, tell it to run npx \-y openfilm@latest and follow what it prints, or run npx openfilm open in a folder yourself\.
- Download the desktop app for macOS or Windows from the project website or Releases; it includes ffmpeg and the headless browser\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Node 22\.2\+ and ffmpeg on macOS, Windows, or Linux; git is also needed for Studio's saved versions\.
- The first run downloads a headless Chromium of about 100 MB\.
- Studio should be used in a Chromium\-based browser such as Chrome or Edge so the preview matches the export\.
- From source, use Node 22\.18 or later, pnpm 9 via corepack enable, ffmpeg on the PATH, and git\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Generated voice, music, pictures, and video depend on connecting third\-party services with your own keys or signing in to an OpenFilm account\.

## Overview

OpenHands is an AI agent platform for software development that executes real engineering work, not just suggests code\. It runs autonomous agents that plan, write, and apply changes across your codebase, helping teams complete complex tasks end\-to\-end\. Built on an open source foundation, it is designed for enterprise software development at scale\.

## Key Features

- Model\-agnostic: bring your own agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenHands) and any LLM
- Automations triggered from GitHub, Slack, Jira, Linear, schedules, and webhooks
- Self\-hosted or cloud deployment with secure sandboxes and full auditability
- Multi\-backend support: run agents locally, in Docker, on VMs, or in your VPC
- Agent Control Plane for centralized governance of who, what, where, and spend
- Open source core with MIT license and 89\.2K GitHub stars

## Use Cases

- Review pull requests and fix CI failures automatically
- Triage issues and open draft PRs with context
- Automate QA across the release cycle
- Investigate incidents and propose patches

## Getting Started

- Install via npm: npm install \-g @openhands/agent\-canvas
- Run agent\-canvas to start the local stack
- Optionally use Docker sandbox for isolated execution

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 24 or later and uv for local installation
- Docker for sandboxed execution
- Can run on laptop, dedicated machine, or cloud server

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Running without a sandbox gives the agent full access to your filesystem\.
- Self\-hosting ensures your code never leaves your control\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenHuman is a free, open source personal AI for Mac, Windows and Linux\. It keeps data local, builds persistent memory from connected apps, and uses an orchestration engine to manage fleets of agents\. Its core is written in Rust and supports desktop, browser, and terminal clients\.

## Key Features

- Memory engine decides what to keep, compress, and surface when an agent needs context; it can mirror memory as an Obsidian vault\.
- Connects apps through OAuth, MCPs, and Skills, with support for up to 100 apps, 10,000 MCPs, and 90,000 Skills\.
- Workflows engine orchestrates agents for simple or complex automation graphs; the agent proposes workflows for review and save\.
- Runs fleets of agents in one Rust core process, with measured low marginal cost per additional agent\.
- Pluggable engines for LLM, embeddings, memory, and web search, including local models and bring\-your\-own\-key providers\.
- Ships as a desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, plus a browser UI and terminal client\.

## Use Cases

- Use as a personal AI that lives on your laptop and learns from your connected work apps\.
- Orchestrate multiple agents to carry out tasks across tools instead of only replying in chat\.
- Automate workflows with scheduled, app\-event, or manual triggers and approval gates\.
- Build a second brain from connected apps with a local memory graph\.

## Getting Started

- Download installers from the official website or the GitHub Releases page\.
- For terminal installs, use Homebrew, Debian/Ubuntu \.deb, AUR, install scripts, and platform notes; see INSTALL\.md\.
- The desktop app runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux; browser UI and terminal client use the same core\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app supports Windows, macOS, and Linux\.
- The same core can run as a browser SPA or a terminal client\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: GPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is labeled an early beta and under active development\.
- Remote memory engine adapters ship, but a live install cannot yet switch to one through the host binding\.
- The Jev decision model depends on a TinyHumans credential for full behavior and falls back to BM25 without one\.

## 项目简介

OpenHuman 是一款面向 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 的免费开源个人 AI。它让数据保存在本地，从已连接的应用构建持久记忆，并通过内置编排引擎统一管理大量智能体。其核心使用 Rust 编写，同一核心支持桌面应用、浏览器界面和终端客户端。

## 核心功能

- 记忆引擎决定保留什么、如何压缩，以及在智能体需要上下文时呈现什么，并可将记忆镜像为 Obsidian 仓库。通过 OAuth、MCP 和 Skills 连接应用，支持最多 100 个应用、10,000 个 MCP 与 90,000 个 Skills。工作流引擎负责编排智能体，可搭建简单或含多个智能体与步骤的复杂自动化图，由智能体起草工作流供你在画布上审核并保存。可在单个 Rust 核心进程中运行大量智能体，每个新增智能体的边际开销较低。LLM、嵌入、记忆与网络搜索均可按配置插拔，支持本地模型以及自带密钥的多种提供商。以桌面应用形式提供

## 适用场景

- 作为运行在笔记本电脑上的个人 AI，从已连接的工作应用中持续学习。编排多个智能体跨工具执行任务，而不只是在对话中回复。通过定时、应用事件或手动触发，并结合审批门控来自动化工作流。从已连接的应用构建本地记忆图谱，形成第二大脑。

## 快速开始

- 从官方网站或 GitHub Releases 页面下载安装包。终端安装可使用 Homebrew、Debian/Ubuntu 的 \.deb 包、AUR、安装脚本及相应平台说明，参见 INSTALL\.md。桌面应用支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux；浏览器界面与终端客户端使用同一核心。

## 部署与要求

- 桌面应用支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。同一核心也可以作为浏览器单页应用或终端客户端运行。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：GPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenKnowledge is an open\-source, AI\-native markdown editor and knowledge base for humans and agents\. It combines a rich WYSIWYG markdown editing experience with desktop and web apps, optional git/GitHub sync, and built\-in MCP, skills, and agentic search for LLM wikis, second brains, and engineering documentation\.

## Key Features

- Full true WYSIWYG editing so markdown files feel like editing a Google Doc or Notion page\.
- Desktop apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux plus a web UI with file navigator, search, tabs, and graph wiki link viewer\.
- Integrated side\-by\-side AI editing with Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and other harnesses via MCP or CLI\.
- Out\-of\-the\-box MCP, skills, and agentic search for LLM wikis, second brains, and knowledge graphs\.
- No\-code team sharing and auto\-sync powered by git/GitHub\.
- Embeddable HTML and rich components such as callouts, accordions, tabs, Mermaid diagrams, images, and videos\.

## Use Cases

- Build a living knowledge base or wiki for you and your team with skills, docs, and notes in plain markdown\.
- Write engineering specs, PRDs, and roadmaps that live next to code and can be edited by humans and coding agents\.
- Create a shared second brain or agent memory that AI agents can read from and write to across sessions\.
- Maintain runbooks such as oncall guides, incident postmortems, and deployment runbooks\.

## Getting Started

- Download the desktop app for macOS, Windows, or Linux from the official OpenKnowledge download page\.
- For the web app, install the CLI with Node\.js 24\+ and git, then run ok init to scaffold the project and ok start \-\-open to serve the editor\.
- Open any existing folder on your computer that contains markdown or mdx files to begin editing\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app supports macOS Apple Silicon, Windows 10\+ x64/Arm64, and Linux x64/arm64\.
- The web app requires Node\.js 24\+ and git\.
- The app runs locally on your machine and is local\-first, private by design\.
- Git/GitHub based sync and sharing are optional\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: GPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenKnowledge is local\-first and private by design, with the app running on your machine\.
- The project is open source, uses plain files that users own, and is described as self\-hostable\.
- Git/GitHub\-based sync and sharing are optional rather than required\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenMAIC (Open Multi\-Agent Interactive Classroom) is an open\-source AI platform that turns any topic or document into a rich, interactive classroom experience\. Multi\-agent orchestration generates slides, quizzes, interactive simulations, and project\-based learning activities, delivered by AI teachers and AI classmates that can speak, draw on a whiteboard, and discuss in real time\. The built\-in OpenMAIC Skill also works with OpenClaw and agent workbenches such as Codex, DeepSeek, and WorkBuddy, so classrooms can be generated from messaging apps or an IDE\.

## Key Features

- One\-click lesson generation from a topic or attached materials
- Multi\-agent classroom with AI teachers and peers who lecture, discuss, and interact in real time
- Rich scene types including slides, quizzes, interactive HTML simulations, and project\-based learning
- Whiteboard and text\-to\-speech support so agents can draw diagrams, write formulas, and explain aloud
- Export as a PPTX that keeps every scene, an offline HTML lesson, or a classroom ZIP
- Agent workbench integration through the OpenMAIC Skill with OpenClaw, Codex, DeepSeek, WorkBuddy, and more

## Use Cases

- Generate a full lesson from a topic or uploaded document
- Run interactive classroom sessions with AI teachers and AI classmates
- Create project\-based learning activities and interactive simulations
- Generate classrooms from messaging apps or an IDE through agent workbench integration

## Getting Started

- Prerequisites are Node\.js 22\.19 or newer, pnpm 10 or newer, and PostgreSQL 16\. Clone the repository and run pnpm install\. Copy \.env\.example to \.env\.local and openmaic\.example\.yml to openmaic\.yml, then provide OPENAI\_API\_KEY or configure another provider\. Start the database with

## Deployment & Requirements

- OpenMAIC requires PostgreSQL and a DATABASE\_URL; the server refuses to start without one\. From 1\.2\.0 it needs a long\-running Node\.js process with PostgreSQL because course generation runs on the server and survives closed tabs\. Docker Compose runs the app and PostgreSQL as two

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Upgrading to v1\.3\.0 has release conditions: stop all old instances first, and rollback below 1\.3\.0 is not supported\.
- From 1\.2\.0, deployment needs a long\-running Node\.js process with PostgreSQL rather than serverless hosting\.
- If ACCESS\_CODE is unset, the deployment is not gated and every route, including the API, is reachable\.
- Docker Compose runs in single\-user mode, so every browser shares one library\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

OpenMAIC（Open Multi\-Agent Interactive Classroom）是一个开源 AI 平台，可将任意主题或文档转化为丰富的互动课堂体验。它通过多智能体编排生成幻灯片、测验、交互式模拟和项目式学习活动，并由能够发言、在白板上绘图并进行实时讨论的 AI 教师和 AI 同学呈现。内置的 OpenMAIC Skill 还可与 OpenClaw 以及 Codex、DeepSeek、WorkBuddy 等智能体工作台配合使用，从而通过即时通讯应用或 IDE 生成课堂。

## 核心功能

- 一键从主题或附件材料生成课程；多智能体课堂中的 AI 教师与同学可实时讲授、讨论和互动；支持幻灯片、测验、交互式 HTML 模拟和项目式学习等场景；智能体可通过白板和语音合成绘制图表、书写公式并讲解；可导出保留全部场景的 PPTX、离线 HTML 课程或课堂 ZIP；通过 OpenMAIC Skill 与 OpenClaw、Codex、DeepSeek、WorkBuddy 等智能体工作台集成。

## 适用场景

- 根据主题或上传文档生成完整课程；与 AI 教师和 AI 同学开展互动课堂；创建项目式学习活动和交互式模拟；通过智能体工作台集成，从即时通讯应用或 IDE 生成课堂。

## 快速开始

- 前置条件为 Node\.js 22\.19 或更高版本、pnpm 10 或更高版本及 PostgreSQL 16。克隆仓库并运行 pnpm install。将 \.env\.example 复制为 \.env\.local，将 openmaic\.example\.yml 复制为 openmaic\.yml，然后提供 OPENAI\_API\_KEY 或配置其他提供商。运行 pnpm db:up 启动数据库，取消 \.env\.local 中本地 DATABASE\_URL 行的注释，再运行 pnpm dev，打开本地 3000 端口。

## 部署与要求

- OpenMAIC 需要 PostgreSQL 和 DATABASE\_URL，缺少时服务器会拒绝启动。自 1\.2\.0 起，课程生成在服务器进程中运行，因此需要长期运行的 Node\.js 进程和 PostgreSQL；Vercel 等无服务器托管不受支持。Docker Compose 以两个容器运行应用和 PostgreSQL，课程、生成媒体与运行时会话保存在命名卷中。构建后可运行 pnpm build 与 pnpm start，并保持服务器长期运行。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

MausBot is a free and open\-source chat app for running a team of AI bots on your own machine\. Bots can get their own computer, connect to apps, run automations, and wait for approval before sending or taking action\. It is positioned as an open\-source Grok Bot alternative that works with the agent CLIs and provider accounts you already use\.

## Key Features

- Messaging\-style interface for managing multiple bots with pin, unread, duplicate, hide, and delete actions\.
- Each bot can get its own computer: a cloud desktop from a connected provider, or a bot pointed at your own Mac\.
- Per\-bot model choice across supported providers such as Claude, Codex, Grok, and Kimi, with model switching mid\-conversation\.
- Connected apps such as Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, and Linear through Composio with OAuth\.
- Automations created from one sentence and run on a schedule, a webhook, or an app event\.
- Local\-first operation: bots use installed CLIs, transcripts, keys, and events stay in ~/\.openmausbot, and secrets are write\-only\.

## Use Cases

- Sales follow\-up: find quiet deals, determine the next step, and draft follow\-ups for approval\.
- Chief of Staff: read inbox, calendar, and team channels before the day starts, then send one brief\.
- Recruiter: find candidates, check them against must\-haves, and keep a shortlist for review\.
- Bookkeeper: pull overdue invoices, draft reminders, and keep a running sheet of who owes what\.

## Getting Started

- Download the desktop app from the installer list and open MausBot; phone apps are companions, so start on your computer\.
- Connect one supported provider or agent engine, such as Claude Code or Codex, through onboarding or App settings → Agent engines\.
- Create your first bot via New or share → New bot, name it, choose the connected engine and an available model\.
- Send a small, useful task such as planning your day, summarizing notes, or drafting an email, then review the answer\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A desktop app running on your own computer; phone apps are companions\.
- One supported agent engine or provider connected, such as Claude Code or Codex, with your own account or API key; provider fees and limits apply\.
- A working folder only for tasks that involve files\.
- Local data stored under ~/\.openmausbot on your own disk\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Using the app depends on third\-party AI providers and their pricing or usage limits\.
- Bots rely on agent CLIs already installed on the computer and on the user's existing logins and subscriptions\.
- Local\-first storage is the default, with transcripts, keys, and events kept on the user's disk\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenMontage is an open\-source, agentic video production system that turns AI coding assistants into a full video production studio\. It supports research, scripting, asset generation, editing, and final composition, and can create image\-based videos, local character animation, or real\-footage documentaries\. The desktop app OpenMontage Studio provides a creative workspace where users can direct complete productions or focused tasks\.

## Key Features

- 12 production pipelines, 100\+ tools, and 700\+ agent skill and production\-knowledge files\.
- Works with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, and Codex\.
- Local\-first composition and rendering with no watermarks and a per\-asset provenance report\.
- Can create real\-footage videos by building a CLIP\-searchable corpus from open archives and free stock sources\.
- Supports Remotion and HyperFrames composition, including captions, brand rules, and output formats such as 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16\.
- Includes an approval gate and a decision log so the production plan can be reviewed before asset work begins\.

## Use Cases

- Produce explainers, product ads, launch films, documentaries, animations, and other video formats\.
- Turn a reference YouTube video, Short, Reel, TikTok, or local clip into a grounded production plan\.
- Create a real\-footage documentary montage or stock\-footage collage from open archives and free stock sources\.
- Use existing AI coding assistants to run video editing and generation tasks from a conversation\.

## Getting Started

- Install prerequisites: Python 3\.10\+, FFmpeg, Node\.js 18\+, and an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, or Codex\.
- Clone the repository and run make setup, or use the manual setup commands for macOS/Linux or Windows PowerShell\.
- Open the project in your AI coding assistant and describe the video you want, such as a 60\-second animated explainer\.
- Add optional API keys in \.env for more image, video, music, voice, and stock media tools\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10\+\.
- FFmpeg\.
- Node\.js 18\+\.
- An AI coding assistant such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, or Codex\.
- API keys are optional; more keys provide more tools\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenMontage Studio is currently in private alpha, and beta access is waitlist\-based\.
- Capabilities vary because users bring their own media\-provider accounts and supported local tools\.
- The workflow is local\-first for footage and rendering\.
- Joining the waitlist involves email communication about the beta with an opt\-out option\.
- The website uses Google Analytics but provides an analytics opt\-out\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenMotion is an open\-source, full\-stack agentic video studio and an alternative to Claude Motion and CapCut\. You can upload a reference video or paste a social video link, and an agent breaks down its shots, timing, and transitions, then rebuilds it with your brand kit and copy while generating missing assets\. Timing can be adjusted in the built\-in Studio, and an MP4 can be rendered from the same project\. The project uses the Motion\.md Markdown format to describe shot order, timing, and transitions, and follows a BYOA and BYOK model with local agents and your own API keys\.

## Key Features

- Full\-stack agentic video recreation from a reference video or social video link, rebuilding shots and transitions with your brand kit and copy\.
- BYOA and BYOK: free and open source, with support for local agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and WorkBuddy and use of your own API keys\.
- Motion\.md Markdown format for shot order, timing, and transitions, designed to be shareable shot by shot\.
- Integrated generation of images, video, music, and voice with GPT Image 2\.6, Seedance 2\.5, Suno, and Eleven v4\.
- Studio timeline editing and MP4 rendering from the same project, with scenes described in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript\.
- One\-click installation from ChatGPT Marketplace and an installable Skill for local agents\.

## Use Cases

- Recreating product demos, brand films, talking\-head videos, and social clips from reference videos with your own branding\.
- Adapting videos for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok through MP4 export\.
- Sharing Motion\.md files so others can inspect how a brand film works shot by shot\.
- Editing imported HyperFrames project ZIPs or starting from templates in the local template library\.

## Getting Started

- Install from the ChatGPT Marketplace for one\-click installation, then create, recreate, or start from a template in the conversation\.
- Install the main Skill with npx skills add nexu\-io/openmotion \-\-skill openmotion, then ask your agent to install and connect the local Studio and MCP\.
- For source setup, clone the repository, run npm ci, npm run build:studio, and npm start, then open the studioUrl or previewUrl printed at startup\.
- Connect Claude Code, Codex, or WorkBuddy and supply your own API keys\.
- Upload a reference video or paste a social video link, let the agent rebuild it with your brand kit, adjust timing in Studio, and render MP4\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 22\.18 or later\.
- For local repository use, the source lists Git, npm, and Node\.js 26\.11\.1\.
- Your own API keys are needed for the models you plan to use\.
- A local agent such as Claude Code, Codex, or WorkBuddy to run the BYOA workflow\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Published versions may lag behind the source checkout\.
- Native original\-reference playback requires internet access\.
- Installing only the Skill does not install Studio or connect MCP\.
- The project runs on Node\.js 22\.18 or later\.

projects.taglineZh: 从相机位姿与稀疏点云生成带纹理三维网格
projects.description: OpenMVS is an open-source C++ computer-vision library for Multi-View Stereo reconstruction. It takes camera poses and a sparse point cloud from Structure-from-Motion and produces a dense point cloud, refined mesh, and textured 3D model.
projects.descriptionZh: OpenMVS 是面向多视图立体视觉重建的开源 C++ 计算机视觉库。它接续运动恢复结构流程，接收相机位姿和稀疏点云，输出稠密点云、细化网格和带纹理的三维模型。
projects.content:
## Overview

OpenMVS is a C\+\+ library for computer\-vision scientists and the Multi\-View Stereo reconstruction community\. It fills the last part of the photogrammetry chain after Structure\-from\-Motion, taking camera poses and a sparse point cloud and producing a textured mesh\.

## Key Features

- Dense point\-cloud reconstruction for obtaining a complete and accurate as possible point cloud\.
- Mesh reconstruction for estimating a mesh surface that best explains the input point cloud\.
- Mesh refinement for recovering fine details\.
- Mesh texturing for computing a sharp and accurate texture to color the mesh\.
- A scalable pipeline that splits large scenes into sub\-scenes when memory is insufficient, reconstructs them sequentially, and merges the results\.
- Continuous integration for Windows, Ubuntu, and macOS x64, with automatic Windows x64 binary builds available for each commit on its Artifacts page\.

## Use Cases

- Turning camera\-aligned images and sparse Structure\-from\-Motion geometry into dense point clouds, refined meshes, and textured 3D models\.
- Photogrammetry projects that need to reconstruct large scenes that may not fit available memory\.
- Computer\-vision research and practitioner workflows that require a complete dense\-to\-texture reconstruction chain\.
- Trying OpenMVS on Windows without compiling by using the automatic x64 binary artifacts\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository from the cdcseacave/openMVS GitHub repository\.
- Follow the building wiki page for platform\-specific setup on Windows, Ubuntu, or macOS x64\.
- On Windows, optionally use an automatic x64 binary from the Artifacts page for a commit\.
- Review the usage example on the wiki to understand the input format and module flow\.
- For large scenes, run scripts/python/MvsScalablePipeline\.py scene\.mvs\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- OpenMVS is a C\+\+ library\.
- Building instructions are provided on the project wiki for Windows, Ubuntu, and macOS x64\.
- CI covers Windows, Ubuntu, and macOS x64 builds, and automatic Windows x64 binary builds are posted for each commit\.
- The scalable large\-scene pipeline can split a scene into sub\-scenes to fit the memory available on the machine\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenMVS expects prior Structure\-from\-Motion output: camera poses and a sparse point cloud\.
- Large scenes may not fit available memory; the scalable pipeline splits them into sub\-scenes, reconstructs them one after the other, and merges the results\.
- The project targets researchers and practitioners rather than casual users\.
- Detailed documentation is kept on the wiki because the README is deliberately lean\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenRig turns AI coding agents into a persistent, organized team\. A lead agent coordinates specialists, tracks their work, and brings results and decisions that need attention back to the user; teams can run on the user's own machine with Claude Code, Codex, and Pi\.

## Key Features

- A persistent team of coding agents with roles and shared context\.
- A lead agent can delegate work to specialists and track their progress\.
- Supports Claude Code, Codex and Pi in the same rig, managed as one system\.
- Agents can assign owned work through a queue and keep it visible for follow\-up\.
- An OpenRig TUI shows how agents are organized, what they are working on and where attention is needed\.
- Self\-hosted operation on the user's own machine\.

## Use Cases

- Coordinate a large project across specialist coding agents over weeks or months\.
- Route a question to a specialist agent that already holds relevant project context\.
- Assign a named teammate a task and track its owner and progress\.
- Use Claude Code and Codex together as one managed team\.

## Getting Started

- Install @openrig/cli globally with npm install \-g @openrig/cli\.
- Preview setup with rig setup \-\-dry\-run, then apply it with rig setup\.
- Start the daemon with rig daemon start and open the kernel view with rig terminal open saved:kernel \-\-window\.
- Alternatively, add OpenRig's rigs skill to Claude Code or Codex with npx, then invoke /rigs or $rigs and describe what you want built\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 22 or 24 (22 on Apple silicon) and tmux\.
- macOS or Linux; on Windows, WSL2 is required and native Windows is not supported\.
- A working Claude Code or Codex account, signed in; one provider is enough to start\.
- Self\-hosted; runs on the user's own machine\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenRig's kernel runs with broader permissions than a project team gets by default\.
- OpenRig does not guarantee preservation or rollback of the setup files it changes, so users should back them up first\.
- Windows users must use WSL2 because native Windows is not supported\.
- OpenRig's automated tests do not yet run on WSL2\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenSEO is an open\-source SEO platform and MCP server for AI agents\. It provides data and workflows for keyword research, domain overview, backlinks, rank tracking, site audits, and AI\-search visibility\. It can be used through a hosted version or self\-hosted\.

## Key Features

- Keyword research: find ideas, demand, difficulty, intent, and live SERPs\.
- Domain overview and competitor insights: estimate organic traffic and ranking keywords\.
- Backlinks: inspect backlinks, referring domains, and link quality\.
- Rank tracking: track keyword positions over time\.
- Site audit: crawl pages and surface technical issues\.
- AI visibility and Prompt Explorer: review AI mentions, citations, and prompts; compare prompts across supported AI models\.

## Use Cases

- Entrepreneurs and SEO teams can research keywords, save opportunities, and track rankings\.
- Marketers can analyze competitors, backlinks, and domain visibility\.
- AI agent users can connect agents like Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, OpenCode, or Gemini to run SEO workflows through MCP and skills\.
- Self\-hosters and developers can customize or build on OpenSEO as an open\-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs\.

## Getting Started

- Try the hosted version for free; no credit card required\.
- Connect an AI agent through the OpenSEO MCP server using the setup guide\.
- Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills for reusable SEO workflows\.
- For self\-hosting, follow the Docker or Cloudflare self\-hosting guides\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A DataForSEO API key is required to retrieve SEO data\.
- Self\-hosting supports Docker for personal use/testing or Cloudflare for internet\-facing use across multiple devices or with a team; Cloudflare works on the free plan\.
- When self\-hosting, DataForSEO is paid directly\.
- Local development documentation is provided\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenSEO requires an external DataForSEO API key to obtain SEO data\.
- The project recommends Cloudflare for self\-hosting unless users are already confident self\-hosting other apps, rather than Railway, Coolify, or Dokploy\.
- The hosted service charges a 28% markup on DataForSEO requests, while self\-hosting pays DataForSEO directly\.

projects.content:
## Overview

NVIDIA OpenShell is an open\-source runtime for executing fleets of autonomous AI agents in sandboxed environments with kernel\-level isolation\. It combines sandbox runtime controls with declarative YAML policy so teams can give agents access to files, packages, APIs, and credentials without granting unrestricted access to local files, credentials, or external networks\.

## Key Features

- Kernel\-level enforcement confines file access and system calls and checks every network connection against policy before it leaves the sandbox\.
- Declarative YAML policies define filesystem, network, process, and provider credential controls for each sandbox\.
- Filesystem restrictions use Landlock to limit reads and writes to declared paths only\.
- Network policies allow only approved destinations and deny other outbound traffic\.
- Provider credential handling resolves opaque placeholders only at profile\-authorized endpoints and adds credentials only to requests bound for approved endpoints\.
- Formal verification flags risky new access before a policy change is approved, so changes such as reaching a new host with credentials can wait for human review\.

## Use Cases

- Secure coding agents: run Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, or GitHub Copilot CLI with constrained file and network access\.
- Private enterprise development: grant selected sandboxes access to self\-hosted or private model endpoints while keeping sensitive context under control\.
- Compliance and audit: treat policy YAML as version\-controlled security controls that can be reviewed and audited\.
- Reusable environments: use the default Ubuntu workload or bring your own containerized runtime\.

## Getting Started

- Install the CLI and a local gateway with the install script, then create a sandbox such as demo\. The default sandbox image is minimal Ubuntu with no agent installed\. To run a real agent, follow the Run Your First Agent guide, which runs OpenCode against a free OpenRouter model

## Deployment & Requirements

- You need Linux, macOS on Apple Silicon, or Windows with WSL 2 (experimental), plus Docker, Podman, or host virtualization\. For Kubernetes, deploy the gateway with Helm, and the CNI must enforce NetworkPolicy\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Windows support is labeled experimental and requires WSL 2\.
- Anonymous operational telemetry is collected and can be disabled through gateway or Helm settings\.
- Retrieved external materials are not distributed with OpenShell and are governed by separate terms, conditions, and licenses\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenSRE is an open\-source CLI agent for CI/CD reliability\. It investigates failed CI runs, reads logs, traces causes, and opens fixes as pull requests for review\. It is self\-hosted and works with your own models\.

## Key Features

- Investigates failed CI runs by reading logs, testing hypotheses, and recommending fixes\.
- Separates CI\-caused failures from code\-caused failures so teams fix the right issue\.
- Opens fixes as pull requests for review\.
- Measures CI failure rate, blocked developer time, and how long main stays red\.
- Connects to more than 60 tools across LLM providers, observability, infrastructure, databases, dev tools, incident management, and communication\.
- Posts summaries directly to Slack, PagerDuty, or Telegram\.

## Use Cases

- Diagnose failed builds and trace root causes faster\.
- Fix failing checks on a pull request or set up an agent that keeps CI green\.
- Measure CI reliability costs and reduce how long main stays red\.
- Give every team member senior\-level investigation context\.

## Getting Started

- Ensure a terminal is open in a code project; a Git repository is recommended for the full workflow demonstration\.
- Install on macOS or Linux with the installer, or on Windows with PowerShell, then run opensre\.
- Run opensre to sign in and get started; the first launch activates the hosted model\.
- Use opensre ask with a plain\-language question for a non\-interactive agent turn\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- OpenSRE Cloud managed gateway can be provisioned by an organization admin in the web app\.
- The gateway AMI plus systemd deployment uses make build\-gateway\-image and make deploy\-gateway; it is Telegram gateway only and does not use Docker\.
- Self\-hosted container deployment supports Railway, ECS, or Vercel by deploying the repo Dockerfile, selecting MODE, and setting LLM\_PROVIDER plus its API key\.
- DATABASE\_URL is needed only when the gateway requires shared Postgres\-backed state, such as Slack Events API replicas\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenSRE is in public alpha, so core workflows are usable for early exploration but not fully stable, and APIs and integrations may evolve\.
- Self\-hosted container deployments require an LLM provider and API key\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenStock is a community\-built, open\-source market platform for tracking prices, watching markets, and exploring company insights without an expensive terminal subscription\. It provides market dashboards, stock pages, watchlists, alerts, and sentiment views, and can be used on the hosted site or self\-hosted\.

## Key Features

- A dashboard for seven markets: US, India, Germany, Canada, Australia, Crypto and Forex, with an index pulse, a sector heatmap, market leaders and top stories\.
- Stock pages with TradingView candles, drawing tools, fullscreen charts, selectable indicators, financials, technicals and company profiles\.
- A watchlist of up to 50 stocks saved to an account, plus price alerts above or below a target that are checked every five minutes and emailed in realtime mode\.
- Sentiment from Reddit, X, news and Polymarket side by side for each stock, using an Adanos key\.
- Search across every exchange Finnhub covers with Command\-K and keep stocks open as browser\-style tabs\.
- A weekly, AI\-written news digest by email every Monday for the stocks a user watches\.

## Use Cases

- Following broad market indices, sectors and top stories before the bell\.
- Researching individual companies with charts, indicators, financials and technicals\.
- Tracking a personal watchlist and setting price alerts for target levels\.
- Running a self\-hosted market dashboard for a team with your own Finnhub keys\.

## Getting Started

- You need Node\.js 22 LTS, a MongoDB database and a free Finnhub key\.
- Clone the repository, run npm ci, copy \.env\.example to \.env, and fill in MONGODB\_URI, BETTER\_AUTH\_SECRET and FINNHUB\_API\_KEY\.
- Run node scripts/check\-env\.mjs and npm run test:db to check the environment and MongoDB connection, then run npm run dev\.
- For Docker Compose, fill in \.env and run docker compose up \-d \-\-build, then open the app on localhost port 3000\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A MongoDB database and MongoDB connection URI are required\.
- BETTER\_AUTH\_SECRET is required to sign sessions, and BETTER\_AUTH\_URL is required for auth callbacks and email links\.
- A Finnhub API key is required for market data; multiple free keys can be supplied comma\-separated and are rotated\.
- Production background jobs for welcome emails, price alerts and the weekly digest require Inngest signing and event keys\.
- Email sending uses Nodemailer with Gmail and an app password; without those settings, emails are skipped\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenStock is community\-built, is not a brokerage, and its market data may be delayed depending on the provider and setup; it does not provide financial advice\.
- OpenStock Cloud is listed as coming soon, so hosted live quotes and email price alerts are not yet generally available\.
- Self\-hosted realtime pricing depends on supplying your own Finnhub keys; each key adds 60 requests per minute, and realtime mode refreshes prices every 15 seconds\.

projects.description: openTPU is an open-source AI accelerator developed by AI, combining RTL, ISA, simulator, compiler, and profiler in one repository. It runs Qwen3, LFM2.5, and Qwen3.5 on a Kintex-7 PCIe card.
projects.descriptionZh: openTPU 是由 AI 开发的开源 AI 加速器，将 RTL、ISA、模拟器、编译器和分析器整合在一个代码库中；可在 Kintex-7 PCIe 卡上运行 Qwen3、LFM2.5 和 Qwen3.5。
projects.content:
## Overview

openTPU is an open\-source AI accelerator developed by AI\. Its monorepo includes the SystemVerilog hardware design, instruction set, bit\-exact simulator, kernel language and compiler, host software, and profiler\. The design runs modern models on an Inspur YPCB\-00338 card with a Xilinx Kintex\-7 xc7k480t and two DDR3 channels, and the card produces tokens that match the simulator bit for bit\.

## Key Features

- One monorepo contains RTL, ISA, simulator, compiler, profiler, and host software\.
- Runs ten modern models with real weights on an Inspur YPCB\-00338 Kintex\-7 PCIe card, matching the simulator token for token\.
- Supports int8 and 4\-bit weight formats, with an int8 LM head for accuracy\.
- Provides otpu\-chat, otpu\-serve, otpu\-smi, otpu\-lens, otpu\-selftest, and otpu\-diag tools\.
- Includes an ASIC flow using open\-source tools and NanGate45, from SystemVerilog to routed layout\.
- Streams experts for mixture\-of\-experts models larger than the card's 4 GiB memory\.

## Use Cases

- Learning how an AI accelerator works end to end, from Python matmul kernels to RTL and PCIe card bring\-up\.
- Running supported language models locally on a Kintex\-7 FPGA card or in the ISA simulator\.
- Validating device outputs against Hugging Face transformers with quantization\-aware golden checks\.
- Serving many clients through an OpenAI\-style API with contexts kept on the card and host memory or disk\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Python package with pip install \-e \. and install pytest, torch, and transformers\.
- Run python3 \-m pytest \-q; RTL tests also need Verilator 5\.
- Download a supported checkpoint, for example hf download LiquidAI/LFM2\.5\-230M \-\-local\-dir models/LFM2\.5\-230M\.
- Chat on the simulator with otpu\-chat \-\-model lfm2 \-\-backend isa\.
- With a card, build the bitstream with make bit in boards/ypcb\-00338, load it over JTAG, run sudo otpu\-setup, then use otpu\-chat \-\-backend board\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Everything except the card runs on a laptop\.
- RTL tests need Verilator 5\.
- Board use requires an Inspur YPCB\-00338 card with Xilinx Kintex\-7 xc7k480t and two DDR3 channels, plus a Vivado bitstream loaded over JTAG\.
- Mixture\-of\-experts models larger than the card's 4 GiB require streaming experts from host storage\.
- Gemma 4 E2B validation can peak at 16 GB and needs a host with about 22 GB free\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- RTL testing has an external tool dependency on Verilator 5\.
- Using the FPGA board requires building and loading a bitstream\.
- Mixture\-of\-experts models larger than the card's 4 GiB depend on streaming experts from host storage\.
- Gemma 4 E2B validation has substantial host memory requirements\.
- The production clock has a narrow timing margin\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenUI is the open standard for generative UI\. It enables AI apps and agents to respond with interactive UI, charts, tables, forms, and dashboards\. OpenUI Lang is a compact, streaming\-first language that LLMs write to build interfaces from your own components, and it is not JSON\.

## Key Features

- OpenUI Lang is a compact, streaming\-first language that LLMs write to build interfaces from your own components; each line defines one component, such as root = Stack(\[header, chart\])\.
- Interfaces render while the response is still streaming\.
- Works with any model, any frontend framework, and any design system or component library you already use\.
- Can generate interactive UI, charts, cards, dashboards, forms, and tables\.
- The benchmark page states OpenUI Lang generates up to 3x faster and uses 67% fewer tokens than JSON\-based UI formats\.
- OpenUI is fully open source and works with your own components and design system\.

## Use Cases

- Build AI apps and agents that respond with interactive UI, charts, tables, forms, and dashboards\.
- Render dashboards, forms, tables, charts, and complete application screens from a response, not only chat messages\.
- Add OpenUI to existing agent code using integrations such as Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, Convex, Cloudflare, CrewAI, n8n, and Haystack without a rewrite\.
- Work within existing frontend frameworks such as React, Next\.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Nuxt, Remix, and Astro\.

## Getting Started

- Run pnpx @openuidev/cli@latest create to scaffold a working app\.
- Run npx @openuidev/cli@latest setup\-agent in your project to add OpenUI instructions to AGENTS\.md for coding agents such as Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code\.
- Projects created with npx @openuidev/cli@latest create already include the agent instructions\.

## Before You Adopt

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenViking is an open\-source context database for AI agents that organizes knowledge, memory, and skills as a virtual filesystem under viking://\. Agents can browse, search, and read context as files, with generated summaries and layered access\. It connects with popular agent harnesses and provides benchmarks showing improved long\-term memory accuracy and token efficiency\.

## Key Features

- One filesystem for knowledge, memory, and skills: resources, user memories, and skills each get a viking:// URI for browsing and retrieval\.
- Directory\-scoped semantic search that runs queries within project or memory subtrees instead of scanning a flat vector index\.
- Layered context with L0 abstracts, L1 overviews, and L2 full details so agents can judge relevance before reading source content\.
- Sessions become inspectable Markdown files, and ov compile can organize source material into a wiki, knowledge graph, or report\.
- Integrations with agent harnesses including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, OpenCode, and MCP clients\.
- Benchmarks report 80%\+ long\-term memory accuracy across agent frameworks and up to 63% reduction in input tokens versus baselines\.

## Use Cases

- Providing cross\-session memory for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor through hooks, plugins, or MCP\.
- Organizing and retrieving knowledge from project documentation and GitHub repositories for retrieval\-augmented generation\.
- Improving long\-term memory accuracy and reducing token costs when connecting agent frameworks like OpenClaw, Hermes, and Claude Code\.
- Building custom agent integrations with Python, Go, or TypeScript SDKs and the HTTP API\.

## Getting Started

- Install the package with pip install openviking \-\-upgrade\.
- Run openviking\-server init to configure providers and models\.
- Run openviking\-server doctor to check configuration and connectivity\.
- Start the server with openviking\-server\.
- Use the ov CLI to add resources, run searches, and inspect context with commands like ov add\-resource, ov find, and ov grep\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Python 3\.10\+ and access to an embedding model and a VLM, either cloud or local\.
- The open\-source server runs under AGPLv3 and requires no activation key; configure authentication before exposing it beyond localhost\.
- A Docker and deployment guide is available, and a desktop app beta supports macOS and Windows x64\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The server requires an embedding model and a VLM, which can be cloud or local external dependencies\.
- The desktop app is currently in beta and limited to macOS and Windows x64\.
- The self\-managed commercial edition is activated by a license key and adds distributed deployment and official support\.

- 支持以目录为范围的语义搜索，在项目或记忆子树内执行查询，而不必扫描扁平的向量索引。

## 适用场景

- 借助 Python、Go、TypeScript SDK 与 HTTP API 构建自定义智能体集成。

## 快速开始

- 使用 pip install openviking \-\-upgrade 安装。
- 运行 openviking\-server init 配置提供方与模型。
- 运行 openviking\-server doctor 检查配置与连通性。

- 通过 ov CLI 添加资源、执行检索并查看上下文，常用命令包括 ov add\-resource、ov find 与 ov grep。

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Python 3\.10\+，并需要可访问的嵌入模型与 VLM，云端或本地均可。

## Overview

OpenWhispr is an open source, privacy\-first voice\-to\-text app for dictation, meeting transcription, and notes\. It can run local speech\-to\-text models or use cloud processing with bring\-your\-own API keys, and is available cross\-platform for macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS\.

## Key Features

- Global\-hotkey voice dictation into any app with automatic pasting\.
- Local speech\-to\-text with models such as Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet, or cloud processing with bring\-your\-own API keys\.
- AI agent and Voice Assistant hotkey for commands, in\-place editing of highlighted text, and pasted answers\.
- Meeting transcription with auto\-detected Zoom, Teams, and FaceTime calls, live speaker diarization, voice fingerprinting, and calendar integration\.
- Notes with folders, semantic search, cloud sync, AI actions, and team spaces with sharing controls\.
- Audio and video import with batch upload, URL/paste support, and optional speaker detection\.

## Use Cases

- Dictating into chat, email, docs, and coding apps using a global hotkey\.
- Capturing meeting notes without a bot in Zoom, Teams, and FaceTime calls\.
- Transcribing existing audio or video files, including batch uploads and URLs\.
- Running private offline transcription with local models or using cloud/BYOK processing for speed\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository, run npm install, and run npm run dev\.
- Node\.js 24\+ is required\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Available for macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS\.
- Node\.js 24\+ is required for development\.
- The desktop application runs from the repository root; the Expo mobile application has its own dependencies, lockfile, build configuration, and release process\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Cloud transcription is optional, and recordings are deleted after transcription finishes; local dictation keeps audio on the user’s device\.

projects.content:
## Overview

OpenWorker is an open\-source, local\-first AI coworker for desktop\. It runs on your machine, connects to everyday tools such as Slack, GitHub, email, calendar, and files, and carries tasks through to finished deliverables\. It ships specialist security coworkers first and checks in before consequential actions\.

## Key Features

- Runs locally on your computer as a desktop app with local secret storage for model keys and connector tokens\.
- Bring your own model: use cloud API keys, open\-weight providers, or run fully local with Ollama\.
- Works across 25\+ connectors including GitHub, Slack, Jira, Notion, Linear, HubSpot, Outlook, Gmail, and Google Calendar, plus terminal, local files, and MCP tools\.
- Governed actions include approval gates, standing rules, audit trails, hard floors, and an optional auto\-approve reviewer that escalates uncertainty\.
- Produces finished deliverables such as documents, spreadsheets, reports, web pages, fix pull requests, and Slack thread replies\.
- Supports scheduled automations and Slack mentions with full transcripts\.

## Use Cases

- Security review: scan code and dependencies for real risk and propose fixes that are re\-scanned and diff\-reviewed before approval\.
- Cloud posture: audit cloud configuration against common misconfiguration classes and draft the remediation plan\.
- Incident triage: gather context across tools, draft timelines, and prepare reports for security or ops incidents\.
- Everyday work and standing automations: prep customer calls, create documents, manage calendar and Slack, and run recurring briefs or reports\.

## Getting Started

- Download the macOS app for Apple Silicon\. macOS 12\+ builds are signed and notarized and auto\-update\.
- Windows 10/11 x64 builds are listed but not yet code\-signed, so SmartScreen will warn while signing is in progress\.
- Open the app, add a model key, or point it at Ollama, then ask for something real\.
- Run from source with Python 3\.10\+, Node 20\+, and the Rust toolchain via rustup\. Bootstrap the Python virtual environment, start the local agent server, and run the UI\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app: macOS 12\+ on Apple Silicon or Windows 10/11 x64\.
- Source run: Python 3\.10\+, Node 20\+, and Rust toolchain via rustup for the desktop shell\.
- Model access: bring a supported cloud provider API key or run local models via Ollama\.
- Tool connections: one\-click or manual connections, with MCP tools supported for additional integrations\.
- Optional sandbox: NVIDIA OpenShell for agent shell and file tools\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenWorker is in open beta, so users should expect active polishing of rough edges\.
- Windows builds are not code\-signed, so SmartScreen warnings are expected until signing is completed\.
- Although OpenWorker is local\-first, an optional cloud account brokers OAuth handshakes for connectors\.
- Users pay model providers directly for API usage\.
- Auto\-approve reviewer verdicts are judgments, not guarantees; hard floors and the audit trail backstop them\.

The app combines terminals, diffs, a browser, and a CLI into one environment designed for agents, not just humans\. It is free, open source, and cross\-platform, with a mobile companion for iOS and Android\.

## 项目简介

Orca 是专为并行编码智能体工作流构建的智能体开发环境（ADE）。它允许你并排运行 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Cursor CLI 以及任何其他 CLI 智能体，每个智能体都在自己独立的 git 工作树中。该应用将终端、差异、浏览器和 CLI 整合为一个为智能体而非仅为人设计的环境。它免费、开源、跨平台，并提供 iOS 和 Android 移动伴侣应用。

## 核心功能

- 并行工作树：每个任务在独立的 git 工作树中运行，可将一个提示分发给多个智能体并合并胜出者。
- 终端分屏：WebGL 渲染的终端，支持无限分屏和重启后保留的滚动缓冲区。
- 设计模式：每个工作树一个真实的 Chromium 窗口，点击任意 UI 元素即可将其 HTML、CSS 和裁剪截图发送给智能体。

## 适用场景

- 在同一仓库上并行运行多个编码智能体而不会冲突，每个智能体在自己的工作树中。
- 离开办公桌时，通过手机监控和引导智能体，实时查看状态并发送后续消息。
- 使用远程机器或 VPS 处理繁重的智能体工作负载。

## 快速开始

- 从 onOrca\.dev 下载 Orca 适用于 macOS、Windows 或 Linux，或在 macOS 上通过 Homebrew 安装（brew install \-\-cask stablyai/orca/orca），或在 Arch Linux 上通过 AUR 安装（yay \-S stably\-orca\-bin）。对于移动端，从 App Store 下载 iOS 应用或从 GitHub 下载 Android APK。

## 部署与要求

- 桌面应用支持 macOS（Apple Silicon 和 Intel）、Windows 和 Linux。移动伴侣应用适用于 iOS 和 Android。对于远程使用，Orca 可通过 orca serve 在无头 Linux 服务器上运行，SSH 工作树允许连接到远程机器。需要你自己的智能体订阅。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Orkas is an open\-source, local\-first multi\-agent AI desktop client\. A Commander turns goals into to\-dos and coordinates specialist agents, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors, to complete complex work together\.

## Key Features

- Commander coordinates 16 built\-in specialist agents plus supported coding agents to split and combine complex work\.
- Projects keep goals, rules, memory and files so new conversations continue prior context\.
- To\-dos, Auto\-advance and scheduled automations help work keep moving between check\-ins\.
- Local\-first storage keeps files, chats and memory on the user's computer, with optional cloud sync\.
- Model choice includes managed official models or user\-provided providers through OAuth or an API key\.
- MCP tool connections and shared projects support collaboration with external tools and teammates\.

## Use Cases

- Research markets and turn findings into reports, slides or launch videos\.
- Create marketing content, images, videos and editable presentations\.
- Develop and fix software with UI design, feature code and tests\.
- Run recurring business operations such as weekly briefs, client updates and store reviews\.

## Getting Started

- Download Orkas for macOS or Windows; the app is free and includes 500 credits for managed official models\.
- Official models work out of the box, or connect your own model provider and local agents\.
- Use projects to set a goal, then let the Commander coordinate agents and keep work moving\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Official downloads are available for macOS and Windows\.
- The open\-source repository also supports Linux, which users build themselves\.
- Orkas is a desktop client rather than a server; self\-hosting means running the app on your own machine\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- By default, local data and user\-provided keys stay on the user's machine, while selected managed or cloud features use Orkas services\.
- Managed models and optional cloud features depend on Orkas services when those features are selected\.
- Self\-hosting Orkas does not mean deploying a team server; it means running the desktop app on your own machine\.
- Published web apps have limitations and cannot directly use desktop AI, local files or connectors\.
- Credits apply only to the Orkas\-managed model service; bring\-your\-own\-provider usage is billed by the provider\.
