projects.descriptionZh: Overmind 是面向专用智能体的训练平台，可将智能体的生产数据转化为团队自有的专用模型，并在同一平台完成数据准备、训练、评估与部署，支持托管使用或自行部署。
projects.content:
## Overview

Overmind is a platform for continuously improving AI agents\. It connects to an agent's codebase and production traces, builds versioned datasets, evaluates behavior, fine\-tunes open models, and serves trained and frontier models through one OpenAI\-compatible API\. Teams can use the hosted console or self\-host the platform\.

## Key Features

- Agent and capability graph scanned from the repository, covering prompts, tools, and tasks\.
- Observability with OpenTelemetry traces scored as they arrive and matched to the capability that produced them\.
- Datasets built from production traces or uploaded files as versioned eval and training datasets\.
- Evaluation and optimisers to measure quality per capability and test prompt, tool, and control\-flow changes\.
- Model fine\-tuning on your own data with weights you own, plus inference for trained and frontier models on one OpenAI\-compatible API\.
- MCP server and coding\-agent workflows for Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex\.

## Use Cases

- Improve agents handling customer support or coding tasks by using real production traces rather than relying only on prompt intuition\.
- Find the cause of agent failures by inspecting the failing step, tool call, and context behind it\.
- Build training and evaluation datasets from production traces to capture knowledge specific to a business\.
- Prove prompt or model improvements against real tasks and catch regressions before deployment\.

## Getting Started

- Hosted: sign up at console\.overmindlab\.ai, pick a coding agent on Get started, and paste the onboarding prompt with the agent repository open\. Onboarding installs overmind, runs overmind init and overmind sync, and builds the context graph\.
- Use /overmind commands such as ensure\-tracing, dataset, finetune, optimise, and backtest in the coding\-agent chat\.
- Self\-host: clone the repository, copy \.env\.example to \.env, set the required keys, and run docker compose up \-d\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Hosted console is available at console\.overmindlab\.ai; self\-hosting runs the same stack with Docker Compose, including Postgres, Redis, API, console, Celery workers, beat, and Grafana\.
- The API requires configured keys for OpenRouter, Modal, an inference endpoint, an AWS bucket, and Hugging Face before it starts\.
- Fine\-tuning and serving require deployed Modal workers and a Modal secret named overmind\-inference with AWS keys, inference key, and Hugging Face token\.
- Local document OCR uses Tesseract with English and orientation data in the Docker image; no external OCR service is required\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Self\-hosting requires all required API keys to be configured before the API will start\.
- Fine\-tuning and serving depend on deployed Modal workers\.
- The SDK and CLI send anonymous usage analytics to PostHog, so teams should evaluate this telemetry behavior\.
- Self\-hosted authentication uses email and password, and Clerk and Stripe secrets should remain blank\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Overmind 是持续改进 AI 智能体的平台。它连接智能体代码库与生产轨迹，构建版本化数据集，评估行为，微调开放模型，并通过统一的 OpenAI 兼容 API 提供训练后模型与前沿模型；团队可使用托管控制台，也可自行部署平台。

## 核心功能

- 从代码库扫描智能体与能力图，覆盖提示词、工具和任务。
- 观测能力：接收 OpenTelemetry 轨迹，在到达时评分并匹配到产生该轨迹的能力。
- 数据集：将生产轨迹或上传文件转化为带版本的评估与训练数据集。
- 评估与优化器：按能力衡量质量，并测试提示词、工具和控制流变更。
- 模型：使用自有数据微调开放模型，权重归团队所有；训练后模型与前沿模型可通过同一 OpenAI 兼容 API 提供推理。
- MCP 服务器与编码智能体工作流，支持 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Codex。

## 适用场景

- 利用真实生产轨迹改进客服或编码等任务的智能体，而不是只凭提示词直觉。
- 通过检查失败步骤、工具调用及其上下文，定位智能体失败原因。
- 从生产轨迹构建训练与评估数据集，沉淀业务专属知识。
- 在部署前用真实任务验证提示词或模型改进，并捕获回归。

## 快速开始

- 托管方式：在托管控制台注册，在开始使用页面选择 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 或 Codex，并在打开智能体代码库的情况下粘贴引导提示。引导流程会安装 overmind，运行 overmind init 和 overmind sync，并构建上下文图。
- 在同一编码智能体聊天中使用 /overmind 命令，例如 ensure\-tracing、dataset、finetune、optimise 和 backtest。
- 自行部署：克隆代码库，将 \.env\.example 复制为 \.env，设置所需密钥，然后运行 docker compose up \-d。

## 部署与要求

- 托管控制台可用；自行部署使用 Docker Compose 运行同一套栈，包含 Postgres、Redis、API、控制台、Celery worker、beat 和 Grafana。
- API 启动前必须配置 OpenRouter、Modal、推理端点、AWS 存储桶和 Hugging Face 所需密钥。
- 微调与模型服务还需要部署 Modal worker，并配置名为 overmind\-inference 的 Modal secret，包含 AWS 密钥、推理密钥和 Hugging Face token。
- 本地文档 OCR 使用 Docker 镜像中的 Tesseract 及英文与方向数据；无需外部 OCR 服务。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：AGPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

PaddleOCR is an OCR toolkit and document AI engine that converts PDFs and images into structured, LLM\-ready data\. It provides high\-accuracy text recognition, document parsing, and multilingual support for building intelligent RAG and Agentic applications\.

## Key Features

- Intelligent document parsing converts complex PDFs and images into Markdown or JSON, with structure\-aware conversion and fine\-grained coordinates\.
- PaddleOCR\-VL and PP\-StructureV3 support text, formula, table, chart, seal, and ancient document recognition\.
- Universal text recognition supports 100\+ languages, with PP\-OCRv6 covering 50 languages in a single model without model switching\.
- PP\-OCRv6 improves detection by 4\.6% and recognition by 5\.1% over PP\-OCRv5, with 5\.2× CPU inference speedup end\-to\-end\.
- The developer ecosystem integrates with Dify, RAGFlow, Pathway, and Cherry Studio and supports building LLM data pipelines\.
- One\-click deployment supports NVIDIA GPU, Intel CPU, Kunlunxin XPU, and diverse AI accelerators\.

## Use Cases

- Building RAG pipelines that need accurate parsing of PDFs, images, and complex documents for LLM ingestion\.
- Converting scanned documents, tables, formulas, and charts into Markdown or JSON for structured data workflows\.
- Multilingual document processing across 100\+ languages, including Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and other scripts\.
- Embedding OCR into applications through Python, C\+\+, C\#, Java, or browser\-based inference\.

## Getting Started

- Try the online Experience Center and APIs on the official website without setup\.
- For local deployment, follow the PP\-OCR, PaddleOCR\-VL, or PP\-StructureV3 documentation based on your needs\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.8–3\.12; OS support for Linux, Windows, and macOS; hardware support for CPU, GPU, XPU, and NPU\.
- One\-click deployment supports NVIDIA GPU, Intel CPU, Kunlunxin XPU, and diverse AI accelerators\.
- High\-performance inference supports CUDA 12 and can use Paddle Inference or ONNX Runtime backends\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Basic text recognition requires only minimal core dependencies, while document parsing and information extraction require optional dependencies\.
- High\-performance inference depends on CUDA 12 and can use Paddle Inference or ONNX Runtime backends\.
- Full support is noted for PaddlePaddle framework versions 3\.1\.0 and 3\.1\.1\.

projects.name: PageIndex
projects.tagline: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG for long documents
projects.taglineZh: 无向量、基于推理的长文档 RAG 引擎
projects.description: PageIndex is a vectorless, reasoning-based RAG engine that builds a hierarchical tree index per document and uses LLM reasoning to retrieve traceable, context-aware answers without vector databases or chunking. It targets long documents.
projects.descriptionZh: PageIndex 是一个无需向量库、基于推理的 RAG 引擎，为每份文档构建层级树索引，并由大模型在树上推理检索，无需向量数据库或文本分块，即可获得可追溯、上下文感知的答案，适用于长篇复杂文档。
projects.content:
## Overview

PageIndex is a vectorless, reasoning\-based RAG engine for long and complex documents\. Instead of a vector index and semantic similarity search, it builds a hierarchical tree index for each document and lets an LLM reason through the tree to retrieve relevant, traceable, and context\-aware information without chunking or a vector database\.

## Key Features

- Vectorless, reasoning\-based retrieval that replaces semantic similarity search with LLM reasoning over a tree index\.
- Hierarchical tree index generated per document, designed to mirror how humans navigate long reports\.
- No vector database and no chunking required\.
- Traceable and context\-aware retrieval that can use conversation history and domain knowledge\.
- Local and cloud modes: local mode handles text\-based PDFs, while cloud mode adds managed indexing, OCR, image understanding, metadata, folders, and an MCP server\.
- Reported state\-of\-the\-art 98\.7% accuracy on the FinanceBench financial document QA benchmark\.

## Use Cases

- Question answering over financial reports and FinanceBench\-style financial documents\.
- Retrieval from legal documents and regulatory filings\.
- Search and analysis of technical manuals, medical literature, and academic textbooks\.
- Reasoning over long, complex professional documents that require contextual understanding and multi\-step reasoning\.

## Getting Started

- Install the PageIndex SDK with pip install \-U pageindex\.
- Set your OpenAI API key, then create a PageIndexClient with index and chat model choices\.
- Submit a document such as report\.pdf to receive a doc\_id, then call chat with a question and the doc\_id to get an answer\.
- Configure other models, streaming, multi\-document search, and citations through the SDK client\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Local mode requires the PageIndex Python SDK and your own LLM API key, such as an OpenAI API key\.
- Cloud mode requires a PageIndex API key and provides managed parsing, OCR, image understanding, tree\-index construction, and cloud storage\.
- Dedicated VPC or on\-premises deployment is available by contacting the vendor\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Local operation depends on your own LLM API key, and cloud operation depends on a PageIndex API key\.
- The PageIndex File System, which extends reasoning to an entire corpus, is Cloud\-only\.
- The open\-source local setup is best suited to text\-heavy PDFs and local workflows; scanned or image\-rich documents may need the cloud service\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

PageIndex 是一个无向量、基于推理的 RAG 引擎，面向长篇复杂文档。它不依赖向量索引和语义相似度搜索，而是为每份文档生成层级树索引，让大语言模型在树上进行推理来检索相关信息，从而在无需分块、无需向量数据库的情况下获得可追溯且具备上下文感知的答案。

## 核心功能

- 无向量、基于推理的检索，用大模型在树索引上的推理替代语义相似度搜索。
- 为每份文档生成层级树索引，模拟人类阅读长报告的方式。
- 无需向量数据库，也无需文本分块。
- 检索结果可追溯，并能结合对话历史和领域知识等上下文。
- 支持本地和云端两种模式：本地模式处理文本型 PDF，云端模式提供托管索引、OCR、图像理解、元数据、文件夹和 MCP 服务器。
- 在 FinanceBench 金融文档问答基准上报告达到 98\.7% 的准确率。

## 适用场景

- 金融报告和 FinanceBench 类金融文档的问答。
- 法律文件和监管申报文件的检索。
- 技术手册、医学文献和学术教科书的搜索与分析。

projects.content:
## Overview

Paperclip is an open\-source app that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business\. It combines org charts, budgets, governance, and goal alignment in one deployment\. The platform is model\-agnostic, allowing you to bring any agent that can receive a heartbeat signal\. It looks like a task manager but under the hood handles agent coordination, cost tracking, and accountability\.

## Key Features

- Bring Your Own Agent: Any agent, any runtime, one org chart\. If it can receive a heartbeat, it's hired\.
- Org Chart: Hierarchies, roles, and reporting lines for agents, giving them a boss, title, and job description\.
- Goal Alignment: Every task traces back to the organization mission, so agents know what to do and why\.
- Cost Control: Monthly budgets per agent with hard limits; agents auto\-pause at 100% utilization\.
- Ticket System: Every conversation, tool call, and decision is traced with an immutable audit log\.
- Governance: Approve hires, override strategy, pause or terminate any agent at any time\.

## Use Cases

- Running autonomous AI organizations with multiple agents across business functions\.
- Coordinating many different agents (OpenClaw, Codex, Claude, Cursor) toward a common goal\.
- Monitoring costs and enforcing budgets for AI agent operations\.
- Managing autonomous businesses from a phone or dashboard with full audit trails\.

## Getting Started

- Run \`npx paperclipai onboard \-\-yes\` to start an interactive setup that walks you through installation and creating your first agent team\. No Paperclip account is required, and no agents are installed automatically\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Paperclip is a Node\.js server with a React UI\. It can run locally with an embedded Postgres database or be deployed remotely with your own Postgres\. Self\-hosting is supported\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Security of your agents is your responsibility; Paperclip provides governance controls but does not secure your agents\.
- Bring\-your\-own\-ticket\-system is not yet available; it is on the roadmap\.
- Agents auto\-pause when they hit their budget limit, which may interrupt work until you override\.

## 项目简介

Paperclip是一个开源应用，用于编排AI代理团队来运营业务。它在一个部署中整合了组织架构、预算、治理和目标对齐。平台与模型无关，允许你接入任何能接收心跳信号的代理。它看起来像任务管理器，但底层处理代理协调、成本跟踪和问责。

## 核心功能

- 自带代理：任何代理、任何运行时，一个组织架构。只要能接收心跳，就被录用。
- 组织架构：层级、角色和汇报关系，让代理有上级、职位和职位描述。
- 目标对齐：每项任务都追溯到组织使命，代理知道做什么和为什么。
- 成本控制：每个代理有月度预算和硬性限制；达到100%利用率时自动暂停。
- 工单系统：每次对话、工具调用和决策都有完整追踪和不可变审计日志。
- 治理：批准招聘、覆盖策略、随时暂停或终止任何代理。

## 适用场景

- 运行跨业务职能的多代理自主AI组织。
- 协调多种不同代理（如OpenClaw、Codex、Claude、Cursor）朝共同目标工作。
- 监控AI代理运营成本并执行预算。
- 从手机或仪表盘管理自主业务，并保留完整审计轨迹。

## 快速开始

projects.content:
## Overview

PaperPilot is a PDF and document toolkit written in Rust\. The same engine runs as an MCP server for coding agents, a CLI for batch workflows, a browser/WASM tool, a Tauri desktop app, and a local REST API\. It supports operations such as merging, splitting, OCR, compression, page layout, extraction, and security analysis\. Its stated design goal is local processing: files are processed on the machine or in the browser rather than uploaded to a cloud service\.

## Key Features

- One Rust core shared across MCP server, CLI, browser/WASM, desktop app, and local REST API surfaces\.
- PDF organization and layout: merge, split, rotate, delete, reorder, extract pages, booklet imposition, N\-up grids, and poster tiling\.
- Optimization and extraction: lossy compression, stream deduplication, structured text, detected Markdown tables, and pure\-Rust OCR\.
- Security and analysis tools: watermarking, signature validation and removal, PII scanning, deep sanitize, and malformed\-input fuzzing\.
- Office data conversion: Excel to JSON and Excel to CSV\.
- MCP\-compatible local stdio server for clients such as Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, Pi, Claude Desktop, and Cursor\.

## Use Cases

- Give coding agents and MCP clients local PDF merge, split, OCR, and compression tools\.
- Run batch or scripted document workflows through the CLI\.
- Use zero\-install browser tools for local PDF operations without uploading files\.
- Call document operations from Python, Node, or n8n through the local REST API\.

## Getting Started

- Download paperpilot\-mcp from Releases, add it to claude\_desktop\_config\.json under mcpServers\.paperpilot\.command, restart Claude, then try a prompt such as 'Merge these two PDFs and compress the result\.'
- Build from source with cargo build \-\-release \-p paperpilot\-cli \-p paperpilot\-mcp \-p paperpilot\-gateway\.
- For the desktop app, run pnpm install and pnpm tauri dev in apps/desktop\.
- Use CLI commands such as paperpilot merge \-\-inputs doc1\.pdf doc2\.pdf \-\-output merged\.pdf\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Rust 1\.75 or newer is required for source builds\.
- Node\.js and pnpm are required for the desktop app\.
- The project states no Chromium, C\+\+ runtime, or cloud calls are required\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The current documented feature set is v0\.6, which signals an early\-stage release\.
- The project emphasizes privacy by keeping document processing local to the user's machine\.
- Building the desktop app adds Node\.js and pnpm as external toolchain dependencies\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Paradev, formerly Superset, is an agentic IDE for running and orchestrating many coding agents in parallel\. It provides one workspace for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, or another CLI coding agent, with isolated Git worktrees, terminal sessions, diff review, browser previews, automations, remote access, and CLI, SDK, and MCP controls\.

## Key Features

- Parallel workspaces: each task gets its own Git worktree, branch, and terminals so multiple agents can work without overwriting each other's files\.
- Agent flexibility: use Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, or another CLI\-based coding agent while keeping existing subscriptions\.
- Built\-in review: inspect, comment on, and edit agent changes in the diff viewer, then commit and push when ready\.
- Browser previews and port detection: preview running dev servers in a browser pane with ports detected per workspace\.
- Automations: run agent sessions on a schedule or event, such as issue triage, changelog drafts, dependency bumps, and PR review\.
- Remote and scriptable control: use the iPhone and iPad app, Remote Access, CLI, TypeScript SDK, and MCP server to manage workspaces and agents\.

## Use Cases

- Run parallel agents across features, bug fixes, and refactors while monitoring status from one workspace\.
- Review and revise agent work by inspecting diffs, sending PR feedback to an agent, and previewing app changes\.
- Automate recurring chores such as issue triage, changelog drafts, dependency upgrades, and PR reviews on schedules or events\.
- Check on agents and review diffs away from the desk via iPhone or iPad, or connect another machine for remote workspaces\.

## Getting Started

- Download and install the desktop app for macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel) or the experimental Linux AppImage; Windows is not yet available\.
- Install Git; the GitHub CLI is optional and enables PR workflows\. The CLI can be installed with brew install paradevai/tap/superset\.
- Add a repository or clone one, create a workspace, choose a CLI agent, and describe a small change\.
- Inspect the patch in Changes, run relevant tests, and preview the app in the browser pane before committing\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app: macOS is the primary target; Linux x64 AppImage is experimental; Windows is not yet available\.
- Git is required; GitHub CLI is optional and enables PR workflows\.
- Mobile app requires Paradev Pro and iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later\.
- Remote Access to workspaces on your own computer requires keeping that host awake and online\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Worktrees isolate working files but do not sandbox processes or prevent merge conflicts\.
- Remote Access to workspaces on your own computer depends on keeping the host awake and online\.
- The mobile app requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later\.
- Repositories, worktrees, terminal output, and agent sessions stay on the machine, while cloud sync covers account and organization metadata only\.

- Multi\-provider support: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, Pi, and more via ACP\.

- Privacy\-first: no telemetry, tracking, or forced log\-ins\.

- Start work at your desk, check in from your phone\.

- Automate workflows via MCP, CLI, or TypeScript SDK\.

## Deployment & Requirements

projects.content:
## Overview

PDF Craft is a Python library and online service for converting scanned PDF books, research papers, and technical documents into editable Markdown or reader\-friendly EPUB\. It can also translate PDF and EPUB content, produce translated or bilingual EPUBs, and write translations back onto original PDF pages\. It recognizes body text, chapters, tables of contents, footnotes, tables, formulas, and images so content can be searched and edited beyond the scanned page\.

## Key Features

- Converts scanned PDFs into Markdown with text and image assets\.
- Creates EPUB output with book metadata and a table of contents for ebook readers\.
- Translates PDF and EPUB documents, with translation\-only and bilingual EPUB modes\.
- Recognizes body text, chapters, tables of contents, footnotes, tables, formulas, and images\.
- Supports remote OCR and local OCR configurations, including DeepSeek OCR, DeepSeek OCR 2, and Unlimited OCR\.
- Provides Python APIs and reusable \.pcex extraction files for later rendering or translation\.

## Use Cases

- Read scanned books on a phone or e\-reader with adjustable, reflowable text\.
- Convert research papers, textbooks, or lecture notes into Markdown for notes and excerpts\.
- Translate whole EPUB books and read the translation alongside the original\.
- Create translated PDFs by writing translated text back onto source pages\.

## Getting Started

- Use PDF Craft Online in a browser: upload a PDF, submit a conversion task, and download the result when ready; no Python, CUDA, or OCR provider setup is required\.
- For the Python library, install with python \-m pip install pdf\-craft using Python 3\.11–3\.13 and Poppler\.
- Configure a DeepSeek OCR\-compatible service, then call craft\.convert\_pdf\_to\_markdown("input\.pdf", "output\.md") for Markdown or craft\.convert\_pdf\_to\_epub("input\.pdf", "output\.epub") for EPUB\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Online conversion requires only a browser; no Python installation or OCR service setup\.
- Python with remote OCR requires Python, Poppler, a compatible OCR service URL, and credentials\.
- Python with local OCR requires an NVIDIA GPU, CUDA, sufficient VRAM, and model files, plus the pdf\-craft\[local\] extra\.
- Creating a translated PDF also requires Ghostscript and suitable local fonts\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Remote OCR depends on a configured external OCR service and credentials, and sends document pages to that service\.
- Even with local OCR, using a remote LLM for translation or table\-of\-contents analysis sends the corresponding content to that service\.
- Output quality depends on scan quality, page layout, and the OCR model, so a representative document should be checked before batch processing\.
- Online conversion cost is based on page count and selected processing mode\.
- Online processing time can vary with document size, layout complexity, and server traffic\.

projects.content:
## Overview

PDFMathTranslate translates scientific PDF documents while preserving their layouts, including formulas, charts, tables of contents, and annotations\. It provides command\-line, browser\-based GUI, Docker, and Zotero workflows, with support for multiple languages and translation services\.

## Key Features

- Preserves formulas, charts, table of contents, and annotations in translated PDFs\.
- Supports multiple languages and diverse translation services, including Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI\.
- Produces monolingual translated PDFs and bilingual dual PDFs\.
- Offers command\-line, interactive GUI, Docker, and Zotero plugin usage\.
- Includes experimental OCR for image\-only pages and an ultrafast mode for native\-text PDFs\.
- Provides Python and HTTP APIs for downstream development\.

## Use Cases

- Researchers and developers can translate scientific papers while retaining formulas, charts, and layout\.
- Readers can generate bilingual dual PDFs alongside monolingual translated PDFs\.
- Teams can run translation locally through the CLI or GUI, or deploy it with Docker\.
- Developers can integrate PDF translation into downstream Python or HTTP API applications\.

## Getting Started

- Install with pip install pdf2zh, or use uv tool install \-\-python 3\.12 pdf2zh\.
- Run pdf2zh document\.pdf to translate a local PDF; output files are generated in the current working directory\.
- Start the browser GUI with pdf2zh \-i and open http://localhost:7860/ if it does not open automatically\.
- Docker users can pull byaidu/pdf2zh and run it on port 7860\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.11 to 3\.12 is required for local Python installation\.
- Docker deployment uses byaidu/pdf2zh and exposes port 7860\.
- An alternative container image is available at ghcr\.io/byaidu/pdfmathtranslate\.
- The Windows app is distributed as a win64 zip; vc\_redist\.x64\.exe may be needed if the app does not open\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The AI model download can fail in some network environments\.
- Precise mode is experimental and requires the pdf2zh\_next submodule\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Pebrel (formerly Nebula) is a native desktop workspace that brings local shells, remote hosts, files, and AI command\-line tools together\. It is built with Rust and GPUI for Windows, macOS, and Linux and arranges terminals in tabs and splits so users can follow agent activity and read output without leaving the application\.

## Key Features

- Terminal tabs and draggable split panes with per\-pane working directories and saved workspace layouts\.
- SSH host management with saved hosts, SSH config aliases, proxy and jump\-host options, private\-key and keyboard\-interactive authentication, host\-key verification, and SFTP transfers\.
- AI CLI workflow support for Claude Code, Codex, and other recognized CLIs, with activity states, notifications tied to source panes, and captured answer reading\.
- Intelligent completion from Git repositories, project scripts, SSH config, and the filesystem, plus registered WSL distributions on Windows\.
- GPU\-accelerated GPUI interface with light and dark themes, opacity controls, eleven UI language choices, searchable settings, a command palette, and Lua configuration with validation and live reload\.
- Native Markdown document tabs and mathematical typesetting without a WebView\.

## Use Cases

- Managing local shells and remote SSH/SFTP sessions in one desktop workspace\.
- Running and monitoring Claude Code, Codex, or other AI CLIs in split panes with notifications and answer reading\.
- Using intelligent completions for Git branches, npm scripts, SSH aliases, WSL distributions, and filenames\.
- Reading Markdown documents and formulas natively alongside terminal work\.

## Getting Started

- Choose a package from the latest release\.
- On Windows, run the installer or extract the ZIP and launch pebrel\.exe while keeping the bundled directories together\.
- On Linux, install the DEB or make the AppImage executable\. On macOS, open the matching DMG and drag Pebrel into Applications\.
- For configuration, run pebrel config init \-\-language en\-US and pebrel config check\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows 10 1809\+ or 11 on x64; installer \.exe and portable \.zip packages are provided\.
- Linux Preview on x64 with glibc 2\.35\+; AppImage, \.deb, and portable \.tar\.gz packages are provided\.
- macOS Preview with deployment target 14\+ on Apple Silicon/arm64 or Intel/x64; \.dmg packages are provided\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: GPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Restoring an AI conversation after the process exits depends on a supported CLI and a usable session identity\.
- Image attachment previews for AI CLIs depend on the CLI itself\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Pele is a lightweight open source library developed for Obsidian that renders Mermaid diagrams to SVG\. It is synchronous, has no runtime dependencies, and uses CSS variables for colors and fonts\. Pele supports every diagram type built into Mermaid 12\.1\.0\.

## Key Features

- Renders Mermaid syntax to SVG and supports every diagram type built into Mermaid 12\.1\.0\.
- Themes diagrams with CSS variables for colors and fonts; color changes apply without re\-rendering\.
- Has zero runtime dependencies and a 230 kB gzip bundle, compared with 1\.6 MB for Mermaid\.js\.
- Adapts diagram layout to small screens and container width when mounted in a browser\.
- Provides render(), mount(), renderAsync(), and individual diagram registration for bundle control\.
- Escapes diagram text, filters links and styles, and limits source and output size\.

## Use Cases

- Render Mermaid diagrams in web apps by passing Mermaid syntax to render() and inserting the returned SVG\.
- Mount diagrams into browser elements with mount(), which reads fonts from CSS and adapts layout to container width\.
- Match an application or editor theme by setting CSS variables on the diagram or a parent element\.
- Render diagrams quickly in Obsidian and match the app theme\.

## Getting Started

- Install Pele with npm install pele, pnpm add pele, yarn add pele, or bun add pele\.
- Alternatively, load the browser build from a CDN with a script tag\.
- Import render from pele, pass Mermaid syntax to render(), and insert the returned svg into the page\.
- In a browser, use mount() to render into an element, read fonts from CSS, and adapt layout to the container width\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Install from npm, pnpm, yarn, or bun, or load Pele from a CDN in the browser\.
- The library has no runtime dependencies\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Pele targets Mermaid 12\.1\.0 syntax but uses its own layout and visual style, so output may differ from Mermaid\.js\.
- Handling untrusted diagrams requires following Pele's security guidance for errors and icons\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Phone Harness is an open\-source tool that lets Claude Code, Codex, or any agent control a real iPhone or Android phone\. Agents can tap, type, scroll, and read the screen through the phone interface, without jailbreak, Xcode, or installing an app on the phone\.

## Key Features

- Agents interact with real phone apps by tapping, typing, scrolling, and reading the screen\.
- iPhone control works through the Mac's iPhone Mirroring window, including in the background; Android control works over adb\.
- Uses Vision OCR or the phone's accessibility tree to see the screen, with real input events for actions\.
- Phone Harness Cloud offers hosted Android and iPhones, real phone numbers with eSIM, persistent logins, and multiple devices\.
- Integrations include CLI, MCP server, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw, with shared helpers across phones\.
- Cloud Android can start a fresh phone per session or a saved phone that keeps apps and logins; iPhone control can run over HTTPS\.

## Use Cases

- Test and use real mobile apps with an AI agent\.
- Message and call people through the phone interface\.
- Grab verification codes for 2FA\.
- Run agent\-driven tasks such as booking a ride or interacting with apps on hosted Android or iPhone devices\.

## Getting Started

- Send the setup prompt to a coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex to install or upgrade the phone\-harness CLI with uv on Python 3\.12 and register the skill\.
- Run phone\-harness doctor to check the phone setup\.
- For cloud phones, use phone\-harness cloud login, phone\-harness cloud ls, phone\-harness cloud start, and phone\-harness cloud stop\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- iPhone: macOS 15 or later, iPhone Mirroring paired to an iOS 18 or later iPhone, and Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions\.
- Android: adb and USB debugging on macOS, Linux, or Windows\.
- Cloud Android or iPhone: a Phone Harness Cloud account; cloud Android also needs adb\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Unlocking the iPhone pauses mirroring, and a PIN\-locked Android needs the user\.
- OCR sees text rather than icons; unlabeled controls need a screenshot and a vision\-capable model\.
- Multi\-touch, camera, Face ID, and DRM video are not supported\.
- Connecting the phone is always the user's responsibility\.
- Phone Harness Cloud is marked as an open beta\.

- 使用 Vision OCR 或手机的无障碍树查看屏幕，并通过真实输入事件执行操作。
- Phone Harness Cloud 提供托管的 Android 和 iPhone，支持带 eSIM 的真实手机号码、持久登录和多台设备。
- 集成方式包括 CLI、MCP 服务器、Hermes Agent 和 OpenClaw，各手机共享同一套辅助函数。
- Cloud Android 可按会话启动全新手机，或使用保留应用和登录状态的已保存手机；iPhone 控制可通过 HTTPS 运行。

## 适用场景

- 用 AI 智能体测试和使用真实移动应用。
- 通过手机界面给他人发消息和打电话。
- 获取用于双重验证的验证码。
- 在托管的 Android 或 iPhone 设备上执行智能体任务，例如预订行程或与应用交互。

## 快速开始

- 向 Claude Code 或 Codex 等编码智能体发送设置提示，以使用 uv 在 Python 3\.12 上安装或升级 phone\-harness CLI，并注册技能。
- 运行 phone\-harness doctor 检查手机设置。
- 对于云手机，使用 phone\-harness cloud login、phone\-harness cloud ls、phone\-harness cloud start 和 phone\-harness cloud stop。

## 部署与要求

- iPhone：macOS 15 或更高版本、与 iOS 18 或更高版本 iPhone 配对的 iPhone Mirroring，以及辅助功能和屏幕录制权限。
- Android：在 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 上使用 adb 和 USB 调试。
- Cloud Android 或 iPhone：需要 Phone Harness Cloud 账户；Cloud Android 还需要 adb。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

PhoneBox pairs a full\-screen Android app with a small desktop agent to turn an old Android phone into a customizable desk panel and touch control deck for Windows, Linux, and macOS\. It supports USB or Wi\-Fi connections, browser\-based layout editing, and local operation without PhoneBox accounts or cloud services\.

## Key Features

- Visual layout editor with more than 120 widgets and 30 templates on a 12 x 6 grid, multiple pages, portrait or landscape layouts, and Smart Stack\.
- PC monitoring for CPU, GPU, RAM, disks, network, ping, charts, GPU details, and process controls\.
- AI coding views for Claude, Codex, and Antigravity quotas, reset times, burn\-rate forecasts, local sessions, GitHub reviews and CI status, plus Claude Code permission Allow or Deny\.
- Control Deck touch controls for apps, URL shortcuts, key combinations, macros, application audio, microphone, media, OBS, tasks, dev servers, and display brightness\.
- USB or Wi\-Fi and Tailscale connectivity with a pinned certificate and paired key; PhoneBox has no accounts or telemetry and does not require a cloud service\.
- Webhook values and notifications plus Home Assistant controls and rules that can switch pages based on computer activity\.

## Use Cases

- Repurpose an old Android phone as a secondary desk display for system, network, and process monitoring\.
- Keep AI coding quotas, sessions, GitHub reviews, and Claude Code permission prompts visible while coding\.
- Use the phone as a touch control deck for media, OBS, apps, shortcuts, volume, microphone, and display brightness\.
- Push CI, script, or Home Assistant values and notifications through webhooks and automate page changes with rules\.

## Getting Started

- Install the desktop agent with the Windows PowerShell setup script or the Linux/macOS shell setup script; setup checks the download, installs adb if missing, and can install the phone app\.
- Connect an Android 5\+ phone over USB with USB debugging enabled, or enable Wi\-Fi in settings and pair a phone by scanning the QR code\.
- Open the local settings page, choose a template under Pages, drag and resize widgets, then save; Live preview shows unsaved edits with live data\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows 10/11 x64, Linux x64 or ARM64 with glibc, or macOS on Apple silicon or Intel for release builds\.
- An Android 5\+ phone, with Android 6 or later recommended; there is no iOS version\.
- USB requires a data cable and USB debugging; Wi\-Fi pairing works without either\. Release agents include \.NET, so the runtime does not need separate installation\.
- Widgets depend on host hardware, installed tools, and permissions; advanced Control Deck features have their own platform requirements, and there are no release builds for Windows ARM or musl Linux such as Alpine\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Windows release agents are currently unsigned while the SignPath Foundation application is pending\.
- The native audio and display controls are Windows\-only\.
- USB debugging should be authorized only on computers you trust\.

projects.content:
## Overview

PhotoCraft is an open\-source image editor and clean\-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop, rebuilt in pure Rust\. It is a native, offline application with layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors, brushes, and real layered PSD files\. It runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and Web\.

## Key Features

- Familiar menus, shortcuts, panels, and tools designed to be productive on day one\.
- Native GPU canvas rendering on Metal, Vulkan, DirectX 12, and WebGPU, with no Electron or web view\.
- Real layered files: opens and saves layered PSD and PSB documents\.
- Non\-destructive editing with 16 adjustment layers, more than 70 live\-preview filters, smart objects, smart filters, and layer styles\.
- On\-device selection tools for subjects and objects, with mask refinement that runs on your machine\.
- Serious color support for 8, 16, and 32\-bit documents in RGB, CMYK, Lab, and Grayscale, with ICC color management and soft proofing\.

## Use Cases

- Editing and retouching photos with layers, masks, adjustment layers, and live\-preview filters\.
- Compositing and design work using type, vector shapes, layer styles, and smart objects\.
- Opening and saving layered PSD and PSB documents for Photoshop\-compatible workflows\.
- Exporting images with format, quality, transparency, and scale controls, plus one\-click PNG quick export\.

## Getting Started

- Download a standalone installer for macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, or the self\-hosted web build\.
- Install the ArtCraft Launcher to install PhotoCraft and keep it updated alongside other Crafting Apps\.
- To build from source, install Rust 1\.90 or newer, clone the repository, and run cargo run \-\-release \-p photocraft\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Build from source requires Rust 1\.90 or newer\.
- Native builds are available for macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and Web\.
- Linux Flatpak is sandboxed and can be installed with flatpak install \-\-user\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- PhotoCraft is presented as an early\-alpha product\.
- The recommended installation route depends on the ArtCraft Launcher\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Pi is an AI agent toolkit that provides a unified LLM API, an agent loop, a terminal UI, and a coding agent CLI\. It includes multiple packages for building agents, telemetry, durable runtimes, and more\.

## Key Features

- Unified multi\-provider LLM API supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others
- Agent runtime with tool calling and state management
- Interactive coding agent CLI
- Terminal UI library with differential rendering
- Durable conversation, task, and document runtime

## Use Cases

- Building custom AI agents with tool calling and state management
- Using the interactive coding agent for development tasks
- Creating terminal\-based AI applications
- Implementing durable conversation and task systems

## Getting Started

- For development, run \`npm install \-\-ignore\-scripts\` to install dependencies, then \`npm run build\` to build all packages\. Use \`\./test\.sh\` to run tests, and \`\./pi\-test\.sh\` to run pi from sources\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Pi can be containerized or sandboxed for stronger boundaries\. See the containerization documentation for patterns using Gondolin, Docker, or OpenShell\. Standalone binaries can be built from release source archives using the provided build script\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Pi does not include a built\-in permission system; it runs with the permissions of the launching user and process\.
- New issues and PRs from new contributors are auto\-closed by default, with maintainers reviewing them daily\.

projects.content:
## Overview

PI\-Desktop is a local\-first desktop workspace for AI agents\. It brings projects, agents, models, plugins, and workflows into one persistent environment, supports Agent, Plan, and Goal work modes, and uses a plugin\-powered core to extend the agent, workspace, and platform\.

## Key Features

- Persistent workspace for projects, sessions, reviews, previews, and agents, with sessions that can continue across app launches\.
- Plugin system for commands, panels, floating widgets, work panel views, agent tools, completion, skills, themes, MCP servers, services, and a plugin message bus\.
- Agent orchestration through Subagents for independent work and Worker Sessions for longer parallel flows\.
- Model\-agnostic configuration with cloud models, local models, custom gateways, OpenAI\-compatible APIs, Ollama, and LM Studio, with per\-model settings and in\-session switching\.
- Local\-first data handling: projects, sessions, settings, and logs stay local by default; credentials use the OS keychain; model requests go directly to the configured provider\.
- Permission layer for privileged operations with Allow, Ask, and Deny decisions, so each session can have its own level of autonomy\.

## Use Cases

- Everyday AI\-assisted development where the agent reads code, edits files, runs commands, tests, and iterates\.
- Refactors and high\-risk changes where Plan mode reviews an implementation plan before execution\.
- Complex, long\-running work where Goal mode locks the objective and acceptance criteria and Worker Sessions run parallel workstreams\.
- Building plugin\-powered workspace products such as voice agents, DevOps consoles, GitHub workspaces, data assistants, or multi\-agent control centers\.

## Getting Started

- Download and install PI\-Desktop for macOS, Windows, or Linux\.
- Connect a model by configuring a provider\.
- Open a local project repository\.
- Start working in Agent, Plan, or Goal mode\.
- Developers can run from source with Node\.js \>=22\.19, pnpm \>=10, and a stable Rust toolchain; the documented flow is clone the repository, run pnpm install, build host\-core with cargo build \-p host\-core, run pnpm build:js, then pnpm dev\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, Windows x64, and Linux x64/ARM64\.
- Linux packages require glibc 2\.35\+, with common support for Ubuntu 22\.04\+, Debian 12\+, and Fedora 36\+\.
- Running from source requires Node\.js \>=22\.19, pnpm \>=10, and a stable Rust toolchain\.
- macOS releases are signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: LGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The 0\.21\.x release line is labeled Early Preview, indicating pre\-1\.0 maturity\.
- When a remote model is used, the context required for the request is sent directly to that provider\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Pi GPUI is a native desktop app for the pi coding agent on macOS and Linux\. It is written in Rust with GPUI and drawn with Metal on macOS and Vulkan on Linux, without Electron or a webview\. Each session starts your installed pi over RPC with the same models, extensions, skills, and sessions you use in the terminal\.

## Key Features

- Projects and pi sessions in a sidebar, with open sessions in tabs; each open session runs its own pi\.
- Session tree with keyboard navigation, branch summaries, and forking from any message\.
- Slash commands include extension commands, prompt templates, skills, and built\-ins such as /compact, /model, /name, /copy, and /export\.
- Paste or drop files and images into the message field; they appear as chips and are sent as paths\.
- A context ring shows context usage, compaction timing, cache metrics, plan limits, and token totals\.
- Extension questions appear inline as cards and can be answered by click, number, arrow keys, or typing\.

## Use Cases

- Working across several pi projects and sessions in one window while sessions keep running\.
- Trying a different direction from any message by forking without touching the original session\.
- Using pi's installed models, extensions, skills, and prompt templates through a native desktop interface\.
- Running plugins that add buttons, tools, or live views inside tool calls\.

## Getting Started

- Install pi 1\.4 or newer if it is not already installed, then log in to connect a subscription or API key\.
- On macOS, install with brew install \-\-cask bytesbay/tap/pi\-gpui or use the release zip\.
- On Linux, use the provided install script; it needs no root and places the app under ~/\.local\.
- Open Pi GPUI; it finds pi on its own and lists your projects and sessions\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires pi 1\.4 or newer within pi 1\.x installed on the machine\.
- macOS 13 or newer on Apple silicon\.
- Linux on x86\_64 and arm64, on X11 and Wayland, with glibc 2\.35 or newer and a Vulkan driver\.
- The app finds pi in PI\_EXECUTABLE, PATH, or your login shell\.
- Windows is not supported\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Pi GPUI requires a separately installed pi 1\.4 or newer within pi 1\.x\.
- The app does not install or update pi itself\.
- Linux support is beta and has limited reported testing\.
- Some extension UI surfaces are not displayed yet\.
- A pi session already running in a terminal is not detected by the app\.

projects.content:
## Overview

PilotDeck is an open\-source AI Agent workbench and agent operating system built around the WorkSpace concept\. It targets long\-running, multi\-project productivity work with isolated project files, memory, and skills, plus white\-box memory, smart routing, and always\-on background execution\.

## Key Features

- WorkSpace\-level isolation gives each project its own file system, memory store, and skill set so parallel projects do not interfere with each other\.
- White\-box memory makes memory generation, extraction, storage, and retrieval visible and editable, with Dream Mode consolidation and one\-click rollback\.
- Smart routing detects task difficulty and sends complex calls to flagship models while routing simpler work to lighter models to reduce token spend\.
- Always\-on background execution lets the agent keep discovering tasks, run long\-horizon monitors, and land deliverables as local files with a summary report\.
- MCP\-native extension and an open plugin architecture support MCP servers, custom tools and skills, lifecycle hooks, and custom memory providers\.
- An out\-of\-the\-box Web UI provides WorkSpace management, white\-box memory editing, and visualization of multi\-agent collaboration\.

## Use Cases

- Office document generation, including presentations and formal HTML white papers\.
- Data analysis and spreadsheet cleanup for attendance, reimbursement, asset ledgers, and anomaly marking\.
- Mini\-game and app development, including an iOS AR mini\-game and a low\-code AI engineering platform from scratch\.
- Multilingual podcast push and social media operations, including generating graphic push pages in multiple languages\.

## Getting Started

- Use the one\-line installer for macOS or Linux, or the PowerShell one\-line installer for Windows, then open the local URL printed by the command\.
- For development, clone the repository, enable corepack, install with the pinned pnpm workflow, configure a model provider, and start the UI in development or production mode\.
- Docker Compose is available as an alternative startup path when Docker is installed\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows 10 or later; macOS 14 or later; Linux packages for x64 and ARM64 in DEB or RPM formats\.
- The one\-line installer and source workflow require Node\.js 22\.13 or newer and below version 23 for the built\-in SQLite runtime\.
- A model provider configuration is needed, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, other OpenAI\-compatible endpoints, or local Ollama\.
- Docker Compose can be used when Docker is installed\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The one\-line installer depends on a specific Node\.js 22 runtime range for the built\-in SQLite runtime\.
- Demo media via Git LFS is optional; if Git LFS is unavailable or times out, installation continues without demo videos or GIFs\.
- Windows source compilation may require Visual Studio Build Tools with the C\+\+ workload and Python if prebuilt native packages are unavailable\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Pinky is a cross\-platform desktop app that lets MCP\-capable AI agents operate a real iPhone or Android phone while the user watches and approves risky steps\. Approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway rather than by agent instructions, and each run can be reviewed through step records, screenshots, and screen recordings that stay on the computer\.

## Key Features

- Controls Android 10 to 17 phones and iPhones or iPads on iOS 17\.4 or later from macOS, Windows, or Linux\.
- Connects MCP\-capable agents such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, and Cursor, or scripts, over stdio or HTTP\.
- Enforces approvals in the gateway for payments, trades, transfers, and other risky actions, with optional waiting for sends, orders, deletions, calls, installs, external links, and settings changes\.
- Makes banking, wallet, and password\-manager apps off\-limits by default and prevents typing into password or one\-time\-code fields\.
- On Android 13 and later, agents can work on a hidden second screen while the phone's own screen stays yours or stays off and locked\.
- Lets the user take over at any time, pausing the agent, and records each step with screenshots and a screen recording exportable as an HTML report\.

## Use Cases

- Ask an agent to perform phone actions such as opening Messages and drafting or sending a reply while you approve sensitive steps\.
- Review and approve payments, trades, or transfers that an agent attempts on a phone\.
- Test agent workflows against iOS Simulators or Android emulators when a physical phone is not available\.

## Getting Started

- Download and install Pinky from the latest release for macOS, Windows, or Linux\.
- Connect a phone by enabling the required debugging or developer mode, then follow Pinky's Add phone steps\.
- Open Settings › Agents and connect an MCP\-capable agent, or add Pinky's MCP server manually if the agent is not listed\.
- Ask the agent to do something on the phone and watch it work in Pinky's window, approving any steps that wait\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon or Intel, Windows 10 or 11 64\-bit, or a 64\-bit Linux system with Ubuntu 20\.04, Debian 11, or newer and GTK 3\.
- Android 10 to 17 phone and a USB cable; Wi\-Fi pairing needs Android 11 or later, and Android 10 can move to Wi\-Fi from USB\.
- iPhone or iPad on iOS 17\.4 or later and a USB cable for setup; iOS 17\.4 to 26 also needs the WebDriverAgent helper installed once from Xcode\.
- An MCP\-capable agent such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, or Cursor\.
- For iPhone setup, Apple's developer disk image, which comes with Xcode and is not shipped by Pinky\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Pinky is explicitly marked as pre\-alpha, so users should treat it as immature and expect some functionality to still need real\-world validation\.
- The Windows installer is currently unsigned, so SmartScreen may warn users during installation\.
- On iOS 17\.4 to 26, the WebDriverAgent helper installed with a free Apple ID expires every 7 days and must be reinstalled\.
- iPhone setup depends on Apple's developer disk image, which comes with Xcode and is not bundled by Pinky\.
- Below iOS 27, the WebDriverAgent helper connection is not encrypted, so security depends on the Wi\-Fi network\.

projects.content:
## Overview

PipesHub is an open\-source context layer for AI agents\. It connects business systems such as Slack, Microsoft 365, GitHub, Google Drive, and Notion, then provides permission\-aware search and trusted context with citations back to source documents\. It combines a knowledge graph, page ranking, connectors, agents, MCP, and SDKs for building on company knowledge while keeping deployment under your control\.

## Key Features

- Permission\-aware search across connected business systems, inheriting original document permissions so users only find content they can access\.
- Verified citations with page numbers, paragraph references, and direct links to source documents across connected systems\.
- Knowledge Graph and Page Ranking retrieval for structured reasoning across documents, entities, and metadata\.
- Connectors to Slack, Microsoft 365, GitHub, Google Drive, Notion, Jira, Salesforce, and other business systems\.
- No\-code agent builder plus Python, Go, and TypeScript SDKs, with an MCP server to expose the knowledge graph to tools such as Claude, Cursor, and VS Code\.
- Model\-agnostic configuration with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Ollama, or local LLMs\.

## Use Cases

- Answer employee questions over company knowledge with citations back to source documents\.
- Search across Drive, Slack, Jira, email, and other connected systems from one permission\-aware workspace\.
- Build department\-specific AI agents and event\-driven or scheduled workflows without code, or with Python, Go, and TypeScript\.
- Expose a company knowledge graph to external AI tools and developer products through MCP and SDKs\.

## Getting Started

- Try the hosted product for free, or deploy the open\-source edition on your own instance\.
- Start with the open\-source edition or contact the team for enterprise deployment\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Deployment options include cloud, VPC, on\-premise, and air\-gapped environments\.
- The platform can scale from a single Docker deployment to enterprise\-wide infrastructure\.
- Model access can use your own keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Mistral, or run fully local with Ollama\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.description: Pixeltable is an open-source Python library for AI apps on video, images, audio, and documents. Tables hold references and computed columns, so inserting a row runs transcription, model calls, and embeddings, indexing and serving in app.py.
projects.descriptionZh: Pixeltable 是面向视频、图像、音频和文档 AI 应用的开源 Python 库，也是智能体用来构建应用的多模态后端。它把数据库、编排与服务集中到一个 Python 文件：表保存文件引用与计算列，插入一行即可执行转写、模型调用和嵌入，并完成索引与服务。
projects.content:
## Overview

Pixeltable is an open\-source Python library for building AI applications that work with video, images, audio, and documents\. It organizes file references, computed work, indexes, and HTTP routes around tables, with the backend contained in one Python file, app\.py\.

## Key Features

- Tables can hold references to files next to ordinary columns; inserted paths or URLs stay in place, while uploaded or generated files go to a media store on local disk or in your own bucket\.
- Computed columns can sample frames, transcribe audio, call a model, or embed results; inserting a row runs the dependent work, stores outputs, and indexes them\.
- Embedding indexes are declared in a table's \_\_indexes\_\_, removing the need for a separate embed\-and\-upsert job\.
- Dependency tracking determines what to run and what to rerun after changes, so new uploads cost new work and prompt changes rerun only affected summaries\.
- A FastAPIRouter can expose insert and search routes, with the whole backend from tables to HTTP routes in one Python file, app\.py\.
- The same app\.py can run on Pixeltable Cloud, where pxt db update uploads the project to a hosted database and commands use a pxt:// URI\.

## Use Cases

- RAG and live APIs: documents are split into chunks, indexed for embeddings, and exposed through a search route without a re\-embed job when documents are added or removed\.
- Agents: tool calls are columns, so every call becomes a row that can be queried later\.
- Media pipelines: frames and transcripts are rows, ready to export for training\.
- Video search: uploaded videos are transcribed and summarized, and users can search the summaries\.

## Getting Started

- Install with pip install \-U 'pixeltable\[serve\]' on Python 3\.11 or newer\.
- Run pxt init before pxt schema update\.
- Run pxt schema update app\.py my\_app to create the table and its index\.
- Run pxt service update app\.py my\_app to start the service\.
- For Pixeltable Cloud, use pxt login and then the same commands with a pxt:// URI in place of my\_app\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.11 or newer\.
- Install the serve extra with pip install \-U 'pixeltable\[serve\]'\.
- pxt init is a prerequisite for pxt schema update\.
- Media can be stored on local disk or in your own bucket\.
- Pixeltable Cloud: pxt db update uploads the project to a hosted database, and the same two commands take its pxt:// URI in place of my\_app\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Pixeltable is not appropriate for users who do not want a schema\.
- Pixeltable is not a no\-code builder; it requires Python and acts as the data layer under the app\.
- Pixeltable does not choose models or judge answer quality, and users still face large video files and model API failures\.
- The project advises keeping an existing stack when it works and the integration glue is not costly\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Plannotator provides a review workspace for coding agents\. It intercepts plan approval, lets users annotate proposed plans and agent\-written code diffs, and returns structured feedback to the agent\. It runs locally and integrates with supported agents and editors\.

## Key Features

- Automatic plan review that hooks into an agent's plan approval step\.
- Inline annotations on plans, including comments, deletion marks, and replacements\.
- PR\-style code review for local diffs and GitHub or GitLab pull requests, with side\-by\-side or unified views and line\-level suggestions\.
- Version history with diffs between plan revisions and draft auto\-save that survives server crashes and restarts\.
- Local review data by default, with no usage telemetry or analytics\.
- Integrations for VS Code, Obsidian, Bear, GitHub PRs, and multiple coding agents\.

## Use Cases

- Review an agent's proposed plan before it executes and approve or deny it with structured feedback\.
- Review uncommitted agent\-written code in a diff viewer and stage or unstage files before committing\.
- Annotate markdown files, specs, folders, URLs, or an agent's last message and send feedback back\.
- Share review links with teammates using URL fragments or encrypted short links\.

## Getting Started

- Run the provided shell install script\.
- In Claude Code, add the plugin marketplace and install the Plannotator plugin\.
- Restart Claude Code to activate hooks\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs locally\.
- Integrates with supported agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Codex, and VS Code\.
- Works with any agent that supports plan mode\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Review data stays local by default, and the project states there is no usage telemetry or analytics\.
- Plannotator Workspaces, the hosted team layer, is listed as a waitlist offering\.
- Integration behavior depends on the host agent: hooks are available only where supported, with slash commands used where they fit\.

## Overview

Plannotator is a locally running tool for reviewing and annotating plans and code produced by AI coding agents\. It intercepts plan approval steps, provides a diff viewer for agent\-written code, and sends structured feedback back to the agent\. It also includes agent skills for HTML artifacts, wireframes, interactive prototypes, plans, and diagrams\.

## Key Features

- Plan review: automatically hooks into the agent's plan step so you can annotate plans before they run\.
- Code review: PR\-style diff viewer for local diffs or GitHub/GitLab PRs, with side\-by\-side or unified view and line\-level annotations\.
- Runs locally with review data staying local by default; no usage telemetry or analytics\.
- Version history saves every plan revision with diffs between versions, and draft auto\-save preserves annotations across server crashes and restarts\.
- Link sharing uses URL fragments for small shares and encrypted short links for larger and HTML shares\.
- Integrations for VS Code, Obsidian, Bear, and GitHub PRs, plus commands like /plannotator\-annotate, /plannotator\-review, and /plannotator\-last\.

## Use Cases

- Review an agent's proposed plan before execution: annotate inline, mark deletions, add comments or replacements, then approve or deny with structured feedback\.
- Review agent\-written code before committing: run /plannotator\-review to see uncommitted changes in a diff viewer, add line\-level suggestions, and stage or unstage files\.
- Share annotated plans and code feedback with a team using local data, link sharing, or the hosted Workspaces layer\.
- Annotate the agent's last message or any markdown, spec/plan, folder, or URL using /plannotator\-annotate or /plannotator\-last\.

## Getting Started

- Install Plannotator locally with: curl \-fsSL https://plannotator\.ai/install\.sh \| bash
- In Claude Code, add the marketplace with /plugin marketplace add backnotprop/plannotator, install with /plugin install plannotator@plannotator, then restart Claude Code to activate hooks\.
- Use /plannotator\-annotate \<file\|dir\|url\> to annotate any markdown, spec/plan, folder, or URL and send feedback\.
- Use /plannotator\-review \[PR\_URL\] for code review of local diffs or GitHub/GitLab pull requests\.
- Use /plannotator\-last to annotate the agent's last message\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs locally\.
- Integrates with Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Codex, and VS Code; works with any agent that supports plan mode\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Review data stays local by default, with no usage telemetry or analytics\.
- Link sharing uses URL fragments for small shares and encrypted short links for larger and HTML shares\.
- Draft auto\-save preserves annotations across server crashes and restarts\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Poki is an open\-source local MCP server and agent for controlling a real iPhone from a Mac\. It uses native touch events to operate real iOS apps and system interfaces without jailbreak or extra hardware\. Verified runs compile into routes, so similar tasks take a shorter path on repeat\.

## Key Features

- Poki Agent is an autonomous iPhone agent with self\-learning routes\.
- Poki MCP is a standard MCP server for iPhone control\.
- Verified runs compile into routes, making repeated tasks take a shorter path\.
- Integrations include Claude Code, Codex, iMessage, and Terminal, with Telegram marked coming soon\.
- Poki controls a real iPhone through a Mac with native touch events, without jailbreak or external hardware\.
- Poki MCP and Poki Agent are open source under AGPL\-3\.0\.

## Use Cases

- Add a shopping list from an iMessage conversation into Reminders\.
- Operate real iOS apps and system interfaces such as Xiaohongshu saved places, Maps directions, and WeChat sending\.
- Read Alipay bills, calculate category totals, and write the summary into Notes\.
- Search Trip\.com train options, stop before payment, and add the selected train to Calendar\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository, run \./bin/setup, then start the server with npm start\.
- Register the MCP server with claude mcp add \-\-scope user poki\-mcp \-\- node "$PWD/src/stdio\.mjs" for Claude Code, or codex mcp add poki\-mcp \-\- node "$PWD/src/stdio\.mjs" for Codex\.
- For Poki Agent, run npm ci \-\-prefix agent, add the bin directory to PATH, then run poki login and poki status\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Source setup requires macOS 15 or later, full Xcode, Rust, Node\.js 24\+, and ffmpeg\.
- The prebuilt macOS arm64 package requires Apple Silicon macOS, full Xcode, Node\.js 24\+, Python 3, and ffmpeg; Rust and \./bin/setup are not required\.
- For a physical iPhone, pair it with the Mac over USB first\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Poki acts on a real iPhone and can send messages or make payments when asked; screen contents are sent to the configured model service\.
- Automating third\-party apps and websites may violate their terms of service, so use with a given service is the user's decision\.
- Physical iPhone support has verified limits: only Chinese\-interface iPhones have been verified, portrait orientation only is supported, and some capabilities are unavailable\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Pomerado is an open\-source core integration minting harness that builds MCP integrations for websites, including sites without an API\. It turns a natural\-language task description into a deterministic integration by exploring the site, completing an example, and generalizing the interaction\. The integrations can work behind login and two\-factor authentication and are saved as source code that agents can call\.

## Key Features

- Builds MCP integrations from a natural\-language task description, without requiring a HAR file or recording\.
- Produces deterministic integrations intended to be faster and more reliable than computer use\.
- Works on sites behind login and two\-factor authentication\.
- Uses a real Chromium browser, with Guardian reviewing browser actions and the finished source during minting\.
- Saves integrations as owned source code with schemas, deployment metadata, and an MCP server entry\.
- Runs as a standard MCP stdio server exposing mint, get\_job, provide\_input, and cancel\_job tools\.

## Use Cases

- Create a read\-only integration that extracts information from a website without an API\.
- Create a write integration for tasks such as submitting a form or making a booking\.
- Connect websites behind login and two\-factor authentication to an agent through deterministic MCP tools\.
- Run each integration locally as its own MCP server for supported clients\.

## Getting Started

- Check the Node version with node \-\-version; Pomerado requires Node 24\.21 or a later Node 24 release\.
- Install Pomerado and Chromium with npx \-y \-p pomerado pomerado\-mcp \-\-help and npx \-y \-p pomerado playwright install chromium\.
- Configure an MCP client to run Pomerado as a standard MCP stdio server, using an absolute \-\-root path for integrations\.
- Set OPENAI\_API\_KEY in the server environment; minting uses OpenAI models, while running integrations makes no model request\.
- Ask the agent to mint an integration by naming the site, describing the task, and choosing read or write authority\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS or Linux\.
- Node 24\.21 or a later Node 24 release\.
- Chromium installed for the minter to drive\.
- An OpenAI API key for minting\.
- An MCP client that runs local servers, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, or Gemini CLI\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Minting depends on OpenAI models and requires an OpenAI API key\.
- Each mint has a bounded active\-work window of 20 minutes, excluding time spent waiting for user answers\.
- Sign\-in typing is limited to the site and configured sign\-in origins, and Pomerado does not check where the page's own scripts send typed data\.
- Canceling a job does not guarantee that an action already sent to a website did not take effect\.

- 将集成保存为自有源代码，包含模式、部署元数据和 MCP 服务器入口。
- 作为标准 MCP stdio 服务器运行，提供 mint、get\_job、provide\_input 和 cancel\_job 工具。

## 适用场景

- 创建只读集成，从没有 API 的网站提取信息。
- 创建写入集成，用于提交表单或进行预订等任务。
- 将登录和双重验证之后的网站通过确定性 MCP 工具接入智能体。
- 在支持的客户端中，将每个集成作为独立 MCP 服务器本地运行。

## 快速开始

- 使用 node \-\-version 检查 Node 版本；Pomerado 需要 Node 24\.21 或更高的 Node 24 版本。

- 配置 MCP 客户端，以标准 MCP stdio 服务器方式运行 Pomerado，并为集成使用绝对 \-\-root 路径。
- 在服务器环境中设置 OPENAI\_API\_KEY；铸造使用 OpenAI 模型，而运行集成不会发起模型请求。
- 让智能体铸造集成：说明站点、用自然语言描述任务，并选择 read 或 write 权限。

## 部署与要求

- macOS 或 Linux。
- Node 24\.21 或更高的 Node 24 版本。
- 为铸造器驱动安装 Chromium。
- 铸造需要 OpenAI API key。
- 可运行本地服务器的 MCP 客户端，例如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Claude Desktop 或 Gemini CLI。

projects.content:
## Overview

Spotify Portal AI Plugins brings Spotify Portal into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and pi\. It provides focused workflows for the Portal CLI covering authentication setup, catalog and documentation search, service briefings, diagnostics, and Portal action invocation\. The marketplace also includes shunt, a Claude Code plugin that routes I/O\-heavy agent work to AiKA modes through the Portal CLI actions registry\.

## Key Features

- Set up Portal CLI authentication for the current coding\-agent environment\.
- Run read\-only diagnostics to verify plugin, CLI, authentication, and action readiness\.
- Search the software catalog and technical documentation using natural language queries\.
- Generate concise service briefings with ownership, health, incident, and documentation details\.
- Discover and safely invoke Portal actions with built\-in help, dry\-run, and confirmation safeguards\.
- Create, run, check, and troubleshoot Fleetshift shifts, open PRs from completed runs, and stop a run on request\.

## Use Cases

- Searching a software catalog and technical documentation from an AI coding agent\.
- Producing concise operational service briefings with ownership, health, incident, and documentation details\.
- Verifying plugin, CLI, authentication, and action readiness before using Portal workflows\.
- Managing Fleetshift shifts and opening PRs from completed runs\.

## Getting Started

- In Claude Code, add the marketplace with claude plugin marketplace add spotify/portal\-ai\-plugins, install portal@portal, optionally install shunt@portal, start a new session, and run /portal:setup\.
- In Codex, add the marketplace with codex plugin marketplace add spotify/portal\-ai\-plugins, open /plugins, install Spotify Portal, start a new task, and ask to set up Spotify Portal\.
- In Cursor, register the spotify/portal\-ai\-plugins repository in the Cursor team marketplace, then install Spotify Portal from Cursor Settings → Plugins\.
- In pi, run pi install git:github\.com/spotify/portal\-ai\-plugins, start a new session, and run /skill:setup\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The workflows invoke the upstream CLI through npx @spotify/portal\-cli \<command\>\.
- Setup verifies the required auth, actions, owner, search, and service commands before proceeding\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The plugin workflows depend on the upstream Portal CLI invoked with npx\.
- The shunt plugin is currently available only in Claude Code\.

projects.content:
## Overview

PPT Master is an open\-source workflow, or skill, for agent\-capable AI tools that generates natively editable PowerPoint decks from documents or topics\. It produces real PowerPoint objects such as shapes, transitions, animations, data\-backed charts and tables, and audio narration from speaker notes rather than flat images\. It also supports templates, reuse of existing \.pptx files, and multiple generation routes\.

## Key Features

- Generates natively editable PPTX with real PowerPoint shapes, slide masters, and layouts, not flat images\.
- Accepts PDF, DOCX, URL, Markdown, images, and other document formats as source material\.
- Supports native transitions, animations, data\-backed charts and tables, and audio narration from speaker notes\.
- Works with free design, structured templates, and your own \.pptx templates\.
- Can distill reusable brand, style, layout, and deck templates from references\.
- Can fill an existing \.pptx with new content while preserving its design and unchanged pages\.

## Use Cases

- Creating a deck from a PDF or report placed in the projects directory\.
- Turning a topic or pasted text into a PowerPoint presentation directly in an AI chat\.
- Reusing an existing \.pptx template or brand deck for new content\.
- Adding native charts, tables, formulas, notes, animations, or narration to a finished deck\.

## Getting Started

- Install Python 3\.10\+, clone or download the project, run pip install \-r requirements\.txt, open the project folder in an agent\-capable AI tool, place source files in projects/, and ask the AI to create a deck from a chosen file or pasted content\. The project notes that no coding

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10\+ and an agent\-capable AI tool that can read and write files, execute commands, and sustain multi\-turn conversation\. Install dependencies with pip install \-r requirements\.txt\. Pandoc is optional and only needed for legacy document formats such as \.doc, \.odt, \.rtf,

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project states that the model sets the ceiling, so output quality depends on the chosen model\.
- The tool is intended to remove tedious work, but users should not expect a finished, perfect deck in one shot\.
- Privacy: apart from AI model communication, the pipeline runs locally on the user's machine\.
- Capability boundary: SmartArt is intentionally omitted\.

projects.content:
## Overview

PR\-Agent is a community\-maintained, open\-source AI\-powered code review agent\. It automates pull request descriptions, reviews, improvements, and free\-text Q&A, and can be invoked through PR comments, webhooks, CI, or the terminal\. It supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, and Gitea\.

## Key Features

- Describes, reviews, and improves pull requests through commands such as /describe, /review, and /improve\.
- Answers free\-text questions about a pull request with /ask and supports issue\-scoped similar issue discovery with /similar\_issue\.
- Works with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, and Gitea\.
- Runs from PR comments, webhooks, GitHub Actions, Docker, self\-hosted deployment, or the CLI\.
- Supports multiple AI models through LiteLLM, including OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, and Mistral\.
- Uses a PR Compression strategy for small and large PRs and allows JSON\-based prompt customization\.

## Use Cases

- Automate first\-pass pull request reviews and reviewer guidance\.
- Generate or update pull request descriptions\.
- Suggest code improvements from a PR comment or the command line\.
- Answer questions about a pull request and find similar issues\.

## Getting Started

- For GitHub, add a workflow that uses the\-pr\-agent/pr\-agent@main with OPENAI\_KEY and GITHUB\_TOKEN secrets\.
- For local CLI use, install pr\-agent\[github\], set OPENAI\_KEY, and run pr\-agent with \-\-pr\_url and the pull request URL, followed by review\.
- For a Docker quick start, run pragent/pr\-agent:latest with OPENAI\_\_KEY and GITHUB\_\_USER\_TOKEN\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A terminal or Docker quick start requires an OpenAI key and a GitHub token\.
- Git provider SDKs are optional extras; install the one for your provider or pr\-agent\[all\] for all integrations\.
- Docker releases 0\.34\.2 and later are published under pragent/pr\-agent\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project describes itself as a community\-maintained legacy project of Qodo, separate from Qodo's primary AI code review offering\.
- Older releases remain available in the legacy codiumai/pr\-agent namespace as a frozen archive, and no new images are pushed there\.
- /help\_docs is temporarily disabled since v0\.36\.1 pending a fix for a credential\-exposure issue\.
- When self\-hosting with an OpenAI API key, data handling is between the user and OpenAI\.

projects.name: Prism
projects.tagline: Fast, free, open-source download manager
projects.taglineZh: 快速、免费、开源的下载管理器
projects.description: Prism is a free, open-source download manager for Windows, macOS and Linux that uses up to 32 connections per file, captures browser downloads and videos, and supports crash-safe resume.
projects.descriptionZh: Prism 是一款适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的免费开源下载管理器，可作为 IDM 的替代方案；每个文件最多使用 32 个连接，可接管浏览器下载、视频与 MP3，支持 BT 种子和崩溃安全续传。
projects.content:
## Overview

Prism is a free, open\-source download manager for Windows, macOS and Linux\. It splits files across multiple connections, integrates with browsers to catch downloads and videos, resumes interrupted downloads safely, and adds features such as torrents, scheduled queues and Hugging Face model downloads\.

## Key Features

- Multi\-connection engine splits files across up to 32 connections, respects per\-host limits and backs off politely\.
- Crash\-safe resume flushes data to disk before progress is saved and checks ETag or Last\-Modified when resuming\.
- Browser integration captures downloads and videos, with rules by file type, MIME and size\.
- Video downloads work through yt\-dlp on 1000\+ sites, with MP4 up to 8K HDR or audio\-only formats, plus subtitles, chapters and SponsorBlock\.
- Hugging Face model downloading selects the needed files, supports gated and private models with an access token, and verifies SHA\-256\.
- Queues and scheduler give each queue its own concurrency, speed limit and schedule, with post\-completion actions such as sleep or shutdown\.

## Use Cases

- Speed up large downloads from servers that throttle each connection\.
- Capture downloads and videos from the browser and hand them to Prism\.
- Download Hugging Face models and verify files against listed SHA\-256 checksums\.
- Schedule queues with their own concurrency, speed limits and start times\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Prism app for Windows, macOS or Linux\.
- On first start, Prism opens with a short welcome tour\.
- After installing the app, add the browser extension so Prism can catch downloads and videos\.
- On Windows, use More info then Run anyway if SmartScreen appears; on macOS, allow Prism once if Gatekeeper blocks it\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11, 64\-bit\.
- macOS 11 Big Sur or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel\.
- 64\-bit Linux, with deb, rpm or AppImage builds\.
- Browser extension support includes Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Helium, Firefox and Zen\.
- For video features on AppImage, install ffmpeg from your distribution\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper may warn on first run because builds are not signed with paid certificates\.
- There is no Flatpak yet, and sandboxed Flatpak browsers cannot run the native helper needed for full browser integration\.
- Video downloads rely on external tools that Prism installs and verifies\.
- Prism states it has no telemetry, ads or account, and the extension communicates only with the local app\.

## 适用场景
