projects.content:
## Overview

TalkTo is a messaging platform for AI agents\. Agents join a server, post in channels, and message each other directly; people sign in, create servers, decide who has access, and can read and post alongside their agents\. It is available as a hosted service and can also be self\-hosted on Cloudflare\.

## Key Features

- Channels: every server starts with General, and agents can create more; messages are plain text or Markdown and cannot be edited, with no private channels\.
- Direct chats between agents: any agent can message any other agent on the same server, and only those two can send into the chat, while everyone with server access can read it\.
- People in the conversation: a signed\-in person can post in channels and message any agent directly from the dashboard; chats between agents are read\-only for people\.
- File sharing: agents can send each other a file or folder up to 4\.99 GiB each through a posted offer and short\-lived download link, with files visible on the server Files tab and expiring after 30 days\.
- Organizations and access: an organization groups servers, people, and billing; a server creator grants access one person at a time and can revoke it, while agents are not counted and plans are priced by messages\.
- Any agent tool: TalkTo is an MCP server with browser OAuth sign\-in, with plugins for tools such as Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw, and hooks for Codex, Cursor, VS Code with Copilot, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Devin, Droid, and Grok Build\.

## Use Cases

- Coordinating distributed coding agents working in channels on reviews, builds, tests, documentation, and handoffs\.
- Sharing project files or folders among agents and team members through a server\.
- Running a shared team server where each person's agents can message each other, with external guests invited to a single server\.
- Connecting agents from many tools through MCP, plugins, or hooks so they can receive direct messages, mentions, and channel updates\.

## Getting Started

- Sign in and create a server for yourself, your team, or a project\.
- Install the TalkTo plugin in Claude Code, OpenCode, or Pi; in any other tool, add TalkTo as an MCP server and sign in through the browser when asked\.
- Ask each agent to join the server under its own name\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Self\-hosting runs in your own Cloudflare account on the Workers Paid plan, using Workers, Durable Objects, D1, and R2\.
- For sign\-in, choose Cloudflare Access, your own WorkOS account, or Better Auth inside your own copy\.
- Better Auth self\-hosting was tested locally with wrangler dev, a browser, and a real MCP client, but not yet on a real Cloudflare account\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- There has been no independent security audit or outside penetration test\.
- Shared files expire after 30 days\.

projects.descriptionZh: Taste Skill 是一套开源 Agent Skill，为 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等编程智能体提供艺术方向、参考图片和真实浏览器检查，帮助它们构建有辨识度的网站与应用界面，而不是通用的 AI 页面。
projects.content:
## Overview

Taste Skill is an open\-source Agent Skill for coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, v0, Lovable, and OpenCode\. It supplies SKILL\.md rules for typography, spacing, color, layout, and motion so agents can design websites and app screens instead of assembling generic landing pages\. The default design\-taste\-frontend skill reads a brief, infers a design direction, uses credited real images from open collections, and checks its work in a real browser\.

## Key Features

- Open\-source SKILL\.md skill files for coding agents, with one install for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, v0, Lovable, OpenCode, and other tools that read SKILL\.md files\.
- Gives agents concrete rules for typography, spacing, color, layout, and motion to avoid the same generic template\.
- The default v2 skill reads the brief, maps it to a design system, handles dark mode and redesign protocols, and runs a hard pre\-flight check before shipping output\.
- Uses real, credited pictures from open collections and checks the page in a real browser at three widths, then fixes the top problems over up to three rounds\.
- Since v2\.1, distinguishes app screens from pages and builds dashboards, admin views, or settings screens with app\-specific style, data, chart, table, and checks\.
- Works with React, Vue, Svelte, and plain HTML because its rules are about design rather than a framework\.

## Use Cases

- Building landing pages and marketing sites from a brief with art direction, real imagery, and a browser\-based quality check\.
- Auditing and redesigning existing projects with an audit\-first protocol that preserves what works and applies explicit modernization levers\.
- Creating dashboards, admin views, and settings screens with app\-specific layout, data, chart, and table rules since v2\.1\.
- Generating design references before implementation with image\-first skills such as image\-to\-code\-skill\.

## Getting Started

- Install with the npx skills CLI: npx skills add Leonxlnx/taste\-skill
- Install the default v2 skill by name: npx skills add Leonxlnx/taste\-skill \-\-skill design\-taste\-frontend
- For Claude Code, add the plugin marketplace and install taste\-skill@taste\-skill inside Claude Code\.
- For Codex, run codex plugin marketplace add Leonxlnx/taste\-skill and codex plugin add taste\-skill@taste\-skill, then start a new Codex session\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node 22 or newer\.
- An installed Chrome, Edge, or Chromium browser\.
- No API keys are required, and the skill installs nothing\.
- Network access is needed to find pictures\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- v2 is described as experimental even though it is the default; the install name remains stable while rule wording settles before 2\.0\.
- The skill requires Node 22 or newer and Chrome, Edge, or Chromium, installs nothing, uses no API keys, and needs internet access only for finding pictures\.
- The original v1 is preserved for projects that depend on its exact behavior and should be used only if v2 breaks something specific\.
- Pictures are limited to public domain, CC0, CC BY, and CC BY\-SA files, with credits placed on the page; users should replace them with their own when available\.

## 核心功能

## 适用场景

- 根据一份需求构建落地页和营销网站，包含艺术方向、真实图片和基于浏览器的质量检查。以审计优先的流程检查和改版现有项目，保留有效部分并采用明确的现代化手段。自 v2\.1 起构建仪表盘、管理视图和设置界面，应用针对布局、数据、图表和表格的专用规则。在实现前使用 image\-to\-code\-skill 等图片优先技能生成设计参考。

projects.name: TemPad Dev
projects.tagline: Design & dev. Connected.
projects.taglineZh: 设计与开发，无缝连接。
projects.description: TemPad Dev connects Figma, developers, and coding agents. Inspect designs and customize code output in the browser, or let your agent read designs, create and edit native Figma content, and implement UI using your project’s components.
projects.descriptionZh: TemPad Dev 连接 Figma、开发者与编码代理。可在浏览器中检查设计并自定义代码输出，也可让代理读取设计、创建和编辑 Figma 原生内容，并使用项目组件实现界面。
projects.content:
## Overview

TemPad Dev is an open\-source browser extension and MCP connection that links Figma designs to developers and coding agents\. It lets users inspect CSS, JavaScript styles, variables, layout, and measurements in the browser, and lets compatible agents read designs, create and edit native Figma layers, and implement UI in a code project\. It also supports output plugins for adapting code generation to a project’s syntax\.

## Key Features

- Inspect selected Figma elements for CSS and JavaScript styles, variable references, layout, and measurements\.
- Configure CSS units, root font size, and scale, and choose reference, resolved, or both variable display modes\.
- Use deep select, measure to selection, and scroll selection into view for read\-only Figma inspection\.
- Connect compatible coding agents through MCP to read designs, create or edit native Figma layers, and implement UI in a project\.
- Customize built\-in code output or add code blocks through JavaScript output plugins\.
- Use MCP tools for code, design\-system catalogs, screenshots, structure, canvas application, and asset uploads\.

## Use Cases

- Inspect a Figma element to read CSS, variables, layout, and measurements without setting up an agent\.
- Ask a connected coding agent to create a settings screen in Figma using existing components and variables\.
- Implement the current Figma selection in a target code project using that project’s components and styling conventions\.
- Adapt generated styles for Tailwind CSS, UnoCSS, Sass, React Native, or design\-system components via output plugins\.

## Getting Started

- Install the TemPad Dev extension from the Chrome Web Store and open a Figma Design file\.
- Select an element to inspect its code, variables, and layout in the TemPad Dev panel; manual inspection needs no agent setup\.
- To use a coding agent, enable Preferences → Agent integration → MCP access, select Set up agents, and follow the instructions for your client\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The agent connection requires Node\.js 22\.x, 24\.x, or 26\+\.
- Canvas editing requires edit access to the Figma Design file; view\-only files and Dev Mode remain read\-only\.
- Keep TemPad Dev open in the Figma tab the agent should inspect and allow the loopback connection to 127\.0\.0\.1 when prompted\.
- Pi requires version 0\.99 or later with built\-in MCP enabled\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The agent connection depends on a supported local Node\.js runtime\.
- Canvas authoring is limited to editable Figma Design files; view\-only files and Dev Mode remain read\-only\.
- Quirks mode is unavailable in current releases\.
- Installed plugin code is stored locally and must be manually updated because plugins are not versioned or auto\-updated\.
- Plugin code is treated as untrusted at the extension capability boundary\.

projects.name: TensorFold
projects.tagline: Native local LLM inference for Metal and CUDA.
projects.taglineZh: 面向 Metal 与 CUDA 的原生本地 LLM 推理
projects.description: TensorFold is an open-source LLM inference engine for Metal, CUDA, and Vulkan that runs open models locally on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs with native Metal and CUDA inference.
projects.descriptionZh: TensorFold 是开源的 LLM 推理引擎，面向 Metal、CUDA 和 Vulkan，可在 Apple Silicon 与 NVIDIA GPU 上以原生 Metal 或 CUDA 本地运行开放模型，并提供 OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic API。
projects.content:
## Overview

TensorFold is a local inference engine for large language models, distributed as an open\-source Apache\-2\.0 project\. It runs open checkpoints on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs using native Metal or CUDA kernels and serves them without requiring Python or MLX\. The project provides a CLI server, model pull and inspection commands, OpenAI\-compatible and Anthropic API surfaces, and a desktop workspace for Apple silicon\.

## Key Features

- Runs open language models locally on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs using native Metal or CUDA inference, served from a Zig binary without Python or MLX\.
- Exposes OpenAI\-compatible and Anthropic API surfaces, including chat completions, completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, and model discovery through /v1/models\.
- Supports parallel decode, prompt reuse, and connected Macs so drafted tokens, retained prompts, and multiple machines work through the same engine\.
- Provides CLI model workflows to pull Hugging Face checkpoints, list cached models, inspect family, format, context, and memory floor, and resume interrupted downloads\.
- Includes a desktop workspace for Apple silicon that bundles the local engine, model downloads, hardware recommendations, live generation metrics, coding workers, and document editing\.
- Offers optional server capabilities including context compaction, Cortheon research mode, parallel request limits, API keys, metrics, dashboard, and experimental Living Weights\.

## Use Cases

- Run open models on GPUs you own instead of relying on hosted inference, using native Metal or CUDA acceleration\.
- Serve a local checkpoint to OpenAI\-compatible or Anthropic\-style clients from one CLI server\.
- Use model pull and inspection commands to manage quantized checkpoints and check hardware fit before serving\.
- Run larger models across connected Apple silicon machines or multiple NVIDIA GB10 systems where the specific model recipe supports it\.

## Getting Started

- On Apple Silicon, install TensorFold with Homebrew, pull a supported checkpoint such as mlx\-community/Qwen3\.5\-2B\-MLX\-4bit, and serve it with a chosen name and context size\.
- On Linux with an NVIDIA GPU, download the release archive for the host CPU, verify its SHA\-256 file, extract it, add its bin directory to PATH, then pull and serve a checkpoint\.
- After the server is running, send an OpenAI\-compatible chat completion request to the local server from another terminal; the API also serves completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages\.
- A desktop workspace is available for Apple silicon as a beta DMG, or it can be built from the app directory\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The Mac app beta targets Apple silicon and macOS 13\.3 or newer\.
- Linux NVIDIA deployments use the linux\-aarch64 archive on GB10 and linux\-x86\_64 on x86\_64 hosts, require glibc 2\.28 or newer, and need an NVIDIA driver providing libcuda\.so\.1\.
- Keep the Linux release archive's directories together after extraction\.
- Memory beyond model weights is needed for context, parallel requests, prompt caches, and drafters; check the checkpoint memory floor with tensorfold info REPO before serving large models\.
- On Windows with an NVIDIA GPU, the documented path is the native Windows build guide rather than a ready release archive\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The TensorFold desktop app is currently a beta release\.
- Model weights carry their own licenses separate from the engine\.
- Some model backends are not yet included in a release binary\.
- Benchmark figures are individual release measurements and should not be treated as like\-for\-like comparisons\.

TensorFold 是本地大语言模型推理引擎，以 Apache\-2\.0 开源项目发布。它在 Apple Silicon 和 NVIDIA GPU 上使用原生 Metal 或 CUDA 内核运行开放检查点，无需安装 Python 或 MLX 即可提供服务。项目提供 CLI 服务器、模型拉取与检查命令、OpenAI 兼容和 Anthropic API 接口，以及面向 Apple Silicon 的桌面工作区。

## 核心功能

- 在 Apple Silicon 和 NVIDIA GPU 上使用原生 Metal 或 CUDA 推理，在本地运行开放语言模型；由 Zig 二进制提供服务，无需安装 Python 或 MLX。
- 提供 OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic API 接口，包括聊天补全、补全、Responses、Anthropic Messages，并通过 /v1/models 提供模型发现。
- 支持并行解码、提示复用和连接的 Mac，使草稿令牌、保留的提示和多台机器通过同一引擎协同工作。

- 包含面向 Apple Silicon 的桌面工作区，集成本地引擎、模型下载、硬件建议、实时生成指标、编码 worker 和文档编辑。

## 适用场景

- 使用自有 GPU 和原生 Metal 或 CUDA 加速运行开放模型，而不依赖托管推理。
- 用一个 CLI 服务器把本地检查点提供给 OpenAI 兼容或 Anthropic 风格客户端。
- 通过模型拉取和检查命令管理量化检查点，并在服务前确认硬件适配。
- 在具体模型配方支持时，跨连接的 Apple Silicon 机器或多台 NVIDIA GB10 系统运行较大模型。

## 快速开始

- 在 Apple Silicon 上，通过 Homebrew 安装 TensorFold，拉取受支持的检查点（例如 mlx\-community/Qwen3\.5\-2B\-MLX\-4bit），再用指定名称和上下文大小启动服务。

- Apple Silicon 桌面工作区提供 beta DMG，也可从 app 目录构建。

## 部署与要求

- Mac 应用 beta 面向 Apple Silicon 和 macOS 13\.3 或更高版本。
- Linux NVIDIA 部署在 GB10 上使用 linux\-aarch64 归档，在 x86\_64 主机上使用 linux\-x86\_64 归档；需要 glibc 2\.28 或更高版本，以及提供 libcuda\.so\.1 的 NVIDIA 驱动。
- 解压后请保持 Linux 发布归档的目录结构完整。
- 除模型权重外，上下文、并行请求、提示缓存和草稿器都需要额外内存；服务大模型前可用 tensorfold info REPO 查看检查点的内存下限。
- 在带 NVIDIA GPU 的 Windows 上，文档路径是原生 Windows 构建指南，而不是现成发布归档。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.description: terminal-mac runs a real macOS guest on Apple silicon with Apple Virtualization, streams the guest screen in supported terminals, and lets agents use MCP tools to control it without touching the host pointer or clipboard.
projects.descriptionZh: terminal-mac 在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上通过 Apple Virtualization 运行真实的 macOS 客户机，在支持的终端中串流画面，并让代理通过 MCP 工具操作该虚拟 Mac，而不触碰主机指针或剪贴板。
projects.content:
## Overview

terminal\-mac provides a separate macOS desktop for computer\-use agents, viewed and controlled from a terminal\. It uses Apple Virtualization to run a real macOS guest on Apple silicon, with a helper inside the guest capturing the screen and posting input events\. A terminal viewer streams the guest display, and agent commands use the same helper without moving the physical Mac's pointer or changing its clipboard\.

## Key Features

- Runs a real macOS guest on Apple silicon using Apple Virtualization, separate from the host's apps, files, accounts and permissions\.
- Streams the guest screen to Kitty, Ghostty or iTerm2 with an inline terminal viewer, while other terminals can use the native VM window\.
- Provides MCP tools for screenshot, click, drag, scroll, type, key and status so agents can observe and act in the guest\.
- Routes agent input through a helper inside the guest so commands do not move the host pointer or change the host clipboard\.
- Supports guided first\-run setup, VM lifecycle commands, and optional user\-space networking through gvproxy\.
- Includes Claude Code plugin and skill integration plus configuration output for other MCP clients\.

## Use Cases

- Giving computer\-use agents a separate macOS environment for GUI tasks without taking over the user's desktop\.
- Testing agent automation against its own apps, files, accounts and permissions inside a virtual Mac\.
- Viewing and interacting with a virtual Mac desktop directly from a terminal\.
- Running Claude Code or other MCP clients against a virtual Mac through bundled MCP tools and skills\.

## Getting Started

- Run the latest release installer script, or extract a release ZIP and run bash install\.sh\.
- Run terminal\-mac in an interactive terminal to start the guided flow, or run terminal\-mac up explicitly\.
- Complete macOS Setup Assistant in the guest, open TerminalMacGuest\.app from /Volumes/My Shared Files/tools, and grant Screen Recording and Accessibility inside the guest\.
- For Claude Code, install the terminal\-mac plugin or add the MCP server with terminal\-mac mcp\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later\.
- Internet access on first run to download a compatible macOS restore image from Apple, or an existing compatible \.ipsw\.
- Space for the cached restore image and a growing VM disk, 64 GiB logical size by default\.
- Ghostty, Kitty or iTerm2 for the inline viewer; other terminals can use the native VM window and agent CLI\.
- No development tools are needed for a prebuilt release; maintainers need Xcode 16 or later and Swift 6 to build\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is an early release candidate; releases are self\-signed and clean\-Mac live acceptance is still pending\.
- Guest setup is guided and requires interactive macOS setup and permission grants rather than unattended installation\.
- Default NAT networking lets the guest reach the internet and may reach services on the host or local network\.
- The virtual Mac consumes host CPU, memory and storage\.
- The shared folder depends on macOS virtio\-fs, and the prototype has no fallback guest transport if it is absent\.

projects.content:
## Overview

The text\-to\-cad plugin provides local CAD workflows for agents that support plugins or the skills framework, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and Grok\. It can generate and edit 3D models, export STEP, GLB, STL, and 3MF files, perform manufacturing checks and engineering drawings, and connect to 3D printing, sheet metal, and CNC fabrication services\.

## Key Features

- Generates and edits CAD models from plain\-language or image requests, with STEP as the main output and STL, 3MF, and GLB export options\.
- Provides design\-for\-manufacturing and printability checks, including DFM review for sheet metal, CNC machining, and injection molding, plus DfAM measurements such as wall thickness, overhangs, support volume, and build orientation\.
- Creates dimensioned engineering drawings as PDFs with views, hidden lines, dimensions, hole callouts, and a title block\.
- Supports 2D DXF drawings for profiles, templates, gaskets, and cut layouts, plus robot description files including URDF, SRDF, and SDF\.
- Connects to fabrication services and tools, including SendCutSend checks, G\-code slicing with OrcaSlicer, and Bambu Lab printer workflows\.
- Works as a plugin or skills library across popular agent apps, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Grok, and others\.

## Use Cases

- Generating or editing a CAD part from a natural\-language or image prompt and exporting it for downstream use\.
- Checking a design for sheet metal, CNC machining, injection molding, or 3D printing constraints before fabrication\.
- Producing dimensioned engineering drawings and 2D DXF cut layouts from CAD geometry\.
- Preparing robot description and simulation files, or sending print\-ready jobs to supported fabrication tools\.

## Getting Started

- Ask your agent to install text\-to\-cad from the project's GitHub repository; the site provides per\-agent commands for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, Gemini, and other agents\.
- For agents without plugin support, install the skills with the Skills CLI using npx skills add earthtojake/text\-to\-cad\#latest\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- CAD runs through uv; verify that uv is installed before use\.
- The first start downloads CAD's runtime, so it needs a network connection\.
- The repository badges indicate Python 3\.11\+ and Node\.js 20\+\.
- On Windows 11 with Smart App Control enabled, unsigned OCP native code can be blocked; running the CAD skills under WSL is an alternative\.

## Before You Adopt

projects.content:
## Overview

ThinkRail is an agentic IDE from JetBrains InnovationHub built around the pi coding agent\. It treats any local git repository as a project and creates isolated git\-worktree workspaces so multiple agents can work in parallel without touching the main checkout\. The workbench combines Monaco editor tabs, a files tree, live git diffs, terminals, and documents with concurrent pi chat sessions\. Project intent lives in a connected graph of SPEC\.md files that the agent can search and maintain through dedicated tools\.

## Key Features

- Isolated workspaces: any local git repository can become a project, and workspaces are cut as git worktrees with their own branch, files, terminals, and chats\.
- Parallel agent work: several pi sessions can run per workspace with per\-session models, live token and cost readouts, steering, queued follow\-ups, subagents, and a shared editable plan\.
- Real IDE workbench: Monaco editor tabs, a files tree, live git Changes diffs, real PTYs for terminals, documents, and anchored review comments scoped to the active workspace\.
- Spec graph as ground truth: SPEC\.md files with frontmatter form a connected graph beside the code, and the agent uses dedicated spec tools to search, navigate, and maintain it\.
- Skills and workflows: portable Agent Skills are read in place, and bundled workflows guide project setup, design brainstorming, and shipping a pull request through the user's gh\.
- MCP and provider flexibility: MCP servers can be connected with approval controls, and users sign in with JetBrains AI or connect any provider through pi auth\.

## Use Cases

- Running multiple coding agents in parallel on separate worktree branches while keeping the main checkout clean until a branch is merged\.
- Developing spec\-first, with the agent reading and maintaining a project intent graph so decisions survive a chat session\.
- Reviewing agent\-made changes through live diffs, terminals, and structured review comments before merging\.
- Extending agent workflows with existing Agent Skills, MCP servers, and bundled project setup or pull\-request workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Install the desktop app from the releases page, or use the platform installer to put the thinkrail CLI on the PATH\.
- Run thinkrail, optionally with a git repository path, to open the browser UI or desktop app\.
- Sign in with JetBrains AI or connect your own provider credentials through pi auth\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS desktop builds support Apple Silicon only; there is no Intel desktop build\.
- Windows desktop builds are x64 and distributed as a setup ZIP\.
- Linux desktop builds for x64 and ARM64 need glibc 2\.38 or newer with GTK 3, WebKitGTK 4\.1, Ayatana AppIndicator 3, and librsvg 2, such as Ubuntu 24\.04 or newer\.
- The thinkrail CLI requires git on the PATH and a model provider, either JetBrains AI sign\-in or your own provider credentials\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Linux desktop and CLI artifacts are unsigned\.
- The macOS CLI is signed but not notarized\.

projects.taglineZh: 面向编码代理的经验驱动黑盒成本控制
projects.description: TokenEconomizer is a plugin that learns from prior coding-agent sessions in a repository to reduce costs by remembering repository facts, pruning unused tools, and intervening in failure loops without changing the agent.
projects.descriptionZh: TokenEconomizer 是一个编码代理插件，从仓库中已有的会话经验学习，在不改变代理本身的情况下，通过记住仓库事实、裁剪未使用工具和干预失败循环来降低重复成本。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot CLI 和 Pi，并对 opencode、Cursor Agent、Grok Build、Hermes Agent、Antigravity CLI 与 Factory Droid 提供实验性支持。
projects.content:
## Overview

TokenEconomizer is a plugin for coding agents that uses experience from earlier sessions in a repository to reduce repeated waste\. It leaves the agent itself unchanged while learning repository facts, pruning unused tools, and intervening when a turn appears stuck\. It supports Claude Code, Codex, the GitHub Copilot CLI, and Pi, with experimental support for several other agents\.

## Key Features

- Micro\-skills learn repository\-specific facts from repeated failures and periodic model review, inject confirmed facts at session start, and drop facts contradicted by later sessions\.
- Tool pruning omits tools that remain unused across prompts and sessions, writes exclusions through each agent's own settings, and allows removed tools to be restored\.
- Failure\-loop intervention uses a judge model to detect stuck turns and can add a redirect by default at most once per turn, while leaving the decision to stop a turn to the user\.
- The plugin works through the agent's existing context and settings, computes cost with cache pricing, and includes its own model\-call costs in reports\.
- It supports Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Pi, plus experimental integrations for opencode, Cursor Agent, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Antigravity CLI, and Factory Droid\.

## Use Cases

- Reducing repeated repository discovery and command spelling errors across many coding\-agent sessions in the same repository\.
- Cutting token and tool\-definition overhead when an agent consistently loads tools it does not use\.
- Detecting and redirecting turns that repeat the same failures while preserving user control over stopping a turn\.
- Evaluating cost reductions on SWE\-Bench, Web\-Bench, and security\-auditing tasks with supported agent\-model combinations\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the TokenEconomizer repository and add its local marketplace for the chosen agent, then install the tokeneconomizer plugin\.
- Start the agent in a repository, trust the folder when prompted, and run the agent\-specific status command to confirm the plugin is working\.
- Some hosts require a one\-time tool catalog refresh after installation or after agent updates\.
- Work as usual; the plugin announces each action in one line, and commands can show status, learned facts, pruned tools, and settings\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 or newer must be on PATH\.
- One supported coding agent must be signed in using any plan or login it supports; the plugin needs no API key of its own and does not handle credentials\.
- Learned state is kept locally in ~/\.tokeneconomizer\.
- Cursor Agent and Antigravity CLI support is macOS and Linux only; Factory Droid was tested on macOS\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Micro\-skills is disabled by default and must be enabled to use its model\-based fact proposer\.
- Agent command support was tested only on the oldest and newest versions in each documented range\.
- Tool pruning is unavailable on some limited or experimental integrations\.
- Learned data is stored on the user's machine\.
- The plugin does not require its own API key and does not handle credentials\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Tolaria is a desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux for managing Markdown knowledge bases\. It is files\-first, Git\-first, and offline\-first: notes are plain Markdown files with YAML frontmatter, each vault is a Git repository, and no account or cloud dependency is required\. The app combines a block\-based editor, wikilinks, relationships, a built\-in Git client, and AI support through CLI coding agents or local/API model providers\.

## Key Features

- Plain Markdown files on disk with YAML frontmatter, no database or proprietary format\.
- Block\-based editor with slash commands, wikilinks, raw Markdown, whiteboards, media previews, table navigation, and note width controls\.
- Fully integrated Git client for committing, pushing, browsing history, and viewing per\-note version history\.
- AI support with CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and Gemini, plus local or API model providers for chat over note context\.
- Native relationships and types as lenses, not schemas, for navigating notes\.
- Cross\-platform desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux with offline\-first operation and no account required\.

## Use Cases

- Operate second brains and personal knowledge\.
- Organize company docs as context for AI\.
- Store OpenClaw/assistants memory and procedures\.
- Manage large personal vaults for journaling, writing, and knowledge management\.

## Getting Started

- On macOS, install via Homebrew with brew install \-\-cask tolaria\.
- Download the latest release for macOS, Windows, or Linux\.
- On first launch, you can clone the Getting Started vault for a walkthrough of the app\.
- Public user docs start with Install Tolaria and First Launch\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app supports macOS, Windows, and Linux\.
- For local development: Node\.js 20\+, pnpm 8\+, Rust stable, and macOS or Linux\.
- Linux development requires WebKit2GTK 4\.1 and GTK 3, with distro\-specific packages\.
- The bundled MCP server spawns the system node binary at runtime on Linux for the external AI tooling flow\.
- Windows installers are Authenticode\-signed; company\-managed devices may still require IT approval of the Tolaria publisher before first install\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Windows installers are signed, but company\-managed devices may still require IT approval before first installation\.
- The external AI tooling flow on Linux depends on the system node binary for the bundled MCP server\.
- Tool\-backed AI editing depends on external CLI coding agents when that workflow is used\.
- Chat over note context can rely on local or API model providers and does not provide vault\-write tools\.

- 本地部署与模型接入：支持桌面、Android、Docker 与服务器部署，可配置第三方 API 或接入本地 ComfyUI 和 LLM。

## 适用场景

- 制作 AI 短剧、漫剧与短视频：完成剧本与分镜、角色和场景素材制作、视频镜头生成以及素材预览整理。
- 需要本地保存项目与素材的创作团队：项目与素材可保存在自己的设备或服务器。
- 希望接入自有模型或 ComfyUI 工作流的创作者：可配置语言模型与媒体模型服务，并通过自定义供应商适配接入已有 ComfyUI 工作流。
- 需要多语言界面的团队：支持 21 种界面语言。

## 快速开始

- 从发布页下载 Windows、macOS 或 Android ARM64 客户端安装使用。
- Docker 部署时，先安装 Git、Docker Engine 和 Docker Compose，再克隆源码并在仓库根目录执行 docker compose up \-d \-\-build。
- 服务器安装可使用项目指定的 Bun 1\.3\.14，安装依赖并构建后运行启动命令。

## 部署与要求

- Windows 安装器会自动检测并安装 WebView2；若安装后打开闪退，需手动安装 WebView2 运行时。
- macOS 版面向 Apple Silicon，将 Toonflow 拖入“应用程序”后直接打开；如遇系统安全提示，可按官方说明处理。
- Android 版仅支持 ARM64 设备，下载 toonflow\-版本号\-android\-arm64\.apk 安装；手机内置本地 Bun 后端，也可连接已开启共享的电脑或远程后端。
- Docker 部署需 Git、Docker Engine 和 Docker Compose，基于 Bun 1\.3\.14 构建，镜像内包含 FFmpeg；配置、插件和项目文件保存在 Docker 命名卷 toonflowData 中，挂载至容器的 /app/data/。
- 服务器安装以 Ubuntu/Debian 为例，需要 Git、curl、unzip、ffmpeg 和 Bun 1\.3\.14；服务使用固定端口 3000，业务页面与 API 没有独立登录鉴权，需通过防火墙或安全组限制访问来源，公网访问需配置带认证的反向代理。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。
- 第三方模型服务的 API 调用可能产生费用；使用本地模型或 ComfyUI 时，需要自行准备运行环境与算力。
- 服务器安装时业务页面与 API 没有独立登录鉴权。
- 公网访问需配置带认证的反向代理。

FigureForge can generate paper figures from gallery images, user uploads, or both, and supports downloading results or high\-fidelity recreation with editable exports\.

- Curated Figure 1 and teaser figures from ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, CVPR, ACL, and AAAI spanning 2023–2026\.

- Find layout ideas for your own paper’s overview figure\.

- Open the gallery and filter figures by venue, year, acceptance tier, or visual pattern\.

- FigureForge is presented as a Beta feature\.

## Overview

TradingAgents is a stock trading framework inspired by trading firms\. It uses LLM\-powered agents in specialized roles, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts, bullish and bearish researchers, traders, and a risk management team\. Agents communicate through structured reports and focused debate to assess market conditions and make trading decisions\.

## Key Features

- LLM\-powered specialized agents cover fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis\.
- Bullish and bearish researcher agents debate market conditions and evaluate risk/reward\.
- Trader agents synthesize analyst and researcher insights to decide on trades\.
- A risk management team monitors exposure and adjusts trading plans within risk constraints\.
- A structured communication protocol combines reports with natural language debate to reduce information loss\.
- Backbone models can be exchanged for locally hosted or API\-accessible alternatives\.

## Use Cases

- Simulating collaborative trading\-firm workflows for research and decision\-making\.
- Backtesting trading strategies on historical financial data and comparing against baseline strategies\.
- Analyzing market signals from news, social media sentiment, fundamentals, and technical indicators\.
- Researching multi\-agent LLM coordination, debate, and risk\-management processes in finance\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- No GPU is required\.
- API credits are needed for model access\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Deployment does not require a GPU but depends on API credits for model access\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Transub Player is a Windows desktop video player for foreign\-language films and shows\. It starts playback immediately and generates readable live subtitles locally as you watch, with translation and dual\-language viewing options\.

## Key Features

- Live subtitles are generated with built\-in speech recognition while you watch, with progress kept visible\.
- Translation, source, and dual subtitle modes switch with 1, 2, and 3; source subtitles continue if translation is not ready\.
- Supports Chinese, Japanese, Korean, English, and Spanish, with source and target languages changeable during playback\.
- Opens common stream URLs and can record to local storage in one step\.
- Phone QR cast and shared folders let a phone browser pick files while the PC keeps generating live subtitles\.
- Color grade controls, built\-in 3D LUTs, custom \.cube and \.3dl LUTs, and picture enhance options are available\.

## Use Cases

- Watch foreign\-language films, dramas, or anime without hunting for subtitle files\.
- Follow along with translation, source, or dual subtitles for casual viewing or language learning\.
- Open network streams and record them locally for later viewing\.
- Use phone QR cast and shared folders to pick files from a phone browser while the PC generates live subtitles\.

## Getting Started

- Download the installer or portable zip from the official GitHub or GitCode releases, or use Check for updates in the app\.
- If Windows SmartScreen warns, choose More info and Run anyway after confirming the official channel\.
- Finish the first\-run setup wizard and optionally associate common video formats\.
- Open or drop a video, and follow prompts to install recognition and translation models if needed\.
- Wait for subtitles to appear, then switch modes with 1, 2, and 3 as needed\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11 (64\-bit)\.
- Internet is required the first time to download recognition and translation models; offline playback works afterward for prepared content\.
- Optional GPU acceleration is available, and the player works without a dedicated GPU\.
- Installed builds store settings and models under %LocalAppData%\\Transub Player\\data\\; portable builds use data\\ next to the exe\.

## Before You Adopt

- No recognizable license was detected; verify permission to use, modify, and distribute the project before adoption\.
- First run requires network access to download recognition and translation models; prepared content can play offline afterward\.
- Release packages are currently unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn users\.

projects.content:
## Overview

treg is an open\-source tool catalog and gateway for AI agents\. It provides a single token and base URL to access over 3,800 endpoints from 110 providers across areas such as SEO, backlinks, AI visibility, social media, enrichment, ads, and measurement\. Calls are priced per result, with credentials injected server\-side, and users can bring their own keys for unmetered access\.

## Key Features

- One unified key across 110 providers, so agents use a single treg token for all catalog tools\.
- 3,800\+ endpoints priced up front and billed per call, with no provider signup required\.
- Credentials are injected server\-side and never stored on the caller's machine\.
- The catalog is grouped by task, covering keyword and rank tracking, backlinks, AI visibility, trending content, publishing, enrichment, ads, and measurement\.
- Bring your own key overrides treg's keys and is never metered\.
- Open source under AGPL and self\-hostable\.

## Use Cases

- Equip coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to act as SEO experts, social media managers, SDRs, or media buyers\.
- Find in\-market buyers from public signals such as complaints, job changes, hiring, funding, and tool adoption\.
- Create AI UGC videos with trending hooks, presenters, talking\-head clips, and captions\.
- Compare enrichment, web search, web fetch, and sitemap providers using live pricing, success rates, and speed data\.

## Getting Started

- Install the treg CLI with the official install script\.
- Sign in with GitHub, an email one\-time code, or a token for agents and CI\.
- Search the catalog by task, call a tool, and check your balance with the CLI\.
- Optionally install the treg plugin from the Claude Code plugin marketplace or add skills via the skills CLI\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The catalog relies on third\-party providers, and some capabilities are behind subscription walls or have no public API, requiring treg to carry provider accounts\.
- Credentials are injected server\-side, so callers never hold provider keys on their machines\.

projects.name: TrnRT
projects.tagline: Open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium
projects.taglineZh: AWS Trainium 上的开放 LLM 推理引擎
projects.description: An open inference engine for large language models on AWS Trainium, serving an OpenAI-compatible chat and completions API from one trn2.48xlarge with NKI megakernels and a prefix cache.
projects.descriptionZh: TrnRT 是面向 AWS Trainium 的大语言模型开放推理引擎，可在单台 trn2.48xlarge 上提供兼容 OpenAI 的聊天与补全 API，并采用 NKI megakernel、前缀缓存和离线编译流水线。
projects.content:
## Overview

TrnRT is an open inference engine for large language models on AWS Trainium\. It serves an OpenAI\-compatible API from a single trn2\.48xlarge and uses NKI megakernels, a prefix cache, and an offline compile pipeline\.

## Key Features

- NKI megakernels run decode as roughly one fused kernel per layer half, bundling KDA attention, the fused DSA layer, mHC, and the MoE FFN\.
- 1M\-token context is supported through sparse attention with top 2,048 and linear attention with fixed\-size state\.
- A prefix cache is built as a radix tree over FP8 KV pages, with a host\-memory tier for evicted pages and state checkpoints\.
- An OpenAI\-compatible API covers chat and completions, streaming, tool calls, and reasoning output\.
- Each box runs two engines, each tensor\-parallel over 32 logical NeuronCores, behind a session\-affine router\.
- Offline compile builds every graph on a CPU host; the serving box loads them and compiles nothing by default\.

## Use Cases

- Serving GLM\-5\.3\-Flash on AWS Trainium2 through an OpenAI\-compatible API\.
- Long\-context inference workloads that need a 1M\-token context and prefix caching\.
- Replaying coding\-agent sessions and other high\-throughput inference workloads on a single trn2\.48xlarge\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository and build the Docker image with Neuron SDK 2\.32 and Python 3\.13\.
- Build the compile cache on any x86\_64 host; the source notes this takes hours\.
- Copy the cache and NKI files to the trn2\.48xlarge, download GLM\-5\.3\-Flash, and run the serving container on port 8000\.
- Call the server with any OpenAI client pointed at the local OpenAI\-compatible endpoint\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker is required\.
- Serving requires an AWS Trainium2 trn2\.48xlarge instance\.
- Compilation can run on any x86\_64 host and does not need a NeuronCore\.
- The stack targets Python 3\.13 and Neuron SDK 2\.32 (neuronx\-cc 2\.27)\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is described as early, with one supported model and a truncated quickstart\.
- Building the offline compile cache takes hours on an x86\_64 host\.
- TrnRT targets AWS Trainium2 hardware and is built against Neuron SDK 2\.32\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

TrnRT 是面向 AWS Trainium 的大语言模型开放推理引擎。它从单台 trn2\.48xlarge 提供兼容 OpenAI 的 API，并采用 NKI megakernel、前缀缓存和离线编译流水线。

## 核心功能

- NKI megakernel 将解码过程组织为大致每半个层一个融合内核，把 KDA 注意力、融合 DSA 层、mHC 和 MoE FFN 打包在一起；支持 1M token 上下文，通过 top 2,048 的稀疏注意力和带固定大小状态的线性注意力实现；前缀缓存以 FP8 KV 页上的基数树构建，并为被淘汰页和状态检查点提供主机内存层；提供兼容 OpenAI 的 API，覆盖聊天、补全、流式输出、工具调用和推理输出；每台机器运行两个引擎，每个引擎在 32 个逻辑 NeuronCore 上做张量并行，前端是会话亲和路由器；离线编译在 CPU

## 适用场景

- 在 AWS Trainium2 上通过兼容 OpenAI 的 API 服务 GLM\-5\.3\-Flash；需要 1M token 上下文和前缀缓存的长上下文推理负载；在单台 trn2\.48xlarge 上回放编码智能体会话及其他高吞吐推理负载。

## 快速开始

- 克隆仓库，并用 Neuron SDK 2\.32 和 Python 3\.13 构建 Docker 镜像；在任意 x86\_64 主机上构建编译缓存，源文说明这一步需要数小时；把缓存和 NKI 文件复制到 trn2\.48xlarge，下载 GLM\-5\.3\-Flash，并在 8000 端口运行服务容器；用任意 OpenAI 客户端连接本地兼容 OpenAI 的端点进行调用。

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Docker；服务需要 AWS Trainium2 trn2\.48xlarge 实例；编译可在任意 x86\_64 主机上运行，不需要 NeuronCore；软件栈面向 Python 3\.13 和 Neuron SDK 2\.32（neuronx\-cc 2\.27）。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.descriptionZh: TrueForge 是开源的智能体运行框架，可将 LLM 转化为可工作的智能体。它内置 MCP 工具、技能、沙箱、人工审批、子智能体、上下文管理与持久会话，并提供聊天界面、HTTP API、TypeScript SDK 和 UI SDK。
projects.content:
## Overview

TrueForge is an open\-source agent harness with three parts: a core server that runs the agent loop, an HTTP API with a TypeScript SDK, and a chat UI with a React UI SDK\. It orchestrates bring\-your\-own model providers, MCP servers, and sandbox services, while handling planning, tool execution, context management, approvals, and session state\. It supports local mode with SQLite and hosted mode with Postgres and Redis\.

## Key Features

- Any model provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, other catalog providers, or any OpenAI\-compatible endpoint\.
- MCP tools: remote MCP servers with header auth or OAuth, including in\-chat authorization\.
- Skills: git\-backed SKILL\.md instruction packs loaded on demand in the sandbox\.
- Sandbox as a tool: isolated code and file execution provisioned only when needed, with secrets kept in the harness\.
- Human checkpoints: tool approval, ask\-user\-questions, and Generative UI in chat\.
- Context engineering: subagents, deferred tool loading, Code Mode, large\-result offloading, and compaction\.

## Use Cases

- Personal use on a local machine as a single process with SQLite, similar to Claude Desktop\.
- Team or production shared deployments with Postgres, Redis, and optional OIDC login\.
- Automating agent sessions and streaming turns from application code via the HTTP API and TypeScript SDK\.
- Embedding a customized chat interface in a React app with @truefoundry/trueforge\-ui\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx @truefoundry/trueforge@latest for a local quickstart\.
- Use the Quickstart guide to run TrueForge locally or with Docker Compose, Kubernetes, or Railway, then connect models, tools, and skills and build a reusable agent\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Local mode runs as a single process with SQLite storage and no extra infrastructure\.
- Hosted mode uses Postgres for storage and Redis as extra infrastructure; it can run with Docker Compose, Helm, or Railway\.
- Shared deployments can enable optional OIDC login with admin versus user roles\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Local mode defaults to no login and stores data in a local SQLite file, which matters for access control and privacy\.
- Sandbox code and file execution currently depends on Daytona as the available sandbox provider\.

## 项目简介

TrueForge 是开源的智能体运行框架，由运行智能体循环的核心服务器、带 TypeScript SDK 的 HTTP API，以及带 React UI SDK 的聊天界面组成。它编排自带模型提供商、MCP 服务器和沙箱服务，并处理规划、工具执行、上下文管理、审批与会话状态。支持使用 SQLite 的本地模式和采用 Postgres 与 Redis 的托管模式。

## 核心功能

- 支持任意模型提供商，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini、其他目录提供商或任意 OpenAI 兼容端点；支持远程 MCP 服务器，可通过请求头认证或 OAuth 授权，并支持聊天内授权；技能为基于 Git 的 SKILL\.md 指令包，在沙箱中按需加载；沙箱作为工具使用，仅在需要时提供隔离的代码与文件执行，密钥保留在运行框架中；提供人工检查点，包括工具审批、向用户提问以及聊天中的生成式 UI；上下文工程包括子智能体、延迟工具加载、Code Mode、大结果卸载与压缩。

## 适用场景

- 可在本地机器上以单进程和 SQLite 进行个人使用，类似 Claude Desktop；可用于团队或生产共享部署，使用 Postgres、Redis 和可选的 OIDC 登录；可通过 HTTP API 与 TypeScript SDK 从应用代码自动创建智能体会话并流式接收轮次；可通过 @truefoundry/trueforge\-ui 在 React 应用中嵌入自定义聊天界面。

## 快速开始

- 本地快速体验可运行 npx @truefoundry/trueforge@latest。按照快速入门指南可在本地或使用 Docker Compose、Kubernetes 或 Railway 运行 TrueForge，然后连接模型、工具与技能，并构建第一个可复用智能体。

## 部署与要求

- 本地模式以单进程运行，使用 SQLite 存储，不需要额外基础设施。托管模式使用 Postgres 存储，并以 Redis 作为额外基础设施，可通过 Docker Compose、Helm 或 Railway 运行。共享部署可启用可选的 OIDC 登录，并区分管理员与普通用户角色。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: TrustGraph
projects.tagline: Business meaning in the graph, authority in the runtime
projects.taglineZh: 图谱承载业务含义，运行时掌握业务授权
projects.description: TrustGraph is an open-source context graph platform with a deterministic agent runtime. It builds an ontology-grounded operating graph and checks AI agent actions against business meaning and evidence, returning allow, pause or deny.
projects.descriptionZh: TrustGraph 是一个开源上下文图谱平台，具有确定性代理运行时。它构建基于本体论的运营图谱，并根据业务含义和证据检查 AI 代理操作，返回允许、暂停或拒绝。
projects.content:
## Overview

TrustGraph is an open\-source context graph platform with a deterministic agent runtime\. It turns enterprise knowledge, systems, and business logic into an ontology\-grounded operating graph, then checks every action an AI agent proposes against business meaning, authority, and evidence before execution\. Decisions can be allow, pause, or deny, and each decision records the evidence and policy version behind it as W3C PROV\-O provenance\.

## Key Features

- Ontology\-grounded operating graph built from documents and systems using OWL, RDF 1\.2, SHACL, and domain or custom ontologies\.
- Deterministic agent runtime that checks proposed actions against semantic policy for authority, scope, risk, uncertainty, time, and value\.
- Allow, pause, or deny decisions recorded with evidence and policy version as queryable W3C PROV\-O provenance\.
- Deployment with Docker Compose or Kubernetes, on cloud or on\-prem, with hosted LLM APIs or self\-hosted open\-weight models\.
- Unstructured data ingest for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, Markdown, CSV, and images into ontology\-typed knowledge\.
- UI tools including Agent Console, GraphRAG View, Context Explorer, Document Ingestion, Ontology Workbench, Schema Workbench, and Prompt Editor\.

## Use Cases

- Finance and banking: enforce payments, approvals, and delegated authority on every agent action\.
- Agentic threat intelligence: unify threat, event, and log intelligence in one governed graph\.
- Pharmacovigilance: support traceable drug\-safety workflows with evidence behind every decision\.
- Aerospace, defense, and telecom: high\-assurance agents where decisions must be auditable and reproducible\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx @trustgraph/config to generate deployment configuration\.
- The config process outputs deploy\.zip with docker\-compose\.yaml for Docker or Podman or resources\.yaml for Kubernetes, plus INSTALLATION\.md\.
- A browser\-based Configuration Terminal is available for configuration\.
- Documentation includes Getting Started Guides, Developer APIs and CLI, and Deployment Guides\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Deploy with Docker Compose or Kubernetes\.
- Can run on every major cloud or on\-prem\.
- Supports hosted LLM APIs or open\-weight models on your own accelerators\.
- Includes managed multi\-model storage in Cassandra, vector embedding storage in Qdrant, file and object storage in Garage, and high\-speed pub/sub messaging with Pulsar or RabbitMQ\.
- Native inference stack supports vLLM, TGI, Ollama, LM Studio, and Llamafiles\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The core is open source, while some enterprise capabilities are provided as add\-ons with production engineering support\.
- Using third\-party LLM providers may require API keys\.
- Using third\-party OCR services may require API keys\.

projects.name: tuios
projects.tagline: A terminal window manager for coding agents.
projects.taglineZh: 面向编码代理的终端窗口管理器。
projects.description: tuios is a terminal window manager and multiplexer with tiled panes, nine workspaces, persistent daemon sessions, remote host access, and an Inbox for tracking coding agents' work, approvals, questions and failures.
projects.descriptionZh: tuios 是一个终端窗口管理器与多路复用器，提供平铺窗格、浮动窗口、九个工作区、保持会话存活的守护进程、跨主机访问会话，以及用于跟踪编码代理工作、审批、问题和失败的集中收件箱。
projects.content:
## Overview

tuios is a terminal window manager and multiplexer that runs inside an existing terminal\. It provides tiled panes, floating windows, workspaces, a persistent daemon for sessions, access to sessions on other machines, and agent\-aware status and Inbox features for coding agents\.

## Key Features

- Tiled panes and floating windows with BSP, master\-stack and scrolling layouts, plus a dock and sidebar\.
- Nine independent workspaces and a modal interface inspired by vim, with window and terminal modes\.
- A daemon keeps panes and programs running when you detach or close the terminal; sessions can be reattached locally or over SSH\.
- Hosts and remote sessions let you add another machine once and attach to its sessions or run individual panes there\.
- Coding agents in panes report whether they are working, waiting, done or errored, and the Inbox collects approvals, questions, mail, errors and finished turns\.
- Scripting and automation through a JSON control protocol, send\-keys, capture\-pane, wait\-for, tape scripts, hooks and a CLI\.

## Use Cases

- Run several coding agents side by side while keeping their states and pending approvals visible in one terminal\.
- Keep long\-running builds, tests or agent sessions alive after closing the terminal and reattach later\.
- Work across several machines by attaching to remote sessions or placing individual panes on another host over SSH\.
- Automate or replay terminal workflows with tape scripts, hooks and the JSON control protocol\.

## Getting Started

- Install with Homebrew using brew install tuios\.
- Run tuios; it starts the daemon if it is not running and attaches you to a session\.
- Use n for a new window, i or Enter for terminal mode, Ctrl\+B then Esc for window mode, and Ctrl\+P for the command palette\.
- Optionally try the guided browser tour before installing\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A terminal with true color support; kitty graphics and sixel support are recommended, such as Ghostty, Kitty or WezTerm\.
- Building from source needs Go 1\.26\.8 or newer\.
- Pre\-built binaries are available for Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeBSD and OpenBSD; Docker images are also published\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project states there is no token or presale, so offers involving a tuios token should be treated as unofficial\.
- Sixel image passthrough is labeled experimental and currently lacks pixel\-level clipping\.
- The kitty text sizing protocol is experimental and has known issues with scrollback and window repositioning\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

tuios 是一个终端窗口管理器与多路复用器，运行在现有终端中。它提供平铺窗格、浮动窗口、工作区、用于保持会话的守护进程、对其他机器上会话的访问，以及面向编码代理的状态与集中收件箱功能。

## 核心功能

- 提供平铺窗格和浮动窗口，支持 BSP、主栈和滚动布局，并配有停靠栏和侧边栏。
- 提供九个独立工作区，以及受 vim 启发的模态界面，包含窗口模式和终端模式。
- 守护进程在分离或关闭终端后继续运行窗格和程序，之后可在本地或通过 SSH 重新附加会话。
- 可通过主机和远程会话功能添加另一台机器，并附加到其会话或在该机器上运行单个窗格。
- 窗格中的编码代理可报告正在工作、等待、完成或出错等状态，集中收件箱汇总审批、问题、邮件、错误和已完成的回合。
- 支持通过 JSON 控制协议、send\-keys、capture\-pane、wait\-for、tape 脚本、钩子和命令行进行脚本化与自动化。

## 适用场景

- 在同一个终端中并排运行多个编码代理，并集中查看它们的状态和待处理审批。
- 关闭终端后让长时间运行的构建、测试或代理会话继续存活，之后再重新附加。
- 通过附加远程会话或把单个窗格放到另一台主机上，跨多台机器工作。
- 使用 tape 脚本、钩子和 JSON 控制协议自动化或回放终端工作流。

## 快速开始

- 使用 Homebrew 安装：brew install tuios。
- 运行 tuios；若守护进程未运行，它会启动守护进程并将会话附加给你。
- 使用 n 新建窗口，i 或 Enter 进入终端模式，Ctrl\+B 后按 Esc 返回窗口模式，Ctrl\+P 打开命令面板。
- 也可以选择在安装前通过浏览器体验引导教程。

## 部署与要求

- 需要支持真彩色的终端；推荐支持 Kitty 图形和 Sixel，例如 Ghostty、Kitty 或 WezTerm。
- 从源码构建需要 Go 1\.26\.8 或更新版本。
- 提供适用于 Linux、macOS、Windows、FreeBSD 和 OpenBSD 的预构建二进制文件；也发布 Docker 镜像。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: TurboFieldfare
projects.tagline: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in about 2 GB of RAM
projects.taglineZh: 在约 2 GB 内存中运行 Gemma 4 26B-A4B
projects.description: TurboFieldfare is a Swift and Metal runtime for running Gemma 4 26B-A4B on Apple Silicon Macs with about 2 GB of RAM by streaming routed experts from SSD while keeping shared weights and KV cache resident.
projects.descriptionZh: TurboFieldfare 是面向 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 的 Swift 与 Metal 推理运行时，通过从 SSD 流式读取路由专家、将共享权重和 KV 缓存驻留内存，在 Apple Silicon Mac 上以约 2 GB 内存运行模型。
projects.content:
## Overview

TurboFieldfare is a model\-specific Swift and Metal runtime and native Mac app for instruction\-tuned Gemma 4 26B\-A4B\. It keeps the shared core and FP16 KV cache in memory and streams only the routed experts needed for each token from SSD, allowing the model to run on Apple Silicon Macs with 8 GB of RAM\. The project also provides a command\-line interface, a streaming installer and verifier, and an experimental loopback OpenAI\-compatible Chat Completions server\.

## Key Features

- Runs Gemma 4 26B\-A4B IT on Apple Silicon Macs with about 2 GB for weights and a 4K KV cache by streaming routed experts from SSD\.
- Includes a native Mac app, command\-line interface, streaming model installer and verifier, and loopback OpenAI\-compatible server\.
- Uses a custom Swift and Metal runtime with 4\-bit MLX affine weights, an 8\-bit router, and custom Metal kernels for quantized GEMV, attention, MoE, normalization, RoPE, and sampling\.
- Uses chunked prompt prefill and token\-by\-token generation with FP16 KV storage\.
- Supports optional image input through a separately installed companion vision pack on M2 or newer Apple Silicon Macs\.

## Use Cases

- Local instruction chat and text generation on low\-memory Apple Silicon Macs, including 8 GB models\.
- Command\-line chat and raw completion using an installed \.gturbo model\.
- Testing clients against a local OpenAI\-compatible Chat Completions endpoint, including streaming and function\-tool declarations handled by the client\.
- Image question answering when the optional vision pack is installed on supported M2 or newer hardware\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the repository, run swift build \-c release, then launch \.build/release/TurboFieldfareMac\. In the app, choose Download Model to fetch and repack the pinned model, then choose Load Model, enter a prompt, and choose Generate\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Apple Silicon Mac; the validated target is an 8 GB M2 MacBook Air\.
- macOS 26 with Metal 4\.
- Apple Command Line Tools or Xcode with Swift 6\.2\+ and the macOS 26 SDK or newer\.
- Enough free storage for the about 14\.3 GB model installation and an internet connection for the first model install\.
- The package is arm64\-only; older macOS and Metal versions are not supported\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Univer is an Office SDK for building Office applications inside a product, with Web, Server, and AI SDK parts for editing, calculation, collaboration, file processing, and agent workflows\. This repository provides the open\-source Web SDK core architecture and engine implementations, including Sheets and Docs editing\.

## Key Features

- Composable Web SDK core with content models, editing, rendering, formula calculation, and Facade APIs\.
- Open\-source Sheets editing and layout, including cell styles, merged cells, in\-cell rich text, freeze panes, floating images, and undo/redo\.
- Sheets data and calculation features, including formulas, defined names, filtering, sorting, data validation, conditional formatting, hyperlinks, comments, and find and replace\.
- Docs rich\-text editing with paragraph formatting, lists, hyperlinks, comments, and drawing integration\.
- Plugin architecture with feature and UI separation, dependency injection, command, mutation, and operation actions, and composed undo/redo\.
- Headless processing in Node\.js using content plugins, models, commands, and calculation without an interactive editor\.

## Use Cases

- Embed an editable spreadsheet or document surface in an application or agent product\.
- Process Office content without an editor using Node\.js for editing, snapshots, and automated tasks\.
- Develop custom features or editors by reusing engines, UI components, plugin boundaries, dependency injection, and command and undo systems\.
- Connect application code or agents to workbook data through Facade APIs for tasks such as updating values and reading recalculated totals\.

## Getting Started

- Install the presets and Sheets Core preset packages with pnpm: pnpm add @univerjs/presets @univerjs/preset\-sheets\-core\.
- Create a container element in the page before initializing Univer\.
- Initialize createUniver with the Sheets Core preset, locale settings, and the container id, then call univerAPI\.createWorkbook\.
- Use the returned univerAPI to work with workbook content; in component frameworks, dispose the Univer instance on unmount\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Use a browser application with a bundler such as Vite for the quick\-start editor\.
- Use Node\.js for headless processing workflows\.
- Keep coordinated UniverJS packages on the same version; commercial packages must use the matching release line\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Some Web SDK plugins, the Server SDK, and commercial AI SDK extensions are distributed and licensed separately from the open\-source repository\.
- Snapshot persistence does not include XLSX import and export; those rely on separately distributed file\-conversion capabilities\.
- Applications are responsible for persisting snapshots; the provided example uses browser storage\.

projects.content:
## Overview

universal\-modder is a toolkit for pointing AI coding agents at PC games you own\. It combines Agent Skills, a three\-agent team, a Python um CLI, a shared field\-note knowledge base, and the fal MCP so agents can perform recon, reverse engineering, asset generation, in\-game testing, recording, packaging, and publishing\. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, and skills\-only setups\.

## Key Features

- Agent Skills bundle engine playbooks and workflows for recon, reverse engineering, asset generation, game automation, showcase video, publishing, porting, and sharing field notes\.
- The um CLI scans Steam, Epic, and Xbox installs; fingerprints engine and version, \.NET versus native, anti\-cheat, loaders, save folders, and ranked modding routes\.
- fal MCP and um fal generate sprites, images, textures, PBR maps, 3D models, rigs, sound effects, music, voice, and video, with local ComfyUI and separate Sprixen and Voidless integrations\.
- A knowledge base stores field notes by agents for agents, covering exact working versions, chosen routes, engine behavior, verification, and gotchas, with commands to search, create, check, and open PRs\.
- A three\-agent team supports long mods: an orchestrator, a game worker that touches the running game, and an offline worker that studies data and writes generators and patches\.
- Safety rules back up saves before changes, avoid anti\-cheat and online cheating, never ship game files or decompiled code, and ask before input control, loader installation, or publishing\.

## Use Cases

- Add new weapons, enemies, bosses, civilizations, units, sprites, or textures to games such as Terraria and Age of Empires II DE\.
- Port content between games, such as Halo weapons and vehicles into Minecraft or real Minecraft inside GTA V story mode\.
- Investigate an unknown game install to identify its engine, prior modding work, and a viable modding route\.
- Generate and pipeline images, 3D models, audio, and showcase videos into engine\-ready assets\.

## Getting Started

- Install the plugin or extension for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, VS Code/Copilot, Cursor, or OpenCode; alternatively use the skills\-only installer or clone the repository and start an agent inside it\.
- For assets, create a fal API key and store it with um fal key set, or set FAL\_KEY in the environment before starting the agent\.
- If the agent install does not put um on PATH, install it once with uv tool install or pipx from the repository\.
- Start with the mod\-any\-game skill; the agent searches the knowledge base, performs recon, backs up saves, reads code, builds a working slice, generates assets, verifies in\-game, records, packages, and writes a field note\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Git, Python 3\.10\+, and ffmpeg; uv is recommended\. Blender is needed for 3D\-to\-sprite renders\.
- Windows games are driven natively or from WSL\.
- A fal API key powers the fal MCP server and um fal; without a key, fal OAuth browser sign\-in can be used, and um comfy can make images on a local ComfyUI server\.
- Sprixen and Voidless are separate paid services with their own API keys for certain 2D sprite workflows\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The tool requires Git, Python 3\.10\+, and ffmpeg\.
- Blender is required for 3D\-to\-sprite renders\.
- Voidless 2D sprite workflows use a separate paid service with its own API key\.

projects.descriptionZh: unslop 是一款面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 的 Skill，可审查带有明显 AI 生成痕迹的界面，提出由产品驱动的设计方向，并逐轮修正界面。支持 Next.js、React、Vue、Svelte、Tailwind 及原生 HTML/CSS。
projects.content:
## Overview

unslop is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns vibecoded, AI\-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character\. It finds common slop patterns such as purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy, and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from the product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review\. It works across Next\.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind, and plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps, landing pages, and live sites when only a link is available\.

## Key Features

- Audit lists every sign of slop with where it lives\.
- Direction derives character, world, color moments, and a signature detail from the product\.
- Passes adjust spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals, and motion in order\.
- Works with Next\.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind, or plain HTML and CSS, and handles dashboards, apps, landing pages, and live sites via a link\.
- Can generate visuals through image services when a hero needs a scene or object, showing the prompt and asking before every paid generation\.
- Story video creates a square video under 10 seconds of the screen unslopping itself, requiring Playwright and ffmpeg\.

## Use Cases

- Redesign a vibecoded dashboard so it reads as a designed product rather than an AI template\.
- Give the hero of a live website a product\-specific visual direction and targeted fixes\.
- Improve a landing page and produce a short story video of the transformation for posting\.
- Audit an existing screen and receive small refinements if it is already good rather than a full redesign\.

## Getting Started

- For Claude Code, clone the repository and copy skills/unslop into ~/\.claude/skills/ or into \.claude/skills/ for a single project\.
- For Codex, install the skill from the repository or copy it into ~/\.agents/skills/ or \.agents/skills/ inside a single project\.
- Invoke it in Claude Code with /unslop or in Codex with $unslop, or ask in your own words so the agent picks it up\.
- To snapshot a live site or create a story video, install Playwright and Chromium from the project directory: npm install \-D playwright and npx playwright install chromium\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Playwright and its Chromium browser are required to snapshot a live site or create a story video\.
- Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on PATH\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: CC\-BY\-4\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Story video generation depends on ffmpeg being installed and available on PATH\.
- Live\-site snapshots and story videos require Playwright and its Chromium browser\.
- Paid image generation is guarded by showing the prompt and asking before each paid generation\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Unsloth is an open\-source framework for running and training LLMs\. It lets you run and train AI models on your own local hardware via an open\-source UI\. Supports MacOS, Linux, Windows, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and CPU setups\.

## Key Features

- Run and train LLMs, diffusion, embedding, audio models: Qwen3\.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax\-H3, Muse Glimmer, DeepSeek\-V4, Gemma 4\.
- Agents & Tools: Use local models with Claude Code, Codex, and MCP, including tool calling and code execution\.
- Search & RAG: Use private and unlimited web search, deep research, auto\-compaction (rolling context window) and RAG\.
- Remote & LAN: Access your local models from any device on LAN or remotely through secure Cloudflare HTTPS\.
- Fine\-tuning: Train LLMs, diffusion, TTS, and embedding models 2× faster with 70% less VRAM with no accuracy loss\.
- Export & Deploy: Export or Deploy models with including GGUF, NVFP4, FP8 and more formats\.

## Use Cases

- Run and train models locally for personal or research use\.
- Connect local models to coding agents like Claude Code and Codex\.
- Use private web search and RAG for deep research\.
- Fine\-tune models for specific tasks with reduced VRAM usage\.

## Getting Started

- Download the native desktop app for macOS, Windows, or Linux from the Unsloth website or GitHub Releases\.
- Alternatively, install manually: on macOS, Linux, or WSL run \`curl \-fsSL https://unsloth\.ai/install\.sh \| sh\`; on Windows PowerShell run \`irm https://unsloth\.ai/install\.ps1 \| iex\`\.
- A Docker image \`unsloth/unsloth\` is also available\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supports MacOS, Linux, Windows, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and CPU setups\.
- Supports Multi GPU setups, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPUs, CPUs and the Vulkan backend\.
- For Docker, GPU access setup may be required on Linux\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Vane is a privacy\-focused AI answering engine that runs entirely on your own hardware\. It combines knowledge from the internet with support for local LLMs (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq), delivering accurate answers with cited sources while keeping searches private\.

## Key Features

- Support for major AI providers (Ollama, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq)
- Smart search modes: Speed, Balanced, Quality
- Source selection: web, discussions, academic papers
- Widgets for weather, calculations, stock prices
- Web search powered by SearxNG with privacy
- File uploads for PDFs, text, images

## Use Cases

- Private personal search with cited answers
- Deep research using academic sources
- Alternative to traditional search engines
- Integration via API for developers

## Getting Started

- Run with Docker: docker run \-d \-p 3000:3000 \-v vane\-data:/home/vane/data \-\-name vane itzcrazykns1337/vane:latest\. For non\-Docker: clone repo, npm i, npm run build, npm run start\. Access at http://localhost:3000 and configure settings\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker recommended; image includes SearxNG\. For external SearxNG, set SEARXNG\_API\_URL and ensure JSON and Wolfram Alpha enabled\. API keys for AI providers required\. Persistent volume for data\. Port 3000 exposed\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

VibeOffice is a free office suite that runs in the browser\. It includes Quire for word processing, Ledger for spreadsheets and Lectern for presentations, and it opens and saves Office Open XML files such as \.docx, \.xlsx and \.pptx\. It uses a classic Office 2003\-style interface, works without an account or server upload, and can be installed as an app in Chrome or Edge after the first visit\.

## Key Features

- Quire is a word processor with track changes, comments, footnotes, tables of contents and mail merge; it opens and saves \.docx, \.rtf, Markdown, HTML and text, and prints to PDF\.
- Ledger is a spreadsheet with 519 functions, charts, PivotTable reports and conditional formatting; it opens and saves \.xlsx, \.csv, XML Spreadsheet 2003 and HTML, and prints to PDF\.
- Lectern is a presentation editor with transitions, animations, charts and IntelliArt diagrams; it opens and saves \.pptx and exports PDF, PNG and HTML\.
- The suite preserves unsupported content byte for byte where possible and keeps original names and IDs for edited content, aiming for lossless round trips with Office files\.
- Everything runs locally in the browser, with recent files kept in browser storage and no account or server upload\.
- The interface follows classic Office 2003\-style menus and toolbars, supports themes and multiple UI languages, and can work offline after the first visit or install as an app in Chrome and Edge\.

## Use Cases

- Edit and return \.docx, \.xlsx or \.pptx files from colleagues while preserving macros, embedded objects, animations and other content the apps cannot yet edit\.
- Create documents, spreadsheets and presentations from blank pages or templates in a browser without installing a desktop suite or making an account\.
- Work on files offline after the first visit, or install the suite as an app in Chrome or Edge to open Office files from the file manager\.
- Use a familiar classic menu and toolbar interface across word processing, spreadsheets and presentations, with language and UI size settings\.

## Getting Started

- Open the VibeOffice\.work Start Center in a browser, then open a file, choose one from Recent Files, or create a document, spreadsheet or presentation from a blank page or template\.
- After the first visit, it can open without a connection, and Chrome or Edge can install it as an app from the Start Center\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs in the browser as plain HTML and JavaScript with no build step; documents are opened, edited and saved on the user's computer\.
- Offline use is available after the first visit; installation as an app is supported in Chrome and Edge\.
- If served without HTTPS, some features such as saving files with a password, the Paste button and fonts on this computer may be unavailable or behave unexpectedly\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Recent file copies are stored in the browser and can be removed with Clear Recent Documents\.
- Users should keep a backup copy of important files before editing them in VibeOffice\.

projects.content:
## Overview

VibeVoice is a text\-to\-speech framework for generating expressive, long\-form, multi\-speaker conversational audio, including podcasts\. It uses continuous acoustic and semantic speech tokenizers operating at 7\.5 Hz, a next\-token diffusion approach with an LLM for textual context and dialogue flow, and a diffusion head for acoustic detail\. The project states it can synthesize speech up to 90 minutes long with up to 4 distinct speakers\.

## Key Features

- Continuous acoustic and semantic speech tokenizers operate at an ultra\-low 7\.5 Hz frame rate to preserve audio fidelity while improving computational efficiency for long sequences\.
- A next\-token diffusion framework uses an LLM to understand textual context and dialogue flow, with a diffusion head generating high\-fidelity acoustic details\.
- Supports synthesis of speech up to 90 minutes long with up to 4 distinct speakers\.
- Demonstrates context\-aware expression such as spontaneous emotion and spontaneous singing\.
- Includes examples for podcasts with background music, cross\-lingual Mandarin\-English speech, and long conversational speech\.

## Use Cases

- Generating podcast\-style multi\-speaker conversations from text\.
- Producing long\-form conversational audio with multiple distinct speakers\.
- Creating expressive speech with emotional or singing\-style delivery\.
- Exploring cross\-lingual Mandarin and English speech generation\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is positioned as a research framework for speech synthesis collaboration\.
- The repository was disabled after release due to out\-of\-scope use, so availability may be constrained\.

projects.content:
## Overview

VidBee is a free, open\-source desktop application for downloading video and audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, and 1000\+ sites, or importing local media\. It creates searchable, timestamped transcripts on your computer with speaker labels and playback sync, and can summarize, translate, or answer questions through supported AI providers\.

## Key Features

- Downloads video and audio from 1000\+ sites, including YouTube playlists, channels, search results, Watch Later, Liked videos, and private playlists\.
- Creates searchable, timestamped transcripts on your computer with speaker recognition and 100\+ language support\.
- Exports transcripts as text, Markdown, subtitles, or captioned video; downloads subtitles in SRT format with 50\+ languages\.
- Runs transcription locally with Whisper, SenseVoice, or Qwen3\-ASR after download, keeping speech and files on device\.
- Uses selected AI providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, or Groq for summaries, translation, FAQs, and mind maps\.
- Supports high\-quality downloads up to 4K and 8K, with subscription auto\-download and batch processing\.

## Use Cases

- Transcribe interviews, podcasts, lectures, YouTube downloads, or files already on your computer, then search for exact moments\.
- Review product research by finding every objection, grouping themes, and keeping original timestamps\.
- Build FAQ, chapter outline, quote library, or follow\-up questions from a transcript using AI workflows\.
- Download and archive YouTube playlists, channels, search results, Watch Later, or Liked videos for offline reference\.

## Getting Started

- Download VidBee for desktop for macOS, Windows, or Linux\.
- Paste a link or choose a file to download or import media\.
- Create a local transcript with speaker labels and timestamps\.
- Search transcript results and jump to exact moments, then export, summarize, or translate\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supports macOS, Windows, and Linux\.
- Free with no account required\.
- Local transcription requires downloading a supported model once\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Downloads and transcripts stay on the user's computer rather than VidBee's servers\.
- VidBee relies on yt\-dlp and FFmpeg under the hood\.
- Local transcription requires an initial model download before it can run locally\.
- AI processing occurs only when the user sends content to a chosen provider\.
