projects.description: VideoLingo is a one-click AI subtitle and dubbing pipeline for video localization, offering Netflix-level subtitle cutting, translation, alignment, and dubbing.
projects.descriptionZh: VideoLingo 将语音识别、字幕翻译、分段对齐和配音整合到 Streamlit 界面，一键生成字幕文件，也可输出带字幕或配音的视频，用于视频本地化；翻译质量取决于源音频、语言和所选模型。
projects.content:
## Overview

VideoLingo is an AI video localization tool that combines speech recognition, subtitle translation, segmentation, alignment, and dubbing in a Streamlit interface\. It produces subtitle files and optionally subtitled or dubbed videos\. Translation quality depends on the source audio, language, and chosen models\.

## Key Features

- Intelligent subtitle segmentation using NLP and LLM technologies to segment subtitles based on sentence meaning\.
- Context\-aware translation with GPT\-generated terminology knowledge base and a three\-step process of direct translation, reflection, and paraphrasing\.
- Precise word\-level subtitle alignment using Qwen3\-ASR with Qwen3\-ForcedAligner\.
- High\-quality dubbing with GPT\-SoVITS, OpenAI, Edge TTS, and other TTS solutions, including personalized voice cloning\.
- YouTube video download via yt\-dlp and one\-click startup and processing in Streamlit\.
- Developer\-friendly structured files, multiple deployment methods, model searchbox with API auto\-fetch, and task control for pause, resume, or stop\.

## Use Cases

- Localize videos by generating translated subtitles and optionally dubbed audio\.
- Create dual subtitles for videos\.
- Dub videos with a cloned voice using GPT\-SoVITS or other TTS methods\.
- Process YouTube videos through a multilingual subtitle and dubbing workflow\.

## Getting Started

- On Windows, download the source code zip from the latest release, extract it, double\-click OneKeyStart\.bat, and keep the window open; the first run installs uv, Python 3\.12, app dependencies, and FFmpeg and requires an internet connection\.
- After installation, VideoLingo opens in the browser; enter the API URL, key, and model in the sidebar to start using it\.
- Install from source on Windows, macOS, or Linux by cloning the repository and running uv run start\.py\.
- For the HTTP API, configure config\.yaml and run uv run start\.py \-\-api from the project root\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- VideoLingo supports Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel), and Linux\.
- The Windows one\-click first run requires an internet connection and installs uv, Python 3\.12, app dependencies, and FFmpeg\.
- Docker deployment for Linux NVIDIA containers requires Docker, a compatible GPU driver, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit; the image uses Python 3\.12 and CUDA 12\.8\.1/cu128 by default\.
- LLM use requires an OpenAI\-compatible Chat Completions provider and model that can return the structured JSON required by the workflow\.
- Speech recognition runs Qwen3\-ASR with ForcedAligner locally by default, or can use ElevenLabs or MAI\-Transcribe\-2\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The former Excel batch mode has been replaced by a local HTTP API for agents and scripts\.
- Some speech recognition options send audio to external providers and may incur charges\.
- Recognition and word timestamps can be affected by background noise and language\-specific alignment models, and numbers or symbols may lack reliable word timings\.
- The workflow requires LLM output to satisfy its JSON structure\.
- Dubbing quality and timing depend on translation, TTS service, and speech rate, and speed adjustment does not guarantee natural delivery or perfect synchronization\.

## 项目简介

VideoLingo 是一款 AI 视频本地化工具，将语音识别、字幕翻译、分段、对齐和配音整合在 Streamlit 界面中。它会生成字幕文件，并可选择输出带字幕或配音的视频。翻译质量取决于源音频、语言和所选模型。

## 核心功能

- 智能字幕分段：利用 NLP 和 LLM 技术根据句意准确切分字幕，确保每组短语长度合适。
- 上下文感知翻译：GPT 总结并提取术语知识库，实现上下文连贯的翻译，使每句自然流畅。
- 三步翻译流程：直译、反思、意译，多重保障，质量可媲美专业字幕组翻译。
- 精准字幕对齐：使用 Qwen3\-ASR 与 Qwen3\-ForcedAligner 进行词级时间轴字幕识别，确保每个词准确同步。
- 高质量配音：支持多种 TTS 方案，包括 GPT\-SoVITS 个性化配音，让视频更具吸引力。
- YouTube 视频下载：通过 yt\-dlp 下载视频，并在 Streamlit 中一键启动和处理。

## 适用场景

- 通过生成翻译字幕和可选的配音音轨来本地化视频。
- 为视频创建双语字幕。
- 使用 GPT\-SoVITS 或其他 TTS 方法以克隆声音为视频配音。
- 通过多语言字幕和配音工作流处理 YouTube 视频。

## 快速开始

- 在 Windows 上，从最新 Release 下载 Source code (zip)，解压到桌面或其他文件夹，双击 OneKeyStart\.bat 并保持窗口打开；首次运行会自动安装 uv、Python 3\.12、应用依赖和 FFmpeg，需要联网。
- 安装后 VideoLingo 会自动在浏览器中打开；在侧边栏输入 API URL、密钥和模型即可开始使用。
- 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上从源码安装：克隆仓库后运行 uv run start\.py。
- 使用 HTTP API 时，配置 config\.yaml，并从项目根目录运行 uv run start\.py \-\-api。

## 部署与要求

- 支持 Windows、macOS（Apple Silicon / Intel）和 Linux。
- Windows 一键安装首次运行需要联网，并安装 uv、Python 3\.12、应用依赖和 FFmpeg。
- Linux NVIDIA 容器 Docker 部署需要安装 Docker、兼容的 GPU 驱动和 NVIDIA Container Toolkit；镜像默认使用 Python 3\.12 和 CUDA 12\.8\.1/cu128。
- 使用 LLM 需要 OpenAI 兼容的 Chat Completions 提供商和模型，并能返回工作流所需的结构化 JSON。
- 语音识别默认在本地运行 Qwen3\-ASR 与 Qwen3\-ForcedAligner，也可选择 ElevenLabs 或 MAI\-Transcribe\-2。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

vLLM is an open\-source library and serving engine for LLM inference, originally developed in the Sky Computing Lab at UC Berkeley\. It provides state\-of\-the\-art serving throughput and efficient attention key and value memory management with PagedAttention\.

## Key Features

- State\-of\-the\-art serving throughput with continuous batching, chunked prefill, and prefix caching\.
- Efficient attention key and value memory management using PagedAttention\.
- Quantization support including FP8, INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF, and more\.
- OpenAI\-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support\.
- Tensor, pipeline, data, expert, and context parallelism for distributed inference\.
- Supports 200\+ model architectures on Hugging Face and diverse hardware platforms\.

## Use Cases

- Serving open\-source LLMs behind an OpenAI\-compatible API\.
- High\-throughput production inference with optimized GPU utilization\.
- Running quantized models to reduce inference costs\.
- Deploying models across NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, CPU, and other hardware environments\.

## Getting Started

- Install vLLM with uv: uv pip install vllm
- Optionally run vllm download\-kernels for precompiled kernels for faster startup\.
- Alternatively build from source for development\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Python 3\.10\+; Python 3\.12\+ recommended\.
- uv is recommended for faster and more reliable installation\.
- Supports NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, Intel XPU, and CPU platforms, among others\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- vLLM requires a Python runtime of at least version 3\.10, with Python 3\.12\+ recommended\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Void is a CLI, platform, and full\-stack SDK that unifies building and deploying apps\. It supports building and deploying full\-stack apps with Vite on Cloudflare Workers, with server routes, pages, typed APIs, databases, storage, AI, and one\-command deployment workflows\.

## Key Features

- Void SDK provides file\-based API routes, server\-rendered pages, and typed APIs for databases, storage, and AI, carrying types from database queries to the UI\.
- Void CLI builds apps, provisions Cloudflare resources, applies migrations, deploys, manages resources, inspects logs, and rolls back\.
- Void Platform installs a shared deployment environment in your Cloudflare account for teams or customers, with access controls, resource limits, usage reporting, and connected applications\.
- SDK features are optional and composable; you can use React, Vue, Svelte, or Solid for Void pages or keep a supported application framework\.
- Void supports TanStack Start, SvelteKit, Nuxt, and more through adapters, and can build APIs, SPAs, or server\-rendered pages\.
- npx void deploy builds the app, provisions resources, applies database migrations, and prints the deployed URL\.

## Use Cases

- Build and deploy full\-stack Vite apps on Cloudflare Workers\.
- Let a team build and deploy apps with coding agents while admins retain control of Cloudflare access\.
- Self\-host a shared Void Platform in your Cloudflare account for your team or customers\.
- Build APIs, SPAs, or server\-rendered pages with supported Vite frameworks\.

## Getting Started

- Use Node\.js 24\.21\.0 or later\. In an empty directory, run npm install \-D void, npx void init, and npm run dev\.
- Choose your UI framework and starter, then select Cloudflare to deploy to your account\.
- Run npx void deploy to build the app, provision resources, apply database migrations, and print the deployed URL\.
- To deploy to a team platform, run npx void connect \<url\> first, then use the same deploy command\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 24\.21\.0 or later\.
- A Cloudflare account as the deployment target for npx void deploy\.
- For team platform deployment, run npx void connect \<url\> before deploying\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Team deployments are designed so admins retain control of Cloudflare access and credentials\.
- Void Platform can be self\-hosted and customized for a team's security needs\.

projects.content:
## Overview

vork is a headless 3D and VFX engine built for agents\. An agent writes a scene as code, renders it, inspects the result and revises the code\. It is written in Rust and Slang and renders on GPUs through Vulkan and Metal\. It is source\-available and free during the research preview\.

## Key Features

- Scene programs define materials, cameras, lighting, simulation and compositing, so agents can rewrite behavior such as light propagation or flocking simulations\.
- A small kernel provides geometry and ray queries while agents write the rest of the shot as code; getting\-started help is about 2,500 tokens and includes a complete first scene\.
- Default rendering combines raster visibility with hardware ray\-traced lighting, and a path tracer is also available\.
- The engine supports compositing against tracked footage using external camera and matte tools plus authored proxy geometry\.
- Python and TypeScript SDKs can author scene JSON, and JSON can also be written directly\.
- Slang compute programs support GPU simulations such as a liquid simulation and a million\-agent flocking scene\.

## Use Cases

- Agent\-driven shot creation: an agent writes, renders, inspects and revises a scene until the look is ready\.
- VFX on real footage: composite rendered 3D elements against tracked footage and relight live\-action plates\.
- Procedural simulation and effects: author GPU simulations, flocking, liquid, and custom light propagation such as a black\-hole scene\.
- Prototyping and final renders: iterate with standard preview or draft profiles and render final stills or movies with std/final or std/path\.

## Getting Started

- Install vork using the provided installer; the installer verifies the release and runs vork setup\.
- Run vork init my\-shot to create a working project, then cd my\-shot\.
- Render a quick preview with vork render scene\.json \-\-profile std/draft \-\-out render\.png and open the image\.
- Use vork help for the starting scene and concepts; use vork help TOPIC \-\-all and vork help field PATH for details\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on Windows x64 (Windows 10/11) and Linux x64 (Ubuntu 22\.04\+ or glibc 2\.35\+) with a recent NVIDIA GPU; install the NVIDIA driver first\.
- Runs on Apple Silicon with Metal; the bundled Slang toolchain targets macOS 26, and older macOS versions are unqualified\.
- Rendering requires Apple Silicon or an NVIDIA GPU with Vulkan ray queries; scene authoring and vork help work without a GPU\.
- Cloud rendering can lease a cloud GPU that runs vork, billed by the second from a paid Voyager workspace\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- vork is a research preview and is source\-available and free during the preview\.
- Fog and volumes are not implemented yet; heavy interiors can abort on Mac; the path tracer is slower than Cycles in measured cases\.
- The bundled Slang toolchain targets macOS 26, and older macOS versions are unqualified\.
- Cloud GPU rendering needs a paid Voyager workspace (Starter or above)\.

projects.content:
## Overview

VoxCPM is a tokenizer\-free text\-to\-speech system that generates continuous speech representations through a diffusion autoregressive architecture\. VoxCPM2, the latest major release, is a 2B\-parameter model trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech data\. It supports 30 languages, voice design, controllable voice cloning, and 48kHz studio\-quality audio output, and is built on a MiniCPM\-4 backbone\.

## Key Features

- 30\-language multilingual synthesis that accepts text directly without a language tag
- Voice Design that creates a new voice from a natural\-language description without reference audio
- Controllable voice cloning from a short reference clip, with optional style guidance for emotion, pace, and expression
- Ultimate cloning using reference audio and its transcript to preserve timbre, rhythm, emotion, and style
- 48kHz high\-quality audio output via AudioVAE V2 with built\-in super\-resolution
- Context\-aware synthesis and real\-time streaming, with RTF as low as about 0\.3 on an NVIDIA RTX 4090

## Use Cases

- Expressive audiobooks with natural rhythm and intonation
- Game NPCs and character voices with rich emotional layers
- Multilingual speech with stable timbre and seamless switching
- Custom voice creation from text\-based descriptions of style, age, tone, emotion, and pace

## Getting Started

- Install the package with pip install voxcpm\.
- Use the Python API by loading openbmb/VoxCPM2 with VoxCPM\.from\_pretrained and calling model\.generate with the target text\.
- Launch the web demo with python app\.py \-\-port 8808, optionally selecting a device such as auto, cpu, mps, or cuda\.
- Use the CLI for voice design, voice cloning, ultimate cloning, batch processing, and optional timestamp generation\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python ≥ 3\.10 (\<3\.13), PyTorch ≥ 2\.5\.0, and CUDA ≥ 12\.0 are required\.
- VoxCPM2 uses about 8 GB of VRAM and has an RTF of about 0\.30 on an NVIDIA RTX 4090\.
- High\-throughput serving can use Nano\-vLLM\-VoxCPM, with RTF as low as about 0\.13 on an NVIDIA RTX 4090\.
- Production multi\-tenant serving can use vLLM\-Omni with an OpenAI\-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint\.
- On\-device or edge inference can use llama\.cpp\-omni with GGUF weights on CPU, Metal, CUDA, or Vulkan\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The standard Python package has explicit Python, PyTorch, and CUDA version requirements\.
- vLLM\-Omni is described as rapidly evolving\.
- The on\-device inference path is positioned as deployment without Python\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Warp is an agentic development environment that evolved from the terminal\. It provides Warp Factories, an open platform for building cloud software factories: fleets of agents wired to the SDLC and defined in code\. Teams can automate work across tasks such as triage, implementation, review, and incident response, with evals, benchmarks, and self\-improvement built in\.

## Key Features

- Warp Factories as code in factory\.yaml, defining repositories, agents, models, permissions, checkpoints, and triggers\.
- Works with any MCP\-capable coding agent and any model or harness, including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI\.
- Provides API, CLI, SDK, and MCP interfaces for running agents and integrating with workflows\.
- Includes built\-in evals, benchmarks, quality loops, and self\-improvement that scores runs and can open PRs against the factory config\.
- Offers a governance and control plane for centrally configured agent access, permissions, and cost per PR visibility\.
- Includes Warp Terminal and Warp Agent CLI for agentic coding in the terminal and any terminal\.

## Use Cases

- Code review: first\-pass review on every PR\.
- Bug investigation: reproduce bugs and route fixes\.
- Refactors and migration: scope, migrate, and validate changes\.
- Incident response: investigate alerts and summarize next steps\.

## Getting Started

- Download Warp terminal and read the docs for platform\-specific instructions\.
- Request early access to Warp Factories\.
- To build and run Warp from source, run \./script/bootstrap, \./script/run, and \./script/presubmit\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Warp Factories are in closed early access, with usage credits available to qualifying organizations\.
- Warp Factories use usage\-based pricing charged per agent run\.
- Customers can choose where data lives, including a self\-hosted VPC under existing retention and compliance rules\.
- The new agentic management workflows are powered by GPT models, and OpenAI is the founding sponsor of the open\-source Warp repository\.

projects.content:
## Overview

WaterCrawl is a self\-hosted web application built with Python, Django, Scrapy, and Celery\. It combines configurable web crawling and scraping with a search engine, exposed through a REST API and integrations for AI and automation platforms\.

## Key Features

- Advanced web crawling and scraping with configurable depth, speed, and targeted content\.
- Search with basic, advanced, and ultimate depth options\.
- Multi\-language support with country\-specific targeting\.
- Asynchronous processing with real\-time progress via Server\-Sent Events\.
- REST API with OpenAPI documentation and client libraries\.
- Integrations with Dify, N8N, and other AI or automation platforms\.

## Use Cases

- Preparing LLM\-ready data from websites for AI pipelines\.
- Running web research and data collection tasks on self\-hosted infrastructure\.
- Adding web crawling and search into automation workflows through Dify, N8N, or the REST API\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the WaterCrawl repository and enter the project directory\.
- From the docker directory, copy \.env\.example to \.env\.
- Run docker compose up \-d\.
- Open localhost in a browser to access the application\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker is used for the documented quick\-start deployment path\.
- If deploying on a domain or IP other than localhost, update MINIO\_EXTERNAL\_ENDPOINT, MINIO\_BROWSER\_REDIRECT\_URL, and MINIO\_SERVER\_URL in the \.env file\.
- Before production deployment, update the \.env file and set up the database, MinIO, and other required services\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Non\-localhost deployments require MinIO configuration updates, or file uploads and downloads will break\.
- Production deployment requires additional configuration of the environment, database, MinIO, and other services\.
- Security issues should not be posted on GitHub; the project asks users to email support instead\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Wealthfolio is an open\-source personal finance app for tracking investments, net worth, spending, and planning\. It stores financial data locally on your devices and can run as a standalone desktop or mobile app, or be self\-hosted for browser access\.

## Key Features

- Track holdings, performance, allocation, and income across accounts\.
- Monitor net worth including cash, property, crypto, debts, loans, mortgages, and other assets\.
- Categorize spending, set budgets, and review cash flow\.
- Plan financial goals and retirement with a FIRE planner\.
- Use an AI assistant with local or cloud models and connect MCP\-compatible AI tools\.
- Protect privacy with local data storage, optional database encryption, app lock, and separate profiles\.

## Use Cases

- Individual investors tracking portfolios across multiple brokers and banks\.
- Households wanting a private view of net worth, spending, and financial goals\.
- Self\-hosters who want browser access on infrastructure they control\.
- Users exploring AI\-assisted questions about their own financial data with local or cloud models\.

## Getting Started

- Download the free app for macOS, Windows, Linux, iPhone, iPad, or Android\.
- Add accounts manually or import CSV files; no account or sign\-up is required\.
- For self\-hosting, use the provided Docker command or follow the Docker, Docker Compose, Unraid, Proxmox, Coolify, or PikaPods setup guides\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop and mobile installs require macOS 12 or newer, iOS/iPadOS 16 or newer, or Android 7\.0 or newer\.
- Windows uses the evergreen WebView2 runtime; Linux and self\-hosted installations should keep WebKitGTK or their browser updated\.
- Self\-hosted web mode requires a secret key set through WF\_SECRET\_KEY or WF\_SECRET\_KEY\_FILE\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Automatic brokerage syncing is provided through Wealthfolio Connect, an optional subscription\.
- The core app does not require the optional Connect service; manual tracking and CSV import remain free\.
- On macOS 12, users should keep macOS and Safari updated so the system WebView meets the required browser floor\.

projects.content:
## Overview

WebLLM is a high\-performance in\-browser LLM inference engine that brings language model inference directly into web browsers\. It runs entirely in the browser with WebGPU hardware acceleration and no server support, aiming to enable client\-side AI assistants with benefits such as lower cost, personalization, and privacy protection\.

## Key Features

- Runs language model inference directly in web browsers using WebGPU hardware acceleration, with no server\-side processing\.
- Provides full OpenAI API compatibility, including streaming, JSON mode, seeding, and preliminary function calling support\.
- Natively supports model families such as Llama, Phi, Gemma, Mistral, and Qwen, plus custom models in MLC format\.
- Integrates through npm, Yarn, pnpm, or CDN, with modular UI hooks and examples for different use cases\.
- Supports streaming chat completions for real\-time output in chatbots and virtual assistants\.
- Can offload computation to dedicated Web Workers or Service Workers and supports Chrome extension examples\.

## Use Cases

- Building browser\-based chatbots and virtual assistants that generate responses in real time\.
- Creating privacy\-focused personal AI assistants that run models locally in the client\.
- Adding local LLM features to Chrome extensions\.
- Prototyping OpenAI\-compatible web applications with open\-source models\.

## Getting Started

- Install @mlc\-ai/web\-llm with npm, Yarn, or pnpm, or import it from a CDN\.
- Create an MLCEngine using CreateMLCEngine with a supported model such as Llama\-3\.1\-8B\-Instruct\-q4f32\_1\-MLC\.
- Send chat messages through engine\.chat\.completions\.create, and use stream: true for streaming responses\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A browser environment with WebGPU support and sufficient hardware resources for model inference\.
- Model loading requires downloading model files, and the first run can take significant time without a cache\.
- The browser Cache API is the default cache backend; IndexedDB and OPFS are also available, with OPFS requiring OPFS support\.
- The cross\-origin cache backend requires installing and enabling a compatible browser extension\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The hosted demo is intended for research purposes only and is subject to the model licenses for LLaMA, Vicuna, and RedPajama\.
- Initial model loading requires downloading and can take a significant amount of time without cached files, so applications should handle the asynchronous operation\.
- Service worker lifecycles are managed by the browser and can be killed at any time without notifying the web application\.
- The cross\-origin cache backend does not support programmatic tensor\-cache deletion; cache clearing is managed by the extension\.

WeKnora is an open\-source, LLM\-powered knowledge framework from Tencent for enterprise document understanding, semantic retrieval and reasoning\. Version 0\.9\.0 adds the WeKnora assistant, multi\-agent collaboration, automations and execution permissions\.

## Key Features

- RAG question answering with hybrid semantic and keyword retrieval, multimodal embedding for images, citations that jump to the cited passage in the original document, and an image gallery filterable by source, caption and OCR text\.

- Enterprise controls including multi\-workspace RBAC, per\-workspace audit logs, a runtime task\-queue dashboard with worker\-pool governance, and Langfuse tracing for agent steps, token usage and pipelines\.

- Team knowledge Q&A where answers cite the original passage so readers can verify them\.

projects.description: Wenyi is a desktop app for translating books and long-form writing, combining whole-book understanding, consistent terminology, and evidence-based review to carry stories across languages.
projects.descriptionZh: 文译（Wenyi）是一款用于翻译书籍和长篇文本的桌面应用，结合整本书理解、术语一致性和基于证据的审校，帮助作品跨越语言。
projects.content:
## Overview

Wenyi is a local desktop app for translating books and long\-form texts such as novels, social\-science monographs, and narrative nonfiction\. It prescans the whole book, tracks terminology as translation proceeds, and supports polishing and evidence\-based review before export\.

## Key Features

- Desktop workspace for importing books, translating, proofreading, and exporting in one application; packaged releases include the Python engine without separate PostgreSQL, Redis, or Docker setup\.
- Whole\-book prescan creates per\-chapter digests and a book\-level synopsis that are injected into every translation batch\.
- Real\-time glossary extracts proper names, terms, and recurring expressions, detects conflicting translations, and feeds terms into later batches\.
- Multi\-stage workflow includes translation, optional polishing with a strong model, and evidence\-driven whole\-book AI review\.
- Batch checkpoints and chapter status tracking let users reopen a project and resume saved progress\.
- EPUB output writes translated text back into original XHTML templates and attempts to preserve styles, images, table of contents, and anchors; bilingual output is optional\.

## Use Cases

- Translating novels, social\-science monographs, and narrative nonfiction across languages such as Chinese to English or English to Japanese\.
- Producing monolingual or bilingual EPUB editions while attempting to preserve original layout elements\.
- Translating SRT subtitles through a lightweight subtitle workflow without glossary, polishing, or whole\-book review\.
- Converting PDF input with MinerU before translation, with an optional BabelDOC bridge for layout\-preserving PDFs\.

## Getting Started

- With Python 3\.10\+ and uv installed, run uv sync \-\-locked from the repository root\.
- Set DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY to your own DeepSeek key and review config\.yaml before translating\.
- Run uv run wenyi translate book\.epub, or use the Desktop quick start for a graphical app\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- CLI use requires Python 3\.10\+ and uv\.
- Packaged desktop releases include the Python engine and do not require separate Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Docker setup\.
- PDF input defaults to MinerU and requires its API key for initial conversion; the BabelDOC bridge is optional for layout\-preserving PDFs\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Multilingual translation remains experimental, with English prompt instructions and target\-language metadata\.
- Polishing and final review are the most expensive stages\.
- PDF input depends on MinerU and its API key for initial conversion\.
- Translation quality is bounded by the capabilities of the chosen LLM model\.
- Very long books can create large workspaces and increase storage requirements\.

projects.tagline: General-purpose speech recognition model
projects.taglineZh: 通用语音识别模型
projects.description: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model trained on a large dataset of diverse audio. It performs multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.
projects.descriptionZh: Whisper 是一个通用语音识别模型，在大量多样化音频数据上训练，可执行多语言语音识别、语音翻译和语言识别。
projects.content:
## Overview

Whisper is a general\-purpose speech recognition model trained on a large dataset of diverse audio\. It is a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification\. It uses a Transformer sequence\-to\-sequence model trained on various speech processing tasks, including voice activity detection, with tasks represented as token sequences\.

## Key Features

- Multilingual speech recognition
- Speech translation
- Language identification
- Voice activity detection
- Multiple model sizes (tiny to turbo) with speed and accuracy tradeoffs

## Use Cases

- Transcribe speech in audio files using command\-line or Python API
- Translate non\-English speech into English
- Detect spoken language in audio
- Process audio with a sliding 30\-second window for long recordings

## Getting Started

- Install with pip install \-U openai\-whisper\. Requires ffmpeg installed on the system\. For Python usage, load a model with whisper\.load\_model('turbo') and call transcribe on an audio file\. Command\-line usage: whisper audio\.flac \-\-model turbo\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Python 3\.8\-3\.11 and PyTorch\. Requires ffmpeg\. Model sizes have varying VRAM requirements from ~1 GB to ~10 GB\. May require Rust if tiktoken does not provide a pre\-built wheel\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Performance varies widely by language and real\-world speed depends on many factors\.

projects.description: whisper.cpp is a dependency-light C/C++ port of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition model, optimized for high-performance inference across CPUs, Apple Silicon, GPUs, NPUs, and edge platforms.
projects.descriptionZh: whisper.cpp 是 OpenAI Whisper 自动语音识别模型的 C/C++ 移植版，以无依赖、高性能推理为目标，支持 CPU 以及 Apple Silicon、NVIDIA、AMD、Vulkan、OpenVINO、Ascend NPU、Moore Threads 等多种硬件加速后端。
projects.content:
## Overview

whisper\.cpp provides high\-performance inference of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition model in plain C/C\+\+\. It is a lightweight implementation that can be integrated into different platforms and applications, with support for CPU\-only inference and acceleration across Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, Vulkan, OpenVINO, Ascend NPU, Moore Threads, and other targets\.

## Key Features

- Plain C/C\+\+ implementation without dependencies
- Apple Silicon optimization via ARM NEON, Accelerate framework, Metal, and Core ML
- AVX intrinsics for x86, VSX intrinsics for POWER, and mixed F16/F32 precision
- Integer quantization support
- Support for CPU\-only inference and acceleration via CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, OpenVINO, CANN, MUSA, and other backends
- C\-style API and voice activity detection (VAD)

## Use Cases

- On\-device and offline speech recognition on platforms such as iOS, Android, WebAssembly, Raspberry Pi, and desktop OSes
- Real\-time audio input transcription from a microphone
- Building offline voice assistant applications
- Transcribing audio with timestamps, word\-level timestamps, speaker segmentation, and karaoke\-style movie generation

## Getting Started

- Clone the whisper\.cpp repository\.
- Download a Whisper model converted in ggml format, for example by running sh \./models/download\-ggml\-model\.sh base\.en\.
- Build the project with cmake \-B build and cmake \-\-build build \-j \-\-config Release\.
- Transcribe a 16\-bit WAV file with \./build/bin/whisper\-cli \-f samples/jfk\.wav\.
- For a quick demo, run make base\.en\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- CMake is used to build the project\.
- A Whisper model converted to the custom ggml format is required\.
- The whisper\-cli example only accepts 16\-bit WAV files, so input may need conversion with ffmpeg or another tool\.
- Optional acceleration backends have their own dependencies, such as CUDA, Vulkan, ROCm, OpenVINO, CANN, MUSA, Core ML, and ANEForge\.
- Docker images are available for CPU, CUDA, MUSA, and Vulkan configurations\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project supports inference only, not training or fine\-tuning\.
- The whisper\-cli example only accepts 16\-bit WAV files, so users may need to convert input audio before running it\.
- Core ML execution has a slow first run because the ANE service compiles the model to a device\-specific format\.
- OpenVINO execution has a slow first run because the framework compiles the model to a device\-specific blob\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Windhawk is a customization marketplace for Windows and programs\. It provides mods that can be installed with a few clicks and customized through user\-friendly options, with each mod supplied as source code that can be reviewed\.

## Key Features

- Stability and performance are a very high priority, with Windhawk designed to run constantly in the background without a noticeable impact on the system\.
- Mods can be installed with just a couple of clicks and customized through user\-friendly options, without requiring computer expertise\.
- Each mod is provided as source code that can be reviewed to confirm it does exactly what it says\.
- Featured mods cover taskbar clock customization, Windows 11 Start menu styling, taskbar auto\-hide behavior, taskbar height and icon size, and middle\-click taskbar actions\.

## Use Cases

- Customize the taskbar clock with date/time formats, weather, performance metrics, media player information, custom fonts, and colors\.
- Style the Windows 11 Start menu using themes contributed by others or create your own\.
- Make the taskbar auto\-hide only when a window is maximized or intersects the taskbar\.
- Adjust taskbar height and icon size, improve icon quality on Windows 11, and close programs with a middle click on the taskbar\.

## Getting Started

- Download Windhawk from the official site and browse the mod marketplace to find mods\.
- To modify Windhawk source code, extract the portable version with the official installer, build the part you want to modify, and replace the corresponding files in the portable version with the newly built files\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Windows

## Before You Adopt

- License: GPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

WordCraft is an open\-source, clean\-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word built in pure Rust\. It is a native word processor with the familiar ribbon workflow, styles, tables, track changes, references and mail merge, and it reads and writes \.docx\.

## Key Features

- Familiar ribbon interface with tabs, groups, keyboard shortcuts and a live Styles gallery\.
- Reads and writes \.docx natively, imports and exports \.odt, \.rtf, \.html, \.md and \.txt, and exports PDF with selectable text\.
- Cached paragraph layout and on\-demand page rendering keep large documents responsive\.
- Track changes, margin comment balloons, accept/reject review, document comparison, and offline spelling and grammar\.
- References support including tables of contents, footnotes, citations and bibliographies in APA, MLA, Chicago and IEEE styles, indexes and captions\.
- Command\-driven automation through a command\-line tool, JSON control channel and MCP server\.

## Use Cases

- Writing and editing \.docx documents in a Word\-like native application\.
- Producing academic and business documents with citations, bibliographies, footnotes and tables of contents\.
- Reviewing documents with track changes, comments and document comparison\.
- Automating document inspection, conversion and editing through CLI and MCP workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Download a standalone build for macOS, Windows, Linux or Web, or use the ArtCraft Launcher\.
- To build from source, install Rust 1\.90 or newer, clone the repository, change into the wordcraft directory, and run cargo run \-\-release \-p wordcraft\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and BSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly\.
- Build from source requires Rust 1\.90 or newer\.
- Linux builds are available as Flatpak, AppImage, Debian package, RPM package and tarball\.
- A web build is available to host yourself\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project page lists WordCraft as in development\.

projects.description: Worktrunk is a Rust CLI that makes Git worktrees as easy as branches for parallel AI agent workflows. It provides switch, list, merge, and remove commands plus hooks, LLM commit messages, and build cache sharing.
projects.descriptionZh: Worktrunk 是用于 Git worktree 管理的 Rust CLI，面向并行 AI 代理工作流。它让 worktree 像分支一样易用，提供 switch、list、merge、remove 等核心命令，并支持钩子、LLM 提交信息与构建缓存共享。
projects.content:
## Overview

Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management designed for parallel AI agent workflows\. It makes worktrees as easy as branches: worktrees are addressed by branch name, paths are computed from a configurable template, and commands that take a branch also accept the path of the worktree it is checked out in\. It includes core commands plus quality\-of\-life features for working with many parallel changes\.

## Key Features

- Core commands make worktrees as easy as branches: wt switch, wt list, wt merge, and wt remove\.
- Hooks run commands on create, pre\-merge, post\-merge, and other workflow points\.
- LLM commit messages generate commit messages from diffs\.
- The merge workflow can squash, rebase, merge, and clean up in one command\.
- The interactive picker browses worktrees with streaming CI status, diff, log, PR, and comment previews\.
- Copy\-on\-write build caches let multiple worktrees share target, node\_modules, and similar directories on APFS, btrfs, and XFS\.

## Use Cases

- Running multiple AI coding agents in parallel on the same repository, each in its own Git worktree\.
- Creating a branch and worktree and launching Claude in one command with wt switch \-c \-x claude feat\.
- Checking status across worktrees with wt list and cleaning up a worktree and branch with wt remove\.
- Following either a PR workflow or a local merge workflow, then cleaning up\.

## Getting Started

- Install with Homebrew on macOS or Linux using brew install worktrunk, then run wt config shell install\.
- Alternatively install with Cargo using cargo install worktrunk, then run wt config shell install\.
- Create and switch to a new feature worktree with wt switch \-\-create feature\-auth\.
- List worktrees with wt list; remove a completed worktree with wt remove\.
- For parallel agents, use wt switch \-x claude \-c feature\-a \-\- 'Add user authentication'\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supported installation paths include Homebrew on macOS and Linux, Cargo, Arch Linux pacman, Conda or Pixi, and Winget on Windows\.
- On Windows, Winget installs Worktrunk as git\-wt because wt conflicts with Windows Terminal’s command\.
- Shell integration is installed with wt config shell install and is needed for commands that change directories\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Worktrunk relies on shell integration for commands that change directories\.
- Copy\-on\-write build cache sharing is documented for APFS, btrfs, and XFS filesystems, so other filesystems may not get the same no\-build, no\-copy behavior\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Worktrunk 是面向并行 AI 代理工作流的 Git worktree 管理 CLI。它让 worktree 像分支一样易用：worktree 以分支名寻址，路径由可配置模板计算，接受分支的命令也接受该 worktree 的检出路径。它包含核心命令，以及用于简化大量并行变更的便利功能。

## 核心功能

- 核心命令让 worktree 像分支一样易用：wt switch、wt list、wt merge 和 wt remove。
- 钩子可在创建、合并前、合并后等工作流节点运行命令。
- LLM 提交信息可根据差异生成提交信息。
- 合并工作流可用一条命令完成压缩、变基、合并和清理。
- 交互式选择器可浏览 worktree，并查看流式 CI 状态、差异、日志、PR 和评论预览。
- 写时复制构建缓存让多个 worktree 在 APFS、btrfs 和 XFS 上共享 target、node\_modules 等目录，无需构建或复制。

## 适用场景

- 在同一仓库上并行运行多个 AI 编码代理，每个代理使用自己的 Git worktree。
- 用 wt switch \-c \-x claude feat 一条命令创建分支和 worktree 并启动 Claude。
- 用 wt list 查看各 worktree 状态，并用 wt remove 清理 worktree 和分支。
- 按 PR 工作流或本地合并工作流完成后进行清理。

## 快速开始

- 在 macOS 或 Linux 上用 Homebrew 安装：brew install worktrunk，然后运行 wt config shell install。
- 也可用 Cargo 安装：cargo install worktrunk，然后运行 wt config shell install。
- 用 wt switch \-\-create feature\-auth 创建并切换到新的功能 worktree。
- 用 wt list 列出 worktree；完成后用 wt remove 移除 worktree。
- 并行代理可使用 wt switch \-x claude \-c feature\-a \-\- 'Add user authentication'。

## 部署与要求

- 支持的安装方式包括 macOS 和 Linux 上的 Homebrew、Cargo、Arch Linux pacman、Conda 或 Pixi，以及 Windows 上的 Winget。
- 在 Windows 上，Winget 将 Worktrunk 安装为 git\-wt，因为 wt 与 Windows Terminal 的命令冲突。
- 通过 wt config shell install 安装 shell 集成；改变目录的命令需要 shell 集成。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Other。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

World Monitor is a free, open\-source (AGPL\-3\.0) real\-time global intelligence dashboard\. It streams 468 news and OSINT feeds from 815 attributed providers onto one live world map with 59 map layer types spanning geopolitics, markets, shipping, aviation, and cyber\. It correlates signals so converging events can surface before headlines, and it cites sources and documents methods\.

## Key Features

- Live world map with 59 map layer types spanning geopolitics, markets, shipping, aviation, cyber, weather, infrastructure, and country risk\.
- 468 news and OSINT feeds from 815 attributed providers, with sources cited on every panel\.
- Correlation engine that places multiple signal types on one surface so converging events can be seen together\.
- Country dossiers with instability scores, cited AI briefs, active map signals, and a 7\-day timeline\.
- Tracking for 13 maritime chokepoints with live AIS vessel counts, week\-over\-week transit change, and disruption scoring\.
- Developer access through a documented REST API, 100 MCP tools, and official SDKs for npm, PyPI, RubyGems, and Go\.

## Use Cases

- Verify a breaking event with current crisis trackers, dated metrics, and cited context before trusting a claim\.
- Check a maritime chokepoint for disruption status, vessel flows, and risk across critical passages\.
- Explain a country\-risk move by tracing political, security, economic, and resilience signals\.
- Monitor markets, commodities, AI infrastructure, or subsea cables through dedicated lenses\.

## Getting Started

- Open worldmonitor\.app/dashboard in any browser; the free dashboard requires no account\.
- Click any country to open its dossier, or press Cmd\-K / Ctrl\-K to use the command palette\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The free plan excludes the Resilience map layer and curated feeds, while Pro adds decision\-layer features\.
- MCP access requires a Pro subscription starting at $39\.99 per month\.
- Self\-hosted Docker deployments operate on their own data rather than Pro cloud data\.
- The dashboard depends on 815 attributed external providers for its feeds and datasets\.
- The free dashboard requires no account, and the site states there is no user data to sell\.

projects.name: XERJ
projects.tagline: Search built for AI agents.
projects.taglineZh: 为 AI 智能体打造的搜索
projects.description: XERJ is an AI-native search engine that indexes code, documents, and data, then answers agent questions from the index instead of the context window. It speaks the Elasticsearch API and ships as one Rust binary.
projects.descriptionZh: XERJ 是 AI 原生搜索引擎，为代码、文档和数据建立索引，随后由索引而非上下文窗口回答智能体的提问。它兼容 Elasticsearch API，现有客户端无需改动即可连接，并以单个 Rust 二进制文件形式发布。
projects.content:
## Overview

XERJ is an AI\-native search engine that indexes code, documents, and data, then answers agent questions from the index instead of the context window\. It speaks the Elasticsearch API and ships as one Rust binary\.

## Key Features

- One Rust binary with no JVM, Apache\-2\.0 licensed, running from laptop to server with the same artifact\.
- Autoindex sniffs 13 format families by content, infers mappings, records junk instead of crashing, and resumes idempotent ingest\.
- AST code search parses source with tree\-sitter across 36 languages into symbols, kinds, line numbers, and searchable definitions\.
- Hybrid search supports 50 query types, including native BM25 and kNN fusion in one query tree\.
- Elasticsearch API compatibility with 1,366 of 1,369 wire\-conformance cases green on every commit\.
- Agent memory and graph features provide namespaced /\_memory REST APIs and a /\_graph knowledge layer with evidence on every link\.

## Use Cases

- Reference coding: clone and index open\-source repos closest to a task, then retrieve how they solved a problem before writing code\.
- Codebase Q&A and RAG: index a repo and get the mechanism with file line details instead of a directory listing\.
- Security audits: index a target tree and query for sink patterns, secrets, and dangerous calls across every file type at once\.
- Agent long\-term memory: store what an agent learns and recall it by meaning in later sessions\.

## Getting Started

- Install XERJ with the one\-line installer\.
- Start a node with xerj \-\-insecure \-\-data\-dir \./data & for local development\.
- Run xerj autoindex ~/my\-project to index a folder by content\.
- Use xerj search for ranked passages and xerj def for go\-to\-definition results\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Prebuilt for Linux, macOS, and Windows on x86\-64 and arm64\.
- Static musl by default, so it can run on any distro including Alpine\.
- No JVM and no dependencies; the same static binary runs from laptop to server\.
- Auth is on by default unless \-\-insecure is used; autoindex needs \-\-api\-key or XERJ\_API\_KEY when auth is enabled\.
- The default lexical embedder is offline; neural mode needs three model files staged locally before the first semantic operation\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The built\-in embedder is lexical rather than neural, so semantic retrieval is based on vocabulary overlap, not neural understanding\.
- Neural embedding mode requires staging three model files locally before semantic operations\.
- Reference coding can be neutral or harmful on popular public libraries the model already knows\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

XERJ 是一个 AI 原生搜索引擎，为代码、文档和数据建立索引，随后由索引而非上下文窗口回答智能体的提问。它使用 Elasticsearch API，并以单个 Rust 二进制文件的形式发布。

## 核心功能

- 单个 Rust 二进制，无 JVM，Apache\-2\.0 许可，同一构件从笔记本到服务器通用。
- autoindex 按内容嗅探 13 种格式家族，推断映射，把无用文件记录下来而不是报错，并支持可断点续传的幂等导入。
- AST 代码搜索使用 tree\-sitter 解析 36 种语言的源码，提取符号、类型、行号和可搜索的定义字段。
- 混合检索支持 50 种查询类型，包括在单个查询树中融合原生 BM25 与 kNN。
- 兼容 Elasticsearch API，每次提交有 1,366 / 1,369 条 wire 一致性用例通过。
- 智能体记忆与图谱：带命名空间的 /\_memory REST API，以及每条链接都带证据的 /\_graph 知识层。

## 适用场景

- 参考编码：克隆并索引与任务最接近的开源仓库，在写代码前检索它们如何解决该问题。
- 代码库问答与 RAG：为仓库建立索引，得到含 file:line 的机制说明，而不是目录列表。
- 安全审计：为目标代码树建立索引，一次跨所有文件类型查询 sink 模式、密钥和危险调用。
- 智能体长期记忆：存储智能体学到的东西，并在之后的会话中按语义召回。

## 快速开始

- 使用一行安装命令安装 XERJ。
- 本地开发时用 xerj \-\-insecure \-\-data\-dir \./data & 启动节点。
- 运行 xerj autoindex ~/my\-project 按内容为文件夹建立索引。
- 用 xerj search 获取排序后的段落，用 xerj def 获取定义位置。

## 部署与要求

- 提供 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 的 x86\-64 与 arm64 预编译版本。
- 默认使用静态 musl，因此可运行于包括 Alpine 在内的任何发行版。
- 无 JVM、无依赖；同一个静态二进制可从笔记本运行到服务器。
- 除使用 \-\-insecure 外默认开启鉴权；启用鉴权时 autoindex 需要 \-\-api\-key 或 XERJ\_API\_KEY。
- 默认的词法嵌入器离线工作；神经模式需要在首次语义操作前把三个模型文件放到本地。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: xnulinux
projects.tagline: Run macOS userspace on Linux without a hypervisor
projects.taglineZh: 在 arm64 Linux 上无需虚拟机管理程序运行 macOS 桌面
projects.description: xnulinux builds Apple's open-source XNU kernel and runs it as a loadable module inside an unmodified arm64 Linux kernel, letting macOS userspace run alongside Linux processes without a hypervisor.
projects.descriptionZh: xnulinux 从 Apple 公开源码构建 XNU，并作为 xnu.ko 加载到未修改的 arm64 Linux 内核中；配套 fki.ko 提供 CPU、内存、定时器、文件、网络和 GPU 访问，使 macOS 用户态与 Linux 进程在同一批 CPU 上原生运行，无需 hypervisor。
projects.content:
## Overview

xnulinux builds XNU, the open\-source kernel of macOS, from Apple's published sources and runs it as xnu\.ko inside an unmodified arm64 Linux kernel\. A companion fki\.ko module provides CPUs, memory, timers, files, network, and GPU access\. With a stock Ubuntu kernel, insmod xnu\.ko boots a macOS 27 system disk made by Apple's installer to the desktop, with macOS processes running natively alongside Linux processes on the same CPUs\.

## Key Features

- XNU runs as xnu\.ko inside an unmodified arm64 Linux kernel, with no hypervisor between hosted macOS and Linux\.
- fki\.ko supplies the foreign kernel interface for CPUs, memory, faults, IPIs, files, network, and host calls\.
- macOS processes and Linux processes run natively on the same CPUs; each hosted CPU is a Linux kernel thread pinned to a Linux CPU\.
- Devices are provided through kexts for disk, display, keyboard and pointer, Ethernet, keystore, and a GPU bridge\.
- Metal support can use gpu/xnu\-cpu\-metal over Vulkan and a DRM bridge, with CPU rendering as fallback when no supported DRM backend is present\.
- Runs on stock distro kernels, demonstrated with Ubuntu and on an NVIDIA DGX Spark\.

## Use Cases

- Running a macOS 27 desktop and macOS applications on an arm64 Linux host without a hypervisor\.
- Studying or experimenting with two kernels sharing CPUs, memory, faults, and devices through a foreign kernel interface\.
- Exploring kernel internals, MMU behavior, and device handoff between XNU and Linux\.
- Using a hosted macOS system alongside Linux processes, such as an SSH session from hosted macOS into the underlying Linux\.

## Getting Started

- On the arm64 Linux host, run scripts/vm\-xnu\-build\.sh once to set up the toolchain and build XNU xnu\-12377\.121\.6 natively\.
- Run scripts/vm\-xnu\-rebuild\.sh to apply xnu\-patches, build the kernel and kexts, and link the kernel collection with Apple's kexts from your macOS installation\.
- On the Mac, run scripts/mk\-macvm\-disk\.sh to turn a macOS VM disk made by Apple's installer into the hosted system disk and copy it into the Linux VM\.
- On the arm64 Linux host, run scripts/xnulinux\-boot\.sh to build fki\.ko and xnu\.ko against the running kernel, bring up networking and the optional GPU bridge, and boot the hosted system\.
- Optionally run scripts/install\-service\.sh to run it as xnulinux\.service configured in /etc/xnulinux\.conf; on the Mac, scripts/install\-krun\-agent\.sh keeps the VM running\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- An arm64 Linux host with PAC (FEAT\_PAuth), 4K pages, and at least 16 GB of RAM, with 8 GB reserved for the hosted kernel\.
- A Mac with Xcode to make the system disk and build the GPU parts\.
- A macOS 27 installation from an Apple Virtualization VM disk of your own; no Apple binaries are included or distributed by the repository\.
- Tested on NVIDIA DGX Spark bare\-metal Ubuntu 24\.04\.5 LTS aarch64 with Linux 7\.0\.0\-1025\-nvidia, and on an Apple Silicon Mac M1 or later running an arm64 Linux VM via krunkit or tart\.
- For bare\-metal hosts, set the carve\-out (mem=, carve\_base=, carve\_mb=) and set GPU=off because xnudrmd supports only virtio\-gpu for now\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project is explicitly experimental and systems\-level\.
- The working configurations are described as narrow, with two arm64 Linux setups demonstrated\.
- The Apple kexts, macOS system disk, and trust cache must come from the user's own installation\.
- The module is reported as non\-GPL, which taints the Linux kernel as ZFS does\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

xnulinux 从 Apple 公布的源码构建 XNU——macOS 的开源内核——并将其作为 xnu\.ko 载入未经修改的 arm64 Linux 内核。配套的 fki\.ko 模块为 XNU 提供 CPU、内存、定时器、文件、网络和 GPU 访问。使用发行版自带的 Ubuntu 内核时，insmod xnu\.ko 可把由 Apple 安装器制作的 macOS 27 系统盘启动到桌面，macOS 进程与 Linux 进程在同一批 CPU 上原生并列运行。

## 核心功能

- XNU 以 xnu\.ko 运行在未修改的 arm64 Linux 内核中，托管的 macOS 与 Linux 之间没有 hypervisor。
- fki\.ko 提供外部内核接口，覆盖 CPU、内存、缺页与用户异常转发、IPI、文件、网络和主机调用。
- macOS 进程与 Linux 进程在同一批 CPU 上原生运行；每个托管 CPU 都是绑定到某个 Linux CPU 的 Linux 内核线程。
- 设备通过 kexts 提供，包括磁盘、显示、键盘与指针、以太网、密钥存储和 GPU 桥。
- Metal 可经 gpu/xnu\-cpu\-metal 走 Vulkan 和 DRM 桥；没有受支持的 DRM 后端时回退到 CPU 渲染。
- 可在发行版自带内核上运行，已在 Ubuntu 和 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上演示。

## 适用场景

- 在 arm64 Linux 主机上运行 macOS 27 桌面和 macOS 应用，无需 hypervisor。
- 研究或实验两个内核如何通过外部内核接口共享 CPU、内存、缺页和设备。
- 探索内核内部、MMU 行为以及 XNU 与 Linux 之间的设备交接。
- 让托管的 macOS 与 Linux 进程并存，例如从托管 macOS 通过 SSH 连接到其下运行的 Linux。

## 快速开始

- 在 arm64 Linux 主机上运行 scripts/vm\-xnu\-build\.sh 一次，设置 macOS\-DroidVM Linux 工具链并在 arm64 上原生构建 XNU（xnu\-12377\.121\.6）。运行 scripts/vm\-xnu\-rebuild\.sh 应用 xnu\-patches、构建内核与 kexts，并用你 macOS 安装中的 Apple kexts 链接内核集合。在 Mac 上运行 scripts/mk\-macvm\-disk\.sh，把 Apple 安装器制作的 macOS VM 磁盘转换为托管系统磁盘并复制到 Linux

## 部署与要求

- 需要带 PAC（FEAT\_PAuth）、4K 页且至少 16 GB 内存的 arm64 Linux 主机，其中 8 GB 预留给托管内核。需要一台装有 Xcode 的 Mac 来制作系统盘并构建 GPU 相关部分。需要你自己的 macOS 27 安装（Apple Virtualization VM 磁盘）；仓库不包含也不分发任何 Apple 二进制。已在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 的裸机 Ubuntu 24\.04\.5 LTS aarch64（Linux 7\.0\.0\-1025\-nvidia）以及 Apple Silicon M1 或更新机型上通过

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Other。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.description: Yogurt is a free, open source AI meeting notes app that records your microphone and computer audio without joining calls as a bot, then transcribes and summarizes locally so recordings, transcripts, and notes stay on your computer.
projects.descriptionZh: Yogurt 是一款免费开源的 AI 会议笔记桌面应用，不添加机器人加入通话，而是录制麦克风与电脑音频，并在本地完成转写和总结，让录音、转写和笔记留在你的电脑上。
projects.content:
## Overview

Yogurt is a desktop app for private AI meeting notes\. It records your microphone and the audio playing on your computer, transcribes calls, and creates summaries and answers using local models\. It is free and open source and does not need an account\.

## Key Features

- Live transcription turns speech into text as you talk\.
- Meeting summaries combine the conversation with notes you add\.
- Local AI processing keeps audio, transcripts, and notes on your computer\.
- Yogurt records microphone and system audio without a bot joining the call\.
- Ask questions across meetings and get answers with source transcripts\.
- Multi\-language mode supports transcription of 99 languages\.

## Use Cases

- Capture private notes and summaries from customer calls, planning meetings, and other online conversations\.
- Review what was discussed by searching meetings by folder, title, notes, or transcript\.
- Ask follow\-up questions about prior meetings and jump back to the supporting transcript\.
- Use a local MCP server to let a chosen assistant read notes when access is explicitly allowed\.

## Getting Started

- Download Yogurt for Mac, Windows, or Linux from the official releases\.
- Complete setup, which downloads local AI models; recording works once setup finishes\.
- Start recording your microphone and call audio, add notes as needed, then review the transcript and summary\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 14\.4 or newer, a 64\-bit PC with Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, or a 64\-bit Linux computer with Ubuntu 22\.04 or newer\.
- At least 8 GB of memory\.
- After a one\-time model download, transcription and summaries run locally; model downloads and update checks require going online\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Yogurt does not join meetings as a visible bot, so users should let other participants know they are recording\.
- MCP access is off by default and read\-only; when enabled, apps can read meetings, notes, and transcripts and may send what they read to their own online model\.
- Meeting data stays local, but Yogurt goes online for model downloads and update checks\.
- Windows may display a protection warning because the app is not signed with a Microsoft certificate yet\.
- MCP has no per\-app token, so any app running under your account can read while access is on\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Yuvomi is a self\-hosted family planner built as a single container and PWA\. It brings tasks, calendar, budget, meals, recipes, shopping, documents, health and other household modules into one place, with data stored in one SQLite file\.

## Key Features

- Tasks with Kanban boards, deadlines, recurring chores and multi\-assignment\.
- Calendar with sync, subscriptions and per\-event visibility\.
- Weekly meal planning with recipes and export to a shared shopping list sorted by aisle\.
- Shared shopping lists and pantry tracking with amounts, locations and best\-before dates\.
- Budget tracking for income, expenses, accounts, savings goals and shared costs with debt simplification\.
- Document management for searchable family files, plus 20 modules, 27 languages and zero trackers\.

## Use Cases

- Households, couples or solo users who want shared life organized in one self\-hosted place\.
- Families replacing separate subscription apps for tasks, calendars, groceries, budgets and receipts\.
- Home server or NAS owners who want a PWA reachable from phones and a kitchen tablet\.
- Privacy\-conscious users who want family data kept on their own disk\.

## Getting Started

- Use the published container image ghcr\.io/ulsklyc/yuvomi:latest or the repository's docker\-compose\.yml, set SESSION\_SECRET and DB\_ENCRYPTION\_KEY in the \.env file, run docker compose up \-d, then open the app on port 3000 and create the admin account\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs as a container on Docker or Podman, or through supported NAS and home\-lab platforms such as TrueNAS SCALE, Umbrel, Unraid, Home Assistant, YunoHost or Proxmox\.
- Image supports amd64 and arm64, uses one port by default 3000, and lists 256 MB RAM minimum\.
- Data is one SQLite file at /data/yuvomi\.db, with volumes for data, backups, modules and documents\.
- Push notifications require HTTPS; browsers include Chrome and Edge 105, Firefox 115, Safari 15\.4 and iOS 15\.4 or newer\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Health module handles sensitive data and is not a medical device; the source recommends enabling database encryption\.
- The project has 20 modules, creating broad surface area; users should verify that the modules they need are mature enough for their use\.

projects.content:
## Overview

ZCode is an AI coding workbench from Z\.ai that provides desktop, browser, and terminal Agent experiences\. It is designed for vibe coding and complex goals, with multiple agents, long\-running task management through Goals, and remote control from messaging platforms\.

## Key Features

- Long\-running tasks: Goals supports continuous planning, execution, and verification for complex work\.
- Bot control: start and steer ZCode from WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram so work can continue anywhere\.
- Deep GLM\-5\.3 integration: optimized for reasoning, coding, and multi\-agent collaboration, with GLM\-5\.3\-Flash built in for multimodal tasks such as screenshot understanding and image analysis\.
- Multiple surfaces: desktop application, browser interface, and terminal Agent, plus a CLI distribution that can run TUI or Web modes\.
- UI Plugin development support, including examples such as Excalidraw canvas collaboration\.
- Shared UI, services, server, RPC, and client SDK packages organized in the repository\.

## Use Cases

- Managing complex coding goals with continuous planning, execution, and verification\.
- Steering development work remotely from WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram\.
- Using a terminal or browser interface without Electron for local Agent and Web workflows\.
- Building and testing UI plugins from provided examples and host integration entry points\.

## Getting Started

- Download ZCode installers for macOS, Windows, or Linux from the all\-downloads section, or read the documentation\.
- For source development, prepare Git, Node\.js 24\.14\.0, and pnpm 10\.33\.2, then run pnpm bootstrap in the repository root\.
- Run pnpm dev:desktop to start the desktop development workflow\.
- Run zcode for the terminal interface, or zcode \-\-web to start the Web interface\.
- Run pnpm dev:web to start the Web development server and backend together\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop installers are available for macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Windows 64\-bit, Windows ARM64, Linux x64, and Linux ARM64\.
- Source development requires Git, Node\.js 24\.14\.0, and pnpm 10\.33\.2, with versions defined by mise\.toml\.
- The CLI distribution still requires Node\.js, with the version defined by mise\.toml\.
- Web mode listens on 127\.0\.0\.1 by default, auto\-selects a free port, and can bind to other hosts with \-\-host\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Linux x64 downloads are labeled Beta in the source\.
- GLM Coding Plan prices and benefits may change, with final details shown on z\.ai\.
- Old Lite users need to switch to the new build commands, environment variables, and install script; new installation does not delete old Lite directories or migrate or delete existing session data\.

projects.content:
## Overview

ZeroLeaks provides security testing for AI agents and LLM system prompts\. Its hosted product continuously red\-teams agents through tools, memory, credentials, MCP servers, permissions, and connected agents, while the source\-available CLI and TypeScript library test standalone system prompts for extraction and injection vulnerabilities\.

## Key Features

- Hosted continuous red teaming tests agents on every change, including tools, memory, MCP servers, permissions, and connected agents\.
- Automated CI/CD scans can start from a pipeline through the REST API or SDK and gate releases on the returned score\.
- Each finding is ranked by severity and includes attack evidence, affected behavior, and remediation; the next scan reruns the attack to confirm the fix\.
- Shield flags prompt injection in user messages, retrieved documents, and tool results with one API call\.
- The open\-source CLI and TypeScript library run extraction and injection scans on a system prompt using selected model providers\.
- The probe library draws on published attacks and sources, with an injection corpus split across extraction, tool hijacking, indirect injection, authority abuse, multi\-turn grooming, and protocol exploits\.

## Use Cases

- Security teams red\-teaming deployed AI agents before launch and on every change\.
- Developers testing standalone system prompts for prompt extraction and injection vulnerabilities\.
- Teams adding automated security gates to CI/CD pipelines for agent releases\.
- Applications checking user messages, retrieved documents, and tool results for prompt injection with Shield\.

## Getting Started

- For hosted use, start a 14\-day trial or link an agent endpoint and run a scan from the dashboard\.
- For the open\-source scanner, install with npm install zeroleaks or bun add zeroleaks\.
- Set OPENROUTER\_API\_KEY or another supported provider configuration, then run zeroleaks scan \-\-prompt followed by the system prompt\.
- Programmatic use can call runSecurityScan with a system prompt and model options\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The open\-source scanner requires at least one model\-provider key or an OpenAI\-compatible base URL for a local server\.
- Hosted agent scans target a configured HTTP endpoint or run through your own agent code with the SDK\.
- Enterprise plans offer a dedicated private\-cloud deployment; other plans are hosted\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Running the open\-source scanner requires configuring model\-provider credentials or an OpenAI\-compatible local endpoint\.
- The hosted API no longer runs standalone prompt scans; that capability is handled by the CLI package\.
- The hosted service retains certain conversation logs, tool logs, skill archives, and runtime\-scan instructions for up to 365 days, or less on higher plans\.
- Shield request logs normally store metadata rather than request text, with a redacted excerpt only when the free Shield model flags a request on a free plan\.
